title: Corporate-Family Resolution Is Not a String-Matching Problem: A Public Benchmark Stratified by Name Visibility
comment: 21 pages, 8 tables. Benchmark, full adjudication log, and code reproducing every number: this https URL
summary: Deciding whether two supplier records belong to the same corporate family is a prerequisite for spend consolidation, credit exposure aggregation and sanctions screening. It is usually treated as entity matching, but the tasks differ: a family link connects records that are deliberately different entities, and the evidence often appears in neither record. We introduce CorpFam, a public benchmark of 54,864 candidate pairs over 10,307 corporate families, derived from 6,638,350 US federal award records in which every supplier self-reports its ultimate parent to a government registry. Pairs are stratified by name visibility: whether the names are identical after normalisation, share a distinctive token, or share none. Because strata have positive rates from 10.2% to 97.3%, we report per-stratum recall, base-rate invariant, rather than F1, which is not. The strongest of 5 matchers recovers 100.0% of identical pairs and 4.2% of invisible ones; no method exceeds 4.7% on the latter. The failure begins before matching. Blocking decides which pairs a matcher sees, and we evaluate 7 schemes spanning phonetic keys, attribute keys that ignore the name, and semantic nearest neighbours. None reaches three percent on invisible pairs, and their union recovers 6.8%. 93.2% of these links never enter the candidate set, so no matching-stage improvement can reach them. The links are real: against SEC Exhibit 21 subsidiary schedules, which share no provenance with procurement registration, 64.2% of invisible links are corroborated, against 0.16% under permuted parents and 0.41% against the same parent's wrong exhibit: two unrelated nulls agreeing to within 0.25 points. Corporate-family resolution is a retrieval problem misfiled as a matching problem; the intervention point is candidate generation, not ranking. The benchmark, adjudication log, and code reproducing every number are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出企业家族识别（corporate-family resolution）应作为检索问题而非实体匹配问题。作者发布了CorpFam基准（54,864对，10,307个家族），按"名称可见性"（identical/visible/invisible）分层评估。核心发现：93.2%的"不可见"关联在候选生成阶段就已丢失，匹配器根本看不到它们；最强匹配器在invisible层召回率仅4.2%。通过SEC Exhibit 21独立验证，64.2%的invisible关联为真实关联。结论是干预点应在候选生成阶段而非排序阶段。
AI.motivation: 企业家族识别对支出整合、信贷风险合并、受益所有权审查和制裁筛查至关重要，但该任务被错误地归类为实体匹配（entity matching）。实体匹配判断两个记录是否指向同一实体，而家族关联连接的是明确不同的法律实体，且证据常不出现在任一记录中。基于名称相似性的匹配方法无法解决这一本质差异，导致商业价值最高的关联恰恰落在方法的盲区。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：美国联邦合同授予数据（FY2025），6,638,350条记录，每个供应商自报终极母公司UEI。去除自报自身为父实体的"自我父陷阱"后，获得14,288条真实关联。2. 按名称可见性三层分层：Identical（名称归一化后相同）、Visible（共享至少一个区分性token）、Invisible（无共享区分性token）。3. 评估5种匹配器、7种阻塞方案（含token、q-gram、sorted-neighbourhood、Soundex、属性键、嵌入近邻）。4. 独立验证：SEC Exhibit 21子公司清单（与采购注册无共同来源），设置两个无关零条件（置换父实体、正确父实体的错误Exhibit）。5. 家族级聚类评估，区分阻塞条件与oracle条件。
AI.result: 匹配阶段：最强匹配器TF-IDF char 3-gram在invisible层召回率仅4.2%（95% CI [2.9, 6.1]），MiniLM嵌入4.7%，无一方法超过4.7%。阻塞阶段：所有方案union后在invisible层仅恢复6.8%，93.2%的invisible链接从未进入候选集。嵌入近邻（2.89%）和属性键（2.39%）作为非名称函数也未能突破。SEC验证：invisible层64.2%被Exhibit 21确认，而置换父实体0.16%、正确父实体的错误Exhibit仅0.41%，两个零条件相差0.25点。家族级聚类：移除阻塞反而降低精确家族恢复率（16.6%→14.9%），表明更多候选引入虚假链接经传递性合并不同家族。94.1%的父实体从未作为受款人出现，无地址可比较。
AI.conclusion: 企业家族识别被错误归类为匹配问题，实为检索问题。标准流水线的失败发生在阻塞（候选生成）阶段而非匹配阶段。名称相似性方法无法捕获名称无关联的真实企业关系（如Blue Aerospace LLC与Heico Corp），且这类关联因公司治理结构（母公司常为无运营场所的控股实体）而缺乏属性证据。需报告按难度分层的指标而非聚合指标；干预应集中在候选生成阶段，通过引入外部所有权文件作为证据来重构问题。

title: A Semantic Model of Genetic Evidence: A Step Toward Bridging the Basic-Science-Clinic Gap
comment: 16 pages; supplementary material (32 pages) included in this submission. Schema, annotations, and code: this https URL (archived at this https URL )
summary: Scientific and clinical decision-making depends on evidence from the primary literature, but existing standards for representing that evidence (FHIR Evidence, ECO, SEPIO, and the GA4GH Genomic Knowledge Standards) are oriented toward clinical-trial workflows, evidence codes, or single-variant assertions, and do not capture the fine-grained, domain-specific structure of claims in basic and pre-clinical research. We introduce a semantic model for scientific evidence with three core classes, specialize it for genetics, align it structurally to FHIR Evidence with a SEPIO-anchored credibility decomposition, and attach a compact dimensional vocabulary whose conditional-activation rules are validated by a SHACL schema for the implemented constraints. Using clinical variant interpretation as the driving use case, we evaluate the model through a human-AI annotation pilot over six genetics papers, yielding 28 evidence items and 95 source-anchored assertions, with a workflow that keeps curator-authored reference annotations distinct from AI-drafted annotations. Treating the pilot as a feasibility study rather than a benchmark, we argue that the model is a useful increment toward trustworthy, AI-ready infrastructure for variant interpretation: a reference data model and validation schema for representing genetic evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于表示遗传证据的语义模型(GEM),包含三个核心类(ScientificEvidence、EvidenceVariable、EvidenceAssertion),通过约20个维度的词汇表描述遗传证据条目,并采用条件激活机制(SHACL约束)使词汇保持紧凑。该模型在结构上与FHIR Evidence对齐,使用SEPIO锚定可信度分解,并通过6篇遗传学论文的人类-AI协作标注试点进行可行性评估,产出28条证据条目和95条源锚定断言。
AI.motivation: 现有的证据表示标准(FHIR Evidence、ECO、SEPIO、GA4GH基因组知识标准)主要面向临床试验工作流、证据编码或单变异断言,无法捕捉基础和临床前研究中声明的细粒度、领域特定结构。这在将实验室研究成果转化为临床应用时造成了基础科学-临床差距。遗传证据涉及从实验模型系统到大规模人群研究的多样化语境,需要专门的结构化表示来支持自动化推理和AI就绪的基础设施。
AI.method: 方法包含三个主要部分:(1) 三个抽象核心类(ScientificEvidence、EvidenceVariable、EvidenceAssertion)及其遗传学专门化;(2) 紧凑的维度词汇表,包括6个始终必需维度(知识领域、方法、目标类型、分辨率、可信度、表型尺度)和约14个条件维度(如遗传模式、变异确认、敲除类型等);(3) 条件激活机制,通过SHACL形状(SHACL shapes)和SPARQL约束实现,规定维度仅在其他维度取特定值时才必需。当前有3个激活条件被形式化为可执行SHACL形状(Variant Ascertainment、Mode of Inheritance、Organism)。可信度作为结构化分解,包括总体评级和5个独立评估方面(样本量/统计功效、独立重复、多重检验控制、祖先/人群分层控制、确认)。模型采用"两篇论文规则"保守地扩展模式:在某篇论文中观察到的表征缺口仅记录在该论文的candidate_extensions中;在第二篇独立论文中观察到时才提升为一阶维度。人类-AI协作标注工作流区分策划者手工标注(参考集)和AI起草的标注(待人工审核),每条断言强制携带源文本锚定(source_span)。
AI.result: 六篇遗传学论文试点(Gupta经典孟德尔遗传学、Duerr GWAS、Davis病例对照重测序、Jossin和Nelson模型生物/体外功能遗传学、Inouye多基因风险评分)产出28条GeneticEvidence条目和95条源锚定断言。AI起草的9条条目中:1条批准,3条带非阻塞标志批准,5条编辑修订。试点促进了两个候选扩展提升为一阶维度:Phenotype Scale(从Jossin首次提出,后在Davis、Nelson等重复使用)和Variant Ascertainment(从Davis首次提出,后在Nelson和Duerr重复使用)。另有15个候选扩展因未在第二篇独立论文中观察到而保持未提升状态。试点暴露了模型当前局限:多基因风险评分需要占位符赋值(目标类型variant、变异确认标记为不适用),药物反应证据不在模型范围内,需要6个多基因评分相关扩展。可信度的人工标注轨道使用5个query、6个suggestion、1个disagreement;AI起草轨道使用6个uncertainty和6个assumption。UMLS交叉映射揭示了GEM标记的组合性问题(如statistical_genetics是statistics×genetics的交集复合词),需通过概念层后协调解决。
AI.conclusion: 该模型是一个可行性的增量贡献,朝向可信赖、AI就绪的变异解读基础设施迈出的具体一步。它提供了:(1) 遗传证据的参考数据模型和SHACL验证模式;(2) 可执行的条件激活约束(3个形状);(3) 源锚定的可审计注释;(4) 策划者权威、AI辅助的工作流;(5) 保守的两篇论文规则以防止模式过早膨胀。局限性包括:6篇论文和单一标注者不支持标注者间一致性的结论;评估非临床部署;UMLS交叉映射的组合性问题。近期方向:标注第二个语料库以验证最强候选扩展;从单一来源生成OWL、SHACL、JSON Schema和LinkML渲染;进行临床部署研究。

title: Reducing the Cross-Model Tax: Query Optimization over Multi-Model Data
summary: Querying across heterogeneous data models incurs substantial overhead from query decomposition, data transfer, and processing outside the underlying database systems. We show that, in the evaluated decomposition-based architecture, a substantial part of this cross-model tax is not inherent to heterogeneity itself, but results from avoidable decisions made by the unifying query processor. We present a mapping- and capability-aware optimization approach that systematically moves processing closer to the data. It combines model-aware predicate pushdown, cross-model dependent joins, and non-redundant query-part construction within a unified optimization pipeline applicable across relational, document, and graph databases. The approach is implemented in MM-quecat and evaluated over PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, and their heterogeneous combination. It reduces query latency by up to two orders of magnitude, eliminates all out-of-memory failures observed in the original single-DBMS experiments, provides further order-of-magnitude improvements through dependent execution, and reduces planning time for complex graph plans from hundreds of milliseconds to several milliseconds. The results demonstrate that established optimization principles can be generalized across data-model and system boundaries and can substantially improve the efficiency and robustness of decomposition-based multi-model query processing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向分解式多模型查询处理的映射与能力感知优化流水线，通过模型感知谓词下推、跨模型依赖连接和非冗余查询部分构造三项技术，将处理尽可能下推到 PostgreSQL、MongoDB 和 Neo4j 等底层数据库中，从而显著降低"跨模型税"。在 MM-quecat 中的实验表明，该方法可使查询延迟最高降低两个数量级，消除原有单 DBMS 实验中的全部内存溢出故障，并将复杂图计划的规划时间从近 600 毫秒降至数毫秒。
AI.motivation: 多模型应用日益普遍，但基于分解架构的统一查询处理器在跨异构数据模型查询时面临显著的性能开销（作者称之为"cross-model tax"）。现有研究多关注多模型查询的功能表达能力，而对如何系统性地减少跨模型查询开销缺乏成熟的优化方法。作者认为这部分开销很大程度上并非源于数据模型本身的异构性，而是由统一查询处理器中可避免的操作符放置、跨模型连接的独立检索以及冗余的查询部分构造所导致。
AI.method: 方法核心是一个映射与能力感知的优化流水线，包含三项技术：(1) 模型感知谓词下推（Model-Aware Predicate Pushdown）—— 将统一模式上的过滤器沿 QEP 下推，但必须经映射覆盖检查与原生查询构建器能力检查，确认能翻译为 SQL、MongoDB aggregation pipeline 或 Cypher 后才下推，否则保留在统一层；(2) 跨模型依赖连接（Cross-Model Dependent Joins）—— 在不能下推到单一原生查询的等值连接处，先评估独立输入，提取连接变量的不同值集合，作为限制条件传入依赖子树，使依赖端的检索结果被预先约束，限制可通过任意异构子树传播，并保留原始连接作为安全回退；(3) 非冗余查询部分构造（Non-Redundant Query-Part Construction）—— 识别冗余度评分为 1 的强制 kind pattern，一次性联合加入而非枚举其插入顺序，从而消除 k! 的等价构造路径。三者集成在 MM-quecat 中，配合基于执行观察与原生规划信息的轻量级基数估计器来选择依赖连接的独立输入。
AI.result: 在 Cal.com 模式派生的 20 个 MMQL 查询、四种执行环境（PostgreSQL-only、MongoDB-only、Neo4j-only、混合异构）的实验评估中：(1) 谓词下推对单个查询-环境组合使延迟最高降低两个数量级，并消除了原单 DBMS 实验中所有的内存溢出（OOM）故障；(2) 在谓词下推基础上，依赖连接对部分 MongoDB 与异构查询再带来最多约一个数量级的额外改进（受保守适用条件约束，如 Q12 因独立结果过大而回退）；(3) 非冗余查询部分构造在 Neo4j 环境效益最大，将访问 8 个 kind 的图计划规划时间从近 600 毫秒降至数毫秒，总体延迟降低约一个数量级；(4) 优化后各单 DBMS 环境在不同查询上各具优势，后见 oracle 在三个单 DBMS 环境间选择可将工作负载平均延迟再降约 20%。主要剩余瓶颈是无法被任一输入有效约束的跨部分连接。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明：在所评估的分解式多模型架构中，"跨模型税"的很大一部分并非异构性本身的固有成本，而是统一查询处理器可避免的决策造成的。通过将已建立的优化原理（谓词下推、依赖连接、搜索空间削减）在概念语义、物理映射与原生执行能力三者之间进行协调，可以系统性地跨数据模型和系统边界泛化这些原理，使底层 DBMS 尽可能多地承担工作，统一层仅保留无法委托的操作。多模型优化不是一组独立的局部启发式方法，而是对若干成熟原则的跨表示与跨执行域协调。未来工作应将本流水线与全局基于代价的计划选择、源/映射选择、更广泛的连接排序以及投影/聚合/排序/限制下推相结合，并在真实工作负载与物理分布式部署上进一步评估。

title: CAT-LDP: Cloud-edge Adaptive Taxonomy under Local Differential Privacy
summary: Recommender systems are widely used in daily life, but their direct collection and use of user preference data can also lead to privacy leakage. Existing privacy-preserving recommendation methods often find it hard to balance user privacy and recommendation performance. This problem is more serious in implicit-feedback settings, where data sparsity further increases the loss of useful signals caused by privacy perturbation. To solve this problem, we propose CAT-LDP, a cloud-local collaborative recommendation framework under local differential privacy constraints. CAT-LDP combines a hierarchical taxonomy tree with an adaptive privacy budget allocation strategy to keep more useful signals in users' active categories while protecting user privacy. Specifically, users upload perturbed category profiles that satisfy LDP. Based on these profiles, the cloud performs coarse-grained candidate generation, and the local device then carries out fine-grained reranking by using unperturbed local history. Experiments on the Amazon Video Games dataset show that CAT-LDP consistently outperforms its fixed-budget ablation variant and representative baselines on HR@K and NDCG@K under different privacy budgets. The results show that combining category-space modeling with cloud-local task decoupling can effectively reduce noise amplification in long-tail sparse settings and provide a better balance between privacy and utility for implicit-feedback recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAT-LDP框架,在本地差分隐私约束下,通过层次化分类树与自适应隐私预算分配策略,实现云端-本地协同的隐式反馈推荐,在长尾稀疏场景下有效平衡隐私保护与推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护推荐方法难以在用户隐私与推荐性能间取得平衡,尤其在隐式反馈场景中,数据稀疏性进一步加剧了隐私扰动对有用信号的损耗,高维平坦物品空间中的LDP机制在长尾场景下易放大噪声。
AI.method: 1) 构建三级层次化分类树,将物品映射到粗粒度(L2)和细粒度(L3)类别空间;2) 本地端基于用户活跃度分配自适应隐私预算(均值等价约束下,通过二分搜索求解缩放因子),对类别profile进行BRR扰动;3) 云端基于扰动数据进行多阶段图共识聚类(多K-Means+谱聚类),采用乘性门控机制进行粗排序;4) 本地端利用未扰动的真实历史记录,通过Jaccard相似度对Top-M候选进行细粒度重排序。
AI.result: 在Amazon Video Games数据集(稀疏度99.96%)上,ε=1.0时,CoarseOnly场景HR@10达0.2050(NDCG@10为0.0990),较固定预算消融版本CT-LDP提升约17.5%/16.0%,较最佳基线LCF-AP提升约42.7%/40.0%;HybridLocalRerank场景HR@10达0.2946(NDCG@10为0.1889),较CT-LDP提升约13.0%/12.7%,较LCF-AP提升约39.1%/33.5%。消融实验表明自适应预算机制在不同隐私预算(ε=0.1~1.0)下均稳定优于固定预算。
AI.conclusion: CAT-LDP通过类别空间建模与云端-本地任务解耦,在长尾稀疏隐式反馈场景下有效降低噪声放大,在固定平均隐私成本下提升关键类别信号的保留质量,实现了隐私与效用的更优平衡;未来工作将验证该框架在多数据集与不同评估协议下的泛化性。

title: EXAONE Forecast for Finance
summary: This technical report presents EXAONE Forecast for Finance (EXAONE Finance), a financial time series (TS) foundation model (TSFM) tailored to financial forecasting. Recent TSFMs achieve strong zero-shot performance through large-scale pretraining. However, they are primarily developed for general-domain TS and largely rely on self-attention backbones whose computational cost grows quadratically with sequence length and variate count. Moreover, they assume fully observed inputs and are pretrained on corpora that fail to capture the unique dynamics of financial markets. These limitations hinder their applicability to finance, where long, many-channel, intermittently observed panels are common. To address these challenges, EXAONE Finance adopts an attention-free architecture, replacing self-attention with two simple yet effective linear-time operators: 1) a causal 1D convolution for temporal mixing and 2) a group-aware pooling multi-layer perceptron (MLP) for variate mixing. Furthermore, a masked context augmentation exposes the model to contiguous missing spans during training, improving robustness to the missingness pervasive in financial markets. EXAONE Finance is pretrained on a large-scale financial corpus covering not only equities but also foreign exchange, commodities, crypto-assets, fixed income, and macroeconomic indicators. On FinVerse, a financial forecasting benchmark covering diverse asset classes, EXAONE Finance attains state-of-the-art performance, ranking first across all three evaluation tiers---point-forecast accuracy, cross-sectional asset ranking, and portfolio profitability.

AI.tldr: EXAONE Finance是一个针对金融时间序列预测的基础模型（TSFM），采用注意力无关架构（因果1D卷积+分组感知池化MLP），支持线性时间复杂度，并通过掩码上下文增强提升对金融数据缺失的鲁棒性，在多资产金融预测基准FinVerse上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用领域时间序列基础模型（TSFM）主要基于自注意力机制，存在两个关键局限：(1) 自注意力计算复杂度随序列长度和变量数呈二次方增长，难以处理金融场景中的长序列、多通道面板数据；(2) 假设输入完全可观测且在非金融语料上预训练，无法捕捉金融市场独特动态，对金融数据中普遍存在的间歇性缺失缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: EXAONE Finance提出三个核心设计：(1) 采用注意力无关架构，将自注意力替换为两个线性时间算子——因果1D卷积（用于时间维度混合）和分组感知池化MLP（用于变量维度混合），实现O(L·V)线性复杂度；(2) 引入掩码上下文增强（masked context augmentation），在训练中暴露连续缺失片段，提升对金融数据间歇性缺失的鲁棒性；(3) 在大规模金融语料（覆盖股票、外汇、大宗商品、加密资产、固定收益及宏观经济指标）上进行预训练。评估使用FinVerse基准，覆盖三类评估层级：点预测精度、截面资产排序和投资组合盈利能力。
AI.result: 在FinVerse金融预测基准上，EXAONE Finance在全部三个评估层级（点预测精度、截面资产排序、投资组合盈利能力）均排名第一，达到state-of-the-art性能，验证了注意力无关架构和金融领域预训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EXAONE Finance通过注意力无关线性时间架构、针对缺失数据的掩码增强训练以及大规模多资产金融语料预训练，成功解决了通用时间序列基础模型在金融场景中的适用性问题，为金融时间序列预测提供了一个高效且鲁棒的专用基础模型。

title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance
comment: 53 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables; companion literature-coding and search-log CSVs included in the source package
summary: Artificial intelligence in recruitment has shifted the object being automated from profile pairs and ranked lists to multi-stage workflows that retrieve evidence, compare candidates, and support or execute actions. This systematized narrative review traces that development from bilateral retrieval and behavioral ranking through neural person--job matching, large language model (LLM) components, and tool-using recruiting agents. Using a purposive search and coding protocol updated through 23 July 2026, plus targeted updates through 2 September 2026, we organize 40 representative works with supporting industrial and legal sources. This synthesis is not a prevalence estimate. We analyze three coupled transitions: from similarity to reciprocal suitability, from a model to a compound workflow, and from offline prediction to evidence- and productivity-aligned evaluation. Across document understanding, retrieval, ranking, assessment, interviewing, sourcing, and human handoff, we distinguish field-, pair-, list-, case-, trajectory-, and outcome-level evidence. Persistent gaps arise because behavioral labels confound exposure, preference, and qualification; private and synthetic data limit external validity; final-output scores conceal pipeline failures; and, within the coded set, privacy is not directly evaluated and no row jointly evaluates utility, fairness, privacy, and security. These observations describe the coded set rather than the field as a whole. We therefore introduce a staged mapping from evaluation evidence to the strongest defensible claim, together with an agenda for reciprocal, evidence-grounded, temporally controlled, selective, and auditable systems. Progress should be judged by whether workflows retrieve the right evidence, preserve uncertainty, support contestable decisions, and improve outcomes under explicit cost and risk constraints.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于AI招聘系统的系统化叙事综述，核心论点为：随着招聘AI从简单的配对评分演变为多阶段工具调用型智能体，评估单位必须随之扩展。论文提出"评估单位—可辩护主张"的分级映射（L1文档字段→L6实际结果），并梳理了40项代表性工作的演变与治理空白。
AI.motivation: 当前AI招聘领域缺乏统一的评估框架：传统指标（如AUC、nDCG、点击率）无法验证新型智能体系统的真实效用、公平性与安全性。作者旨在填补这一"测量错位"（measurement mismatch）问题，建立从自动化对象到评估证据再到可主张上限的完整链条。
AI.method: 采用系统化叙事综述方法（更新至2026年7月23日，补充更新至2026年9月2日），通过目的性检索与编码协议梳理40项代表性工作（含档案论文、预印本、系统演示和部署证据），辅以工业、法律和监管资料。提出五层自动化范围（A0-A4）、四级工作流权限（P0-P3）、六个评估单位（L1-L6）的三维框架，并以阶段式证据-主张映射（claim ladder）为核心分析工具。
AI.result: 1. 识别招聘AI的三大耦合转变：从相似度到互适性、从单模型到复合工作流、从离线预测到证据与生产力对齐的评估；2. 揭示编码集合中隐私未被直接评估，无任何工作同时评估效用、公平性、隐私与安全性；3. 发现行为标签混淆了曝光、偏好与资格；4. 明确列出最终输出分数掩盖管道失败、私有数据限制外部效度等持续性缺口；5. 提出互惠型、证据锚定型、时序受控型、选择型、可审计型系统的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 进展的衡量标准不应是更具说服力的推荐，而是工作流能否检索正确证据、保留不确定性、支持可质询决策，并在明确成本与风险约束下改善结果。论文主张证据链需按评估单位分级主张上限，反对低层级指标向上推论；为未来构建可问责的招聘智能体提供了框架、治理对照（覆盖中国、欧盟、英国、美国）及可测试的人机协作契约设计。

authors: et al. (20 additional authors not shown)
title: Harbor Adapters and Harbor-Index: Infrastructure and a Curated Meta-Dataset for Large-Scale Agentic Evaluation
summary: Evaluating agents on the growing number of agentic benchmarks is challenging because they often require complex environments and agent integrations. We introduce Harbor Adapters, a unified evaluation infrastructure for agentic benchmarks. Our work makes three contributions. First, we develop benchmark adapters that port more than 80 benchmarks to evaluate arbitrary agents, and validate them through rigorous code review and parity experiments. Second, we conduct a large-scale evaluation of 8 models spanning capability tiers across 54 benchmarks; every model is run with Terminus-2 and with one of 3 native harnesses. This enables a broader analysis of agent capabilities and failure modes than was previously possible. Third, we introduce Harbor-Index, a curated set of 82 difficult, diverse, and high-quality tasks spanning 29 benchmarks, refined from the adapted suite through difficulty filtering, AI and human audit, and an audit-and-fix loop. Harbor-Index preserves the challenge and breadth of large-scale agentic evaluations while being affordable to run; no evaluated model-harness configuration exceeds 30% pass rate, and the strongest (GPT-5.5 with Codex) reaches 28.0%. We release the adapters, evaluation results, in-depth analysis, and Harbor-Index as open-source artifacts to support more reliable and comprehensive evaluation of language-model agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Harbor Adapters（统一智能体评测基础设施，将80多个智能体基准通过标准化模式接入，降低集成复杂度从O(mn)到O(m+n)）和Harbor-Index（82个精选的高质量困难任务数据集，覆盖29个基准）。通过大规模评估8个模型在54个基准上的表现，并审计6028条轨迹，作者发现基础模型能力比harness设计更影响性能，许多基准存在冗余排名信号，前沿模型更token高效但成本仍高，且低通过率常反映任务设计缺陷而非真实难度。
AI.motivation: 随着200多个智能体基准的涌现，每个基准需要与每个智能体单独集成，导致O(mn)的工程负担和评测碎片化。模型发布通常仅报告少数流行基准的结果，难以判断进展是否跨领域泛化，且不同基准实现、环境设置和评测协议的差异混淆了对比。论文旨在解决智能体基准评测的碎片化问题，提供统一的基础设施和高质量的精选数据集。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心部分：（1）Harbor Adapters——基于Harbor框架开发80多个基准适配器，每条适配器经过三阶段质量审查（自动bot、初级和高级reviewer）和parity实验验证，parity实验在原版基准和Harbor适配版上使用相同agent、模型和执行配置进行k=3次试验，报告均值±SEM；（2）大规模评估——评估8个模型（Gemini-3.1-Pro/Flash、Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 4.x、GPT-5.4/mini/nano）在54个基准、6,627个任务上的表现，每个模型使用Terminus-2和对应的native harness（Codex/Claude Code/Gemini CLI），共16种模型-harness配置，每种配置3次试验；（3）Harbor-Index——通过多阶段流水线从1,311个候选任务中精选82个：难度过滤（3个领先模型18次试验中通过率≤33%）、Gemini-3-Flash AI审核、14名人类领域专家复审、轨迹审计和修复循环，任务涵盖29个基准。分析技术包括PCA降维分析基准空间冗余性、Spearman秩相关贪心前向选择、独立任务筛选、线性混合模型（LMM）控制benchmark难度随机截距以分离model和harness效应，以及对6028条失败轨迹的失败模式分类（12个rubric，经人类标注员两轮Cohen's κ=0.66和LLM judge κ=0.51校准）。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）Harbor Adports成功将80多个基准集成到Harbor框架，parity实验验证了语义保真度；（2）大规模评估显示：基础模型能力的固定效应范围（0.451）是harness的5.2倍（0.087），6/8模型系数显著而仅2/4 harness系数显著；基准评分矩阵本质低秩（PC1解释67.1%方差），仅12个基准提供独立信号；前沿模型在所有难度层级都使用更少token（在最简单的0-0.1桶中仅使用42%的弱模型token），但单次试验成本仍高2-3倍；失败模式分析显示wrong factual answer、algorithmic bug和hidden-test regression是主要失败类型；（3）Harbor-Index 1.0上，最强配置GPT-5.5配合Codex仅达到28.0%通过率，无任何模型-harness配置超过30%，其中6个开源模型全部为0%通过率。任务设计缺陷普遍存在：在30多个基准中，约1/3的候选困难任务因结构缺陷被拒绝，包括GAIA2上模拟事件从未触发、SWE-bench Pro上验证器过度规定data-testid格式、CRustBench上验证器绑定手写Rust接口等问题。
AI.conclusion: Harbor Adapters通过将异构基准标准化为Harbor任务接口（instruction、environment、tests、solution），将基准-智能体集成从O(mn)减少到O(m+n)。研究发现：基础模型能力是性能差距的主要驱动力；许多基准包含冗余的排名信号；前沿模型更token高效但仍成本更高；低通过率任务通常反映任务设计缺陷而非真实难度。Harbor-Index 1.0将该基准套件提炼为82个紧凑、困难、多样且经过审计的任务。两者结合为语言模型智能体提供了可重用基础设施和经济实惠的高质量测试平台，支持更可靠、可扩展和信息丰富的评测。论文建议将Harbor-Index作为动态维护的评测基准以避免未来的reward hacking。

title: Data-Optimized Contingency Screening: A Machine Learning Approach to Power System Security
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 3rd EIE International Conference on Computing, Networking, Robotics and Telecommunication (EIECon), 2025. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Ensuring the security of the power system is essential for stability and reliability, especially in the event of disruption. Effective classification of contingency in power systems enables proactive decision-making and mitigates large-scale breakdowns and failures. This study explores the use of machine learning algorithms to classify security levels of contingencies in power systems into safe, moderate or severe classes. For this approach, Newton-Raphson load flow method extracts system data from contingency scenarios, using Overall Performance Index (OPI) as safety measure. For data pre-processing, Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to address class imbalance and reduce dimensionality, respectively. K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) is trained and evaluated on datasets generated through N-k contingency scenarios for k equal 1, 2, and 3 on IEEE-14 and IEEE-30 bus systems using four hybrid pre-processing configurations: normalized, SMOTE-balanced, PCA-transformed, and a combined SMOTE PCA-transformed. Performance is assessed by precision, recall and F1 score, with priority given to the severe contingency classes. The RF achieved the highest F1 scores of 0.97 in IEEE-30 and 0.86 in IEEE-14, SVM benefits significantly from PCA and improves the accuracy of the classification, while KNN is best suited for SMOTE and PCA conversion. The findings show that PCA contributes more than SMOTE to the overall performance of the model. However, SMOTE improves recall but can introduce false positives and is therefore a compromise of accuracy. This study highlights machine learning as a scalable and powerful alternative to traditional contingency analysis, which improves the assessment of security in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用机器学习算法（KNN、随机森林、SVM）对电力系统突发事件的安全等级（安全、中等、严重）进行分类，采用牛顿-拉夫逊潮流法提取数据，使用OPI作为安全度量，结合SMOTE和PCA进行预处理，在IEEE-14和IEEE-30节点系统上对N-1、N-2、N-3突发事件场景进行评估。
AI.motivation: 电力系统的安全稳定运行至关重要，传统的偶然性分析方法计算成本高，难以实时评估。突发事件的有效分类有助于主动决策和预防大规模故障，机器学习为实时安全评估提供了可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 1. 使用牛顿-拉夫逊潮流法计算突发事件场景下的系统数据，以总体性能指数(OPI)作为安全度量；2. 采用四种预处理配置：归一化、SMOTE平衡、PCA降维、SMOTE+PCA组合；3. 在IEEE-14和IEEE-30节点系统上生成N-1、N-2、N-3突发事件场景数据集；4. 训练KNN、随机森林(RF)、SVM三种分类器；5. 通过精确率、召回率和F1分数评估性能，优先关注严重突发事件类别。
AI.result: 随机森林在IEEE-30上获得最高F1分数0.97，在IEEE-14上获得0.86；SVM受益于PCA显著提升分类精度；KNN最适合SMOTE和PCA转换；PCA对模型整体性能的贡献大于SMOTE；SMOTE能提升召回率但可能引入误报，是以牺牲精度为代价的折衷方案。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习作为传统偶然性分析的可扩展且强大的替代方案，能够改善电力系统安全的实时评估，为突发事件的分类和安全等级判定提供了有效的方法论框架。

title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
summary: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. Tasks are reverse-constructed from the hyperlink structure of a web corpus: we author multi-hop chains over an entity graph distilled from a seed page and its out-links, rewrite every non-answer entity into a descriptive reference so that no clue can be resolved by string matching, and admit only questions that a reference model fails closed-book yet solves once the supporting evidence is supplied. These questions are then turned into trajectories, which are filtered at both the trajectory and the turn level before SFT. The policy is then optimized by RL against live search, with the reward judge and the observation summarizer served inside the training cluster, and with over-long rollouts interrupted at the request level and resumed from their committed prefix at the next step. We alternate the two stages in a procedure we call SFT-RL climbing, returning the hardest solved and most efficient rollouts of each RL round to the next supervised pass. Because inference-time context management is worth more on these benchmarks than most reported differences between systems, we evaluate every benchmark both with and without it, holding the tool set, the context limit, and the judge fixed. All results come from a single ReAct agent, with no sub-agents and no test-time verification. With management enabled, on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, DeepSearchQA, and HLE the two models reach $82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3$ and $88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4$, the strongest overall results among open-source search agents in their respective parameter ranges. We plan to release the model weights together with the complete recipe for data construction, training, and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Iris-mini(35B-A3B)与 Iris-pro(397B-A17B)两个开源搜索智能体,贡献了一套从数据构建、训练到评估的完整方案,通过反向构建多跳问答、轨迹过滤、SFT-RL 交替爬升,在 BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、DeepSearchQA、HLE 四个基准上取得同参数规模开源模型中的最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体的训练数据常来自自然网络问题,过于简单难以驱动学习;且多数系统只报告带有上下文管理(CM)的结果,无法区分策略本身能力与推理时外壳带来的增益。本文旨在构建一个端到端的训练与评估方案,既能训练出真正具备搜索能力的策略,又能清晰衡量模型本征能力与 CM 的各自贡献。
AI.method: 方法分三部分:(1)数据管线:从网页超链接结构反向构建任务——抽取实体图、生成多跳问题、对非答案实体进行描述性抽象以消除字符串匹配捷径,并通过参考模型的"闭卷失败+有证据成功"双重判据保留难题。(2)训练流程:教师以 ReAct 范式生成轨迹,经过轨迹级(正确性、退化、深度、去重)和回合级(数据驱动 rubric 的 LLM 评判)两级过滤后做 SFT;再通过部分回放(in-cluster FP8 GenRM 作奖励、观察摘要、truncated importance sampling 修正权重漂移)进行 RL;两阶段交替形成"SFT-RL climbing",从 RL 中精选最短正确轨迹回灌 SFT。(3)评估协议:统一工具集、上下文上限和评判流程,在所有基准上同时报告有无 CM 的结果。
AI.result: Iris-mini 在 BrowseComp/BrowseComp-ZH/DeepSearchQA/HLE 取得 82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3,Iris-pro 取得 88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4,在各自参数范围开源模型中均为最优,部分指标超过 1T 规模的 Kimi-K2.6。无 CM 时仍领先 OpenSeeker-v2、REDSearcher、FORT-Searcher 等;discard-all CM 最多可带来 +21.2 点增益且小模型收益更大,组合 retry 后 Iris-pro 在 BrowseComp 突破 90。训练中产生的搜索数据与教师在通用工具调用(BFCL、τ-bench)与协作场景(OfficeQA、APEX)上呈现正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出可复现的搜索智能体训练全流程配方,验证了在严格的数据过滤与 SFT-RL 爬升下,中等规模模型也能逼近更大前沿系统的搜索能力。上下文管理应被视作推理系统的有效组成部分,而非单纯的实现细节。搜索能力更接近一种"原子能力",可迁移到非搜索类智能体场景,作者将后续沿此方向探索更广泛的智能体能力与更高质量的评测基准。

title: A Removal Based Approach to Improve LLM Faithfulness at Test-Time
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for consequential decisions, making their explanations an important tool for auditing model behavior. Unfortunately, these explanations can be unfaithful, failing to reflect the actual reasoning underlying the model's decisions. We consider a setting in which an LLM provides both an answer and an explanation in response to a question. We identify two distinct dimensions of unfaithful explanations: incompleteness, meaning that the explanation omits factors that influence the answer, and unsoundness, meaning that the explanation cites factors that did not influence the model's answer. Existing approaches to improving LLM faithfulness include training-time methods, which require access to model weights and extensive computational resources, and test-time methods that largely focus on addressing unsoundness. We introduce a test-time approach that directly targets incompleteness. We remove from the input the concepts not credited in the model's explanation and re-query the model on the reduced input. This eliminates unmentioned influences while preserving the influence of mentioned concepts. Across two datasets, multiple model families, and two independent faithfulness metrics, our approach improves explanation faithfulness compared to both standard prompting and prompting to encourage faithfulness. Our method is model-agnostic and can be applied at inference time without modifying model parameters, providing a flexible mechanism for reducing hidden influences and improving the reliability and safety of LLM-assisted decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"移除包装器"（Removal Wrapper），一种测试时方法，通过移除输入中未被解释归因的概念并重新查询模型，使模型答案与其解释对齐，从而改善大语言模型（LLM）解释的完整性（incompleteness）。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用于重大决策，其解释用于审计模型行为，但解释常常不忠实——存在两类问题：不完整性（解释省略了影响答案的因素）和不健全性（解释引用了未影响答案的因素）。现有训练时方法需访问模型权重且计算昂贵，现有测试时方法主要解决不健全性，缺乏直接针对不完整性的方法。隐藏概念（hidden concepts）会悄无声息地影响模型行为，绕过人工监督，带来AI安全与可靠性风险。
AI.method: 移除包装器包含四个步骤：(1) 用辅助语言模型识别输入中的所有概念 C(x)；(2) 查询目标模型获得答案 a 和解释 E，用辅助模型判断解释归因的概念集 cr(E)；(3) 用辅助模型从输入中移除未被归因的概念，构建精简输入 x'；(4) 在新的上下文窗口中重新查询目标模型，以 x' 的回答作为最终输出。该方法无需修改模型权重，模型无关。其核心原理是：若辅助模型正确识别概念和归因集，则精简输入只含被归因概念，隐藏概念无法影响最终输出。
AI.result: 在两个数据集（提示增强问答数据集和BBQ偏见基准）、两个模型家族（Qwen3.5-9B/27B和Gemma-4-12B-it）以及三个忠实性指标（提示口头化、因果概念忠实性、归一化可模拟性增益）上评估。在提示增强QA任务上，包装器将Qwen的因果忠实性相关性 r 从0.274提升至0.873，将Gemma从0.335提升至0.924，且使NSG由负转正；在BBQ任务上，移除包装器结合模块化提示的"组合方法"取得最佳结果，例如Qwen3.5-27B的因果忠实性从0.733提升至0.843，NSG从0.054提升至0.180。该方法在减少隐藏概念方面最有效，并将与模块化提示结合后能同时减少隐藏和不健全概念。但Qwen3.5-9B因解释一致性较差而受益较少。
AI.conclusion: 移除包装器是一种有效的测试时方法，可使模型答案符合其自身解释，显著改善解释忠实性，且无需访问模型内部。该方法针对不完整性，与针对不健全性的方法互补；与模块化提示结合后可进一步提升忠实性，为通过API使用LLM时提升AI决策可靠性与安全性提供了灵活机制。局限性：依赖辅助模型的正确性和一致性；将概念视为相互独立，未考虑其依赖关系。

title: Why Better Models Can Create Riskier Systems: Evidence from LLM Agents in Financial Markets
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being deployed at scale in consequential real-world systems, from financial markets to content moderation to hiring. We show that improving individual model capability can degrade rather than improve system-level outcomes. We hypothesize that shared training and architectures can lead more capable LLMs to behave more similarly, creating correlated actions that do not diversify away. We develop a general framework showing how this correlation creates a non-diversifiable risk floor and test its predictions in financial markets using an agent-based simulation with LLM traders of varying general-purpose capability. We find that: (1) frontier LLMs exhibit significantly correlated behavior that increases with capability; (2) when their shared reasoning is accurate, increasing agent participation reduces market-level risk; and (3) when agents share a common misinformation environment, the same correlated behavior becomes a liability. Together, these results identify a capability paradox: improving individual models does not necessarily produce better system-level outcomes. Whether the same dynamics arise in other domains is an open empirical question.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"能力悖论"：更强的LLM在金融市场中可能创造更大的系统性风险，因为共享的训练数据和架构导致前沿模型的行为高度相关，产生无法通过增加智能体数量分散的非分散性风险下限。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM大规模部署到金融、内容审核、招聘等高风险系统中，一个关键问题被忽视：个体模型能力的提升是否可能在系统层面反而恶化结果？现有模型评估范式仅关注个体性能，忽略了多智能体动态系统中的相关性风险。
AI.method: 1. 构建通用分析框架：将智能体行动分解为"纠正性"（推向真值的部分）和"非纠正性"（残差），证明当残差正相关时，系统方差存在不可分散的下限 ρ̄σ²_r。2. 受控面板实验：7个LLM对64个系统变化场景做响应，估计非纠正成分的配对相关性，回归到能力分数（ELO和MMLU-Pro）。3. 基于智能体的市场模拟：使用LLM交易者（Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite）替换噪声交易者，测试在不同信息环境下LLM参与率对市场效率（跟踪误差、波动率）的影响。
AI.result: 1. 前沿LLM表现出显著的非纠正性行为相关性，且相关性随能力增强而上升（ELO回归p=0.001，R²=0.475；MMLU-Pro回归p<0.001，R²=0.580），同源厂商并不显著预测相关性。2. 共享信息准确时，增加LLM参与率单调降低跟踪误差；模型差异由缺口敏感度λ解释。3. 共享错误信息环境下，对抗性干扰使LLM参与完全反转价格发现功能，全参与时跟踪误差达噪声基线的5-7倍，Sonnet方向准确率降至42%（低于随机）。4. 风险下限 ρ̄σ²_r ≈ 0.010，约为单模型方差的一半，独立模型基准预测则无下限。
AI.conclusion: 论文识别出"能力悖论"：个体模型性能的提升不一定带来更好的系统级结果。相关性结构是LLM部署系统性风险的核心决定因素，而该相关性随能力增长。这意味着AI治理需要在个体评估之外补充群体层面的相关性审计；多厂商部署本身不足以解决问题，因为跨厂商的高能力模型仍比同厂商的低能力模型更相关；存在集体行动困境，需要超越个体部署者的协调机制。论文在医疗账单场景中做了类比扩展，并承认其他领域的普适性仍是开放问题。

title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
summary: Enterprise AI deployments fail not from model inadequacy, but because organizations lack a structured substrate encoding how they decide, negotiate, and execute. Generic LLMs carry no firm-specific ontological priors; RAG remains brittle, with no path to executable action; static playbooks encode logic but cannot reason or adapt. This demands an architecture treating tacit-knowledge capture, ontological grounding, sovereign deployment, and auditable actuation as co-designed from the start. This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework transforming a firm's structured, unstructured, multimodal, and tacit knowledge into an ontology-grounded enterprise foundation upon which reasoning and governed execution are composed. CLM has five capability planes and four architectural pillars: a Neurosymbolic Mesh coupling generative models with a knowledge graph; a Skill Graph where reusable tactics, personas, objections, and goals are typed and composed; Living Digital Twins modeling functional areas as reasoning surrogates; and a Deep Security Layer enforcing sovereignty, traceability, and human oversight. A Spec-as-Code paradigm bridges grounded intent and executable artifact. CLM is one instantiation of this foundation-centric class. Four contributions follow: CLM is defined as a distinct object of study; the Skill Graph is introduced for compositional explainability by construction; the Wisdom Listener effect is proposed, whereby tacit-capable foundations compound in value with use, connecting to dynamic capabilities and organizational learning; and evidence from a JCI-accredited tertiary hospital in Brazil instantiates three of the six maturity stages under LGPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Corporate Language Model (CLM)框架，将企业结构化与非结构化、多模态及隐性知识转化为本体驱动的企业基础，支持可治理的推理与执行，旨在解决企业AI部署失败的结构性根源问题。
AI.motivation: 企业AI部署失败的根本原因不在于模型能力不足，而在于缺乏编码组织决策、协商与执行流程的结构化基础。通用LLM缺乏企业特定的本体先验，RAG脆弱且无法执行操作，静态Playbook可编码逻辑但缺乏推理与适应性能力，因此需要一种架构将隐性知识捕获、本体落地、主权部署与可审计执行作为共设计要素。
AI.method: CLM框架包含五大能力平面与四大架构支柱：(1) 神经符号网格(Neurosymbolic Mesh)，耦合生成模型与知识图谱；(2) 技能图谱(Skill Graph)，将可复用的战术、角色、异议与目标类型化并组合；(3) 活体数字孪生(Living Digital Twins)，将职能领域建模为推理代理；(4) 深度安全层(Deep Security Layer)，强制主权、可追溯性与人类监督。此外采用Spec-as-Code范式连接落地意图与可执行制品。
AI.result: 四项理论贡献：(1) 将CLM定义为独立研究对象；(2) 提出技能图谱以实现构造式组合可解释性；(3) 提出"智慧倾听者"效应(Wisdom Listener effect)，即具备隐性捕获能力的基础设施在使用中价值复合递增，关联动态能力与组织学习理论；(4) 来自巴西一家JCI认证三级医院的实证证据，在LGPD合规下实例化了六个成熟度阶段中的三个。
AI.conclusion: CLM是基础中心型架构类的一种实例化实现，将企业知识本体化、推理与执行治理作为一体化设计，为解决企业AI落地中的结构性缺陷提供了理论与实践路径。

title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
summary: Benchmarks for the side effects an agent causes on the way to a goal already exist, but HarvestBench is the first to put a price on avoiding the side effect and to name that side effect as a living creature. It is a farm simulation: LLM sub-agents drive a crew of two tractors through a cooperative corn harvest, with animals in the field. The environment is a reinforcement learning gridworld, every decision is made without memory, and the harm is never named in the goal. When an animal blocks a tractor's route the autopilot stops and asks the model whether to drive on, at no fuel cost, or swerve around it for a posted fuel price. Kills are compared against two controls: rocks, which damage the tractor and are hit under 1% of the time by every model, and hay bales, which are harmless and not alive. Models can also take crops from the neighbor's field instead of their own, a second test of what they treat as moral. Across nine models and 7,201 priced decisions, 3,951 involved an animal rather than a hay bale or a rock. Kill rates range from 0.4% to 98.8%, with Terra and Sol the most merciful and GPT-4o-mini the most cruel, and they are not ordered by capability. Four of six models were sensitive to price at the 5% level, with elasticities from 0.09 to 1.69. All nine drove over wild animals more often than farmed animals on the default map, and the direction held at every map geometry in every model with room to move. The briefing mattered most: under the morality briefing the kill rate was under 6% in five of six reasoning models, and removing it raised the kill rate above 84% in all six. HarvestBench uses no LLM grader. The scorer counts events in the game log, so it is fully reproducible, and it measures what a model will pay to avoid harm rather than what it says about harm.

AI.tldr: HarvestBench 是首个为LLM智能体设置"避免杀死动物"代价的智能体基准测试，通过农场拖拉机仿真测量模型愿付多少燃料费来避免碾压动物，并发现杀戮率与能力无关，简报中提及"道德"和开启推理能显著降低杀戮率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准要么测量表述偏好（说一套），要么测量附带损害但不给代价定价。HarvestBench 首次把"避免杀死活物"标价，让模型在真实资源权衡中暴露其价值排序，揭示说与做的差距。
AI.method: 基于强化学习网格世界的农场仿真：两台拖拉机合作收割玉米，路遇动物时自动驾驶停下，询问模型"直碾（免费）/绕行（付燃料）/重路由（高代价）"。对照包括岩石（损坏拖拉机）和干草捆（无害非生命），并区分农场动物与野生动物、邻居庄稼。通过道德/中性两种系统提示、多个燃料价格档位、是否开启推理、是否告知被评估，共9个模型、7201次定价决策，对比杀戮率与燃料价格弹性。评分采用游戏日志事件计数，无LLM评判。
AI.result: 九个模型动物杀戮率从0.4%（GPT-5.6 Terra）到98.8%（GPT-4o-mini），跨度极大且与能力无关。岩石命中率均<1%，排除理解问题。四款模型杀戮率对燃料价格显著敏感，弹性0.09–1.69。所有九款模型都更常碾压野生动物而非农场动物（九向同向，p≈0.004）。道德简报将六款推理模型中五款杀戮率压至6%以下，去掉则全部飙至84%以上；中性简报下关闭推理影响较小（已接近天花板）。Sonnet 5与Haiku在明确告知动物被评分时杀戮率均<1%，削弱了"游戏化评估"的解释。Sonnet 5在1–8燃料价格间杀戮率从17%升至38.7%。Claude Opus 4.8各推理档杀戮率均约0.6%，几乎不动。
AI.conclusion: 模型是否碾压动物与能力无关而与提示和推理显著相关；动物福利仅在显式进入目标函数时才得到保护。HarvestBench 用可复现的事件计数衡量"愿付多少避免伤害"，比陈述偏好更能揭示模型价值观，为部署型智能体的道德风险评估提供了新工具。

title: PerfReasoning: How Well Do LLMs Reason on Hardware Performance?
summary: Performance modeling is central to hardware design and software optimization, yet constructing these models requires structured reasoning about computation, data reuse, storage, and movement. We introduce PerfReasoning, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs both as direct performance reasoners and as generators of analytical performance-model code. Given workload, architecture, and mapping specifications, models compare mappings and predict off-chip traffic and buffer requirements. The strongest closed-source models exceed 90% on reasoning-based Q&A, and the best open-weight model reaches 82.4%. However, model construction is substantially harder: while GPT-5.6 Sol exceeds 80% pass rate, all other model configurations average below 15% and vary markedly across runs. Task-specific RL raises a 4B model's mapping-reasoning accuracy by 15.7 points, whereas feedback-free multi-round self-revision prompting is not reliably effective. PerfReasoning exposes the gap between plausible architectural reasoning and reliable performance-model construction. We will publicly release the benchmark to support reproducible evaluation and track future progress.

AI.tldr: PerfReasoning 是一个用于评估大语言模型在硬件性能建模任务中推理与代码生成能力的基准测试，包含 216 个配置，覆盖矩阵乘法、批量矩阵乘法和卷积。实验表明，最强的闭源模型在基于推理的 Q&A 上超过 90%（最高 95.4%），最强开源模型达 82.4%；但构建可靠的分析性能模型难度极大，仅 GPT-5.6 Sol 超过 80% 通过率，其余平均低于 15% 且跨运行波动显著。任务特定 RL 提升显著，而无反馈多轮自修订不可靠。研究揭示了 LLM 在架构推理与可靠模型构建之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 性能建模是硬件设计与软件优化的核心，但传统依赖人工或学习预测器，存在泛化性差、可信度不足的问题。随着 LLM 在 AI 辅助芯片设计中扮演越来越重要的角色，亟需一个标准化基准来评估其在硬件性能推理和分析模型代码生成方面的可靠性，避免错误预测误导设计决策。
AI.method: PerfReasoning 基准包含两大组件：(1) 基于推理的 Q&A 任务，通过三种提示模板（一致性、反一致性、直接比较）评估 LLM 对映射（tiling、loop order、keep/bypass）的理解，以最差准确率控制一致性偏差；(2) 分析性能模型构建任务，要求 LLM 生成 Python 程序读取 workload/architecture/mapping YAML 规范并预测 off-chip 流量与 buffer 容量。基于 Timeloop 派生标签，使用双指标精确通过率（容差 10^-6）、Q-error 和成对偏好准确率评估。基准覆盖 16 个模型家族在多种推理力度下的表现，并测试了任务特定 RL 微调与无反馈多轮自修订的效果。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 强闭源模型 Q&A 准确率达 92.6–95.4%，最强开源模型（DeepSeek-V4-Pro）达 82.4%，环路顺序是区分度最高的映射轴；(2) 模型构建远比 Q&A 困难，仅 GPT-5.6 Sol 持续达 84.7–88.4%，其余平均低于 15% 且波动显著；(3) 生成的代码虽常保持正确的成对排序（78.5% vs 直接 Q&A 78.3%），但绝对值常偏离数个数量级；(4) Buffer 容量预测比访存预测容易，访存预测常出现极端数量级错误；(5) 验证器引导的 RL 将 Qwen3-4B 的映射推理准确率从 54.3% 提升至 70.0%，而无反馈多轮自修订效果不稳定（18 个配置不变、10 个变差、仅 7 个变好）；(6) 相比 2025 年快照，最强闭源模型提升约 34 个百分点，开源模型提升约 37 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PerfReasoning 揭示了前沿 LLM 在硬件性能建模中存在的"推理–构建鸿沟"：模型能可靠地定性比较映射对性能的影响，但几乎无法将其转化为定量可靠的分析模型代码，且结果跨运行波动大。任务特定 RL 可显著提升小模型推理能力，但无反馈自修订不可靠。未来 AI 辅助芯片设计需要更强的推理能力以及稳定、可验证的模型生成机制。通过分离推理与构建评估，PerfReasoning 为追踪该领域进展提供了具体基准。

title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
summary: Quantization is widely used to reduce the computational and memory demands of neural-network inference. In recurrent networks, however, the quantized state is stored and returned at the next time step, so the rule used to store that state can alter subsequent computations. Here, we introduce recurrent-state write-back to denote this rule and isolate its effect in a compact GRU encoder--decoder for fluorescence lifetime imaging, a molecular imaging modality used in quantitative biological imaging. A central task is estimating two lifetime parameters, the short-lived component {\tau}1 and the long-lived component {\tau}2, from high-noise time-resolved fluorescence signals. Holding the trained model fixed, replacing continuous state propagation with deterministic 4-bit state storage increases estimation errors for {\tau}1 and {\tau}2 by approximately 70x and 300x, respectively. Failure occurs when repeated small updates remain below the write threshold, leaving the stored state nearly fixed while the network continues to propose change. Error feedback, residual memory, and direction memory carry information from these suppressed updates across time and recover accuracy without retraining. Precision sweeps show that increasing state precision can worsen a fixed recurrent solution, while matched training shows that compatibility with the state interface can be learned. To test whether this behavior extends beyond the GRU, we repeat the post-training intervention in an independently trained LSTM, where coarse write-back reproduces the failure, error feedback restores accuracy, and state-specific interventions reveal greater sensitivity of the cell state than the hidden state. Our results establish recurrent-state write-back as a key determinant of low-precision recurrent dynamics and identify the state-storage interface as a central design consideration for quantized recurrent inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"循环状态写回"（recurrent-state write-back）概念，指出在低精度循环网络推理中，仅改变状态存储规则（而非任何训练参数）即可使已训练网络的时序动力学严重退化。该研究在荧光寿命成像（FLI）的GRU编解码器及独立训练的LSTM上系统验证了这一机制，并提出方向记忆等时序记忆操作器可在不重训练的情况下恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍将低精度循环网络的性能下降归因于位宽不足，但忽略了状态存储规则本身对时序计算的影响。当训练好的网络被部署到更粗糙的状态接口（如后训练量化）时，存储规则可能持续抑制网络提出的状态变化，从而改变整个时序轨迹。本文旨在分离并量化这一存储操作的独立影响。
AI.method: 1. 采用紧凑型GRU编解码器Seq2SeqLite（单层32单元，6,627参数）用于荧光寿命参数估计；2. 提出QMem分阶段量化感知训练流程，在P2F阶段引入4-bit循环状态写回；3. 设计后训练干预实验——冻结所有训练参数，仅替换状态存储规则；4. 定义循环写裕度（recurrent write margin）和死区分数（deadband fraction）量化抑制程度；5. 提出方向记忆（direction memory）算子积累亚阈值方向信息；6. 在独立训练的LSTM上进行跨架构验证，并分别干预细胞状态和隐藏状态；7. 进行精度扫描和匹配训练实验区分数值保真度与动力学保真度。
AI.result: 在P2F检查点冻结后，仅将连续传播替换为确定性4-bit写回即导致τ1和τ2的RMSE分别增加约70倍和300倍（从0.36/0.35 ns增至25.37/106.59 ns）。失败机制为：99.59%的解码器更新落在写边界内，连续同方向亚阈值更新的中位持续长度达132/134步，导致存储状态几乎冻结。误差反馈、残差记忆和方向记忆算子均可恢复精度（τ1/τ2恢复至0.34/0.34–0.46 ns）。精度扫描显示增加位宽不一定改善性能（4-bit原生模型在8-bit状态下反而变差）。LSTM实验复现了该失败模式，且揭示细胞状态对粗写回远敏感于隐藏状态。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态写回是低精度循环推理中的独立设计变量，其影响不可仅以位宽解释。数值保真度（单个状态值的精度）与动力学保真度（写回轨迹与学习到的时序动力学的兼容性）是两个不同概念。已训练网络与其状态存储接口构成耦合的时序系统，评估低精度循环推理需同时考虑存储值的数值精度和返回状态后产生的实际动力学。状态接口兼容性可通过训练学习，且不同循环变量（GRU隐藏状态、LSTM细胞状态与隐藏状态）对写回抑制的敏感度差异显著。

title: ResLearn-XR: Residual Learning for Network Traffic and Quality-of-Experience-Aware Modeling in Extended Reality
summary: We present ResLearn-XR, a residual learning framework for predicting eXtended Reality (XR) network traffic and estimating Quality-of-Experience (QoE) risk. ResLearn-XR adopts a two-stage temporal learning structure comprising a base sequence prediction model augmented with task-specific residual learning components to improve adaptability to bursty, non-stationary XR traffic dynamics. The residual learning stages operate in the value space for continuous XR traffic forecasting and in the logit space for probabilistic QoE risk estimation. \rev{For the QoE-risk branch, we introduce a Data Descriptor Algorithm (DDA), a causal feature-construction module that converts packet-level application-layer observables into frame-timing-aware descriptors suitable for encrypted traffic analysis. We also construct an XR Traffic-QoE dataset that pairs continuous XR traffic traces with session-level user-reported QoE labels. ResLearn-XR reduces SMAPE by up to 17.84% across frame-count, frame-size, and inter-arrival-time prediction, while reducing QoE-risk estimation SMAPE by up to 87.8% over single-stage baselines.

AI.tldr: ResLearn-XR是一个用于扩展现实(XR)网络流量预测和体验质量(QoE)风险估计的两阶段残差学习框架，通过值空间残差修正突发流量预测，对数空间残差优化QoE风险估计概率，并提出数据描述算法(DDA)将加密流量包级观测转化为帧时序感知描述符。
AI.motivation: XR应用具有严格的运动到光子(MTP)延迟约束（<20ms），违反该约束会引发晕动症并严重降低QoE。传统时序预测器（LSTM、GRU、Transformer等）在序列级回归目标下偏向条件均值，会低估短时突发流量；而现有QoE估计方法缺乏帧级时序变化表征且无可用的公开流量-QoE配对数据集。因此需要一种能联合建模长程趋势与突发动态、并在加密流量下估计QoE风险的认知框架。
AI.method: 框架包含两条分支：(1)流量预测分支采用Transformer等基模型加值空间残差头，使用FIA将包级数据聚合为帧级指标（帧数、平均帧大小、帧间到达间隔），引入全局偏置b使残差非负保持时序因果性；(2)QoE风险估计分支通过DDA将包级观测转化为12维因果描述符（包括帧交付率、负载、节律偏差、变异系数、漂移和复合不稳定指数等），用对数空间残差头修正概率估计，最后用分层等渗回归进行概率校准。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，流量预测SMAPE降低最高达17.84%（平均约6.7%），优于Informer、FEDformer等强基线；QoE风险估计SMAPE降低最高达87.8%，AUC最高达0.930。残差头仅增加约4K参数和0.05ms推理延迟，适合边缘部署。但QoE数据集仅含2名参与者，标签为会话级弱监督。
AI.conclusion: ResLearn-XR是首个统一架构中联合处理XR流量预测与QoE风险估计的认知框架之一，发布了含会话级QoE标注的XR Traffic-QoE数据集。未来工作将扩大数据集规模、纳入异构头显与5G/6G接入条件，并开展闭环控制器实验。

title: Rethinking Indirect Prompt Injection as a Test-Time Search Problem
summary: We formulate indirect prompt injection as a test-time search over a task-dependent attack surface induced by the environment, user task, and injection task. To operationalize this formulation, we introduce an agentic attacker with a dedicated search harness that performs environment reconnaissance, structured reasoning over attack strategies, and adaptive evaluation using victim-agent feedback. Across heterogeneous tasks, we find that increasing attacker test-time compute improves vulnerability discovery and exploitation, while ablations show that explicit strategy management is important for avoiding redundant search and sustaining gains at larger budgets. These results suggest that agentic security evaluations should characterize both the attacker's search procedure and compute budget, rather than treating attack success as a budget-independent property of the victim. More broadly, our findings identify the attacker's adaptive search over the system attack surfaces as an important and underexplored security risk for tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: 本文将间接提示注入重新定义为测试时搜索问题，提出基于智能体攻击者的搜索框架，揭示攻击者计算预算对漏洞发现的关键影响，强调智能体安全评估必须刻画攻击者的搜索过程与计算预算。
AI.motivation: 现有间接提示注入基准（如InjecAgent、AgentDojo等）通常将其视为静态评估问题，忽略了任务相关的攻击面，且未刻画攻击效果随测试时计算的变化。前沿模型在推理任务上增加测试时算力可显著提升性能，因此固定攻击预算的评估可能系统性低估智能体系统对自适应搜索型攻击的脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出"任务相关攻击面"的形式化框架，将其建模为搜索问题。设计基于智能体的攻击者，配备专用搜索工具集（Search Harness），包含三大模块：(1) 环境侦察（环境知识工具与注入向量知识工具）；(2) 推理与搜索（Strategy策略账本与History历史记录工具）；(3) 评估与反馈（Evaluate工具运行受害智能体并返回安全/效用分数）。在Workspace（40用户任务×6注入任务，240对）和Retail（17用户任务×8注入任务，136对）两个合成任务套件上，以GLM-5.2为攻击者，GPT-5.5与Opus-4.8为受害模型，报告ASR@T指标。
AI.result: 实验显示：(1) 攻击成功率随攻击者测试时计算预算单调提升——GPT-5.5在Retail上500K token时ASR显著增长，Workspace在100K token即达52.1%；(2) 完整搜索工具集（Full-Harness）优于No-Harness（移除侦察/搜索工具，后者在100K后趋于平台期）和No-Strategy（仅移除Strategy管理，导致过度侦察与重复攻击）；(3) GPT-5.5比Opus-4.8更脆弱（后者500K token仅20.6% ASR）；(4) 攻击成功率与注入目标"公开程度"和"明显危害性"负相关——纯凭证类外泄（IT5/IT6）ASR接近0%，而操作性简单的状态变更（IT2删文件97.5%）仍高度易受攻击；(5) 良性工具调用范围增加会提升ASR但降低联合成功率（JSR）。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三个核心结论：(1) 间接提示注入应被建模为对任务相关潜在攻击面的测试时搜索问题；(2) 攻击效果是攻击者搜索过程与计算预算的函数，而非受害模型的独立属性；(3) 智能体系统的安全评估必须同时刻画攻击者的搜索策略与算力预算。此外，攻击者的自适应搜索构成工具使用智能体中一个重要且未被充分探索的安全风险。建议未来工作向黑盒迁移、更多模型覆盖、真实部署和更强防御方向拓展。

title: BioSync: Transformer-Based Cross-Modal Fusion for a Multimodal Physiological Digital Biomarker
summary: Cardiac, neural, behavioral, and speech measurements from wearable and mobile devices provide partial, noise-sensitive views of physiological state. BioSync combines these measurements into the \textbf{BioSync Index (BSI)}, a continuous composite digital biomarker defined under the BEST framework. The model applies multi-head self-attention to modality tokens and adds a linear branch whose hypothesis class includes standard feature concatenation. This architecture is motivated by latent-variable measurement theory and by the possibility that joint observations contain information unavailable from individual modalities. We evaluated BioSync on two literature-informed synthetic cohorts: a four-modality cognitive-decline cohort using HRV, EEG, actigraphy, and speech, and a metabolic-autonomic cohort structured around the public AI-READI wearable schema. In the cognitive cohort, BioSync and concatenation obtained AUCs of 0.928 and 0.926, respectively. In the metabolic cohort, BioSync obtained accuracy/F1 of 0.764/0.766, compared with 0.756/0.758 for concatenation. The BSI correlated with latent severity in both cohorts ($r=0.91$ and $r=0.68$). A pure-attention ablation obtained cognitive-cohort AUC 0.911, locating the increase to 0.928 in the combined wide-and-deep architecture. With matched modality-dropout training, BioSync led concatenation at five of six cognitive-cohort corruption rates and at the highest metabolic-cohort rate. Its cognitive-cohort AUC was also higher than five published digital-biomarker reference values, although differences in datasets and tasks preclude a controlled benchmark claim. Comparison with single-modality, early-fusion, and late-fusion designs across six prespecified criteria identifies the model's computational properties; validation on real cohorts remains necessary.

AI.tldr: BioSync提出了一种基于Transformer的多模态生理数字生物标志物融合框架，将HRV、EEG、行为记录和语音等可穿戴设备模态融合为连续复合指标BSI，并在两个合成数据集上验证了其性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 单个可穿戴模态只能提供对生理状态的部分、噪声敏感视图，而现有数字生物标志物研究多为单模态且缺乏外部验证，多模态融合方法有限且缺乏对融合机制的深入理论解释。
AI.method: 采用多模态令牌+多头自注意力机制提取非线性交互特征，并行线性分支（wide path）保留特征拼接基线能力，形成宽深混合架构；输出连续BSI指标和每个被试的模态权重向量，理论依据来自潜变量测量模型和部分信息分解中的协同信息概念。
AI.result: 在认知衰退合成队列（4模态）中BioSync AUC达0.928（拼接基线0.926）；在代谢-自主神经AI-READI合成队列（2模态）中准确率/F1为0.764/0.766（拼接基线0.756/0.758）；BSI与潜在严重程度相关系数分别为0.91和0.68；在模态损坏测试中，认知队列在6个损坏率中5个领先于拼接基线。
AI.conclusion: BioSync在合成数据上展示了合理的计算特性和有限的性能优势，但所有结果均来自合成数据而非真实临床数据，真实队列验证仍是必要步骤。

title: What Does Multi-Harness RL Learn? Credit Assignment and Portability in Coding Agents
summary: Agent reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly runs through full execution harnesses, and a multi-harness recipe mixes two choices: exposing the policy to several harnesses, and comparing their rewards inside one relative-advantage group. We isolate the second choice in repository-level coding. From one Qwen3-8B supervised warm start we replay the same frozen task-harness records from Aider, OpenHands, Qwen Code, and SWE-agent, with the same number of updates, under two rules for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), Within (one group per task-harness pair) and Cross (harnesses pooled within a task), and score every checkpoint with a sealed SWE-bench Verified oracle on four source harnesses and a minimal harness held out of training. The evaluation harness is the dominant variable: across 24,000 sealed evaluations it moves the mean solve rate from 2.14\% to 9.27\%, a factor of 4.3, where the training recipe moves it by 1.16. The grouping rule is not. On the held-out harness, Cross minus Within is +0.25 pp, 95\% confidence interval [-0.48, +1.02], at eight attempts per task, and +0.16 [-0.41, +0.72] pooled over three training seeds whose individual estimates change sign. Each rule's own seed range, 0.42 to 0.45 pp, exceeds the difference between them. Both rules place their largest gains on the same source harness. The pooled advantage carries the harness: an out-of-fold classifier recovers the generating harness from Cross's advantage +4.48 pp above the shuffled-label baseline and from Within's not at all, and the two rules still reach the same held-out score and action distribution inside each harness. Re-collecting half the training data on-policy does not change this. Cross-harness credit yields configuration adaptation and no more portable capability than within-harness credit. Multi-harness RL reports should state the grouping boundary and test under an unseen harness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制变量实验，隔离了多智能体RL中"跨harness信用分配"这一独立干预，发现评估harness（而非训练方法）是影响编码智能体解决率的主导因素，且跨harness信用分配与harness内信用分配在未见过的harness上表现无差异，均仅产生"配置适应"而非"可迁移能力"。
AI.motivation: 当前多harness强化学习训练中存在两个混淆的干预：(1) 让策略接触多个harness（暴露），(2) 在同一相对优势组中比较不同harness的奖励（跨harness信用分配）。已有系统（如HarnessX、ClawGym II）同时改变两者，无法分离各自贡献。本文旨在隔离信用分配边界这一变量。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8B为同一SFT热启动，在SWE-Gym任务池上用四个生产harness（Aider、OpenHands、Qwen Code、SWE-agent）回放相同冻结的任务-harness轨迹记录，比较两种GRPO分组规则：Within（每个任务-harness对一个组）与Cross（同一任务内跨harness池化）。还引入Coverage-matched（覆盖率匹配）和Resid（残差化）两个控制臂。使用密封SWE-bench Verified预言机在四个源harness和一个训练未见过的minimal weak-ReAct harness上评估6个检查点（共24,000次评估）。
AI.result: 1. 评估harness是主导变量：在24,000次密封评估中，解决率均值从2.14%到9.27%（4.3倍差异），而训练方法仅带来1.16倍差异。2. 在未见过的harness上，Cross减Within为+0.25pp（95%CI [-0.48, +1.02]，k=8），三种子合并为+0.16pp [-0.41, +0.72]，每个方法自身的种子波动范围（0.42-0.45pp）超过组间差异。3. 两种方法的最大收益均出现在同一源harness上。4. 池化优势携带harness身份信息：分类器从Cross优势中可恢复生成harness（高于洗牌基线+4.48pp），从Within中则完全不能。5. 两种方法在每个harness内的动作分布相同（JSD仅0.0003-0.0029比特，而跨harness为0.17-0.35比特）。6. 重新收集一半训练数据为on-policy不改变结论。
AI.conclusion: 多harness强化学习报告应明确：(1) 生成经验使用的harness，(2) 优势归一化是否跨越harness边界，(3) 源harness上的增益，(4) 至少一个未见harness上的增益。跨harness信用分配仅产生配置适应而非可迁移能力——看到多个harness与比较它们进行信用分配是不同干预，后者本身并不使学到的策略具有harness无关性。

title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
summary: Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. We evaluate MaxKernel on JaxBench, a comprehensive suite of 50 diverse kernel tasks for TPUs, alongside complex, real-world workloads from state-of-the-art open-source models. We demonstrate that MaxKernel consistently generates highly optimized implementations, matching expert hand-tuned baselines and delivering significant performance across the benchmark. Our agent is open-sourced and available this https URL .

AI.tldr: MaxKernel 将 LLM 多智能体、编译器反馈、冻结测试、XProf 硬件剖析与自动调优整合为 TPU/Pallas 内核生成框架，并提供 HITL、Auto 线性优化及基于搜索图的 Parallel/Beam 搜索。其在 JaxBench 50 项任务上实现 50/50 编译与正确性，几何平均加速 1.58×，相对人工 Pallas 基线的 8 个生产内核加速 2.32×；但结果主要来自单一 TPU、单一 LLM，测试容差最高达 0.1，收益仍需跨模型、跨硬件和独立复现验证。
AI.motivation: 高性能 TPU 内核需要处理内存层级、DMA 流水化、多维分块和低层编译错误，生成正确代码后仍需基于真实硬件轨迹反复优化。论文旨在利用多智能体 LLM 将规划、编码、修复、验证、调优和剖析组成闭环，降低对人工硬件专业知识的依赖，并提高可复现性与搜索效率。
AI.method: 系统采用模块化多智能体架构：规划与实现智能体生成 Pallas 代码，修复智能体结合编译器反馈迭代；测试智能体建立冻结测试，验证数值正确性；自动调优智能体搜索分块和瓦片参数；剖析智能体通过 XProf 提取时延、带宽和计算密度并反馈下一轮。框架提供 HITL、Auto 封闭循环及图式并行/Beam 搜索。实验在 TPU v6e 上使用 JaxBench 的 50 个任务，对比 Best-of-100 零样本、5 次独立 Auto、5 路 Parallel（各 5 轮）和 Beam（宽度 3、深度 3、每节点 2 轮），并评测真实开源模型工作负载。
AI.result: JaxBench 上，Best-of-N、Auto、Parallel、Beam 的编译率分别为 10/50、49/50、50/50、50/50，正确率分别为 10/50、48/50、50/50、50/50，几何平均加速分别为 1.08×、1.39×、1.58×、1.49×，fast_1 分别为 6/50、22/50、34/50、31/50。相对人工 Pallas 的 8 个内核，Parallel 和 Beam 分别达到 2.32×与 1.78×，人工基线为 2.02×；7/8 工作负载中自动化方法至少一种优于人工基线。真实工作负载中，MLA 延迟降低 8.68%，Qwen3-Next 训练步骤加速 4.70×，DeepSeek-V4 Sparse Attention 达到 2.36×至 7.85×。这些结果显示闭环反馈与结构化搜索比零样本生成显著可靠，但 Auto 的多次运行波动较大，且部分任务上 Parallel 与 Beam 存在明显取舍。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，多智能体 LLM 配合真实编译器反馈、冻结正确性测试和硬件剖析，可以自动生成达到或超过专家水平的 TPU 内核；结构化搜索能显著提高编译率、正确率与性能上限。图式搜索优于单轨迹 Auto 的关键不在搜索算法本身，而在于将代码生成转化为持久化、可回滚、可并行的状态搜索。不过，论文仍主要使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 TPU v6e，部分容差达到 0.1，并且未报告成本、能耗、跨硬件泛化、不同 LLM 的消融，因此结论应视为特定生态下的强工程验证，而非普适最优解。

title: Towards a universal language of concepts: A survey
comment: Originally completed as an M.S. capstone project at UCLA in 2022
summary: Humans can learn and generalize novel concepts from sparse data because they express knowledge in rich structural formats. In this paper, we propose that programs are a strong candidate for universal representation of concepts. We review computational models of concept learning that use programs as their concept representation and evaluate their contribution toward a universal representational language.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述类论文，提出"程序（programs）"是概念（concepts）的通用表征形式，并综述了认知科学与人工智能领域中以程序作为概念表征的计算模型，评估其在构建"概念的通用语言"方面的进展与不足。
AI.motivation: 人类能够从极少的数据中学习并泛化新概念，这得益于其将知识以丰富的结构化形式进行表征。然而，关于人类心智究竟采用何种表征形式来支持概念的存储、检索、组合与更新，学界尚无统一答案。本文旨在探讨一种能同时满足模块性、抽象性、状态变化、因果性和不确定性等需求的通用概念表征，并系统评估现有计算模型。
AI.method:
1. 概念表征的所需属性分析：从人类认知发展（婴儿从稀疏数据中快速学习与泛化）出发，归纳出理想概念表征需具备的属性——模块性、抽象性、时间状态变化、因果性与不确定性。
2. 程序表征的形式化定义：通过 Python/C 语言示例说明程序由符号序列构成，由形式语法（CFG、PCFG）赋予语法与语义，指出程序是其他结构化表征（图、逻辑等）的超集。
3. 程序与所需属性的对应：论证程序如何天然满足模块性（函数/类）、抽象性（变量绑定）、状态变化（变量重写）、因果性（函数输入输出关系）和不确定性（概率程序）。
4. 现有计算模型的分类综述：将现有工作分为两大类：
   - (a) 概念作为其所有实例的集合：由语法/概率程序生成实例集，包括 Rational Rules 模型（Goodman 等）、Bongard 问题的 PCFG（Depeweg 等）、PRCG 与潜谓词网络（Rule 等）、谓词逻辑组合语言（Kemp）、Bayesian Program Learning（Lake 等）、层级语言思维模型（Overlan 等）、DSL 表征（Mao 等；Lázaro-Gredilla 等）。
   - (b) 概念作为相互依赖程序的集合：基于组合逻辑（Combinatory Logic）及其变体，如 S&K 组合子（Piantadosi）、加入路由器 B/C/S 的概率语法（Liang 等；Dechter 等）。
5. 整合分析：对比两类方法的优劣，指出通用表征需结合二者优势。
AI.result:
1. 程序具备作为通用概念表征的关键属性：模块性、抽象性、状态变化、因果性、不确定性均可通过程序结构（如函数、类、变量、概率生成模型）实现。
2. 两类现有表征各有所长：
   - 概念作为实例集的工作（如 Bayesian Program Learning）在 Omniglot 字符一次性学习任务中达到人类水平并超越深度学习模型，但依赖领域特定原语和较大训练集。
   - 概念作为相互依赖程序的工作（如基于组合逻辑）所需先验最少，理论上可通用，但搜索空间巨大且难以解释。
3. 主要不足：表示与算法的耦合问题尚未解决；两类方法无法单独满足通用性——实例集方法需预定义原语，组合逻辑方法缺乏概率性且难以表达实例。
4. 未来方向：将组合逻辑发展为跨多领域的概率程序，并深入研究表征对算法效率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 程序是概念通用表征的有力候选。现有计算模型分别在"概念作为实例集合"和"概念作为相互依赖程序"两条路径上推进了对概念表征的理解，但二者均存在局限。终极的通用概念表征需融合两者的优势：以组合逻辑的组合能力为基础，同时引入概率性以支持实例生成，从而实现跨领域的概念学习与泛化。

title: Data-Driven Discovery of Composition-Dependent Constitutive Models for Hyperelasticity and Viscoelasticity of Digital Materials
comment: 40 pages including references, 9 figures in the main manuscript. Supplementary material is available upon request from the corresponding author
summary: Digital materials fabricated by multi-material 3D printing are designed as controlled mixtures of stiff and compliant constituents, yielding effective responses that span more than an order of magnitude in apparent stiffness and exhibit strongly nonlinear, composition-dependent, and rate-dependent dissipative behavior. Classical finite-strain viscoelastic models represent such behavior with closed-form strain energy functions for equilibrium and non-equilibrium stresses as well as evolution of internal variables, which may limit flexibility when a single constitutive model is expected to generalize across materials and loading rates. Here, we present a data-driven multi-material constitutive modeling framework that generalizes a formulation by Bergström and Boyce. The proposed framework retains the structure of the classical model, namely multiplicative kinematics, invariant-based strain-energy functions, and a scalar dissipative evolution law directed along the normalized nonequilibrium deviatoric stress. For the equilibrium branch, the data-driven discovery framework either directly predicts closed-form model parameters as functions of composition or automatically constructs a polyconvex strain-energy function using neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs). The nonequilibrium branch kinetics are learned similarly, either by directly identifying closed-form parameters across compositions or by using appropriately constrained artificial neural networks. Using multi-rate uniaxial compression data across multiple material compositions, we show that the proposed formulation captures rate-dependent stiffness and hysteresis across compositions while preserving thermodynamic consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架，在Bergström-Boyce经典有限应变黏弹性模型结构基础上，融合闭合式解析模型与神经网络（NODE、ANN），以准确预测多材料3D打印数字材料在不同配比与加载速率下的率相关刚度与滞回行为，同时保证热力学一致性。
AI.motivation: 多材料3D打印数字材料由刚性与柔性组分混合而成，其有效刚度跨越一个数量级以上，且表现出强烈的非线性、配比依赖与率相关耗散特性。经典有限应变黏弹性本构依赖于闭合式应变能函数和内变量演化方程，难以在单一模型下同时泛化不同材料与加载速率；因此需要一种更灵活的数据驱动方法来扩展其适用范围。
AI.method: 在Bergström-Boyce模型基础上保留乘性运动学、不变量应变能函数与沿归一化非平衡偏应力的标量耗散演化律。平衡分支：通过数据驱动发现框架直接预测闭合式模型参数随配比变化，或利用神经常微分方程（NODE）自动构造polyconvex应变能函数。非平衡分支：通过直接辨识跨配比闭合式参数或使用受约束的人工神经网络（ANN）学习动力学。多速率单轴压缩实验数据用于训练与验证。
AI.result: 所提出的混合框架能够准确捕捉不同配比下的率相关刚度与滞回特性，并保持热力学一致性。闭合式参数化与神经网络（NODE、约束ANN）两种学习策略均有效，为多材料数字材料提供了灵活且物理一致的本构描述。
AI.conclusion: 该数据驱动多材料本构建模框架成功将经典黏弹性模型结构与现代机器学习方法结合，实现了对3D打印数字材料跨配比、跨速率行为的精确预测与良好泛化，同时确保热力学一致性。

title: From Answers to Interpretations: Rethinking Ambiguity-Induced Aleatoric Uncertainty Estimation in LLMs
summary: A key challenge in reliable LLM deployment is recognizing when uncertainty reflects irreducible variability in the task rather than limitations in the model's knowledge. In language tasks, a central source of such aleatoric uncertainty is input ambiguity or underspecification, where multiple interpretations remain plausible. Existing decomposition methods estimate aleatoric uncertainty by generating multiple clarifications of the input, querying the model for an answer under each clarification, and comparing the resulting answers. We argue that answers are not necessary for identifying ambiguity: they are often redundant, add avoidable cost, and can mislead through epistemic leakage. We support this claim theoretically, and propose a clarification-only approach that estimates this ambiguity-induced component directly from the space of plausible interpretations, without answers to the clarified inputs. Using ambiguity detection as an operational evaluation across three benchmarks, this direct approach improves AUROC (63.34 vs. 60.85), reduces computational cost by 4-26x in output tokens and 2.2-3.5x in API calls, and yields estimates with substantially lower correlation with epistemic uncertainty. Overall, our results suggest that ambiguity-induced aleatoric uncertainty is better estimated from the interpretation space than from the response space.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了现有基于"生成答案"来估计大语言模型（LLM）中模糊性诱导的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）的方法，提出直接从澄清（clarification）所揭示的"解释空间"（interpretation space）出发来估计不确定性，无需生成模型答案。
AI.motivation: 在 LLM 部署中，可靠性至关重要。现有不确定性分解方法（如 Clarification Ensembling 和 Spectral Decomposition）通过生成多个澄清并比较模型答案来估计偶然不确定性，但这种方法存在两个问题：(1) 答案会引入目标模型的认知偏差（epistemic leakage），导致冗余、抑制或膨胀；(2) 计算成本高昂。因此，作者希望找到更直接、更高效的不确定性估计方式。
AI.method: 作者提出"仅澄清"（clarification-only）管道，包含四个阶段：(1) 澄清生成：使用 LLM 对输入生成多个可能的澄清（解释方式）；(2) 语义聚类：将语义等价的澄清合并为不同的"解释簇"；(3) 似然估计（可选）：用 LLM 估计各解释的相对合理性；(4) 统计聚合：在解释分布上计算熵、Gini 不纯度或变异比等指标，作为不确定性分数。主要变体为 CO-SemEnt（语义聚类+熵）和 CO-SemEnt+Like（加入似然加权）。理论上通过三个命题形式化证明答案的冗余性、抑制性和膨胀性。
AI.result: 在三个基准（AmbigQA、AmbigVQA、AMBROSIA）上，使用 Claude-Sonnet-4.5、GPT-OSS-120B 和 Llama-3.2-90B 进行实验：宏观平均 AUROC 从 60.85 提升至 63.34；输出 token 减少 4–26 倍，API 调用减少 2.2–3.5 倍；AU 与 EU 的相关性显著降低（62% 的设置中 |ρ| 显著下降）；下游澄清策略中 CO-SemEnt 准确率最高（0.683）。消融实验表明语义聚类和似然加权均带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于由输入模糊性诱导的偶然不确定性，直接从解释空间估计优于从响应空间估计。该方法在提升性能的同时大幅降低计算成本，并减少与认知不确定性的耦合。未来可探索将解释作为不确定性估计核心对象，并扩展到交互式、多轮场景中的下游决策指导。

title: IPGeoAI: Transformer-Based Geolocation with LLM Semantic Fusion
summary: Accurate city-level IP Geolocation is an important enabler for the modern digital ecosystem, underpinning services ranging from local content delivery and targeting to digital rights enforcement. However, traditional heuristic and database-driven methods often struggle to resolve the complex, non-linear allocation patterns of modern network infrastructures, particularly within the exploding IPv6 address space and transient mobile networks. In this paper, we introduce IPGeoAI, a novel deep learning model architecture that reframes geolocation from a static lookup problem to a sequential modeling task. Our approach utilizes the Transformer Encoder to capture hierarchical dependencies inherent in IP subnet structures. We propose a method to resolve geographic ambiguity by integrating unstructured semantic context via a Zero-Shot LLM Feature Extraction pipeline. We utilize Large Language Models to transform raw, noisy Autonomous Systems (AS) descriptions into structured, domain-specific metadata (such as 'University' vs. 'ISP' or 'Global' vs. 'Local') via an offline pre-computation process. By fusing these semantic signals into the network via a Multi-Head Cross-Attention module, we bridge the gap between numerical network topology and real-world semantic identity. Extensive offline evaluation on a proprietary dataset spanning 200,000 cities demonstrates that IPGeoAI significantly outperforms a leading external vendor in city-level granularity. By adopting a hierarchical inference strategy that refines coarse-grained country signals, our model achieves a 6% improvement in city-level accuracy while extending coverage to 100% of the traffic. Furthermore, in large-scale online production tests, the model drove a statistically significant +0.35% improvement in our 1st-tier downstream use cases metric.

AI.tldr: IPGeoAI 是一种基于 Transformer 编码器的 IP 城市级地理定位深度学习架构，通过将 IP 地址视为分层序列并融合由大语言模型（LLM）零样本提取的 ASN 语义元数据，使用多头跨注意力机制实现多模态特征融合。模型在 20 万城市的离线评测中比第三方供应商城市级准确率提升 6%，并在 13 天大规模在线 A/B 测试中使一线下游用例指标提升 +0.35%。
AI.motivation: 传统基于启发式和静态数据库的 IP 地理定位方法在 IPv6 空间、瞬态移动网络等长尾场景下覆盖率和泛化能力不足；现有基于 GNN 和主动测量的方法虽学术上达到 SOTA，但因需要主动探测基础设施、冷启动问题严重、推理延迟过高，无法在超大规模生产环境中实时部署。因此需要一种被动、低延迟、具备强泛化能力且能覆盖长尾 IP 段的城市级定位方案。
AI.method: 1) 数据：使用 7 天滑动窗口聚合 IP-GPS 日志构建稳定 ground truth，覆盖约 20 万城市；2) 特征：除 ASN 与连接类型外，设计 Zero-Shot LLM 特征抽取管线，从 ASN 名称、WHOIS 等生成 9 维语义元数据（组织身份、使用画像、拓扑层级等）；3) 模型：将 IP 字节（IPv4=4、IPv6=16）通过可学习嵌入 + 位置编码输入 16 层 Transformer 编码器，MeanPool 得到 IP 表示；元数据各自经嵌入映射为 context bank；4) 融合：以 IP 向量为 Query、元数据为 K/V 的多头跨注意力 + 残差 + LayerNorm；5) 分类头输出 ~20 万城市 logits，Cross-Entropy（label smoothing=0.1）；6) 分层推理：取 Top-K=100 候选，以第三方国家信号为硬约束过滤后再取 argmax。训练用 8×H100、FSDP、BF16 混合精度、AdamW、OneCycleLR，10 epochs。
AI.result: 离线测试：城市级准确率 36.47%（第三方基线 30.09%），区域级 79.21%（基线 76.63%）；IPv6 上城市准确率 36.46% 显著优于基线 29.58%，但 IPv4 仍落后（45.01%→36.87%）；City Acc@100km 达 36.82%。消融实验逐步验证：MLP 31.76% → 静态特征 Transformer 32.19% → 序列字节 Transformer 33.36% → 注意力融合 35.70% → 语义增强 36.47%。LLM 软标签与 PeeringDB 一致率约 76–80%。在线 13 天 A/B 测试：一线下游用例指标统计显著提升 +0.35%，覆盖 100% 流量。
AI.conclusion: IPGeoAI 验证了将 IP 地址建模为分层序列并融合 LLM 提取语义元数据可显著提升城市级地理定位精度和长尾泛化能力，并通过 O(1) 推理复杂度实现在超规模生产环境中的可部署性；分层国家约束进一步保证了地理一致性。未来工作将面向端到端实时推理、完全替代第三方国家信号，以及从国家到邮编乃至超细粒度地理瓦片的全层级建模。

title: Reducing Hallucinated Transcripts in Whisper via Hallucination Space Projection
summary: Whisper is a widely used foundation model for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its generative decoder can produce fluent hallucinated transcripts for inputs containing little or no speech. We propose a training-free, inference-time method to reduce these hallucinations using low-rank projection of decoder activations. A compact hallucination-associated subspace is estimated from non-speech calibration data, and decoder hidden states are projected away from this subspace during inference. We evaluate two variants: always-on, which applies projection to all inputs, and gated, which applies it only when Whisper predicts that an input is likely non-speech. Across non-speech benchmarks, always-on projection reduces average hallucination rate (HR) from 31.31% to 2.44%, a 92.21% relative reduction, while gated projection reduces HR to 3.74%, an 88.05% relative reduction, with lower false rejection of genuine speech. On LibriSpeech, gated projection increases absolute word error rate (WER) by 0.33-4.39 percentage points and yields false-rejection rates (FRR) of 0.41--9.97% across model and split settings. These results show that low-rank activation projection can substantially suppress Whisper hallucinations without retraining, while providing a controllable trade-off between hallucination suppression and speech recognition performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过低秩投影抑制Whisper在非语音音频上产生的流畅幻觉转录。该方法从非语音校准数据中估计一个紧凑的"幻觉关联子空间"，并在推理时将解码器隐藏状态投影远离该子空间，从而显著降低幻觉率，同时保持对真实语音的识别能力。
AI.motivation: Whisper作为广泛使用的ASR基础模型，其生成式解码器在输入为非语音音频（静音、音乐、环境声等）时仍会产生流畅但无中生有的转录文本。这种系统性失败模式可能导致下游系统将幻觉内容误认为真实转录，尤其在Koenecke等人（2024）指出约1%的Whisper转录包含无依据内容、其中约38%为潜在有害或误导性表述的情况下，问题尤为严重。现有缓解方法各有局限：依赖外部VAD、仅做输出后处理、或需要微调训练，亟需一种轻量、无需训练且不依赖外部模块的推理时干预方法。
AI.method: 方法分三阶段：(1) 校准阶段——从非语音数据中收集两组解码器隐藏表示：一组为产生幻觉转录的样本，一组为被正确拒绝（空转录）的样本；构造激活差矩阵Δ_ℓ，对每层做SVD，取前r个右奇异向量构成低秩投影基B_ℓ,r。(2) 推理阶段——对解码器隐藏状态h_ℓ做低秩投影：h̃_ℓ = h_ℓ − α(h_ℓ B_ℓ,rᵀ) B_ℓ,r，移除幻觉关联方向的成分。(3) 门控机制——仅当Whisper自身预测的无语音概率p_ns^base ≥ 门控阈值γ时才施加投影，避免对清晰语音造成扰动。投影强度α和子空间秩r是关键超参数，通过ESC-50开发集与LibriSpeech验证集联合选择。
AI.result: 在Whisper large-v3上，always-on投影将平均幻觉率从31.31%降至2.44%（相对降低92.21%），gated投影降至3.74%（相对降低88.05%）。在ESC-50、UrbanSound8K、FSD50K三个非语音数据集上均展现强跨数据集泛化能力，提示所识别的子空间捕捉的是可复用的解码器级幻觉签名而非数据集特异的声学特性。在LibriSpeech上，gated投影使绝对WER仅增加0.33–4.39个百分点，FRR为0.41–9.97%，而always-on投影的WER/FRR代价显著更高。门控机制显著优于always-on：large-v3上gated FRR仅1.40–2.86%，而always-on达10.50–11.47%。与基线对比：BoH短语过滤效果有限（HR仍达38.75%/75.41%/18.11%），WhisperX VAD平均HR降至5.24%，本方法gated投影达4.09%、always-on达0.85%，且无需外部VAD或短语表。消融实验显示：默认τ=0.6为最佳阈值；多层投影可进一步降低HR但代价是WER和FRR显著上升。
AI.conclusion: 低秩解码器激活投影是一种有效的推理时干预手段，可在不更新模型参数、不依赖外部模块的前提下大幅抑制Whisper在非语音音频上的幻觉。方法提供HR–WER–FRR可控权衡：always-on适合极低幻觉容忍场景，gated适合兼顾幻觉抑制与语音保真度的实际部署。幻觉关联子空间的存在表明Whisper解码器中存在可被定位和操控的幻觉方向。局限包括：聚焦非语音场景，长音频、多语种、声学模糊等其他幻觉类型未涵盖；子空间估计依赖校准分布，部署偏移需进一步评估；门控变体部分依赖Whisper内部无语音概率的可靠性。

title: La Agente Óptima: Towards Agentic Self-Driving Laboratories
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) combine automated experimentation with adaptive decision-making to accelerate scientific discovery. Their operation nevertheless often depends on human specialists who translate scientific objectives into executable closed-loop campaigns. Specialists adjust them as data and operating conditions change. Here, we present La Agente Óptima, an agentic framework that constructs and supervises Bayesian optimization campaigns across computational and experimental systems while maintaining a persistent optimization state. By separating large language model (LLM) reasoning from executed campaigns, Óptima runs repetitive optimization loops consistently, returns control to the agent only when progress requires interpretation or campaign revision, and keeps every decision auditable. We evaluate Óptima across ablation studies, five digital discovery tasks, and two physical platforms. Throughout, Óptima maintained executable campaigns as both the scientific problem and execution environment evolved. In a closed-loop contact angle optimization campaign, Óptima identified and corrected a mid-run measurement failure, bringing the contact angle from 71.4 to 67.8 degrees, just above the 64-66 degree range. From this result, Óptima correctly inferred that the target was likely unattainable with the available reagents and recommended changing the formulation. In a five-day multi-objective flow-chemistry campaign, Óptima increased the yield from 30% to 59% over 23 experiments. Despite substantial inference costs, it cost less and used substantially less starting material than a human-directed campaign, while selecting a more mass-efficient operating point. These results show that LLM-based agents can make rigorous, long-running optimization campaigns accessible to domain scientists without specialist setup, expanding the scope of SDLs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为La Agente Óptima的智能体框架，能够自主构建并监督跨计算与实验系统的贝叶斯优化（BO）活动，通过分离大语言模型推理与可执行活动，使领域科学家无需专业知识即可运行长时优化活动。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDL）在部署BO活动时面临两大障碍：一是需要BO专家手动配置和维护优化活动；二是人类推理随着活动规模扩大而成为瓶颈，限制了SDL的可扩展性。该研究旨在通过LLM智能体降低BO的使用门槛并实现长时半自主运行。
AI.method: 该框架通过智能体架构实现：协调智能体解读科学目标，BO专家子智能体编写和验证Python活动程序，BO-MCP服务负责管理优化器状态和提供BO即服务。活动程序作为受监控的后台任务执行重复的BO循环，仅在需要科学判断时将控制权返回给智能体。该方法在五个数字发现任务和两个物理平台（RAISE接触角测量平台和RoboChem-Flex流动化学平台）上进行了评估。
AI.result: 在消融研究中，提出的Specialist-script架构在Ackley 6D基准测试中表现最佳（MBSF@60为0.442）。在数字发现任务中，有机固态激光材料的多目标BO活动将超体积从0.791提升至1.038，MOF设计中识别并修正了搜索空间表示缺陷。在物理实验中，RAISE接触角优化将接触角从71.4°降至67.8°，识别出中段测量失败并建议更换配方；RoboChem-Flex五日流动化学活动将产率从30%提升至59%（23次实验中），比人类指导活动成本低13%且原料消耗更少，同时选择了更高质量效率的操作点。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明LLM智能体可以使严格、长时运行的优化活动对领域科学家变得可及，无需专家设置即可扩展SDL的范围。智能体能够诊断和修复活动中的故障，在科学问题演变时保持活动完整性，并通过分离推理与执行实现可审计的决策。该框架代表了一种通用的优化层，使研究人员能够用自然语言指定目标，由智能体选择和配置适当的实验设计方法。

title: Extremely Sparse Supervision Incentivizes Reasoning Ability
summary: Large language models demonstrate increasingly strong reasoning capabilities through effective post-training. Yet, prevailing post-training methods optimize over massive numbers of tokens, implicitly assuming that effective learning must be token-intensive. We revisit this assumption in the on-policy distillation (OPD) setting, which naturally admits dense teacher supervision at every generated token. Using the Qwen3 family, we discover a counter-intuitive phenomenon: reasoning can be effectively incentivized by an extremely small fraction of generated tokens--as few as one or two tokens per reasoning trajectory, corresponding to only 0.05% of all tokens. Surprisingly, this sparse supervision in most cases matches or surpasses full-token training in improving reasoning ability, despite excluding the vast majority of generated tokens from the training objective. This phenomenon is consistently observed across nine teacher--student configurations spanning different model scales on mathematical reasoning tasks, and is further validated on coding reasoning, Llama models and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR). Interestingly, such extremely sparse supervision may be closer to the natural learning process: rather than correcting every step word by word, one reflects on a few critical reasoning steps, updates prior understanding, and continues the trial-and-error, avoiding micro-level corrections while remaining remarkably effective. Overall, our results challenge the assumption that effective post-training must be token-intensive and point to a new direction for understanding and designing more efficient post-training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"后训练必须密集、依赖大量token"这一传统假设，发现在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，每条推理轨迹仅监督1-2个token（约占总token的0.05%）即可有效甚至优于全token密集监督来提升推理能力。该现象在9组Qwen3师生配置、数学/代码推理、Llama模型以及PPO-RLVR中均得到验证。
AI.motivation: 当前主流LLM后训练方法（如RLHF、RLVR、OPD）通常涉及大量token的优化，隐含假设是有效学习必须是token密集型的。本文质疑这一假设，研究OPD中token级密集监督的必要性，探索极稀疏监督是否同样甚至更有效地激励推理能力。
AI.method: 在OPD框架中引入token掩码m_t，仅保留少量token的梯度贡献。设计了多种稀疏OPD变体：rand1tok（随机选1个token）、mintok/maxtok（选奖励最低/最高的token）、minmaxtok（同时选奖励最低和最高的2个token）、randmask 0.1%、pctltail 0.05%（选奖励分布尾部token）。在Qwen3家族上构建9组师生配置（大教师/小学生、同尺度、小教师/大学生），并扩展至代码推理、Llama模型及PPO算法。评估指标包括pass@k、avg@8、反向KL散度及参数冻结率。
AI.result: 1）在所有9组Qwen3师生配置中，每轨迹仅监督1个随机token（rand1tok）即可持续提升学生推理能力；选择极端奖励token（mintok/maxtok/minmaxtok）通常能匹配甚至超越全token密集OPD（9组中7组超越，2组匹配）。2）监督稀疏度与性能呈非单调关系：极度稀疏时性能可恢复并超越密集监督。3）最佳稀疏变体常增加而非减小师生间反向KL散度，表明推理提升不能简单归因于模仿教师。4）极稀疏监督仅更新约10%的模型参数。5）表达能力强的学生（同尺度或大学生配置）从高奖励token（maxtok）获益更多，而表达能力弱的学生（大学生/小教师配置）从低奖励token（mintok）获益更多。6）该现象在代码推理、Llama家族以及PPO中均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 有效的后训练不一定需要token密集型监督。极少量的token级监督（每轨迹1-2个token）即可产生与密集监督相当甚至更优的推理提升效果，挑战了OPD有效性源于密集token级监督的传统观点。这为设计更高效、更节省内存的后训练算法开辟了新方向，并暗示自然学习过程更接近于"反思关键推理步骤"而非"逐字纠正每一步"。

title: Does the Selected Object Reach the Reader? Auditing Identity Handoffs in Grounded Language-Model Pipelines
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 23 tables. Accepted to the GroundLM Workshop (Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Grounded language-model pipelines can be divided into three stages: selecting an object, retrieving passages for it, and using that evidence to answer. If the selected object must reach the reader, losing it breaks the handoff. Benchmark recall checks the dataset-linked object, which can differ. We audit 600 HybridQA questions across three selector families. On 1,463 resolvable records where the selected object matches the dataset-traced passage, exact key lookup and exact title matching return the object every time. With every ranked rule given the same decoded selected title, body-only BM25 omits it on 389 records (26.6%) at cutoff five, while hybrid retrieval with reranking omits it on 14 (1.0%). The two identities differ on 329 of 1,792 resolvable records. With original-question rankings, their top-five checks disagree on 106 records (5.9%). Frozen reader comparisons associate the aligned object's presence with 28.6 to 31.0 points higher exact match. In a deliberately selected 64-item cohort, removing that passage sharply lowers exact match, while removing a similar-length comparison passage does not reproduce the drop. We release the Returned-Object Profile (ROP), an executable record of the target, returned-ID field, cutoff, membership rule, and complete expected population, with data and an offline replay.

AI.tldr: 本文审计基于语言模型的接地（grounded）QA流水线中"选择对象ID→检索→阅读器"这一身份交接（identity handoff）环节，提出返回对象轮廓（Returned-Object Profile, ROP）方法与可执行评估框架，量化在哪些规则下所选对象会从阅读器的top-k证据列表中丢失，并发布可离线复现的数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 接地语言模型流水线通常分为三阶段：选择对象、检索该对象的证据、阅读器基于证据作答。当接口要求所选对象必须保留在阅读器上下文中时，仅报告数据集级的top-k召回率无法区分选择错误、身份交接断裂还是阅读器利用证据失败，因此需要一种针对"选择对象是否到达读者"这一边界的专项审计方法。
AI.method: 定义U为上游选择的对象ID、G为HybridQA数据集链接的段落ID，将top-k证据列表中是否包含U定义为"选择对象返回（selected-object return）"，包含G则为"数据集追踪召回（dataset-trace recall）"，通过同一冻结排序在四种查询形式（原始问题、直接改写、检索事实、解码标题）与五种检索栈（BM25三变体、BGE-M3、ColBERTv2、RRF、混合+重排序）下进行对照；引入Returned-Object Profile (ROP) v1 schema与参考评估器，将目标、身份解析器、返回ID字段、cutoff、期望总体、any/all成员规则、记录裁决与运行状态全部以JSON声明+SHA-256绑定，并区分PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIABLE/INVALID/MISSING等七种记录裁决与五种运行状态；在HybridQA上由三种模型家族（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview）各处理600题得到1,800条记录，并在64项高对比队列上做对齐段落的删除实验。
AI.result: 在1,463条U=G的可解析记录上，精确键查找与精确标题匹配100%返回所选对象；body-only BM25在cutoff=5时丢失389条（26.6%），而混合+重排序仅丢失14条（1.0%）；329条U≠G的可解析记录上，原始问题BM25的U检查与G检查在106/1,792条（5.9%）上结果不同，解码标题查询下差异扩大到213条；冻结阅读器对比显示共享对象存在时EM提升28.6–31.0分（关联性）；64项预选高对比队列上，删除对齐段落使EM下降77.6分，而删除同长度非追踪段落不重现该下降（sham-drop与intact差异包含0）。
AI.conclusion: 身份交接规则（精确查找 vs. 排序检索）显著影响所选对象能否保留在阅读器证据中，即使查询直接命名所选对象亦如此；数据集追踪召回与选择对象返回度量不同组件，分开报告能明确分数指向哪个环节；ROP将文档化的"所选对象必须返回"要求转为完整运行测试，结合冻结排序与SHA-256绑定可离线复现全部聚合结果，为接地流水线提供可执行的接口级审计手段。

title: $τ^τ$-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
summary: LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce $\tau^\tau$-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a business actually keeps, a client who holds requirements, a production API that operations must run through, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models: the same starting point a real engagement provides. From these it must deliver a complete customer-service agent, scored by deploying that agent against held-out simulated users. Across 53 tasks spanning four domains, the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations. Meanwhile, an expert-authored reference ceiling scores 82.2%.
