AI.conclusion: GRPO结合融合SARI与惩罚项的奖励函数能有效提升LLM在加泰罗尼亚语ATS任务上的表现，特别是在抑制过度生成等不良行为方面效果显著。然而，跨语言迁移的成功高度依赖于训练数据的质量：仅在原始英文ASSET上训练带来了跨领域（iDEM）的显著增益，表明英语简化能力可能部分迁移至加泰罗尼亚语；而机器翻译版本未能复现这一效果，可能因翻译过程改变了原文的简化特性。当前方法的局限在于依赖参考语料和SARI指标，未来的工作应聚焦于开发适用于低资源语言的无参考简化指标，以充分发挥RL的优势。

title: MABPD: Multi-Agent Bias Probing & Detection via Structured Argument Debate
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Code: this https URL
summary: Media bias in news articles operates through subtle linguistic cues---loaded language, selective framing, and strategic omission---that resist single-model detection and have traditionally required large annotated corpora for supervised training. We ask whether structured multi-agent deliberation can serve as a principled, training-free alternative to supervised classification for this task. We introduce MABPD (Multi-Agent Bias Probing & Detection), a pipeline in which three specialized LLM agents analyze an article from complementary perspectives and resolve disagreements through a Structured Argument Debate (SAD) protocol. SAD implements a domain-motivated asymmetric burden of proof---biased claims without grounded textual evidence carry zero weight---combined with role-weighted voting and post-consensus verification, replacing task-specific supervised decision boundaries with explicit deliberative structure. Ablation confirms that this structured deliberation, not mere agent parallelism, drives performance: removing the debate module reduces F1 by up to 10.6 points. On the BABE benchmark (4,121 expert-annotated sentences), MABPD achieves 83.4% macro F1 on the held-out test split---within 0.7 percentage points (pp) of the supervised SOTA (MAGPIE, 84.1% macro F1; Horych et al., 2024)---without any task-specific training or threshold tuning on annotated data. Cross-dataset evaluation on the SemEval 2019 HyperPartisan corpus (644 articles) yields 75.0% zero-shot accuracy, within 7.2 pp of the supervised SOTA accuracy (82.2%; Kiesel et al. 2019), confirming transfer across annotation regimes. We release the full pipeline and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MABPD（多智能体偏见探测与检测）框架，通过结构化论证辩论（SAD）协议，利用三个专业化LLM智能体（偏见、证据、框架）以零样本方式检测新闻文章中的媒体偏见。在BABE基准上达到83.4%宏F1，与监督式SOTA（MAGPIE 84.1%）仅差0.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 媒体偏见通过加载语言、选择性框架和策略性省略等微妙语言线索运作，传统监督学习方法依赖大量标注语料且泛化能力差。研究旨在探索结构化多智能体辩论是否能作为有原则的、无需训练的替代方案来应对偏见检测任务。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：1）预处理；2）三个功能隔离的智能体分析（BiasAgent先运行，EvidenceAgent和FramingAgent独立运行）；3）三路径共识引擎（中性否决、强偏见快速路径、完整SAD辩论），SAD协议实现非对称举证责任——无文本证据的偏见声明权重为零；4）非对称验证器（仅允许biased→neutral覆写）。使用LLaMA 3.3 70B模型。
AI.result: 在BABE基准测试集（1000句）上达到83.4%宏F1（84.7%二元F1），与监督式SOTA MAGPIE（84.1% MF1）仅差0.7个百分点；完整数据集（4121句）上86.2%二元F1。SemEval 2019 HyperPartisan跨数据集零样本准确率75.0%（距监督SOTA 7.2 pp）。消融实验显示移除辩论模块F1下降9.3-10.6点，单智能体F1下降18.6-19.5点。异构LLM实验（Mixtral 8x7B + LLaMA 3.1 8B）F1仅变化-0.1 pp。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多智能体辩论可作为媒体偏见检测中监督训练的有效替代方案。SAD协议的证据验证、举证责任机制和非对称验证器是性能提升的主要驱动力（而非单纯的智能体并行性）。系统在保留高精度的同时显著提升召回率，证明了显式审议结构对复杂语言判断任务的价值。

title: MMTClinic: Multimodal, Multilingual Time Series Question Answering and Reasoning Benchmark for Clinical Domain
summary: Time-series data in clinical settings is crucial for capturing dynamic changes in a patient's health over time, enabling timely diagnosis, personalized treatment, and early detection of critical events. However, the development of clinically reliable and linguistically inclusive medical AI systems remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the lack of multimodal, multilingual, and time-series-grounded benchmarks that reflect the complexity of real-world clinical scenarios. To fill this gap, we present MMTClinic, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning and question-answering tasks involving clinical time-series. MMTClinic combines text, medical images, and multivariate physiological signals and includes 30,000 QA pairs (15,000 multiple choice questions (MCQs) and 15,000 open-ended questions) across five languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, and Tamil. These questions cover three important clinical tasks---mortality prediction, heart rate forecasting, and SOFA score estimation. We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art LLMs in zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought settings. Our evaluation reveals notable differences in model performance across tasks, languages, and modalities, highlighting current limitations in clinical reasoning capabilities. MMTClinic provides a valuable resource for advancing multilingual, multimodal, and time-series-aware medical AI research. The dataset will be made publicly available on successful acceptance of the work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MMTClinic基准测试，这是首个面向临床领域的多模态、多语言时间序列问答与推理基准。该基准整合文本、医学图像和多变量生理信号，包含30,000个QA对（15,000个选择题和15,000个开放式问题），覆盖英语、印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语和泰米尔语五种语言，针对院内死亡率预测、心率预测和SOFA评分估计三项ICU任务。作者评估了13个最先进的LLM在零样本、少样本和思维链设置下的表现，揭示了模型在不同任务、语言和模态间的显著性能差异。
AI.motivation: 临床时间序列数据对于捕捉患者健康动态变化、实现及时诊断、个性化治疗和早期检测关键事件至关重要。然而，目前缺乏能够反映真实临床场景复杂性的多模态、多语言、基于时间序列的基准测试，这阻碍了临床可靠且语言包容的医疗AI系统的发展。现有临床时间序列推理基准存在三类局限：仅信号的选择题（缺乏临床文本和影像）、文本+时间序列数据集（缺少视觉数据和选择题格式）、综合多模态数据集（依赖开放式任务和静态影像），且均不支持多语言选择题推理。
AI.method: 数据集构建：基于2012 PhysioNet/CinC挑战赛数据集，采用半自动化流水线生成QA对。通过小时重采样生成六个生理信号的数值（.csv）和可视化（.png）表示；使用GPT-4o结合医学专家策划的少样本提示生成15,000个选择题和15,000个开放式推理QA对；通过Google Translate API翻译后由母语语言学家审查修订。评估设置：覆盖四类多模态设置（MCQ+文本+时间序列、推理+文本+时间序列、MCQ+文本+时间序列+图像、推理+文本+时间序列+图像），三种提示模式（零样本、少样本、CoT），五种语言，三项ICU任务（死亡率预测、心率预测、SOFA评分估计），评估13个LLM（包括LLMs、SLMs、RLMs、MLLMs）。质量保证：约70%的样本由四名认证医学专家独立评审（平均评分4.2-4.5），所有多语言翻译由母语语言学家审核修订。
AI.result: 1. 文本+时间序列设置中，开源推理LLM表现优异：DeepSeek-R1在MCQ和推理任务上均达到65-77%准确率，Qwen3-235B-A22B在推理任务中达到约76%。2. 多模态设置（加入图像）导致性能显著下降：GPT-4.1-nano在MCQ+图像设置中表现最佳（约46%），其他视觉语言模型降至26-32%。3. 跨语言一致性方面，大型模型（如Qwen3-235B、DeepSeek-R1-Llama-8B）在区域语言中仅下降5-10%，而小型模型（如Mistral 7B、Qwen2.5-7B）在泰米尔语和印地语中下降超过30%。4. DeepSeek-R1在所有语言和任务中一致领先（少样本准确率高达98.36%），且对CoT提示的依赖最小，表明其内在推理能力强大。5. 总体而言，开源LLM在基于文本的MCQ和推理任务中表现优异，而专有模型在复杂多模态设置中表现更佳；视觉语言推理和区域语言中的持续性能下降揭示了多模态集成和跨语言泛化的持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: MMTClinic作为一个经过临床验证的基准，为评估大语言模型在文本、生理时间序列和视觉数据跨五种语言的多模态和多语言推理能力提供了重要资源。对13个最先进模型的实验表明：虽然部分开源LLM能较好处理时间序列推理，但专有模型在复杂多模态设置中表现更佳。视觉语言推理和区域语言中的持续性能下降反映了当前模型在多模态集成和跨语言泛化方面的真实推理局限性（而非数据集缺陷）。MMTClinic为推进临床基础的多模态AI研究提供了可靠基础，未来工作方向包括：扩展语言覆盖范围、纳入更丰富的临床影像模态（如X光、CT扫描）、减少对单一数据源的依赖、改进自动翻译质量评估、纳入自由形式推理和CoT监督、以及评估解释质量和临床安全性等更全面的指标。主要局限包括仅覆盖五种印度语言、依赖单一ICU数据集、视觉模态限于线图、使用准确率作为单一评估指标等。

title: CC-Mediation: Evaluating Large Language Models for Cross-Cultural Conflict Mediation
summary: Cross-cultural mediation by large language models (LLMs) requires deciding both when to intervene and how to respond in culturally grounded conflicts. Progress on this problem has been limited by the lack of (1) mediation datasets with measurable downstream effects and (2) principled metrics for evaluating intercultural stance change. To address these gaps, we introduce CC-Mediation, a cross-cultural mediation benchmark of $1{,}661$ ten-turn dialogues grounded in the Developmental Model of Intercultural Sensitivity (DMIS), containing culturally grounded conflicts, mediation interventions, and post-intervention trajectories. We further propose two DMIS-based evaluation metrics: Trajectory AUC, which measures the persistence of intercultural improvement over time, and a signed Wasserstein-1 distance, which measures the magnitude and direction of shifts in intercultural stance. Both metrics show strong agreement with human judgment of DMIS-grounded stance shift. Using CC-Mediation, we find that current LLMs have limitations on both axes: intervention timing (when) failure stems from a positional prior that ignores dialogue content, while mediation strategy (how) failure arises from a late-layer elicitation collapse rather than a knowledge deficit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CC-Mediation基准和两种基于DMIS理论的评估指标，系统评估大语言模型在跨文化冲突调解中的能力，发现其在干预时机和调解策略生成两方面均存在显著缺陷，并通过监督微调验证了改进路径。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs在跨文化调解任务上面临两大瓶颈：一是缺乏具有可测量下游效应的调解数据集，二是缺乏原则性的跨文化立场变化评估指标。现有对话安全和审核数据集仅标注毒性、仇恨言论或规范违反，未涉及基于理论的干预策略及交互结果。
AI.method: （1）构建CC-Mediation基准：基于Bennett跨文化敏感度发展模型（DMIS），采用四阶段LLM驱动流水线（GPT-4o-mini）生成1,661个十轮对话，含文化冲突、调解干预和后干预轨迹；（2）提出两个DMIS评估指标：Trajectory AUC（用梯形法积分干预后立场进展）和有符号Wasserstein-1距离（量化立场分布位移方向与幅度）；（3）评估六个LLM在冲突检测（时机）和调解生成（内容）两轴的表现；（4）通过层间线性探针分析内部表征；（5）通过LoRA微调三款开源模型验证改进效果。
AI.result: 冲突轮次检测准确率仅11.3%–35.8%，近半数模型预测集中在前几轮（Cramér's V=0.17–0.36），证实"位置先验"主导而非依赖对话内容；调解生成AUC仅0.68–1.54，远低于真实参考值1.64；层间探针显示提示端阶段信息近天花板（D≈1.00），但生成端无指导时晚期层出现明显衰退（Δdecay≈0.13），证实"晚期层调用崩塌"而非知识缺失；监督微调将时机准确率提升至91.8%–98.1%，并在控制时机后显著提升较大骨干的Judge分数（Llama 2.90→4.69，Gemma 3.06→4.21）；五项人类验证研究确认指标与人类判断高度一致（Spearman ρ=+0.637）。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs在跨文化调解的两个维度（何时介入、如何介入）均存在严重不足，根源是时机决策上的位置先验偏差和内容生成上的晚期层表征调用失败；提出的CC-Mediation基准和双指标框架能够有效诊断这些问题，监督微调可系统性纠正时机决策，且在较大模型上显著提升调解内容质量，为会话式冲突解决AI研究提供了坚实的理论与实证基础。

title: RefactorPlatform: An Open-Source Harness for Controlled Evaluation of Repository-Scale Refactoring Agents
summary: Repository-scale refactoring requires coding agents to propagate a single change across many interdependent files without altering program behavior, yet to our knowledge no existing harness isolates the design choices that determine agent success on this task. We present RefactorPlatform, an open-source evaluation harness that holds the environment fixed and varies each design axis explicitly: model backbone (via OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot CLI), execution regime (baseline, retrieval-augmented, and multi-agent), and prompt specificity. Each run executes in an isolated workspace with live terminal streaming, per-task logging of tokens, diffs, and transcripts, AST-based verification, and exportable telemetry for audit and reproduction. Demonstrating the platform on 100 multi-file RefactorBench tasks across four model families, we illustrate the analyses it supports: AST-aware chunking outperforms naive token-window chunking by 25-30% across prompt modes, whereas naive retrieval falls below the retrieval-free baseline; a lean retrieval-augmented single agent (86%) beats the sub-agent configuration we evaluated (66%) on matched tasks with no task passing under delegation that fails under retrieval; and retrieval's accuracy gains absorb its token overhead, leaving cost per successful refactoring unchanged. RefactorPlatform is open-sourced to make refactoring-agent evaluation reproducible and auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefactorPlatform，一个开源的仓库规模重构智能体评估框架，通过固定环境变量并显式变化模型骨干、执行机制（基线/检索增强/多智能体）和提示具体性四个设计轴，实现可控且可审计的评估。在100个多文件RefactorBench任务上跨四个模型家族的实验表明：AST感知分块比朴素分块提升25-30pp；精简的检索增强单智能体（86%）优于子智能体配置（66%）；检索的精度提升恰好抵消其令牌开销，每成功重构成本基本不变。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在仓库规模重构中表现不足，源于"结构性盲视"——单智能体视野有限，RAG管道多为基于示例而非结构化发现，多智能体系统又因交接开销而表现不一。然而缺乏标准化评估基础设施来隔离检索、提示、编排和模型路由等设计选择的影响。
AI.method: 构建RefactorPlatform评估框架，包含：(1)四个独立可配置设计轴——模型选择（OpenRouter/Copilot CLI）、执行机制（三层累积：S1基线终端助手、S2基于MCP的任务作用域结构检索、S3原生子智能体委托）、提示模式（Descriptive/Base/Lazy三级特异性）、目标基准（RefactorBench/SWE-Refactor）；(2)隔离工作空间、实时终端流、逐任务令牌/diff/日志记录；(3)AST验证管道——Python通过AST单元测试，Java通过提取-编译-测试-RefactoringMiner四重门控；(4)评估指标为任务通过率（PR_task，全AST测试通过才计1分）和成本效率（CE，总成本/成功任务数）。在qwen3.6-flash上做全因子消融，再跨四个模型家族做S1 vs S2对比。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) AST感知分块在所有提示模式下比朴素分块提升25-30pp（Descriptive 86% vs 57%，Base 74% vs 44%，Lazy 56% vs 31%）；(2) 提示质量是单一最大指标——从Descriptive降至Lazy导致S1基线下降25pp；(3) LSP强制仅带来平均+3.7pp边际收益；(4) S2检索增强单智能体（86%）全面优于S3子智能体（66%），且呈现完全不一致模式（20个任务S2通过S3失败，反向无）；(5) 四模型家族S2平均提升9.5pp（qwen +13pp、minimax-m3 +6pp、kimi +7pp、deepseek +12pp）；(6) 检索使每任务成本上升但每成功成本不变（如deepseek $1.07→$1.23/任务，但$1.39/成功保持不变）；(7) Java SWE-Refactor上加入编译器反馈循环使gpt-5-mini通过率从20%飙升至85%；(8) 5%任务在所有配置下均失败，主因是引用传播不完整（Python失败占50.9%，Java编译失败占73.5%）。
AI.conclusion: RefactorPlatform填补了仓库规模重构智能体可控评估的基础设施空白，证明了结构感知（AST分块）是检索有效性的核心机制，而多智能体委托因通信开销反不如精简单智能体。开源框架使重构智能体评估可复现、可审计，并支持扩展至新基准、验证门控和编排机制。

authors: Cardiovascular Risk of the Italian Society of Hypertension
title: Adaptation Interfaces for In-Context Tabular Foundation Models in Time-to-Event Prediction
summary: Tabular foundation models (TabFMs) achieve strong performance on structured data, particularly for standard classification and regression problems. Yet, extending them to censored time-to-event prediction is challenging because it requires properly handling censoring and event-time dynamics. Building on our prior work, we further link TabFMs with CoxPH and DeepHit and revise the context-resampled training procedure. We evaluate temporal zero-shot reformulation, classification-based fine-tuning, and survival-head adaptation using frozen TabFM backbones on 74 single-risk data sets, and we additionally study 4 competing-risk data sets. Zero-shot inference is effective on smaller single-risk data sets, whereas supervised adaptation becomes increasingly advantageous as data sets scale. Cox provides the most reliably strong interface, especially for Integrated Brier Score (IBS) on larger data sets. DeepHit is relatively stronger for the time-dependent Concordance Index than for IBS, while cause-specific MTLR ranks highest among the TabFM survival heads in the four-data-set competing-risk analysis. Classification fine-tuning becomes more competitive with zero-shot inference as data sets grow but remains weaker for probabilistic prediction. Overall, our results indicate that effective TabFM transfer depends on the data regime and on the statistical structure represented by the chosen adaptation interface. The implementation scripts used for this work are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: This paper systematically investigates how to transfer generic tabular foundation models (TabFMs) to censored time-to-event prediction by comparing three adaptation interfaces over frozen TabFM backbones. Across 74 single-risk and 4 competing-risk datasets, the authors find that no single interface dominates universally; instead, optimal performance depends on data regime and evaluation metric, with Cox being strongest for IBS, DeepHit for discrimination, and cause-specific MTLR ranking highest in the competing-risk setting.
AI.motivation: Tabular foundation models (TabFMs) excel at standard classification/regression but cannot be directly applied to censored time-to-event prediction due to censoring, event-time dependencies, and competing risks. The paper addresses how to adapt a generic pretrained TabFM prior to this fundamentally different statistical structure.
AI.method: The authors formulate TabFM transfer to survival as an adaptation-interface problem and compare three interfaces on frozen TabFM backbones (TabPFN, TabDPT, TabICL): (1) zero-shot temporal horizon reformulation, (2) censoring-aware classification fine-tuning (CE), and (3) survival-head adaptation with CoxPH, DeepHit, or MTLR. They use context-conditioned, context-resampled training with adaptive event-balanced temporal discretization, evaluate 5-fold CV on 74 single-risk datasets (grouped into small/medium/large by N) and 4 competing-risk datasets, and report time-dependent C-index and Integrated Brier Score.
AI.result: Zero-shot TabFM inference is effective on smaller single-risk datasets, while supervised survival-head adaptation becomes increasingly advantageous as data scale grows. Cox provides the most reliably strong interface for IBS, especially on larger datasets; DeepHit is relatively stronger for time-dependent concordance than IBS; cause-specific MTLR ranks highest among TabFM survival heads on the competing-risk benchmark. The single-risk ordering does not necessarily transfer to competing risks. Overall, both the choice of adaptation interface and the data regime substantially affect transfer effectiveness.
AI.conclusion: The study reframes TabFM survival transfer as an adaptation-interface design choice rather than a single best approach. Successful transfer depends jointly on data regime, evaluation target, and how directly the downstream interface represents survival structure. Effective heads include Cox (best for IBS), DeepHit (better for discrimination), MTLR (competitive, best on competing risks), with classification fine-tuning lagging behind survival heads for probabilistic prediction.

title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcase this http URL then evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Our results show that both repair and understanding hallucinations remain prevalent. Across models and settings, only 21.0%-55.9% of generated patches pass the developer-written test suite. Moreover, although more accurate intermediate artifacts are generally associated with successful repairs, this relationship does not always hold. Manual analysis of 812 sampled repairs identifies repair hallucinations in 72.7% of cases, including patches that pass all available tests; incorrect causal localization and incorrect repair strategies account for 45.9% and 18.5% of these hallucinations, respectively. Meanwhile, models frequently misidentify triggering testcases, mispredict line coverage involving branching control flow, and generate additional testcases with missing bug-triggering conditions or incorrect expected behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动程序修复(APR)中的幻觉现象进行了多层分析,区分了最终补丁中的"修复幻觉"和中间工件中的"理解幻觉",通过三个任务(触发测试用例识别、行覆盖预测、附加测试用例生成)在832个Defects4J bug上评估了GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1和Claude Sonnet 4.5,发现幻觉普遍存在且结果中心评估不足。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based APR评估主要关注最终补丁是否通过测试(结果中心),无法揭示幻觉是在理解阶段还是修复阶段产生的,也难以解释修复失败的根本原因。补丁通过测试仍可能语义错误或过拟合,因此需要超越patch-centric的多层评估来理解幻觉在APR全过程中的表现形式。
AI.method: 提出两类幻觉定义:(1)修复幻觉——最终补丁无法编译、未通过开发者测试或过拟合测试;(2)理解幻觉——中间工件(识别的触发测试、预测执行行、生成的附加测试)与执行证据不一致。设计三个互补任务:触发测试用例识别(识别暴露bug的测试)、行覆盖预测(预测触发测试在buggy/patched程序中执行的行)、附加测试用例生成(生成能区分buggy与fixed行为的测试)。在832个Defects4J bug上对GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude Sonnet 4.5进行自动评估,采用独立标注+开放编码+Cohen's kappa+冲突解决流程进行人工标注(κ=0.82修复幻觉,κ=0.49理解幻觉)。
AI.result: 修复幻觉普遍存在:仅21.0%–55.9%的补丁通过开发者测试套件;812个手动检查样本中72.7%存在修复幻觉,包括通过所有测试的过拟合补丁;错误因果定位占45.9%,错误修复策略占18.5%。理解幻觉同样普遍:精确触发测试识别率仅23.0%–40.9%,混合误识别影响33.3%–47.6%的bug;行覆盖预测中88.6%的低分预测涉及分支控制流;附加测试生成中46/185(24.9%)因遗漏触发条件而失效。GPT-5整体表现最佳,行覆盖预测任务获得最高plausible-patch率。中间工件质量与修复成功存在关联但非确定性。识别出三个潜在贡献因素:项目上下文接地不足、因果定位不精确、执行路径推理不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果中心评估不足以衡量LLM理解和修复bug的能力,需要联合评估最终补丁与中间工件。幻觉源于项目上下文接地不足、因果定位不精确和执行路径推理不稳定。未来APR系统应加强仓库感知检索、程序分析、动态覆盖/切片/执行轨迹等修复证据,并将中间工件视为可独立验证的行为声明而非固有可靠解释。分类法可指导针对性验证流水线和分类法导向的训练数据构建。生成的测试用例按bug揭示型/回归保持型/patch特异性/无效型分类评估能提供更丰富的修复证据。

title: ARIA - An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Testing of Infotainment Systems
summary: Automotive infotainment validation still relies on manual testing, slow, costly, and incompatible with agile releases and OTA updates. Scripted automation only partly helps: it couples test logic to implementation, yielding brittle, high-maintenance suites. Existing LLM-driven frameworks mostly target web/mobile apps, using single- or dual-agent setups that overload one or two models with perception, planning, action selection, and validation at once, prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration loops given infotainment complexity. We present ARIA (Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment), a multi-agent LLM framework that autonomously runs end-to-end tests on Android infotainment systems via visual interaction, using a closed-loop pipeline of four specialized agents per step plus a report stage. From single-sentence scenarios (path, action, expected outcome), ARIA runs the interactions and produces reports, reproducible scripts, and visual evidence per step. Evaluated on a manufacturer's physical Android infotainment system across 30 scenarios, ARIA completed 28 (93.3%) with a verdict (2 errored), 20 of which (71.4%) matched ground truth. It caught all 5 known defects, no fault passed as working; its 8 false positives stem from navigation/image limits and unsupported gestures, showing multi-agent LLMs can run infotainment tests industrially while exposing the cost of a low false-positive tolerance. A single-agent baseline confirms the multi-agent design's value: on the first pass, before stronger-model revisitation narrows the gap, it shows a far higher false-positive rate (72.0% vs. 52.6%), conflating navigational difficulty with system failure. We report first-pass/post-revisitation results, token/call/cost per scenario, and show via repeated runs that stability tracks complexity, with fault detection perfectly consistent, pointing to CI integration of visual testing.

AI.tldr: ARIA（Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment）是一个面向Android车载信息娱乐系统的多智能体LLM测试框架。它通过四个专门化智能体（Executor、Translator、Inspector、Evaluator）构成的闭环流水线，利用视觉交互自主执行端到端测试场景，仅需单句自然语言描述即可生成结构化报告、可复现脚本和视觉证据。在工业级物理信息娱乐系统上对30个场景进行评估，28个（93.3%）完成流水线并产出判定，全部5个已知缺陷被检出，无漏报（召回率100%），但存在8个误报（精确率仅38.5%）。与单智能体基线相比，多智能体分解将首轮误报率从72.0%降至52.6%，证明架构分解的价值。
AI.motivation: 现代车载信息娱乐系统的验证仍严重依赖人工测试，成本高、速度慢，难以适应敏捷发布周期和OTA更新。传统脚本化自动化存在测试逻辑与实现耦合、套件脆弱的问题。现有LLM驱动测试框架多针对Web/移动应用，采用单/双智能体架构易产生幻觉和探索循环失效。这些问题在信息娱乐系统的高复杂度界面下尤为突出，亟需面向工业场景的智能自适应测试方案。
AI.method: ARIA采用三层架构：(1) LLM编排层——抽象模型提供商，支持异构即插即用模型选择，通过JSON schema约束与自动重提示保障智能体间通信；(2) 执行层——实现四智能体闭环流水线（Executor基于截图进行人类式视觉推理；Translator将意图映射到XML元素并解析坐标；Inspector对截图裁剪区域进行语义审查拦截错误映射；Evaluator基于前后截图判定行为为Correct/Finished/Incorrect），外加Summarizer生成结构化报告；(3) 设备接口层——通过Appium/ADB与物理设备通信，仅提供tap、long-tap、swipe和文本输入四种基本手势。框架支持四种执行模式：标准执行、短路回放（仅Evaluator）、用更强模型重访、场景转换（手动脚本转自然语言）。Executor被刻意限制为仅接收截图，模拟真实用户视角。
AI.result: 在汽车厂商的物理Android信息娱乐测试环境上对30个场景进行评估，使用claude-sonnet-4.6执行首轮、claude-opus-4.6重访。主要结果：(1) 流水线完成率28/30（93.3%），重访后20/28（71.4%）与真值一致；(2) 全部5个已知缺陷被正确检出，故障召回率100%，但精确率仅38.5%（8个误报）；(3) 多智能体首轮误报率52.6%，显著优于单智能体基线的72.0%（同等模型下），归因于智能体可缓解将导航困难误判为系统故障的倾向；(4) 误报原因50%源于LLM局限性（导航错误、标识符无效），50%源于框架交互限制（不支持复合手势、瞬态UI）；(5) 6个场景各重复运行5次：25/30（83.3%）与模态结果一致，故障检测跨运行完全稳定，稳定性与场景复杂度呈反相关；(6) 总成本约139美元（$4.64/场景），首轮平均40.6次LLM调用、8.4分钟/场景，适合夜间回归而非开发内循环；(7) 模型选型验证显示OpenAI模型族（gpt-5.3-codex、gpt-5.4、gpt-4.1）完成率显著低于Anthropic模型（gpt-5.3-codex 0/6，gpt-4.1 1/6，gpt-5.4 2/6），Sonnet以最低成本（$8.28）取得4/4完美分类。
AI.conclusion: ARIA证明多智能体LLM架构可在工业级车载信息娱乐系统中自主执行端到端测试，无需人工干预且与内部实现解耦。多智能体分解相对单智能体显著降低首轮误报率，从相同廉价模型中提取更可靠的判定结果。短路回放模式为跨版本回归检测提供了CI集成路径。当前精确率（38.5%）和误报水平仍不宜完全无人值守部署，但适合作为夜间回归测试的人工监督辅助工具。未来工作方向包括：通过导航映射和术语词表增强LLM上下文接地、扩展复合手势支持、评估短路回放模式在跨版本场景下的有效性，并通过模型抽象层受益于LLM整体能力提升。

title: Amortizing Scaling Law Construction Costs
summary: Scaling laws guide the design choices for training large foundation models, but deriving them involves training an exhaustive grid over hyperparameters, token budgets, and parameter counts, which is computationally expensive. Fitting a scaling law, however, only requires the best-loss frontier across compute scales, discarding most of the trained configurations. We propose a framework for efficient scaling law construction that formulates data collection as a Bayesian optimization problem, and introduce metrics for comparing scaling law fitting methods under constrained compute budgets. We find that progressively expanding the compute budget during acquisition, mirroring the compute-ordered evaluation of configurations in practice, substantially improves recovery efficiency. Augmenting the observed configurations with surrogate-fantasized evaluations then recovers the broader experimental grid, allowing accurate scaling law fitting without training every configuration. Together, these can closely match scaling law fits over a full dense grid at computational savings of up to $10\text{--}100\times$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将扩展定律（scaling law）构建视为贝叶斯优化（BO）问题，通过"计算切片"（compute slicing）和代理模型幻想（surrogate fantasization）两种机制，在仅使用全稠密网格 1%–10% 的计算预算下，即可恢复与全网格搜索高度一致的扩展律拟合参数，外推至 6–7 个数量级更大算力时预测损失误差仅约 1.6%。
AI.motivation: 传统扩展律构建需对参数规模、token 预算和超参数组合训练完整的稠密网格，计算开销巨大。然而拟合扩展律实际只需各算力尺度上的最优损失边界（best-loss envelope），大量次优配置的评估可被丢弃。该观察为数据采集阶段提供了显著的效率提升空间，但缺乏系统性的高效采集框架与评估指标。
AI.method: 作者提出一种将扩展律数据采集形式化为超参数优化（HPO）的统一框架，在标准贝叶斯优化流程中引入两项关键修改：（1）计算切片——在每次采集迭代中将搜索范围限制在当前已观测计算窗口及其紧邻的下一个计算片内，模拟实践中按算力递增顺序评估配置的方式；（2）代理幻想（fantasization）——利用高斯过程等代理模型对未评估的网格点进行预测，将观测值与代理预测值共同组成"模拟稠密网格"用于拟合扩展律。同时提出了四类评估指标：参数遗憾（parameter regret）、保持集 MSE、损失边界覆盖率、外推相对误差，以联合评估搜索效率。
AI.result: 在 OELLM-English、StepLaw、Porian-HP、Warmstart、OELLM-Multilingual 五个数据集上，使用 GP（Matérn-5/2 核）+ LCB（κ=2）的标准 BoTorch 配置验证：计算切片+幻想机制在仅 1% 的总网格预算下即可恢复高质量的 L(C)=E+AC^α 拟合参数，外推至 10^25–10^29 FLOPs（比网格高 6–7 个数量级）时预测损失与全数据拟合的相对误差仅 1.09%–1.56%；相比 Full 搜索空间+幻想机制实现 10× 加速，相比 Full 仅用观测值实现最高 100× 加速。结论在 L(N,D) Chinchilla Approach 3 的 5 参数形式及 Random Search、TabPFN、XGBoost 等替代代理上同样成立，但收益程度依赖于网格的 (N,D) 覆盖密度——StepLaw 因包含大量不良超参数设置导致恢复较困难。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明将扩展律构建形式化为超参数优化问题，并结合计算切片和代理幻想两项简单修改，可在标准贝叶斯优化框架内实现 10–100 倍的计算节省，同时保持高精度的参数恢复与外推能力。该框架具有通用性，可与不同代理模型（GP、TabPFN、XGBoost）、不同获取函数（EI、PI、LCB）和不同参数化形式兼容。未来工作包括设计感知扩展律形式的专业核函数与获取函数，以及在全新大规模数据收集中验证该方法。

title: Leveraging Low-Level Symbolic Competences for Unsupervised Grounding in Hallucination Detection
summary: Hallucination-where a language model generates outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported by the source-is a major challenge for both prompted and fine-tuned language models. Detecting hallucinations is difficult due to the opaque reasoning processes of LLMs, which often provide little insight into why a model's output may be inaccurate. In this work, we investigate whether an LLM can use an alternative, low level, symbolic competence such as SQL for unsupervised hallucination detection in some high level task. For this, we make an LLM build an SQL database from reference documents. This SQL database is then used for reasoning over the reference and the sampled response in a hallucination detection pipeline that is grounded in the database, thereby providing a neurosymbolic checkup. On RAGTruth and DiaHalu hallucination detection datasets, we find that our approach improves on direct prediction and competes with state-of-the-art hallucination detection methods, while not requiring domain-specific fine-tuning. Instead it relies on a low-level general competence already present in LLMs. This warrants further investigation of low-level LLM competences in neurosymbolic approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TeQHallu：无监督的文本到 SQL 幻觉检测框架。它把参考文档增量式写入关系数据库，再将模型回答拆成待核验声明，通过可执行 SQL 检索显式证据，并让 LLM 综合初始判断与数据库结果给出最终标签及解释。实验表明，该方法在 RAGTruth 和 DiaHalu 上显著优于直接预测和其他无监督方法，性能接近监督式先进方法，同时不需领域微调。其优势来自神经语义理解与确定性符号校验的互补，而非仅靠增加推理步骤；局限主要是五阶段提示带来的较高推理成本，以及 SQL 解析错误、信息损失和参考材料偏差可能影响可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM 的内部推理不透明，常规幻觉检测通常只输出二元标签，既难以诊断错误来源，也难以定位细微的无依据信息。作者因此探索一种不依赖任务专用微调的解释性方法：利用 LLM 已具备的通用、较低层符号能力 SQL，将非结构化参考文档转成可查询、可审查的事实锚点，再以“神经判断＋符号核验”完成检测。
AI.method: TeQHallu 包含五个阶段：①用 PRAGMA 检查现有表结构；②执行 SELECT 查询数据库中已有知识；③以 INSERT/必要的建表操作增量补入缺失事实；④从模型回答中识别待核验声明并生成定向 SQL；⑤将 SQL 证据、原始参考文本和直接预测基线共同交给 LLM，输出二分类、四类错误标签及结构化解释。核心并非硬性集合匹配，而是让 LLM 以实体 ID 和检索结果为提示进行软对齐。评估采用 RAGTruth 三类 RAG 任务和 DiaHalu 任务导向对话，并与直接预测、原子事实分解、键值抽取、SelfCheckGPT、LMvLM 及监督式方法比较；还进行了 SQL 人工审计、消融和开放模型实验。
AI.result: 在 RAGTruth 上，Gemini 2.5 Flash 驱动的 TeQHallu 获得宏平均 P/R/F1 为 61.7/88.9/71.3，优于直接预测的 48.2/95.4/61.6、原子事实核验的 53.3/91.7/65.7 和键值抽取的 52.1/94.8/64.9，并优于微调 Llama-2-13B 的 70.3/74.1/71.8；与 LettuceDetect-large 的 73.5/72.5/72.8 接近，仅低于 RAG-HAT 的 82.4/74.4/78.0。它在 QA、数据生成和摘要上的 F1 分别为 58.5、88.4、66.9，均优于各组无监督方法。DiaHalu 上，TeQHallu 使 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的 F1 从 53.48 提升至 58.11，GPT-4 配置达到 58.18。人工审计显示 SQL 完整解析准确率为 85.33%；22 个不完整数据库样本中有 14 个仍被原始参考文本兜底纠正，级联错误仅 5.33%。消融中，纯 SQL 符号预测 F1 为 39.7，SELECT 实体 ID 直接匹配为 69.7，将 ID 提供给 LLM 做软对齐达到 71.3。开放模型结果并非所有情况下都提升：Qwen3、GPT-OSS 和 Llama 3.3 70B 的 TeQHallu F1 分别为 67.2、68.6、65.4，相比直接预测为 +2.3、-0.1、+1.1，显示收益依赖模型的 SQL 能力。主要代价是每样本需 5 次顺序提示、约 4.5k–9.7k 输入 token 和约 600 个输出 token，而直接预测仅需约 0.8k–1.8k token。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，LLM 通用且相对低层的 SQL 能力可以成为高层幻觉检测的可靠外部事实检查器。TeQHallu 在不进行领域微调的情况下取得接近监督式方法的性能，同时提供比纯神经检测更具体、可检查的 SQL 证据链。其核心机制是使用符号检索约束而非替代神经推理：硬性 ID 匹配过严，完全去除神经判断又会漏检复杂语义错误，软对齐在两者间取得最佳平衡。该方法适合重视可解释性且能承受多步推理成本的场景；实时系统、知识图谱融合、迭代数据库修正、混合结构化知识源以及人工可用性评估是后续重点。

title: How do LLMs Evaluate Perceived Moral Agency? Investigating Moral Decision-Making in Human-Artificial Agents Interactions
comment: 43 pages, 14 figures, 29 tables. Preprint under review
summary: As LLMs take on roles requiring moral advice, understanding how they attribute moral agency becomes critical. Humans possess moral agency, the capacity to make ethically guided decisions and bear responsibility for their consequences, a well-established construct in moral psychology. Yet as artificial agents (AAs) such as robots, drones, and disembodied AI systems become increasingly embedded in smart city environments, the question of whether and how moral agency is attributed to them takes on new urgency. This paper presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first empirical study comparing how humans and LLMs evaluate perceived moral agency (PMA) across human and autonomous artificial agents varying in embodiment, situated in plausible smart city scenarios. Using an adaptation of a validated PMA scale, we applied a protocol to 190 human participants as well as various LLMs. Our evaluation reveals higher perceptions of moral agency in humans than in AAs. However, when facing moral dilemmas in concrete scenarios, LLMs reason outward from the situation, prioritizing harm severity and contextual urgency over any stable assessment of the agent itself, amplifying a context-sensitivity also present in human raters. These findings are particularly relevant as LLMs become increasingly involved in everyday moral decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文是第一项实证研究，比较人类与大语言模型（LLMs）如何评估人类与人工智能体（AA）在智慧城市情境中的感知道德能动性（PMA）。研究发现LLMs在抽象评分中对AAs的道德能动性评分低于人类，但在具体情境中却因情境紧迫性和伤害严重程度而显著放大AAs的道德能动性评分，揭示了一种情境驱动的推理模式。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs越来越多地承担道德建议的角色，理解其如何归因道德能动性变得至关重要。当前研究缺乏对LLMs在涉及人类-AI交互场景中如何评估道德能动性的系统研究，且现有工作多以人类为评估对象，忽略了人工道德主体本身的道德地位。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 基于Banks(2019)的PMA量表进行扩展，新增8个智慧城市场景，每个场景设计9个新条目，涵盖自主性、行动认可和道德判断三个维度；(2) 通过190名人类参与者验证扩展问卷；(3) 设计三阶段LLM调查协议（人类对齐、迭代一致性、提示稳健性），兼容文本和图文多模态模型；(4) 结合定量评分与定性解释分析，比较人类与LLM的道德能动性归因差异。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) 人类对自身的道德能动性评分显著高于对AAs的评分；(2) LLMs在抽象PMA量表评分中对AAs道德能动性评分较低，但在具体场景任务中显著提升对AAs的道德能动性评估，表现出强烈的情境敏感性；(3) LLM生成的解释表明其推理以外部情境为中心，优先考虑伤害严重性和情境紧迫性而非对主体本身的稳定判断；(4) 数值评分相似的LLM可能基于截然不同的推理策略（结果论、义务论或正义论），数值对齐不能完全反映解释质量。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出，LLMs对人工道德主体的道德能动性评估存在情境驱动的推理模式，挑战了仅凭量表分数作为LLM道德推理代理的做法。定性解释分析应作为定量评估的必要补充。研究对LLMs在城市管理系统中的责任分配、设计与治理决策具有实践意义。

title: Beyond Co-purchase Relation: Evolution of Complementary Recommendations at Allegro
summary: When a customer adds a professional camera to their cart, should the system suggest a matching lens, a generic tripod, or another camera body? Complementary Product Recommendation is vital for comprehensive basket building, yet standard models often fail to distinguish between items that are merely bought together and those that truly work together. In this paper, we present AlleCompanion: a production-scale retrieval framework deployed at this http URL that transforms noisy behavioural signals into precise semantic compatibility. We mitigate the intrinsic noise in large-scale co-purchase traffic by combining data-level filtering heuristics with a category-constrained Two Tower architecture. Within this framework, the Category Adapter guides the model in the embedding space, constraining candidates within logically complementary boundaries. Since modelling authentic user behaviour at scale is inherently difficult, we introduce ComCat, a multi-source Complementary Categories Mapping. ComCat acts as a translational layer that distils meaningful patterns from noisy traffic into a maintainable and controllable solution, integrating expert rules, human-in-the-loop feedback, LLM-based reasoning, and statistical mining. Our experimental results demonstrate that combining explicit category-level constraints with neural architectures effectively filters out co-purchase noise to surface recommendations that satisfy real-world user needs. Serving over 20 million active users monthly, the framework delivers significant uplifts in attributed GMV for organic discovery and drives substantial revenue growth in sponsored placements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AlleCompanion，一个部署在Allegro电商平台的大规模互补商品推荐检索框架。该框架通过Two Tower架构配合Category Adapter，将噪声较大的协同购买信号转化为精确的语义兼容性匹配，并引入ComCat（多源互补类别映射）作为类别引导的翻译层。在服务超过2000万月活用户的生产系统中，显著提升了GMV等业务指标。
AI.motivation: 电商推荐系统需要区分"替代品"（相似商品）与"互补品"（协同使用商品），例如为手机推荐保护壳或充电器。然而，原始的协同购买数据存在大量噪声，无法区分真正的功能互补关系（如手机配耳机）与替代/无关购买（如同一用户购买不同口味的狗粮）。现有模型常混淆相似性与互补性，且缺乏对类别级语义兼容性与细粒度物品兼容性（如型号、尺寸匹配）的兼顾。
AI.method:
1. **AlleCompanion架构**：基于内容特征（标题、价格、品类等）的Two Tower检索模型，在查询塔中引入Category Adapter模块，将目标互补类别嵌入与商品嵌入拼接投影至共享空间，并通过辅助的Category Reconstruction Loss（采样softmax）引导模型学习类别判别信号；最终损失为检索损失与重构损失之和。
2. **数据过滤启发式**：剔除99分位以上的"重度买家"，基于成对共现频次与品类对齐（同部门不同品类）进行过滤，使数据集中互补对比例从36%提升至61%。
3. **ComCat多源互补类别映射**：整合三类来源——自动化共购启发式（基于Jaccard相似度与树距/价格比过滤）、人在环标注（含LLM辅助）、以及基于专家规则的产品参数级兼容性；按"标注>专家规则>启发式"优先级融合，并支持同品类映射以兼容替代品场景。
4. **在线部署**：每日用Faiss重建ANN索引，推理时通过ComCat动态确定目标类别空间进行条件检索，无需模型重训即可更新类别策略。
AI.result:
离线实验：AlleCompanion在Test集Recall@20达0.4567、MRR@20达0.2000，在ComCat模拟集上Recall@20达0.0952、MRR@20达0.0258，均显著优于Vanilla-TT、Seller-TT及后过滤基线；属性一致性约21.8%与测试集真实分布吻合。ComCat消融显示，整合全部四类源（含同品类）后，目标类别覆盖率从27.55%提升至43.06%，离线CTR提升450%、CVR提升398%。
在线A/B测试（部署于产品页与购物车）：Sponsored位CVR显著提升+0.53%（Web），Organic产品页GMV提升+8.05%~+9.35%，购物车内GMV提升+15.73%~+21.25%，赞助位广告收入提升约50%。基于显著结果，模型已全量部署至三个核心展位。
AI.conclusion: AlleCompanion通过将类别级意图与物品级兼容性解耦设计，验证了显式类别约束与神经架构结合能有效过滤协同购买噪声。在大规模生产部署中实现显著业务收益。关键洞察包括：(1) 暴露于完整协同购买分布比施加严格领域约束更有利于检索性能，因此将专家逻辑、LLM推理和人工反馈集中在ComCat映射层而非训练数据；(2) 生产中发现，将互补品与同品类替代品混合的相关商品策略带来最强业务增益，反映出真实结账意图倾向于更广泛的发现。框架目前覆盖99.8%的活跃流量，但仍受限于分类法粒度，未来方向包括直接从原始特征学习兼容性、引入个性化排序层以及改进多物品互补意图的离线评估方法。

title: A Structured Debate-Mixture-of-Agents Framework for Complex Clinical Diagnostic Decision Support
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show potential for medical tasks, but their single-turn question-answer format does not reflect how clinical diagnosis is performed in practice. As a result, they remain limited in complex diagnostic settings. We developed Debate-Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a novel multi-agent framework that structures role-based interaction to support iterative diagnostic reasoning. Base models and DMoA were evaluated on 297 rare disease cases and 1,719 challenging cases. Across both datasets, DMoA improved most likely diagnosis accuracy by 10.21 percentage points and safety rate by 11.36 percentage points over GPT-4o baseline. Ablation experiments showed that the gains were not simply due to the use of more models or longer outputs, but also reflected the contribution of the structured workflow. Further analyses examined how framework design, base model choice, and token budget affected performance. DMoA performed better with a 4*2 structure, stronger base models, and a larger token budget. These findings demonstrate the potential of DMoA for clinical tasks and suggest further investigation of multi-agent frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于复杂临床诊断决策支持的结构化多智能体框架DMoA（Debate-Mixture-of-Agents），通过Presenter-Rebutter-Aggregator的角色分工实现迭代式诊断推理。在297个罕见病案例和1719个疑难病例上，相较GPT-4o基线，最可能诊断准确率提升10.21个百分点，安全性提升11.36个百分点。消融实验证实性能增益源于结构化工作流而非单纯提示工程或多模型堆叠。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM采用单轮问答模式，与临床诊断所需的动态迭代推理过程不匹配，在罕见病和疑难病例等复杂诊断场景中表现受限。多智能体系统虽在医疗任务中展现潜力，但缺乏面向复杂诊断的结构化协作推理框架。
AI.method: DMoA在Mixture-of-Agents基础上引入结构化角色约束拓扑，由多个Debater（含Presenter和Rebutter）和一个Aggregator组成。推理流程为：Presenter基于患者信息生成初步诊断→Rebutter批判并指出证据缺失/替代诊断/安全隐患→Presenter根据反馈修正→Aggregator整合所有修正后的假设生成最终诊断。在罕见病（297例）和疑难病例（1719例）上进行评估，同时进行了提示工程模拟、移除Rebutter、MAC式多轮对话等消融实验，以及轻量化模型组合、token预算、信息分区、结构规模（2×2至5×2）等分析。安全性采用Bond等人提出的五维度李克特量表评估。
AI.result: GPT-4o基础4×2 DMoA在罕见病子集上最可能诊断准确率达35.20%（vs GPT-4o单模型28.62%，p<0.05），安全性62.63%；疑难病例子集上准确率25.34%（vs 14.50%，p<0.01），安全性76.14%（vs 63.46%，p<0.001）。消融实验显示：纯提示模拟、MoA（去Rebutter）、MAC式对话均低于完整DMoA。4×2结构最优，token预算降低至4000时性能下降，信息分区无额外收益。轻量化模型GLM-4-9B在DMoA下仍显著优于其单模型。在基础临床知识问答任务上DMoA无显著优势，提示其优势随任务复杂度提升而显现。GPT-4o mini版本平均成本约$0.009/例。
AI.conclusion: DMoA通过将诊断推理组织为生成-批判-修正-聚合四个明确阶段，显著提升了LLM在复杂临床任务中的诊断准确性和安全性。其增益来源于结构化工作流本身而非单纯的多模型或长输出。DMoA在高难度、高不确定性病例中具有作为第二意见工具的潜力，但不能替代临床医生。未来可整合上游数据处理智能体，并部署本地化轻量版本以平衡性能与数据安全。

title: NEAT-POCKET: Pocket-Conditioned Autoregressive 3D Molecular Generation with a Neighborhood-Guided Set Transformer
summary: AI-driven de novo molecular design offers a promising route to accelerate early-stage drug discovery by generating novel ligands directly within target protein binding pockets. We present NEAT-POCKET, a pocket-conditioned extension of the autoregressive NEAT model for 3D molecular generation. NEAT-POCKET generates molecules atom by atom in protein pocket environments while preserving atom permutation invariance and explicitly modeling hydrogen atoms. Benchmarks on the CrossDocked and SPINDR datasets show that NEAT-POCKET achieves competitive structure-based generation performance while sampling substantially faster than existing baselines. Beyond full-molecule generation, NEAT-POCKET naturally enables pocket-conditioned fragment completion, a task directly relevant to lead optimization and scaffold elaboration. These results position NEAT-POCKET as a fast, flexible, and practical framework for structure-based drug design.

AI.tldr: NEAT-POCKET 是一种基于蛋白口袋条件的自回归3D分子生成模型，通过逐原子构建的方式在蛋白结合口袋内高效生成包含显式氢原子的分子，显著提升采样速度并天然支持片段补全任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型或流匹配的蛋白口袋条件3D分子生成方法计算开销大、采样速度慢，且难以直接支持从已有片段出发生成分子的片段补全任务。此外，现有方法大多忽略显式氢原子的建模，导致化学信息不完整。
AI.method: 1. 采用自回归的NEAT基础模型，预训练于GEOM-Drugs数据集，在CrossDocked和SPINDR数据集上微调。2. 引入蛋白口袋编码器，采用细-粗-细(fine-coarse-fine)的Transformer架构，通过残基内自注意力和残基级双向自注意力编码全局结构信息。3. 使用交叉注意力机制将口袋信息注入到分子编码器中，并通过AdaLN-single层进行全局条件注入。4. 引入Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) 控制条件强度，引入clash penalty惩罚与口袋的空间冲突。5. 使用条件流匹配头预测每个新原子的3D坐标，保持原子置换不变性。6. 训练后使用独立的键预测模型推断化学键。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked基准上，NEAT-POCKET达到了69.2%的PoseBusters有效率（第二位），最低的蛋白-配体冲突数（6.6），最佳的理化性质相似性排名（2.48），采样速度达到每口袋100个分子仅需4秒（约比第二快的基线快20倍）。在SPINDR基准上，有效率（80.3%）和冲突数（3.7）均优于FLOWR，采样速度提升9倍。片段补全实验中，片段越大，有效率越高（最大片段达81.8% CrossDocked和88.8% SPINDR），分子内应变能降低，对接分数改善，同时保持前缀的化学和空间一致性。
AI.conclusion: NEAT-POCKET 提供了一个快速、灵活且具有竞争力的蛋白口袋条件3D分子生成框架。其自回归设计避免了昂贵的迭代全局传输过程，显著提升了采样效率，并天然支持从任意片段补全完整分子，无需架构改动或重新训练。该模型适合用于基于结构的hit generation和先导化合物优化工作流。

title: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for AI-Assisted Scoring in Large-Scale Writing Assessment
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), into educational assessment has opened new opportunities to enhance the efficiency and scalability of grading processes. This study presents the design and validation of an AI-assisted scoring framework for written responses in a large-scale national assessment. The proposed approach focuses on short written texts of approximately 150-200 words and incorporates a human-in-the-loop strategy to preserve assessment quality while reducing manual workload. The study is grounded in a real operational context, using data from two recent editions of a nationwide test, each comprising approximately 5,000 student responses. We analyze the alignment between AI-generated scores and human raters across multiple rubric dimensions, as well as the impact of the proposed decision flow on pass/fail outcomes. Results show moderate to high agreement between the model and human evaluations in most dimensions, supporting the feasibility of AI assistance in this setting. Moreover, the proposed correction workflow identifies cases where human review is most valuable, enabling a more efficient allocation of expert effort. The findings suggest that AI-assisted scoring can be safely integrated into large-scale assessment processes only when combined with carefully designed human oversight. The paper concludes by discussing practical implications for deployment in national assessment systems and outlining future research directions, including longitudinal monitoring of model-human alignment and the analysis of potential cognitive bias introduced by AI-supported review workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个人机协同(HITL)框架,将大语言模型(GPT-5)集成到乌拉圭国家级写作评估(Acredita EB)的大规模评分流程中,在保留人类专家终审权的前提下,实现至少50%的人工评分工作量削减。
AI.motivation: 大规模高利害写作评估中,人工评分耗时长(三月以上)且成本高昂;现有AI评分研究多限于英语、小规模或低利害场景,西班牙语大规模高利害评估证据稀缺;且缺乏面向决策(而非仅模型准确性)的人机协同操作框架设计。
AI.method: 采用GPT-5推理模型配合针对每个评分项设计的结构化西班牙语prompt(含评分规则、代码说明、正/反例、JSON输出格式),对15项分析性评分量规逐项评分;拼写项替换为确定性NLP工具(LanguageTool);利用IRT+Bookmark方法设定熟练度等级切线分数,设计HITL工作流:仅对AI评分改变最终通过/未通过决策的文本触发人工审核。
AI.result: 2024与2025各1000份随机样本上,AI与人工评分项级一致率60%–80%,Cohen's Kappa多为fair至moderate;系统呈现稳定的"严格化"保守偏差,导致15.3%–16.5%的人类通过案例被AI判为未通过(反向几乎无);HITL框架仿真显示可减少≥50%人工评分量,而关键决策保持人类监督,误判风险降至0.2%–0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 在精心设计的人类监督下,基于LLM的AI辅助评分可安全嵌入大规模高利害写作评估;保守偏差反而有助于HITL设计——AI判通过可直接接受,AI判未通过则触发人工审核,从而避免将偏差传递至最终认证决策。未来工作重点:受控试点部署、纵向监测模型-人工一致性漂移、研究AI先验对人工评分员的锚定/自动化偏差影响、改进细粒度语言特征的prompt策略。

title: Beyond Stationarity in Time Series: Discovering Causal Structures and Latent Regimes via Markov Blankets
comment: Accepted at the 11th AALTD Workshop at ECML PKDD 2026, Naples, Italy
summary: This paper introduces Regime-aware Constraint-Based and Noise-Based causal discovery with Markov Blankets (RCBNB-MB), a novel causal discovery algorithm for time series that relaxes the common assumption of a single, time-consistent causal structure. Time series are typically observed at discrete time points and often exhibit regime changes that challenge the assumption of a static causal structure, a limitation in many real-world dynamic systems. To address this challenge, RCBNB-MB identifies latent causal regimes, defined as subsets of time points within which a stable causal structure holds. The algorithm follows an iterative strategy that segments the time series into regimes and discovers the causal graph within each regime. By leveraging the Markov blanket rather than direct parents, RCBNB-MB gains robustness to errors in causal discovery and preserves predictive information. We provide theoretical guarantees for RCBNB-MB's ability to recover both regime transitions and causal graphs under reasonable assumptions. Furthermore, we validate its effectiveness through extensive experiments on simulated datasets with known ground truth and real-world IT monitoring data, where taking into account regime shifts is critical. Empirical results show that RCBNB-MB systematically outperforms baseline approaches in accurately detecting regime changes and their associated causal graphs, positioning it as a robust and versatile framework for non-stationary time series analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出RCBNB-MB算法，通过马尔可夫毯替代直接父节点进行区间分配，联合识别潜在因果区间与因果图（含瞬时效应），在合成与真实IT监控数据上系统优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现实时间序列常因隐含因素发生区间切换（regime shifts），违反静态因果结构假设；现有方法多依赖因果父节点集合进行区间分配，易受因果图估计误差影响，且忽视瞬时因果效应。
AI.method: 构建基于约束+噪声的混合因果发现方法（CBNB）发现各区间窗口因果图（含瞬时边），将区间分配重构为基于马尔可夫毯的预测任务（最小化预测误差），通过迭代交替优化分配向量C、窗口因果图{G_w^k}及预测函数集H，并施加最小区间规模和最大转换次数约束，支持非连续区间（gapped regimes）。
AI.result: 在6/15变量、长度600/1200/2000的合成线性SCM数据上（含瞬时效应、2-3区间），RCBNB-MB的MER最低（2区间1.27%、3区间0.81%），F1（总体0.73/0.66）和nSHD（0.52/0.55）均优于VarLiNGAM/Dynotears/PCMCI/PCMCI+/CASTOR/CD-NOD/J-PCMCI+等基线；在EasyVista 8变量IT监控数据上（已知异常时段46683-46783）成功识别正常/异常区间（F1=0.53），并发现潜在过渡区间。
AI.conclusion: 将区间分配作为基于马尔可夫毯的预测任务，理论证明可正确恢复真实区间因果图与分配；实验验证在区间检测与因果图恢复上均优于现有方法，为非平稳时间序列提供了鲁棒通用框架；未来工作包括非线性关系、>3个区间及边界时间戳分配的改进。

title: Phase Transition Frequency as a Training Time Predictor of Test Accuracy in ResNets
summary: The number of discrete class-separability jumps observed during ResNet finetuning is examined empirically as a predictor of final test accuracy. Across 75 experiments spanning four benchmarks (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and CIFAR-10-C) and three architectures (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ResNet-101), with five to ten seeds per configuration, a strong within-dataset negative correlation is obtained on standard i.i.d. classification benchmarks: \(r = -0.84\) on CIFAR-10 (\(p < 10^{-8}\), \(n = 30\)) and \(r = -0.87\) on CIFAR-100 (\(p < 10^{-5}\), \(n = 15\)). Under distributional stress, the relationship attenuates: TinyImageNet yields \(r = -0.45\), and the CIFAR-10-C corruption benchmark yields \(r = -0.19\). Two additional analyses discipline the empirical claim. A partial correlation controlling for architecture depth, treated as a linear covariate, shows that on CIFAR-100 the transition count retains statistically significant predictive power (\(r_{\mathrm{partial}} = -0.69\), \(p = 0.007\)); the corresponding result under the stricter categorical conditioning is not established at \(n = 15\). A comparison against six alternative training-curve signals shows that transition count achieved the strongest correlation among the evaluated signals on CIFAR-100 and one of the strongest on CIFAR-10, but is dominated by other signals on the two stressed benchmarks. The comparison is restricted to training-curve-level signals; comparisons against effective rank, Hessian sharpness, Fisher information, margin, and neural-collapse measures, which are the strongest competitors in the current literature, are not part of the present study and remain open. The observation is presented as an in-distribution training-quality probe among a family of candidate probes, and an inexpensive detection procedure suitable for logging alongside a standard training loop is provided.

AI.tldr: 本文通过75组实验，系统考察了ResNet微调过程中观察到的离散类别可分性跳跃（class-separability jumps）的次数，作为模型最终测试准确率的预测指标。研究发现在i.i.d.分类基准上具有强负相关性，但在分布压力下相关性显著减弱。
AI.motivation: 动机在于探索一种基于训练曲线本身（即训练过程中类别可分性的离散跳跃次数）的廉价预测因子，用于估计模型在未见测试数据上的最终性能，并将其与现有训练曲线信号进行比较，定位其在模型选择/早停中的实用价值。
AI.method: 方法包括：在四个基准（CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet、CIFAR-10-C）和三种架构（ResNet-18/50/101）上进行75组微调实验，每配置5–10个种子；统计训练过程中离散类别可分性跳跃（transition count）的次数；使用皮尔逊相关分析其与最终测试准确率的关系；通过偏相关控制架构深度这一线性协变量；并在CIFAR-10/100上与六种替代训练曲线信号进行比较。
AI.result: 结果：在i.i.d.标准基准上呈现强负相关——CIFAR-10上r = -0.84（p<10⁻⁸，n=30），CIFAR-100上r = -0.87（p<10⁻⁵，n=15）；在分布压力下相关性衰减——TinyImageNet为r = -0.45，CIFAR-10-C为r = -0.19；控制架构深度后，CIFAR-100上偏相关r = -0.69（p=0.007）仍显著，但严格分层条件下n=15未能建立显著性；在与六种训练曲线信号的对比中，transition count在CIFAR-100上最强、CIFAR-10上较强，但在两个压力基准上被其他信号超越。
AI.conclusion: 结论：transition count是一种有前景的in-distribution训练质量探测信号，特别适用于标准i.i.d.分类任务的模型选择；但其在分布外/受扰动场景下泛化能力有限，且尚未与有效秩、Hessian锐度、Fisher信息、间隔和神经坍缩等更强竞争性度量进行比较；作者提供了可与标准训练循环一起记录的廉价检测流程，作为该候选探测家族中的一员。

title: A Verifier-Guided Explainable Reasoning Framework with Gold-Anchored QLoRA, Task-Aware Mixture-of-Experts, and Group-Relative RLVR
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning ability, but their explanations can remain inconsistent, weakly grounded, or difficult to verify. We propose a verifier-guided explainable reasoning framework for transparent educational question answering that combines gold-anchored QLoRA, task-aware symbolic routing, and group-relative RLVR. Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is first adapted with field-weighted QLoRA supervision anchored to authoritative answers. A lightweight router then assigns logic problems to a FOL/Z3 verifier and physics problems to a formula- and unit aware symbolic solver. Verifier feedback is further used to support candidate evaluation, self-revision, and reward construction during RLVR. Candidate responses are evaluated along three complementary dimensions: P1 for answer correctness, P2 for evidence or unit consistency, and P3 for reasoning depth and explainability. At inference, gold-free self-consistency aggregates multiple candidate responses before an optional question-only physics verifier performs conservative system-level correction. On 438 held-out examples, RLVR increases P3 from 50.68% to 72.20%, while hybrid P1 remains approximately stable at 55.94%. Self-consistency improves model only P1 from 48.86% to 50.23%, with symbolic verification providing the remaining hybrid gain. These results indicate that RLVR primarily strengthens explicit reasoning structure, while symbolic verification complements the neural policy by improving answer reliability at the system level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向教育问答的可解释框架，结合 gold-anchored QLoRA、任务感知 MoE 路由与 Group-Relative RLVR，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上分别针对逻辑题调用 FOL/Z3 验证器、物理题调用公式-单位感知求解器；用 P1（答案正确性）、P2（证据/单位一致性）、P3（推理深度）三维评估；在 438 个验证样本上，RLVR 主要提升推理深度（P3 50.68%→72.20%），而系统级混合验证在物理题上带来最大的 P1 增益。
AI.motivation: 大模型在推理时给出的解释可能不一致、缺乏证据支持、难以验证；现有 RLVR 类方法多依赖答案级奖励，无法区分"恰好蒙对"与"推理严谨"。EXACT 2026 任务涵盖逻辑与物理等异构任务，需要不同验证机制（逻辑需前提蕴含，物理需公式与单位一致性），因此需要一个同时提升解释性与可验证性的框架。
AI.method: 框架分七阶段：(1) gold-anchored 规范化，锁定权威答案并修复教师监督；(2) 字段加权 4-bit NF4 QLoRA SFT（r=32, α=64）加答案焦点校准；(3) 任务级 MoE 路由（不变 Transformer 内部，仅按任务选 Logic 或 Physics 专家）；(4) 符号验证——逻辑用 FOL/Z3 做蕴含/矛盾检查，物理用公式-单位感知 SOL 求解并归一化；(5) 基于验证反馈的自修订与候选排序；(6) P1/P2/P3 Group-Relative RLVR（K=3 候选，加权奖励 = 0.50 R_exact + 0.20 R_dense + 0.15 R_P2 + 0.10 R_P3 + 0.05 R_fmt，使用裁剪 surrogate + 参考策略正则）；(7) 推理阶段 5 次生成（1 贪念 + 4 采样）按答案等价聚类，并对物理题设置置信阈值≥0.98 的保守覆写。评估指标 P1（最终答案正确）、P2（逻辑前提 F1 / 物理单位一致）、P3（CoT 步骤数 / 4）。
AI.result: 在 EXACT 2026 数据 438 个保留样本上：RLVR 将 P3 由 50.68% 提升至 72.20%（+21.52），而混合 P1 仅微降至 55.94%（−0.68），P2 由 77.70% 降至 75.33%（−2.37），格式合格率 98.17%→94.52%。所有任务族 P3 均上升（Logic MC +32.19、Yes/No +32.14、Uncertain +17.86、Physics +15.51）。推理阶段消融：自一致性对 SFT/RLVR 仅带来 +0.68/+1.37 的 P1；物理验证器（仅对 274 题中 43 题介入）在两种策略上分别带来 +8.76/+9.12 的物理 P1。按答案表示细分：纯数值物理题 P1=49.74%，科学记数法仅 6.25%，而单位一致性仍达 89.23%，说明主要瓶颈是公式选择、数值执行与科学记数法规范化。
AI.conclusion: RLVR 主要强化显式推理结构（P3），并不自动转化为答案准确性或证据/单位一致性的提升；自一致性提供小幅方差缩减，确定性物理验证器提供主要的物理系统级修正；三者应被视为互补组件而非单一优化目标。未来工作包括改进 P1/P2/P3 奖励配比、加强数值/符号归一化、扩展逻辑/物理验证器覆盖、加入置信区间与多随机种子评估，以及研究自适应候选数与轻量路由。

title: PRICE: A Systematic Study of LLM Adaptation Choices for Bitcoin Price Forecasting
summary: Cryptocurrency markets exhibit extreme volatility and non-stationary dynamics that challenge conventional forecasting methods. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for time series forecasting, the combined effects of adaptation choices remain largely unexplored in financial settings. This study introduces PRICE, a structured approach for adapting LLMs to short-term Bitcoin price forecasting. Built on a 4-bit quantized LLaMA-3 8B model, PRICE investigates how fine-tuning, numerical representation, prompting, inference, and decoding jointly influence forecasting performance. PRICE integrates Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), Recursive multi-step inference, Integer-rounded numerical representation, Context-Task-Format (CTF) prompting, and Exact zero-temperature decoding. Ablation studies show that each component contributes to forecasting accuracy and reliability. LoRA enables efficient training on limited hardware, recursive inference improves accuracy, integer-rounded values reduce errors, CTF prompting outperforms Chain-of-Thought, Implicit Chain-of-Thought (iCoT), and few-shot prompting, and zero-temperature decoding improves stability during recursive forecasting. Comparative evaluation against eight transformer-based and time-series foundation models shows that PRICE achieves the lowest forecasting errors on both validation and test sets while maintaining robust performance across evaluation periods. Despite being based on a model primarily pretrained on text rather than time-series data, PRICE achieves competitive or superior performance relative to specialized foundation models. These findings demonstrate that adaptation choices critically determine the accuracy and robustness of LLMs for numerical time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRICE框架，系统研究将LLM适配到比特币短期价格预测的五种关键选择（LoRA微调、递归推理、整数舍入数值表示、CTF提示、零温度解码），基于4位量化LLaMA-3 8B模型，在验证集和测试集上均达到最低预测误差，优于八种Transformer和时序基础模型。
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场具有极端波动性和非平稳性，传统预测方法难以应对。现有LLM时间序列预测研究多孤立探讨单一适配选择，缺乏对金融场景下多种适配选择联合效应的系统性研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统量化各适配决策对预测精度和鲁棒性的贡献。
AI.method: PRICE框架整合五种适配组件：(1) LoRA参数高效微调（rank=16）；(2) 递归自回归多步推理；(3) 整数舍入数值表示；(4) Context-Task-Format (CTF) 结构化提示；(5) 零温度确定性解码。基于4位量化LLaMA-3 8B-Instruct，使用96小时历史数据预测未来8小时价格。通过控制变量消融实验和与8个基线模型的对比评估验证效果。
AI.result: 消融实验显示：LoRA微调使MAE降低约74-75%；递归推理优于直接多步生成；整数舍入表示在所有数值格式中表现最佳（MAPE 3.01）；CTF提示优于CoT、iCoT和少样本提示；零温度解码降低约3.8% MAE。对比评估中，PRICE在验证集和测试集上均取得最低MAE、MSE、MAPE、SMAPE和NRMSE，且在评估期间表现稳定，而多个基线模型出现显著性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 适配选择（而非仅模型本身）是决定LLM数值预测性能的关键因素。系统性地组合参数高效微调、递归推理、适当数值表示、结构化提示和确定性解码，可使通用LLM在比特币短期预测中超越专业时序基础模型。该框架为将通用LLM适配到数值时间序列预测任务提供了系统性指导。

title: How Does mHC Use Its Residual Streams? Selective Routing and Near-Identity Mixing
summary: Hyper-Connections and their manifold-constrained variant mHC widen a residual pathway from one stream to n, yet how trained models use this capacity remains unclear: how broadly blocks read and write, how strongly the residual pathway mixes streams, and whether the streams carry distinct representations. We examine these properties in the four-stream residual pathway of DeepSeek-V4-Flash using effective stream counts, cross-stream residual weights, and inter-stream cosine similarity. Read/write routing is concentrated but varies across depth: a typical attention or FFN site effectively uses about two streams, while the dominant stream changes across layers and the representations remain directionally distinct. Residual mixing is modest and occurs primarily in early layers; in layers 22-42, the pathway mostly carries each stream forward separately. Targeted interventions establish the functional significance of these patterns. Replacing the late mixers by identity increases C4 perplexity by only 1.9% and preserves the six-task average score, whereas replacing the early mixers increases perplexity by 41%. Fixing each early mixer to its C4 diagnostic mean increases perplexity by only 0.2% and reduces the average score by 0.25 percentage points, showing that its site-specific structure matters more than its token-wise variation on the evaluated metrics. Likewise, retaining the three largest routing weights per token at every site increases perplexity by at most 2.7% and changes the average score by at most 0.4 points. Thus, the studied model realizes only part of the flexibility afforded by four-stream mHC: individual blocks rarely require all four streams, and late residual mixing provides little measured benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文对 284B 参数、43 层的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 进行了真实前向传播诊断与无需再训练的推理干预，系统刻画其四流 mHC 残差路径的实际使用方式。研究发现：每个注意力和 FFN 站点通常只有效使用约两条流，但主路由流会随深度及读写类型变化；四个流保持方向上可区分的表示。跨流残差混合较弱且主要集中于前 22 层，后 21 层几乎退化为单位映射。干预实验进一步表明，top-3 路由和后层单位化造成的性能损失较小，而 top-2 路由或前层单位化会造成显著退化。作者据此认为，该模型并未充分利用四流 mHC 的全部灵活性，而是形成了“局部冗余、深度重排、结构性欠利用”的多流计算组织。
AI.motivation: 现有小规模 HC 研究发现模型可能形成单流主导且残差混合接近恒等映射的组织方式，但尚不清楚这一现象能否推广到大规模 mHC 模型，也不知道这些结构模式在推理时是否真正必要。论文旨在同时回答：四流容量被多大程度使用、混合机制如何分布、流的表示是否冗余，以及弱路由与近恒等混合器是否可安全简化。
AI.method: 研究对象为公开的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 检查点：43 层 MoE、284B 总参数、13B 激活参数、训练数据超过 32T token，使用四流 mHC。作者对全部 43 层的注意力和 FFN 共 86 个子层执行真实前向 instrumentation，并从 C4 训练集随机抽取 512 条、每条 1024 token 的序列进行诊断。测量三类指标：（1）用 winner consistency 和基于 Simpson 集中度的有效流数 n_eff=1/Σp_j² 衡量读写路由宽度；（2）以残差混合矩阵相对单位阵的平均绝对偏差 δ 衡量跨流混合；（3）以六对流的平均余弦相似度衡量表示冗余。随后在不重训的情况下实施两类推理干预：保留每 token 最大 2 或 3 个读/写权重并按总和缩放；将指定深度范围的残差混合器替换为单位阵，或固定为 C4 诊断均值。质量评估采用 GPTQ 协议的 C4 困惑度（256 条×2048 token）及 ARC-E、ARC-C、PIQA、HellaSwag、MMLU、GSM8K 六项零样本任务平均分。
AI.result: 路由在单站点内较集中：读写 winner consistency 均值分别为 0.871 和 0.905；有效流数均值分别为 1.998 和 1.775。写路由更窄，后段层 22–42 的写路由有效流数由前段 0–21 的 1.467 增至 2.098。局部主路由较稳定，62.5% 的相邻层保持同一 winner，但主导流在不同深度和读写/子层类型间重排，因此不是全网络单流坍缩。流表示在第 0 层初始相同，平均余弦为 1.0，随后快速分离；其余站点均值处于 0.235–0.564，全局平均 0.404，未出现表示塌缩。残差混合 δ 在全部 86 站点均值为 0.028；前 22 层均值 0.046，后 21 层仅 0.009，层 23–42 的 40 个站点中 32 个 δ<0.01。干预结果：top-3 读/写使 C4 PPL 分别上升 2.4% 和 2.7%，六任务均分变化为 -0.38 和 -0.05 个百分点；top-2 读/写使 PPL 上升 12.1% 和 14.0%，均分下降 2.92 和 6.59 点。层 22–42 混合器单位化仅使 PPL 上升 1.9%，均分增加 0.04 点；前 22 层单位化使 PPL 上升 41.4%，全层单位化上升 42.3%。将前层混合器固定为各站点 C4 均值后，PPL 仅上升 0.2%，均分下降 0.25 点，说明其价值主要来自学习到的站点结构，而非 token 级动态变化。
AI.conclusion: 四流 mHC 的名义宽度不等于有效容量。DeepSeek-V4-Flash 仅实现部分设计灵活性：单个模块通常依赖约两条流，最低权重的局部路由基本冗余，后层跨流混合几乎没有可测收益；但这并非彻底坍缩，剩余路由和前层混合器的站点特定结构仍然重要。前层混合更像按深度配置的静态结构，后层则可简化为单位残差并跳过 Sinkhorn–Knopp 归一化，从而降低推理成本。论文给出了结构性欠利用的证据，但关于路由集中由何种训练反馈机制形成、后期混合弱源于功能需求不足还是 Sinkhorn 梯度传递不足，仍需结合训练期轨迹和配对消融实验验证。

title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
summary: Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserving training and model personalization. Federated learning offers a natural solution for privacy, but standard FL methods produce global models that sacrifice regional performance, while existing personalized FL approaches operate at the parameter level and catastrophically collapse on modern transformers (below 10\% accuracy on T5) due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm interactions. We introduce RegionFed, an \textit{architecture-robust} federated learning framework that sidesteps this failure by operating entirely at the gradient level. RegionFed uses the $\ell_2$ conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal that (i) diagnoses heterogeneity, (ii) routes each region to the cheapest sufficient personalization strategy, and (iii) adaptively controls personalization strength. Because it treats models as differentiable black boxes, RegionFed deploys on T5-Small, T5-3B, RoBERTa, and CNN with zero code changes, providing large gains on transformers (where parameter-level methods collapse) and consistent improvements on CNNs. Across three public datasets (Amazon ESCI, Amazon Reviews, LEAF-FEMNIST) and four architectures, RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27\%, closing the gap to the privacy-violating centralized upper bound (Centralized + Regional Weighting: 92.04\%, $\Delta$=0.23pp, within 1$\sigma$) while providing $(\epsilon{\approx}0.60)$-differential privacy and $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence.

AI.tldr: RegionFed 是一个面向异构零售环境的联邦学习框架,通过在梯度层面(而非参数层面)进行个性化,解决了现有参数级个性化方法在 Transformer 上灾难性崩溃的问题,在 T5、RoBERTa、CNN 等架构上以零代码修改实现稳定部署,并在 (ε≈0.60) 差分隐私下接近集中式训练精度。
AI.motivation: 零售搜索系统需服务差异显著的地理区域(词汇、产品偏好不同),既要保护用户隐私(GDPR/CCPA)又要实现区域个性化。标准 FL 产生牺牲区域性能的全局模型;现有参数级个性化方法(SCAFFOLD、pFedMe、Ditto、APFL)在 Transformer 上因共享嵌入和 LayerNorm 交互而灾难性崩溃(T5 准确率 <10%)。
AI.method: RegionFed 采用三层架构(全局服务器-区域协调器-客户端),核心创新是梯度级个性化:使用区域梯度与全局梯度之间的 ℓ2 冲突作为统一信号,(1)诊断异构性,(2)将每个区域路由到最便宜足够的策略(Grad/Interp/Meta),(3)通过 sigmoid 函数自适应控制个性化强度 αr。模型被视为可微分黑盒,无需修改代码即可部署于 T5-Small、T5-3B、RoBERTa、CNN。理论证明 O(1/√T) 收敛率,并通过矩账户实现 (ε≈0.60, δ=10⁻⁵)-差分隐私。
AI.result: 在 Amazon ESCI(T5-Small)上 RegionFed-Meta 达 92.27%,与集中式上界 92.04% 差距仅 0.23pp(在 1σ 内);较 FedAvg/FedProx 提升 12-25pp。参数级方法 SCAFFOLD、pFedMe、Ditto、APFL 在所有 Transformer 上崩溃(<10%),且该崩溃在不同 E∈{1,5,10,40} 下持续存在——控制消融证实根因为 T5 共享嵌入(解绑后 SCAFFOLD 恢复至 42.61%)和 LayerNorm(冻结后恢复至 38.47%)。跨架构验证:T5-3B 94.12%、RoBERTa-Base 91.62%、FEMNIST CNN 85.21%(集中式 86.73%)。在 16 个区域(160 客户端)下仅退化 2.41%,FedAvg 退化 8.49%。在强隐私 ε=0.15 下仍保持 88.15% 准确率,优于 FedAvg 的隐私设置。
AI.conclusion: RegionFed 通过梯度冲突而非参数操控实现个性化,能够跨 Transformer 与 CNN 架构稳定部署。梯度级操作避开了参数级修正导致的不稳定性,控制消融证实共享嵌入和 LayerNorm 为不稳定性根源。在三个公开数据集、四种架构上,RegionFed 在 (ε≈0.60)-DP 下达到 92.27%(与集中式 92.04% 在 1σ 内一致)。贡献分解:层次结构贡献 +3.29pp,梯度冲突自适应贡献 +8.80pp(占总增益 12.09pp 的 73%)。局限性:需要预定义区域(自动发现为未来工作;误配置仅损失 4.2pp);Dynamic 策略偶有误路由;多模态任务和状态空间模型未验证。

title: Performance Study of Serverless Workloads in Confidential Virtual Machines
summary: Confidential serverless computing is rapidly emerg- ing as a critical paradigm for application domains requiring strong confidentiality guarantees, such as healthcare, finance, and machine learning. To enable this paradigm in untrusted cloud environments, Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs) provide isolation by encrypting the entire guest memory, and thus securing serverless workloads against host-level access and inter- ference. However, the implications of CVMs for serverless systems remain insufficiently understood. This paper presents an empirical study of serverless work- loads in CVMs, systematically covering memory efficiency and runtime overhead on both warm-starts and cold-starts. Our results show that CVMs incur substantial memory overhead because encrypted memory disables cross-VM page deduplication and reduces memory reclaimability, thereby limiting warm- container capacity under a fixed memory budget. Runtime overhead in warm-starts is workload dependent. Workloads with frequent VMEXITs, particularly idle transitions, suffer substantial slowdowns. These slowdowns are further amplified by common serverless deployment practice that couples vCPU allocation to memory size, as higher-memory configurations expose more vCPUs than some functions can use effectively. For cold starts, the study focuses on container creation, a common and major contributor to startup latency. Motivated by the memory-efficiency results, we consider the deployments in which multiple containers of the same function are consolidated within the same CVM to improve efficiency, and show that selectively relaxing certain isolation mechanisms in this setting can substan- tially reduce startup overhead. These results clarify the main performance tradeoffs of confidential serverless computing and suggest practical ways to improve efficiency and latency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地实证研究了机密虚拟机（CVM）在无服务器计算场景下的性能表现，重点分析了内存效率、热启动执行开销和冷启动容器初始化三个维度，并揭示了关键瓶颈及优化策略。
AI.motivation: 无服务器计算广泛应用于医疗、金融和机器学习等需要强机密性保证的领域。CVM通过加密客户机内存提供隔离，但其在无服务器系统中的性能影响缺乏系统性研究。作者旨在填补这一空白，揭示CVM对内存效率、热启动和冷启动的影响机制。
AI.method: 基于Google Cloud Platform（GCP）和本地测试床，对Intel TDX和AMD SEV-SNP两种CVM实现与常规VM进行对比实验。覆盖15个来自SeBS、FunctionBench和FaaSProfiler的基准测试，分为计算密集型、I/O密集型、ML推理以及Web/加密/API四类。通过控制变量（vCPU数量、线程数、空闲策略HLT/POLL、NUMA亲和性、cgroup配额等）进行根因分析，并辅以硬件计数器profiling和KernelShark追踪。
AI.result: （1）内存效率：CVM因加密内存禁用跨VM页去重（KSM）并降低内存可回收性，导致内存开销随部署规模显著增长。四个VM部署hello-world时开销约120%，IR (ResNet-152) 约147%；（2）热启动开销：具有频繁VMEXIT（尤其是HLT空闲转换）的工作负载慢显著，例如图像识别因VMEXIT率超30万次/秒出现最大降速。vCPU与内存耦合的部署策略加剧此问题——8线程时CVM慢近200%，22 vCPU时达3.5倍。HLT策略下HLT类型VMEXIT虽仅占29%数量但贡献99%开销；（3）冷启动：容器启动占总执行时间约65%，CVM本身不显著增加冷启动开销，但多vCPU同步、cgroup percpu_rwsem争用（占runc启动时间高达50%）成为瓶颈。在受限信任模型下，跳过cgroup配置（-27%）、seccomp过滤（-30ms）、复用网络命名空间（-50ms）可显著降低启动延迟。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统揭示了机密无服务器计算在内存密度、热启动延迟和冷启动延迟三个维度的核心权衡。主要贡献有：量化了去重丢失导致的内存开销及对热容器容量的影响；识别VMEXIT（特别是HLT）与无服务器vCPU-内存耦合策略的交互放大效应；表征runc容器初始化的cgroup争用瓶颈；验证了在受限信任模型下选择性放宽隔离机制可显著降低启动延迟。结论为在新兴机密计算基础设施上设计高效安全的无服务器平台提供了实用指导。

title: Revisiting MemGuard Overhead: A Reproduction Report
summary: As an increasing number of embedded platforms incorporate multiple processing units, shared resource contention induced unpredictable execution time poses a challenge for real-time system design. Memory bandwidth regulation is a popular mitigation approach, and MemGuard is the canonical example. Recently, MemPol introduced a new bandwidth regulation mechanism, which was compared with MemGuard. Specifically, they reported significant overheads for MemGuard, citing up to a 1.79x slowdown, to contextualize MemPol's comparative benefits. This report is meant to clarify and add the necessary nuance to the experiments carried out in that prior work. Specifically, we show that the MemGuard overheads presented in these prior evaluations were unintentionally amplified as the result of using a suboptimal configuration with an older version of MemGuard, wherein the benchmark under test was pinned directly to the master core responsible for handling global timer interrupts. By faithfully reproducing these specific experiments using a modern, decentralized implementation of MemGuard, we demonstrate that the actual execution overhead drops significantly under identical conditions. Consequently, when evaluated with a properly configured recent version, MemGuard exhibits an overhead that is highly comparable to MemPol's overhead. By revisiting these baseline metrics, this report provides an updated and comprehensive perspective required for future evaluations of memory bandwidth regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇复现报告，指出MemPol论文中报告的MemGuard开销（最高1.79倍减速）因使用了旧版集中式MemGuard且将基准测试错误绑定到主核心而被人为放大。使用现代去中心化版本或正确配置后，MemGuard开销降至约1.05-1.09倍，与MemPol相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: MemPol论文报告MemGuard存在显著的执行开销（最高1.79×），并以此凸显MemPol的优势。但这一开销测量可能因实验配置不当而被高估。本文旨在澄清该问题，复现MemPol的实验设置，重新评估MemGuard的真实开销。
AI.method: 在Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102平台上，使用三种配置复现MemPol的MemGuard开销实验：(1) 旧版MemGuard+基准绑定到主核心；(2) 旧版MemGuard+基准绑定到非主核心；(3) 新版去中心化MemGuard（commit 67eb0d8）。测量不同补充周期（32µs-1ms）下的减速比。此外还重新评估了MemGuard与MemPol在SD-VBS基准上的对比实验，并补充评估了MemGuard的带宽回收和共享功能。
AI.result: 在32µs补充周期下，三种配置的开销分别为1.79×、1.05×和1.09×。现代去中心化MemGuard在所有评估周期和基准上与MemPol性能相当，在内存密集型基准（如disparity）上甚至优于MemPol。此外，MemGuard的带宽回收（BR）和空闲带宽共享（SS）机制可显著提升受调控基准的性能。
AI.conclusion: 此前MemPol论文中报告的1.79× MemGuard开销是旧版集中式实现与错误绑定配置导致的人为现象，而非MemGuard的真实特性。使用正确配置后，MemGuard与MemPol性能相当，且其带宽回收和共享功能进一步展现优势。该报告为未来内存带宽调节器的公平评估提供了更新的基线。

title: Improving Progressive Compression with Adaptive Interpolation and Coefficient Decomposition
summary: Exascale simulations generate data far faster than it can be stored or analyzed, making efficient data reduction essential. Error-controlled lossy compression offers high compression ratios under user-specified error bounds, but the target tolerance must be fixed at compression time. Progressive compression relaxes this restriction, yet existing methods still rely on fixed refactoring strategies and do not fully exploit correlations among decomposed coefficients, limiting the efficiency of progressive retrieval. In this work, we present an adaptive progressive compression framework that improves retrieval efficiency for two common targets, namely error-bound and peak Signal-to-Noise ratios. Our contributions are fourfold. (1) We propose to leverage two complementary interpolation schemes for adaptive progressive compression toward different targets, and we optimize them to achieve high efficiency. (2) We propose coefficient decomposition, a novel method that exploits the commonly overlooked spatial correlations among decorrelated data, which further improves the efficiency. (3) We develop the adaptive progressive compression workflow with automatic selection of the best-fit refactoring pipeline and tailored optimizations. (4) We evaluate the proposed framework on five real-world scientific datasets against three state-of-the-art progressive compressors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves the compression ratio by up to $42.3\%$ under the same requested error tolerance and up to $92.5\%$ at the same PSNR, compared with the best-performing existing methods. When transferring $512$ GB of scientific data to remote sites, the framework delivers up to $1.26\times$ speedup in the end-to-end data transfer performance. Furthermore, our method achieves the highest visualization quality while retrieving the least amount of data from storage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ProAICD框架，通过自适应插值方案（per-level与per-region）和系数分解方法，提升科学数据渐进式压缩的检索效率，针对误差界和PSNR两种目标分别优化，在压缩比、传输速度和可视化质量上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: Exascale模拟产生的数据量远超存储和分析能力。传统误差有界有损压缩需预先固定容差，而渐进式压缩虽允许检索时调整精度，但现有方法（如PMGARD、IPComp）采用固定的插值流水线，且未充分利用分解系数间的相关性，导致检索效率受限。
AI.method: 1. 自适应插值：结合per-level（误差传播低，精度较低）和per-region（精度高，但误差传播）两种插值方案，根据误差界或PSNR目标自动选择；2. 系数分解（CoeffDecom）：对分解后的系数沿垂直于插值方向的二维切片再次进行多层per-level线性插值（固定3层），挖掘去相关数据中的空间相关性；3. 目标驱动调优：采样1%数据通过投票自动选择最佳配置；4. 性能优化：沿最快变化方向插值、通用位平面编码消除分支等。
AI.result: 在5个真实科学数据集（CESM、Miranda、SCALE、S3D、JHTDB）上：相同误差界下压缩比提升最高42.3%，相同PSNR下提升最高92.5%；512GB数据端到端传输速度提升最高1.26倍；在CESM温度场可视化中以最低比特率（0.37）实现最高保真度。重构吞吐率与现有方法相当。
AI.conclusion: ProAICD框架通过自适应插值和系数分解显著提升了渐进式压缩在误差界和PSNR两种模式下的检索效率和重建质量，并在实际数据传输和可视化场景中验证了其优势。未来工作将进一步挖掘数据相关性并将框架扩展到GPU。

title: CIERA: Cross-Iteration Exponent Reuse for Lossless Allgather in Sharded MoE Training
summary: In training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, sharded data parallelism partitions each expert's parameters across GPUs, requiring an Allgather operation to reconstruct the full weight matrix before each layer executes. This communication often dominates iteration time. Prior work often reduces this overhead using lossy compression methods that sacrifice numerical fidelity, while existing lossless methods do not exploit cross-iteration exponent stability. In this paper, we propose Cross-Iteration Exponent Reuse Allgather (CIERA), a lossless, system-aware communication method for sharded MoE training. We observe that after a brief warmup phase, the exponent values of most weights remain unchanged across iterations. Based on this, we cache exponents locally and transmit only the sign and mantissa when exponents are unchanged. The receiver reconstructs the original weights exactly by combining the cached exponents with the received data. Since parameter matrices vary in shape across layers, compression is applied only when it yields net time savings. Moreover, the compression operation is overlapped with both Allgather communication and computation. Our real experiments and large-scale trace-driven simulator show that on OLMoE-1B-7B at 16 GPUs, CIERA achieves a 3.70x speedup over the lossless baseline and 3.68x over the lossy baseline, projected to reach 4.28x and 4.42x respectively at 128 GPUs, while preserving bitwise-exact parameter reconstruction in all evaluated runs.

AI.tldr: CIERA提出了一种无损的Allgather通信压缩方法，通过跨迭代缓存和复用浮点权重的指数位（仅传输符号位和尾数位），结合选择性压缩和计算-通信流水线重叠，在分片MoE训练中实现了相比无损和有损基线显著的训练加速，同时保证逐位精确的参数重建。
AI.motivation: 在分片数据并行（Sharded Data Parallelism）的MoE训练中，Allgather操作占通信时间的51.8%–69.0%，成为关键瓶颈。现有方法要么采用有损压缩（如ZeRO++的int8量化）牺牲数值精度，要么采用无损压缩但未利用训练过程中的跨迭代冗余，导致通信开销难以有效降低。
AI.method: CIERA包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于指数复用的压缩（Exponent Reuse based Compression）：将每个权重拆分为符号、指数、尾数，本地缓存指数，仅在指数发生变化时传输变化的指数块，使用ANS编码压缩传输数据，接收端通过本地缓存的指数与接收到的符号+尾数合并重建原始权重；(2) 收益驱动的选择性压缩（Benefit-driven Selective Compression, BSC）：通过离线评估每个分片的块变化率和压缩收益，仅对压缩收益为正的分片启用压缩，跳过attention、routing-gate等变化率高的分片；(3) 计算-通信流水线（Computation-Communication Pipelining, CCP）：使用PyTorch FX图调度，将哈希、压缩等操作提前到前一层的计算阶段执行，使其与计算和通信重叠，仅解压缩操作保留在关键路径上。
AI.result: 在4块A100 GPU上的真实实验中，CIERA在OLMoE-1B-7B等通信受限的MoE模型上相对ZeRO-3无损基线实现1.16×–2.89×加速，相对ZeRO++有损基线实现1.21×–3.80×加速。在16 GPU上OLMoE-1B-7B达到3.70×（vs ZeRO-3）和3.68×（vs ZeRO++）加速，通过基于仿真的扩展预计在128 GPU上分别达到4.28×和4.42×。消融实验验证了三个组件的累积贡献（ER、BSC、CCP逐步叠加）。在20,000步OLMoE-1B-7B训练中，CIERA与ZeRO-3的训练loss曲线完全重合，最大绝对差为零，实现逐位精确重建。
AI.conclusion: CIERA通过利用MoE训练中浮点权重指数位的跨迭代稳定性，实现了无损的Allgather通信压缩，显著降低了分片MoE训练的通信开销，同时保持数值精度。其系统感知设计（选择性压缩和流水线重叠）确保了收益大于开销。在通信受限的稀疏MoE模型上效果显著，但对稠密LLM或块变化率极高的模型收益有限。

title: GreenPipe: Power Modeling for Containerized DNN Inference on Kubernetes Edge Nodes
comment: Accepted to Workshop proceeding of Euro-Par 2026; 6th International Workshop on Performance and Energy Efficiency in Concurrent and Distributed Systems
summary: Distributed DNN inference is increasingly deployed in containerized edge-cloud environments, where workloads run on-device or are exposed to remote clients over the network. Accurate online power estimation on resource-constrained ARM nodes without hardware power counters such as RAPL remains a challenge, and CPU-only models fail to capture multi-resource behavior. We present GreenPipe, an automated profiling-training-validation pipeline that builds multi-resource regression models from external power meter measurements and attributes power to containers proportionally. GreenPipe is evaluated on a Raspberry Pi 4 edge node in a K3s edge-cloud testbed, covering DNN inference with three vision models, multiple precisions, thread counts, and both local and serving scenarios. System-level MAPE is 6.3-9.4%, improving over CPU-stress and utilization-only baselines by 26.9% MAPE on average. We jointly report inference latency and energy per inference, exposing performance-energy trade-offs across workload configurations.

AI.tldr: GreenPipe 是一个针对 Kubernetes 边缘节点上容器化 DNN 推理场景的自动化功耗建模流水线。它通过外部功率计标定多资源指标，训练多资源回归模型，并在运行时提供节点级功耗预测和容器级功耗归因。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备（ARM 架构如树莓派）缺乏 RAPL 等硬件功耗计数器，无法直接获取功耗数据；同时，容器化 DNN 推理涉及 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等多种资源路径，纯 CPU 模型无法准确刻画其功耗行为。需要一种无需硬件支持、可在线运行的功耗建模方法，且能以容器为粒度提供功耗可见性，以支持能效感知的调度与编排。
AI.method: GreenPipe 包含离线建模与在线运行两阶段。离线阶段：基于 Kepler 改造的监控器（Go 语言，支持 ARM）通过 PMU、eBPF、cgroup 等采集 CPU、缓存、内存、磁盘、网络等多维指标，利用 stress-ng、iperf、DeepBench 等三类基准构建训练集，结合外部功率计（Ruideng UM25C, 1Hz）标定数据，筛选 7 个代表性特征，训练并对比 11 种回归模型（LR、Ridge、DT、RF、GB、XGB 等），按 MAPE 选优。在线阶段：训练好的模型作为 sidecar 部署，以每秒粒度预测节点功耗，并通过静态/动态功耗分解、按资源使用比例归因的方式将功耗分配到各容器。
AI.result: 在 Raspberry Pi 4 + K3s 边缘云测试床上，使用 MobileNetV2、EfficientNetB0、ResNetV2 三种视觉模型，覆盖 fp32/int8/fp16 精度、多线程、本地与服务化两种推理场景。系统级 MAPE 为 6.3%–9.4%，相比 CPU 压力基线和利用率基线平均降低 26.9% MAPE；MAE 较 CPU-stress 基线降低 46.9%。精度与模型架构对误差影响有限，而线程数、推理引擎与部署模式（本地 vs. 服务化）是误差的主要来源。线程并行可降低时延但不必然降低能耗；监控与估算开销小于节点总功耗的 2%。
AI.conclusion: GreenPipe 验证了在资源受限的 ARM 边缘节点上，无需硬件功耗计数器即可对容器化 DNN 推理实现准确的多资源功耗建模与在线估算，并支持容器级功耗归因。未来工作将扩展至更多边缘平台、GPU 设备、DVFS 调节场景，并探索基于周期性功率计标定的在线再校准机制。

title: Same Request, Different Answer: Quantization Amplifies Cache-Induced Divergence in LLM Serving
summary: Prefix caching, in which a serving engine reuses the key and value tensors of a shared prompt prefix across requests, is enabled by default in the major open-source stacks and treated as a transparent optimization. We measure what it costs in reproducibility, and find that the cost rises sharply with weight quantization. Holding the model, decoding parameters, seed, and request order fixed, and issuing every request serially at batch size one, we ran an eighty-episode multi-turn agentic tool-use workload with caching enabled and disabled across two engines and four weight formats. Enabling the cache changed the agent's trajectory on 36.2 percent of episodes at 16-bit precision and on 75.0 percent at four-bit, a gradient that survives re-measurement under a controlled cache configuration. With caching disabled, repeated execution was bit-identical in every configuration, 0 of 800 episodes, which bounds other sources of nondeterminism at 0.5 percent. Repeated cache-enabled runs did diverge, and three experiments locate the cause: a single server-level prompt-cache setting moves run-to-run divergence by 37.5 percentage points, execution order acts only while that setting is active, and restoring cache state makes the cached and recompute paths each reproduce on 40 of 40 items while still differing from each other on 14. Cached serving is deterministic given cache state, and irreproducible in practice because that state is absent from the request and never reset by default. A single-turn bridge shows the divergence reaching task outcomes without shifting aggregate accuracy. We release the harness, logs, and analysis pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验，系统量化了前缀缓存（Prefix Caching）对大语言模型推理可复现性的影响。研究发现：(1) 关闭缓存时，重复执行在10种配置、800轮episode中全部逐位一致（0/800），将其他非确定性源上界设为0.5%；(2) 启用缓存后，相同请求在不同运行间产生分歧，16位精度下36.2%episode改变轨迹，4-bit量化下升至75.0%；(3) 量化越粗，缓存诱导分歧越显著（Cochran–Armitage p=1.3e-8）；(4) 单个服务器级prompt-cache配置开关即可使运行间分歧变动37.5个百分点；(5) 单轮任务中，正确性翻转双向发生且方向无偏（McNemar p=0.26），聚合准确率不变。核心结论：缓存服务在给定缓存状态时是确定性的，但在实践中因缓存状态对请求不可见、默认不被重置而不可复现。
AI.motivation: 前缀缓存在主流开源推理栈中默认启用并被当作透明优化，但其对相同请求返回相同结果这一隐含保证从未在真实工作负载上被系统测量。实践中已有用户报告缓存导致准确率下降或同一请求返回不同文本（vLLM issue tracker），但缺乏控制变量的量化研究。本文旨在测量该优化在多轮智能体工作负载下对可复现性的代价，并揭示量化对该效应的影响。
AI.method: 采用配对设计：在固定模型、量化格式、引擎、采样参数（greedy, T=0, seed=42）、批量大小为1、串行请求的条件下，对80轮BFCL多轮智能体工具调用工作负载进行两次完整运行；分别测试llama.cpp（GGUF格式）与vLLM两个引擎、四个权重精度（F16/Q8_0/Q4_K_M/Q3_K_M）。核心机制分析包含三个补充实验：(1) 变化执行顺序；(2) 变化llama.cpp的服务器级prompt-cache开关；(3) 重置缓存状态后比较缓存路径与重算路径。单轮桥梁使用GSM8K数学数据集。统计方法包括Wilson区间、Moving-block bootstrap（因episode非独立）、Cochran–Armitage趋势检验、精确McNemar检验。
AI.result: （1）缓存关闭时全部配置复现完全一致：0/800 episode，将其他非确定性源上界定为0.5%。（2）缓存启用时跨运行分歧率范围8.8%–77.5%；跨臂（缓存开vs关）分歧率36.2%（16-bit）至91.2%（Qwen2.5-14B Q4_K_M）。（3）量化梯度：Qwen2.5-7B在F16/Q8_0/Q4_K_M/Q3_K_M下跨臂分歧分别为36.2/61.3/75.0/77.5%，趋势检验z=5.68, p=1.3×10⁻⁸。（4）单个prompt-cache开关使运行间分歧从1.2%升至38.8%（差37.5pp），执行顺序仅在该层激活时有影响。（5）状态恢复控制：缓存路径与重算路径各自40/40完全复现，但二者相互间仍有14/40不同。（6）单轮任务：路径内部完全确定；跨路径分歧3.5%（F16）至48.0%（Q3_K_M）；20次正确性翻转中13次偏向缓存路径、7次偏向重算路径，McNemar p=0.26，聚合准确率无显著变化。（7）分歧出现早：episode内首次不同请求的中位序号为1–4/约10。
AI.conclusion: 缓存服务在给定缓存状态时是确定性的函数，但因缓存状态不包含于请求中、不在响应中报告、且默认不重置，实践中不可复现。该效应体现为不稳定而非降级：单项正确性翻转双向发生且聚合准确率无偏移。因此对任务正确性的担忧应让位于对可复现性的担忧。建议：(1) 评估报告应明确说明是否启用前缀缓存；(2) 推理引擎应在响应中统一暴露缓存使用情况（llama.cpp已实现，vLLM 0.11.0未实现）；(3) 需要可复现的工作流可通过控制缓存配置并在运行边界重置状态来保留大部分吞吐收益，而非完全关闭缓存。

title: Resilience Beyond Stationary Client Unavailability: Unlocking Efficient and Unbiased Federated Learning
summary: Due to resource constraints or external and internal uncertainties, clients in real-world federated learning systems are often intermittently available edge devices. In highly dynamic environments, the parameter server lacks prior real-time knowledge of clients' availability, making it challenging to adapt traditional federated learning algorithms to be resilient to uncertainties in client availability. If not carefully addressed, complex client availability can introduce significant bias, potentially harming the performance of the trained model. Most prior work either fails to account for non-stationary client availability dynamics or demands significant memory and computational overhead. This paper aims to develop efficient federated learning algorithms that are provably resilient to heterogeneous and non-stationary stochastic client availability. We propose FedSWE, which admits novel algorithmic structures to (i) compensate for missed computations, (ii) stabilize and diffuse the global updates over rounds, and (iii) evenly mix the local updates through implicit gossiping, despite being agnostic to non-stationary dynamics. Compared with the standard FedAvg, FedSWE introduces light additional memory and computation overhead. We show that FedSWE converges to a stationary point of non-convex objectives while achieving the desired linear speedup property in certain special cases. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments over diversified client unavailability dynamics on real-world data sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedSWE算法，解决联邦学习中客户端可用性异构且非平稳所导致的模型偏差问题，在低开销下实现无偏且收敛至非凸目标的平稳点。
AI.motivation: 在真实跨设备联邦学习系统中，客户端因资源约束、时区差异、网络覆盖等因素而具有异构且非平稳的间歇可用性。现有方法要么假设可用性平稳/已知，要么需要巨大内存开销保存历史梯度，导致FedAvg在动态不可用下产生显著偏差，模型性能严重下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出更一般的客户端可用性建模假设（窗口平均下界），允许可用概率偶尔降为零；2) 设计FedSWE算法，融合三个新机制：自适应创新回声（用累计未参与步数放大本地创新以补偿缺失计算）、全局移动平均（用插值系数k平滑与扩散全局更新）、隐式 gossip（延迟多播全局模型，使活跃客户端经参数服务器隐式交换信息以均衡混合本地更新）。
AI.result: 理论证明FedSWE在非凸目标下收敛到平稳点，并在若干特殊情形下达到期望的线性加速（linear speedup）性质；相对FedAvg仅引入轻量级额外内存和计算开销。实验在真实数据集上多种不可用动态下验证了其有效性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: FedSWE是首个在客户端独立、异构且非平稳可用性下，无需先验知识且开销极低的无偏联邦学习算法，其三个核心机制（创新回声、全局移动平均、隐式 gossip）协同补偿偏差、稳定训练并均衡信息混合。

title: Solution-space heterogeneity shapes federated learning dynamics across partial differential equations
summary: Federated scientific machine learning enables institutions to train neural surrogates without centralizing local physical data, yet studies of partial differential equations (PDEs) lack a transferable definition of non-independent and identically distributed data. Existing protocols partition coordinates, coefficients, boundary conditions, or geometries according to equation-specific rules. Here, we introduce solution-space PDE-Dirichlet, a protocol that converts continuous supervised responses into reusable solution bins and quantifies the realized separation between clients through optimal transport over the geometry of these bins. We derive an exact inverse relation between population allocation heterogeneity and the Dirichlet concentration, and we establish conditions under which response heterogeneity induces gradient disagreement, local-update dispersion, and parameter divergence. Across seven controlled and public PDE tasks, three neural-operator families, and five random seeds, a lower concentration consistently increases the realized solution distance and optimization heterogeneity. The degradation in final error is task dependent: the largest effect occurs for low-viscosity Burgers, reaching 4.157 percentage points under the most heterogeneous setting, whereas additional communication or smoother dynamics can reduce the final gap despite persistent parameter separation. These results distinguish a reproducible geometric mechanism from task-dependent generalization outcomes and provide a common basis for evaluating non-IID federated PDE learning.
