AI.tldr: 该论文针对偏微分方程（PDE）联邦学习中缺乏可迁移的非独立同分布（non-IID）数据定义这一核心问题，提出了一种名为"solution-space PDE-Dirichlet"的通用协议。该协议通过将连续监督响应离散化为可复用的解分箱（solution bins），并利用基于分箱质心几何的最优传输距离来量化客户端间的实际异质性。作者在理论上推导了Dirichlet浓度参数与种群分配异质性的精确反比关系，并建立了响应异质性诱导梯度分歧、本地更新分散和参数发散的条件。通过七个PDE任务、三类神经算子家族和五个随机种子的实验验证，揭示了低Dirichlet浓度一致增加解空间距离和优化异质性，但最终测试误差的退化具有任务依赖性——在低黏度Burgers方程中效应最大（达4.157个百分点）。该研究将可复现的几何机制与任务相关的泛化结果区分开来，为评估非IID联邦PDE学习提供了统一基准。
AI.motivation: 在科学机器学习中，联邦学习允许多个机构协作训练神经代理模型而无需集中本地物理数据。然而，现有PDE联邦学习研究缺乏可迁移的非IID数据定义。传统分类任务中，类别标签提供自然的离散变量，可通过Dirichlet分布调节标签偏斜程度，但PDE算子数据集没有类似通用标签。现有协议按方程特定规则对坐标、系数、边界条件或几何进行划分，且输入空间的接近性不等同于响应空间的接近性——PDE解算子可能放大、抑制或定性转换输入扰动。这种模糊性导致名义上相似的非IID实验可能控制不同的物理因素，难以比较；所选划分变量可能无法预测驱动联邦优化的梯度；标量严重程度参数不保证在有限数据集、客户端数量或PDE体系下实现可比的实际异质性。这些限制阻碍了可复现性，并模糊了观察到的性能差距是源于联邦优化器、划分协议还是底层PDE。
AI.method: 论文提出"solution-space PDE-Dirichlet"协议，包含四个关键步骤：(1) 全局响应归一化与离散化——对训练响应进行归一化，应用K-means++聚类将其离散化为B个解分箱（伪类别），计算分箱质心间的欧氏距离作为传输成本；(2) 基于解分箱的Dirichlet分配——对每个分箱从Dirichlet(α·1_K)采样分配比例，通过多项式采样转换为整数客户端计数；(3) 解几何严重性与划分诊断——计算客户端直方图间基于最优传输的解距离D_sol；(4) 优化诊断——包括初始梯度异质性、相对参数发散和符号误差漂移。理论上，作者推导了精确的浓度定律：E[H_u] = (K-1)/(Kα+1)·Σπ_b²，建立了解的分配异质性与Dirichlet浓度的严格递减关系，并通过受限梯度可识别性假设建立了从分箱异质性到梯度异质性的传递定理，以及局部SGD更新分散与梯度异质性的平方关系。进一步推导了FedAvg与中心化训练轨迹的二阶差分表达式，证明全局轨迹漂移是涉及曲率-梯度对齐的二阶效应。实验设计采用K=10个客户端、B=10个分箱、α∈{100,10,1,0.1,0.01}的配置，五次随机种子，1000轮通信，每轮五次本地小批量优化步骤。三类受控任务（反导、Burgers、扩散-反应）使用笛卡尔DeepONet，四个公共任务（Darcy流、浅水、圆柱流、全波形反演）分别使用FNO2D和InversionNet-lite。
AI.result: 实验结果系统性地验证了理论预测：(1) 有限样本划分行为——降低α从100到0.01持续增加实际解距离（从0.15-0.17增至0.91-1.13），同时增加客户端数量变异系数和分配L1误差；(2) 受控任务的优化轨迹与最终误差——α=0.01时Burgers方程产生0.916pp的退化（95% CI [0.238, 1.595]），扩散-反应为0.218pp，反导任务则包含零的置信区间[-0.292, 0.751]；(3) 机制诊断显示解距离与初始梯度异质性（Spearman ρ_s = 0.69-0.83）和最终参数发散（ρ_s = 0.65-0.72）呈强正相关，但与最终过量误差的相关性因任务而异；(4) 物理体系消融揭示低黏度Burgers（ν=0.01）在α=0.01时产生最大退化4.157pp（CI [3.085, 5.228]），表明尖锐输运结构使解空间专业化更具影响；(5) 公共基准测试显示Darcy流和OpenFWI存在显著瞬态过量误差（4-5pp），但通过持续通信在第1000轮大幅恢复至0.465pp和0.228pp；(6) 输入空间W₁距离与解距离在预测梯度和参数发散方面表现相当，但输入距离在三个受控任务中与最终过量误差略更相关。整体而言，几何机制（浓度→距离→梯度→参数）在所有任务中一致，但符号误差漂移是任务相关的条件性下游可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出以下核心结论：(1) 解空间PDE-Dirichlet提供了跨PDE类型的通用联邦学习基准构建方法，通过响应离散化和几何感知传输消除了方程特定输入轴选择的必要性；(2) 浓度参数α与实际解距离、梯度异质性和参数发散之间存在可复现的因果链——降低α始终增加这些量，但有限样本效应和最小尺寸修复会引入实际下界和饱和现象；(3) 最终测试误差的退化具有任务依赖性：物理困难体系（低黏度Burgers）和客户端专业化效应叠加产生最严重后果，而平滑算子和持续通信可显著缩小最终差距；(4) 参数发散比测试误差漂移对非IID优化更为敏感，但单独参数发散不足以建立泛化退化的结论；(5) 输入空间距离与解空间距离在预测梯度异质性方面表现相当，但解空间传输的优势在于概念性和程序性——同一构造可跨前向算子、时间预测和反问题复用，无需为每个方程选择不同物理轴。该研究建立了一个可证伪的基准而非支配最终误差的无条件定律。重要后续工作包括：将解空间距离与自然发生的客户端划分校准、用离散化下稳定的物理表示替换欧氏响应量化、确定解空间诊断能否指导客户端采样或聚合，以期将该机制探针转化为联邦科学学习的实用工具。

title: DTM: Deterministic Approaches for Black-box Test Suite Minimization with Tree-based Similarity
summary: Black-box Test Suite Minimization (TSM) techniques reduce testing costs without requiring access to production code. However, existing effective approaches rely on evolutionary search algorithms, introducing non-determinism that produces inconsistent results across runs, undermining reliability in automated testing pipelines. We propose DTM (Deterministic approaches for black-box Test suite Minimization), a framework that ensures deterministic test suite reduction while preserving effectiveness and efficiency. DTM converts test cases into Abstract Syntax Trees and computes pairwise similarities using four tree-based measures. For subset selection, it employs three deterministic algorithms: Modified Minimum Spanning Tree, Spectral Clustering, and Dynamic Programming. We evaluated DTM on 16 Java projects from Defects4J with 661 buggy versions. Experimental results show that DTM achieved an average accuracy of 0.74 with an execution time of just 0.98 minutes, outperforming all state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, it consistently produced identical results across multiple runs, ensuring full determinism.

AI.tldr: DTM是一个用于黑盒测试套件最小化（TSM）的确定性框架，通过基于AST的树相似度计算和三种确定性子集选择算法（MST、SC、DP），解决了现有方法依赖进化搜索导致的非确定性问题，并在准确性和执行效率上超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒TSM方法（如ATM、LTM）依赖遗传算法等进化搜索策略，导致结果具有非确定性，在自动化CI/CD流水线中产生不一致的测试子集，影响可靠性、可重复性和调试效率。需要一种既能保持高有效性又能保证确定性的TSM框架。
AI.method: 1) 预处理：移除测试用例中无关信息（注释、日志、断言等），规范化变量标识符；2) 使用Eclipse JDT将测试代码解析为AST；3) 采用四种树相似度度量（自顶向下、自底向上、综合、树编辑距离）计算成对相似度；4) 使用三种确定性算法选择最优子集：改进的最小生成树（MST）、谱聚类（SC）、动态规划（DP），目标是最小化所选子集的总体相似度以最大化多样性。
AI.result: 在Defects4J的16个Java项目、661个buggy版本上实验，最佳配置为SC+树编辑距离，平均准确率达0.73（50%最小化预算），比LTM提升2.9%，比ATM提升7%；平均执行时间0.92分钟，比ATM快50倍，比LTM快2.82倍；且在10次独立运行中结果完全一致，实现了完全确定性。
AI.conclusion: DTM是首个在黑盒TSM中同时实现高有效性、高效率和完全确定性的框架。SC+树编辑距离为最佳配置，验证了确定性算法在测试套件最小化中的可行性。未来工作可探索其他确定性策略、张量相似度建模以及跨语言泛化。

title: Breaking the Alphabet: Rethinking File Ordering in Code Review
summary: Effective code review is central to maintaining software quality, yet there is limited research about how the ordering of changed files in Pull Requests (PRs) influences review effectiveness. Most popular code review tools default to alphabetical ordering, favoring predictability over contextual relevance. While prior studies examined how file position shapes reviewer attention, it remains unclear how such ordering influences cognitive load and perceived review thoroughness. This study presents the first large-scale survey of 1,355 professional developers across 182 widely used open-source projects to investigate how file ordering impacts review behavior, comprehension, and perceived effectiveness. Our mixed-methods analysis reveals that only 10.2% of reviewers consider alphabetical ordering optimal, underscoring a cognitive misalignment in their interpretation of code changes. Although some developers appreciate its predictability, more than half (57.6%) report that it increases context switching, disrupts logical reasoning, and contributes to review fatigue, and 63.9% expressed concern that the default ordering may cause them to miss bugs. We further identify key challenges in multi-file reviews and elicit developers' expectations for improved tooling, including dependency-aware grouping and customizable file ordering (requested by 66% of reviewers). These findings highlight the need for reviewer-centric interface designs that better align tool behavior with human cognition.

AI.tldr: 基于 182 个广泛使用的开源项目和 1,355 名专业开发者的大规模调查研究，论文发现代码审查工具默认采用的字母排序与开发者的认知和审查需求并不匹配：仅 10.2% 认为其最优，57.6% 认为会增加上下文切换、扰乱逻辑推理并导致审查疲劳，63.9% 担心因此遗漏缺陷；66% 的开发者希望支持依赖感知分组和文件顺序自定义。论文主张设计以审查者为中心的界面，而非一味追求可预测的默认排序。
AI.motivation: 代码文件在 PR 中的展示顺序可能影响开发者对代码变更的理解、注意力分配、认知负荷及审查完整性，但现有研究尚未充分厘清这些影响。论文因此调查专业开发者对常用字母排序的主观看法，以及其对审查行为、理解和感知有效性的影响。
AI.method: 研究对来自 182 个广泛使用的开源项目的 1,355 名专业开发者开展大规模调查，并采用定量统计与定性分析相结合的混合方法。分析维度包括受访者对字母排序的偏好、上下文切换、逻辑推理、审查疲劳、遗漏缺陷的担忧，以及对依赖关系分组和自定义排序等工具功能的需求。
AI.result: 仅有 10.2% 的审查者认为字母排序是最佳选择。超过一半（57.6%）表示该排序会增加上下文切换、干扰逻辑推理并造成审查疲劳；63.9% 担忧默认排序可能导致漏检缺陷；66% 希望获得依赖感知的分组和可定制的文件排序。研究还归纳了多文件审查中的关键困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有默认字母排序虽然提供可预测性，但可能在认知上与开发者理解代码变更的方式不一致。代码审查平台应采用以人为中心的设计，例如按模块或依赖关系组织文件、支持个性化排序，以降低认知负荷并提高审查的完整性和效率。

title: AI Writes Code, Humans Pay the Debt. An Empirical Study on the Sustainability and Evolution of Agent-Generated Code
comment: ACCEPTED REGISTERED REPORT AT ESEM (CORE A*) 2026
summary: Context. The increasing adoption of Generative AI coding agents in software engineering is transforming how developers implement and maintain code. While these systems provide short-term productivity benefits, their long-term impact on software quality and technical debt remains unclear. Aim. We aim to investigate how agent-generated code affects software quality, focusing on issue localization accuracy, the introduction of technical debt, and its evolution over time. Method. We will conduct a large-scale mining software repositories study using the SQuaD dataset, employing a candidate set of 628k issue tickets. We will generate agent-based implementations for these issues, and compare them with the actual commits done by developers using static analysis metrics and tools. We will analyze differences at the commit level and across releases, and we will consider multiple LLM-based Agents selected through a systematic benchmarking strategy. Expected Results. We expect to provide empirical evidence on the trade-offs introduced by agent-based development, including differences in localization accuracy, variations in technical debt introduction, and potential divergence in long-term evolution. We expect the results to highlight variability across LLMs, to enrich our understanding of software evolution with Agents, and to inform more responsible adoption of Agents in software development.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇已注册的实证研究计划（Registered Report），旨在通过大规模软件仓库挖掘，比较基于LLM的AI编码Agent生成的代码与人类开发者编写的代码在问题定位准确性、技术债务（TD）引入及其随时间的演化方面的差异。研究基于SQuaD数据集（450个项目、628k个issue）展开。
AI.motivation:
生成式AI编码Agent日益普及，但其在短期生产力之外的长期影响——尤其是对软件质量和技
术债务的影响——尚缺乏系统性的实证研究。AI生成代码可能更冗长、与项目惯例不一致，或产生过度耦合/不必要的复杂解决方案，从而在长期内加剧技术债务。因此，需要在受控条件下对其进行大规模、可重复的实证评估。
AI.method: 采用大规模软件仓库挖掘（MSR）方法，基于SQuaD数据集（450个成熟开源项目，63,586个发行版本，628k个issue），筛选2021年1月1日前的已关闭issue以避免AI代码污染。具体步骤：(1) 收集已关闭issue；(2) 链接到人类实现的问题修复提交（HIFC）；(3) 将仓库回滚到修复前状态，由基于OpenCode框架的Agent重新实现（获得AIFC），Agent不允许访问git历史等未来信息；(4) 使用SonarQube、CodeScene、Understand等静态分析工具（最终筛选110个可维护性相关指标）对比分析。通过系统性基准测试策略选出3个LLM（GLM-5、Qwen3.5-397b、Kimi K2.5）。统计分析上根据数据正态性选择Friedman检验/Wilcoxon符号秩检验或重复测量方差分析/配对t检验，效应量报告Kendall's W、秩双列相关系数、偏η²和Cohen's d，使用Bonferroni和Benferroni-Hochberg校正。
AI.result: 本文为第一阶段注册报告（Stage 1），尚未报告实验结果。预期结果包括：(1) 提供Agent在包/类/方法级别问题定位准确性的实证证据；(2) 揭示不同LLM Agent间以及Agent与人类之间在技术债务和可维护性指标上的差异；(3) 展示Agent驱动代码与人类驱动代码在跨发行版本的长期演化轨迹（斜率）上的分歧。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一套结合反事实演化轨迹、多指标分析和跨LLM灵敏度分析的方法论框架，用于在真实开发场景中评估AI生成代码。研究预期为研究者和实践者提供关于采纳LLM Agent之权衡的实证依据，支持更负责任地将AI技术集成到软件开发工作流中，以保障软件质量和长期可持续性。局限包括：固定OpenCode编排框架（结果仅反映LLM差异而非编排框架差异）、反事实轨迹仅作为一阶近似、开源项目可能不适用于工业场景等。

title: The Prompt Triangle: A Registered Report on Prompts as Hybrid Artifacts
comment: Accepted as a Registered Report at the 20th Int.\ Symposium on Empirical Software Engineering and Measurement (ESEM 2026)
summary: AI-based coding assistants are transforming software development by shifting effort from writing code to crafting prompts that guide code generation. Despite their growing importance, little empirical evidence exists on how prompts function as software engineering artifacts. Building on prior work framing prompts as mixed artifacts combining requirement intent and solution guidance, we build on the Prompt Triangle, a conceptual model describing prompts along three components: Functionality and Quality (requirements), General Solutions (architectural guidance), and Specific Solutions (implementation constraints). This registered report presents the Stage 1 protocol for a confirmatory study investigating how prompts evolve and how their alignment with requirements engineering (RE) activities predicts development outcomes. We preregister four hypotheses examining prompt evolution, developer characteristics, RE activity alignment, and temporal patterns. We employ a controlled experiment (n=30), community uploads, and mined data using dual-coding to test whether prompting patterns predict development success.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇ESEM 2026的注册报告（Stage 1），基于"Prompt Triangle"概念模型，研究AI编码助手中的提示（prompts）如何作为混合软件工程制品演化，以及其与需求工程（RE）活动的对齐如何预测开发成果。作者提出了四个预注册假设，并设计了结合控制实验（n=30）、社区上传和公共数据挖掘的多方法研究方案。
AI.motivation: AI编码助手正在将软件开发的核心从编写代码转向构建提示（prompts）。尽管提示日益重要，但关于提示如何作为软件工程制品发挥作用的实证证据仍然匮乏。作者旨在将提示视为一等公民制品，运用需求工程理论系统研究其演化规律与对开发成果的影响。
AI.method: 研究基于"Prompt Triangle"概念模型，将提示分解为三个维度：功能与质量（需求层面）、通用解决方案（架构指导）、特定解决方案（实现约束）。方法上采用三源数据三角验证：（1）控制实验（n=30），四类编码任务（含一个无AI基线），拉丁方设计平衡，采用Dirichlet混合效应回归、层次回归等方法检验四个假设；（2）社区上传（目标n≥150），通过Web平台收集；（3）公共数据挖掘（目标≥200）。双编码法标注提示组件与RE活动（验证、确认、解决方案生成），目标Cohen's κ>0.75。
AI.result: 这是注册报告的Stage 1协议，尚未报告实证结果。文中详细给出了四个假设（H1提示演化、H2用户驱动策略、H3 RE活动对齐、H4时间对齐模式）的具体分析计划，包括Dirichlet回归、层次回归、重复测量ANOVA等统计模型，以及功效分析结果（f=0.35, α=0.05, power=0.80, N=30足以支持所有组内比较）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将提示确立为一等软件工程制品，通过预注册假设的确认性检验为AI辅助软件开发的系统性实证研究奠定基础。研究同时承担Prompt Triangle构念验证功能——若维度无法可靠编码（κ<0.75）或产生退化分布，则构成反驳证据。

title: SH-PDOPS: AI-Driven Cloud Native Enterprise Reliability Framework for Predictive Analytics and Intelligent DevOps Automation
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, submitted with the github link and for educational purposes
summary: This paper presents an AI-driven cloud-native enterprise reliability framework designed to improve predictive analytics, intelligent DevOps automation, and system resilience in modern distributed infrastructures. The proposed framework integrates machine learning models, Kubernetes orchestration, observability pipelines, and automated incident response mechanisms to enhance reliability engineering practices. The study explores predictive failure detection, anomaly monitoring, self-healing infrastructure, and CI/CD optimization using cloud-native technologies. Experimental evaluation demonstrates improved operational efficiency, reduced downtime, and enhanced scalability for enterprise environments. The framework provides a practical approach for combining artificial intelligence with DevOps methodologies to achieve adaptive and autonomous infrastructure management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SH-PDOPS 框架,一个集成 Kubernetes、Docker、Jenkins 与预测性 AI 分析的云原生企业可靠性系统,旨在通过闭环风险评分和策略感知编排实现早期故障检测与受控自愈,实验显示其将 MTTD/MTTR 从分钟级降至秒级,但仍面临模型漂移、安全治理与人工审批边界等挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统监控以被动告警为主,在故障已影响服务后才响应;同时 Kubernetes 重启、Jenkins 流水线等组件各自独立,缺乏对部署事件与运行时行为之间相关性的统一理解,导致企业级可靠性工程难以从"事后告警"转向"事前预测与受控自愈"。
AI.method: 四层闭环架构:遥测采集层(K8s/Pods/日志/追踪/Jenkins 元数据)→ 预测分析层(基于特征向量通过逻辑回归式风险评分 r_t = σ(wᵀx_t + b),可替换为孤立森林/Boosted Tree/RNN)→ 决策编排层(基于策略区分 advisory / semi-automated / automated 三类动作)→ DevOps 执行层(Jenkins + Kubernetes 受控响应)。实验采用三容器微服务 + Minikube/Kind/云集群,注入内存增长/错误率升高/CPU 饱和/镜像构建失败/就绪延迟等故障场景,对比 Manual、Rule-based、SH-PDOPS 三种模式。
AI.result: 在受控故障注入下,SH-PDOPS 将 MTTD 由 3–5 分钟降至 2–5 秒,MTTR 由 5–10 分钟降至 15–30 秒,优于 Railway 内置自动化(10–30 秒/45–90 秒);代价是中等控制面开销,且高风险动作(生产回滚、数据库迁移反转、跨区流量切换)仍需人工审批。系统能区分资源压力事件与发布后回归,但存在模型漂移、误报风险与治理审计需求。
AI.conclusion: SH-PDOPS 证明 AI 可作为 DevOps 工程判断的辅助而非替代,通过关联 CI/CD 与运行时遥测实现更早检测与更一致的响应协调;但需配合 RBAC、密钥管理、审计日志与模型维护机制。未来工作包括异构企业负载的大规模评估、GitOps 控制器集成、形式化策略验证及生产环境模型漂移的纵向分析。

title: Data-Related Challenges and Requirements for Event Log Generation in Process Mining: A Systematic Literature Review
comment: Accepted to the 11th International Conference on Digital Economy (ICDEc), Tallinn, Estonia, May 2026
summary: Process mining is becoming an essential technology that not only supports the improvement of business processes but also enables the software technologies underlying the future digital economy. Among the multiple challenges discussed by the process mining community, data quality is emerging as the most pressing one. However, insufficient attention has been paid to event log generation as the very first phase of process mining and to its relationship with data engineering and requirements engineering. To address this gap, we conducted a systematic literature review of data-related challenges, requirements, and solutions in event log generation. Our results show that a wide range of 29 challenges can be addressed with 5 basic categories of requirements. Existing solutions already embed some form of data engineering and domain knowledge engineering techniques for event log generation. This review can support researchers and practitioners in understanding current trends in event log generation for process mining and in leveraging data and requirements engineering techniques to improve log generation and, ultimately, process mining outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇系统性文献综述，研究过程挖掘中事件日志生成阶段所面临的数据相关挑战与需求，识别出29类挑战与5大类需求，并探讨数据工程与需求工程技术的潜在贡献。
AI.motivation: 过程挖掘高度依赖事件数据的质量，但现有研究多聚焦于日志生成后的清洗与修复（事后处理），而对日志生成阶段本身的数据挑战关注不足，且缺乏数据工程与需求工程视角下的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 遵循Kitchenham的系统性文献综述指南，采用Scopus与IEEE Xplore数据库进行检索（2019年以来文献），制定检索式为 ("event log" OR "event data") AND ("generation" OR "extraction" OR "logging") AND "process mining"，经过去重、标题摘要筛选、全文审查，最终纳入59篇主要研究，采用两轮开放式编码进行数据提取与分析，并构建挑战-需求映射表。
AI.result: 识别出29类数据相关挑战（最常被引用的包括数据质量、数据集成、非过程中心数据、异构性、案例标识、粒度等），归纳为5大类需求：R1数据元素可用性（含时间戳、案例ID、活动等7个子类）、R2数据质量属性（准确性、唯一性、完整性等8个子类）、R3数据访问与结构、R4清晰定义与映射、R5领域知识捕获；并发现现有方案已嵌入ETL、复杂事件处理、数据联邦等数据工程技术，以及OBDA、领域本体、抽象表等需求/领域知识工程技术；挑战与需求之间存在密切关联（部分挑战对应2-3类需求）。
AI.conclusion: 几乎所有事件日志生成的挑战均可通过5大类需求加以应对；数据工程技术对解决数据提取与集成挑战具有重要潜力，需求工程技术则可辅助处理领域知识建模、需求捕获与验证，并为软件系统日志功能的实现提供指导；建议未来研究加强过程挖掘与数据工程、需求工程及软件工程之间的交叉融合，并采用更一致的挑战与需求报告实践。

title: Big Questions on Software Architecture: Report of the ICSE 2026 BoF on Software Architecture
summary: Software Architecture (SA) is more important than ever, from the need to master the pervasive impact of technology in society and planet earth, to balancing the role of humans versus technology, flexibility versus chaos, economic convenience versus digital autonomy. Despite SA importance, we feel that the SA research community needs to reflect on what are the big questions that deserve scientific research, and what are instead technology trends or hypes. In this paper, we report the results of a community initiative aiming to identify and discuss the big questions in SA research. Organised in two sessions hosted in 2026 at the ICSE and ICSA conferences, respectively, this paper reports on the results collected during the first session, and looks forward to complementing them with the results of the second one. To be continued ...

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ICSE 2026软件架构BoF（Birds-of-a-Feather）会议的成果，该会议旨在识别和讨论软件架构（SA）研究中的"大问题"（Big Questions）。通过九个经同行评审的立场论文和社区讨论，提炼出关于架构师技能、AI对架构的影响、架构基础与新颖性、研究议程方向等多个核心研究问题，并计划在ICSA 2026进行第二阶段的深入讨论。
AI.motivation: 软件架构研究领域过度关注短期技术趋势而忽视长期基础性问题；AI技术的快速发展正在重塑架构师角色和架构设计方式，引发了关于人类判断、AI辅助决策、架构知识管理、安全关键系统认证等根本性挑战，亟需社区反思未来研究方向。
AI.method: 采用两阶段社区驱动研究方法：阶段1在ICSE 2026举办BoF会议，征集并同行评审9篇立场论文，分为三个主题小组（架构师技能与知识、架构新颖性与基础、研究议程与方向）进行讨论；阶段2将在ICSA 2026举办工作组会议进行验证、细化和扩展。通过主持人笔记、会场录音和论文分析进行数据综合。
AI.result: 识别出多个核心"大问题"：（1）AI时代"优秀"架构师的定义及所需技能；（2）如何减轻数据采样偏差以建立真实架构数据集和基准；（3）如何处理人机在架构知识方面的不一致性；（4）如何准确建模未来分布式（汽车）系统；（5）AI技术如何辅助架构重建及其可持续性；（6）架构如何从设计层面处理安全与数字主权；（7）如何实现自编码软件系统；（8）AI系统如何反映组织价值观、伦理和要求；（9）社区是否正在遗忘软件架构的基础。讨论揭示了AI在SA中的双重角色——既支持架构推理和决策，又需要保持人类判断和控制权。
AI.conclusion: 软件架构研究未来需平衡两个互补目标：一是探索AI如何支持SA活动并赋能新型软件系统；二是继续解决仍然开放的SA基础性挑战（如建模、抽象、互操作性）。这些初步识别的问题不是最终或详尽的研究议程，而是为社区反思SA研究长期方向提供基础。第二阶段ICSA 2026工作组会议将进一步讨论、细化和挑战这些问题，最终形成社区共识的研究问题集。

title: Toward Model-Driven Digital Twin Configuration: Separating Structure Semantics and Runtime with SysML SAREF and Ditto
summary: Energy communities, neighbourhoods that jointly produce, store, and consume electricity, increasingly rely on \emph{digital twins}: live software copies of physical devices such as a solar panel, a battery, or a heater, kept in sync for monitoring and control. Setting up such a twin is today mostly manual: an engineer hand-writes a configuration whose field names are arbitrary, whose units are implicit, and which carries no machine-readable description of how devices relate, so other systems cannot reliably interpret it. This position paper argues that the task should be split across three complementary tools, each doing what it does best: a modelling language for the system's structure (SysML), a standard energy vocabulary for its meaning (SAREF4ENER), and a digital-twin platform for the running representation (Eclipse Ditto, via the W3C Web-of-Things Thing Description). We give conceptual rules (not yet an executable generator) for deriving a Ditto configuration from a SysML model annotated with that vocabulary, illustrate them on a greenhouse energy-community node modelled in Modelio, and argue that the split improves traceability and configuration consistency, and establishes the semantic hooks needed for interoperability, over hand-written alternatives. We scope the contribution to design-time configuration and discuss its limits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将数字孪生配置任务拆分到三种互补工具中：SysML建模系统结构、SAREF4ENER提供能源领域标准语义、Eclipse Ditto作为运行时平台，通过W3C WoT Thing Description承载部署表示。作者给出了从SysML+SAREF4ENER模型推导Ditto配置的概念性转换规则，并通过温室能源社区节点案例进行说明。
AI.motivation: 当前数字孪生平台的配置大多由工程师手工编写JSON文件，字段名随意、单位隐式、缺乏机器可读的设备关系描述，导致系统间互操作性差、可追溯性弱、配置一致性难以保证。特别是在能源社区场景中，设备类型多样且需要跨系统共享语义，手工配置方式难以扩展。该问题在已有MDE-for-DT映射研究中尚未得到充分解决（能源领域仅占2/11，且无工作以Eclipse Ditto为转换目标）。
AI.method: 将任务分解为三个层面：(1)使用SysML在Modelio中建模系统结构，块定义图(BDD)描述设备及其组成关系；(2)将SAREF4ENER作为引用包导入，为设备块提供标准超类型(saref:Device、s4ener:PowerGenerator等)并为值属性提供测量类型(saref:Power、saref:Energy等)，通过saref:observes和saref:actsUpon关联编码传感器-执行器关系；(3)制定概念性转换规则(表2)：带SAREF超类型的块→Thing级别的@type，块名→Thing ID/feature名，值属性→features.*.properties，属性类型→属性级@type，单位注解→unit字段，saref:observes/actsUpon→语义链接/期望属性，块多重性→重复feature/Thing。转换将SAREF URI携带至@type，使模型与孪生共享本体标识，WoT TD的@context使结果自描述且可被JSON-LD处理。以温室能源社区节点(GreenhouseSystem包含TemperatureSensor、HVACSystem、SolarPanel、GridConnection四个设备块)为运行示例进行说明。
AI.result: 论文作为立场论文(position paper)给出了概念性转换规则(尚非可执行生成器)。通过温室示例展示了SolarPanel块从手工配置(两个不透明数字)到派生配置(携带s4ener:PowerGenerator类型、saref:Power/Energy测量含义、显式kW/kWh单位)的对比；HVACSystem示例展示了测量状态置于properties、actsUpon目标置于desiredProperties。论证了三方分离在可追溯性、配置一致性、互操作性语义钩子方面优于手工方案，并表明规则可通过更换引用包(S4BLDG/S4AGRI/S4CITY)实现领域可移植。当前局限：未形式化为可执行模型到文本模板(如Acceleo)、未用OWL/SHACL等工具做自动推理验证、未验证模型-孪生往返一致性、未在大规模场景中验证。
AI.conclusion: 将结构(SysML)、语义(SAREF4ENER)、运行时表示(Ditto/WoT TD)分离，能在不让任何单一标记语言超出其设计范围的前提下，产出可追溯、语义扎根的配置工件。转换规则带来具体效果：显式类型、单位与传感器-执行器关系。下一步工作：将规则形式化为可执行的模型到文本模板、在更多SAREF4ENER设备类型上进行验证并通过互操作性实验、扩展到需求响应灵活性配置文件、支持从Ditto到SysML模型的运行时反射。

title: A Mixed-Method Empirical Study of LLM Assistance in Software Engineering Workflows
comment: Presented at ENASE 2026 : 21st International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, yet their effects are often discussed without distinguishing between task types, developer seniority, and verification demands. This paper presents a mixed-method empirical study of LLM-assisted software engineering with first-year and fourth-year undergraduates. Phase 1 is a preliminary survey (n=157) that characterizes LLM exposure, reliance, and trust calibration among the two groups. Phase 2 is a task-based quasi-experiment with a purposive sample from both cohorts (n=20). Here, we compare AI-assisted and non-AI conditions on a structured set of software engineering tasks spanning implementation, constraint-driven algorithm selection, and architectural reasoning. We then analyze performance outcomes alongside behavioral traces captured via screen recording and a qualitative coding process. Survey results indicate widespread LLM adoption and substantial verification effort, alongside cohort differences in perceived LLM capability for constraint-heavy scenarios. The quasi-experiment further shows that AI assistance changes workflow structure. For example, participants frequently adopt AI-first task entry, copy-transfer integration, and AI-mediated debugging, whereas non-AI workflows rely more on documentation, prior templates, and iterative trial-error refinement. Overall, our findings suggest that the benefits of LLM assistance are task-dependent and mediated by expertise and verification practices, rather than by generation speed alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM辅助软件工程工作流开展了一项混合方法实证研究,通过调查(N=157)和任务型准实验(n=20)对比一年级与四年级本科生在实施、约束驱动算法选择和架构推理等复杂开放式软件工程任务(COSTs)中的AI辅助与非AI辅助表现,发现LLM收益具有任务依赖性,且受专业水平和验证实践调节。
AI.motivation: 当前关于LLM对开发工作流作用的讨论往往未区分任务类型、开发者资历及验证需求,行业叙事声称LLM可缩小新手与专家差距但缺乏细致验证,亟需从生成速度之外的角度探究AI辅助如何与任务复杂度和开发者经验交互。
AI.method: 两阶段混合方法设计:阶段一为初步调查(N=157,含131名一年级和26名四年级本科生),采用描述性与非参数推断统计(Mann-Whitney U、Fisher精确检验)及效应量分析;阶段二为任务型准实验(n=20,每组每队列5人),比较AI辅助与非AI辅助条件下实施、约束驱动算法、架构推理三类任务的行为表现,通过Azure Video Indexer转录屏幕录像并进行主题分析(开放编码+恒定比较法)。
AI.result: 调查显示LLM使用已成常态(56.06%日常使用,84.62%四年级学生日常集成),94.90%受访者至少"有时"在作业中依赖LLM,但54.78%仍进行"显著"验证,呈现"信任但验证"模式;四年级学生在领域约束场景中显著更倾向人类专家(80.77% vs 46.56%, r=0.51)。准实验识别出AI工作流的典型模式:AI优先任务切入、复制-迁移集成、AI中介调试,以及多LLM切换;非AI工作流更多依赖文档、模板复用和反复试错修正;验证强度与编程熟练度正相关(r=0.21),而与感知可靠性负相关(ρ=-0.21);环境/工具链失败仍是AI辅助的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助效益是任务依赖性的,受专业水平和验证实践调节,而非仅由生成速度决定;AI不应被视为二元条件,而应作为从"校准增强"到"程序化替代"的光谱;建议教学上强调AI素养和验证中心的实践,评估中纳入过程证据(测试用例、API验证、数据库持久化检查等),并加强依赖管理与工具链基础训练。

title: A systematic literature review on logging smell detection
comment: 48 pages, 6 figures, Information and Software Technology
summary: Context:Logging is an important part of software development that helps developers monitor systems, understand behavior, and fix problems. But when logging is done poorly, it can introduce logging smells, which are defects that reduce the usefulness of logs or even make them problematic. Objective:This study looks at how logging smells are currently detected. The goal is to better understand the existing research on automatic detection techniques, datasets, and evaluation methods. Method:We conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) of 21 studies focused on detecting logging smells. In this review, we define key logging-related terms, identify and map the types of smells to an existing taxonomy, and examine the detection techniques, datasets, and evaluation strategies used across the studies. Results:We found that the research is still scattered and inconsistent. For example, there is no common benchmark or standardized approach for evaluating results, making it difficult to compare studies. In addition, we observe inconsistencies in the way log smells are addressed, as studies differ in the types and number of smells they target. Conclusion:There is still room for improvement in how logging smells are studied and detected. We point out several challenges and suggest future directions, such as developing better tools, using large language models (LLMs), and building more standardized datasets for evaluation.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于日志坏味（logging smell）检测的系统文献综述（SLR），基于21项主要研究，系统梳理了日志坏味的类型、检测技术、数据集和评估方法。研究发现该领域存在缺乏统一基准、术语不一致、Java语言偏见等问题，并提出了LLM应用、标准化基准和跨语言扩展等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 日志是软件开发中用于调试、监控和维护的重要工具，但不当的日志实践会产生日志坏味（logging smells），导致日志质量下降。尽管已有研究尝试自动检测日志问题，但现有文献缺乏对检测方法和技术的系统性梳理，研究呈现碎片化、不一致的状态，难以比较、复现和构建。该研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用Wohlin提出的雪球检索（snowballing）方法替代传统数据库搜索。从4篇种子论文出发，经过4轮反向雪球（审查895篇参考文献，筛选10篇）和4轮正向雪球（审查826篇引用，筛选7篇），最终确定21项主要研究。围绕4个研究问题进行数据提取与分析：研究问题1（日志坏味类型与问题定义）、研究问题2（检测技术）、研究问题3（评估方法与数据集）、研究问题4（挑战与未来方向）。利用Saarimäki等人的日志坏味分类法对问题类型进行映射。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）研究趋势自2017年上升，2023年达峰值，2024年引入LLM技术；（2）可复现性不足：仅10/21的研究同时公开了代码和数据，8篇未提供数据集，8篇未提供代码；（3）日志坏味分布不均：最常报告的是"Mercurial Level: incorrect"（8篇），而"duplicated message""long logging code"等仅出现1次；（4）85%的研究基于实证分析定义问题；（5）检测技术分为4类：静态分析、机器学习、深度学习、LLM，各有优缺点；（6）多坏味检测方法各异，部分使用独立模型，部分使用统一LLM框架；（7）评估方法多样但不一致：17篇采用手工验证、17篇使用性能指标、13篇有ground truth、11篇获取开发者反馈、8篇与baseline对比，指标选择不统一；（8）约86%的研究聚焦Java项目，存在明显语言偏见；（9）缺乏统一基准、数据集和任务定义。挑战包括：缺乏标准化指南、日志坏味多样性、日志语句提取困难、误报/漏报、编程语言限制、跨项目泛化差、数据不平衡。未来方向：增强日志分析技术（含LLM）、扩展多语言支持、改进开发者工具、建立统一基准和日志指南。
AI.conclusion: 该领域虽取得显著进展但仍呈碎片化状态，缺少标准化数据集、一致的验证方法和统一的任务定义，这阻碍了研究的比较和可复现性。LLM技术的兴起和自动化研究的增加为日志坏味检测提供了新机遇。未来工作应优先创建社区公认的基准、共享任务和工具支持，推动该领域向更统一、实用和可扩展的方向发展。

title: Engineering as Code: Bringing Software Engineering Methodology to Engineering Design
summary: Large language models have made significant progress in verifiable domains such as code generation and chip design, yet remain limited on engineering design tasks in fields like architecture, mechanical engineering, and HVAC. This paper argues the root cause is not model capability but the absence of a "Design as Code" computable foundation: design representations that can be consumed, verified, and versioned by machines. Existing CAD/BIM systems couple design logic with geometry, causing quality assurance to drift downstream; Automated Compliance Checking (ACC) suffers from geometric false positives and naming-dependent model reconstruction overhead. We propose the Engineering as Code (EaC) paradigm: expressing engineering design as text-native declarative language with automated rule engines, version control, and package management as quality gates. Core contributions: (1) the Information Representation Hypothesis, arguing the engineering AI bottleneck stems from missing computable design representations rather than model capability; (2) ADL (Assembly Definition Language) with Part as atom, organized into three orthogonal sub-languages -- PDL (Part Definition), PML (Part Mating), and PLL (Part Layout); (3) ESA (Engineering Static Analysis), shifting compliance checking from downstream review to design-time, operating on semantic categories (Family types, Mate relations) rather than geometry, eliminating false positives and naming dependencies. A prototype validates ADL expressiveness and ESA detection across three cross-domain samples (telecom rack expansion, modular datacenter, mechanical keyboard), checking 69 rules in under 200ms. A controlled violation injection experiment achieves 100% detection rate with zero false positives. The SD-HWE-Bench benchmark design is complete as an empirical testbed for the hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“Engineering as Code（EaC，工程即代码）”范式，以文本原生、声明式的可计算设计表示替代将设计逻辑耦合于几何的CAD/BIM数据。核心方案包括由PDL、PML和PLL构成的ADL，以及面向语义关系的ESA工程静态分析。原型在三个跨领域案例中检查69条规则耗时低于200ms，人工注入违规的检出率为100%、误报率为0，表明可计算表示有望成为工程设计与自动合规检查的共同基础。
AI.motivation: 工程AI在代码生成、芯片设计等可验证任务中进展显著，但在建筑、机械和暖通工程中的能力有限。作者认为主要瓶颈并非大语言模型本身，而是缺少可被机器消费、验证、比较和版本管理的工程设计表示。现有CAD/BIM把设计语义与几何深度耦合，使质量检查后置，并产生几何误报、规则转换成本以及对对象命名和模型重建的依赖。
AI.method: 论文提出EaC范式和“信息表示假说”，主张工程设计应以文本原生的声明式语言表达，并通过规则引擎、版本控制和包管理设置质量门。核心语言是ADL（Assembly Definition Language）：以Part为原子，并划分三个相对正交的子语言——PDL用于零件定义，PML用于零件配合，PLL用于零件布局；ESA（Engineering Static Analysis）则直接分析Family type、Mate relation等语义类别，而非几何对象。作者实现原型，并在通信机架扩展、模块化数据中心和机械键盘三个跨领域样例中验证表达能力和规则检查能力。实验共检查69条规则，运行时间低于200ms，并通过受控违规注入评估检出率与误报率。
AI.result: 原型成功覆盖三个跨领域装配案例并检查69条规则，单次整体检查耗时低于200ms。受控违规注入实验达到100%的违规检出率且误报率为0，说明基于语义关系的ESA能够避免传统几何检查中的部分误报，并降低对几何重建和对象命名的依赖。论文还完成SD-HWE-Bench基准的设计，以支持后续实证检验。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为工程AI进一步发展的关键前提是建立类似“设计即代码”的可计算表示层。ADL与ESA把工程结构、装配关系和设计规则从几何模型中解耦，使合规检查前置至设计阶段，并与版本控制、自动规则执行和持续质量保证衔接。原型结果支持该方案的表达性和检测有效性，但现有摘要未提供大规模基准结果、工程规模复杂度、与商业CAD/BIM规则的覆盖对比，以及对长尾工程约束和工具互操作性的系统评估。

title: A Governance Methodology Layer for AI-Assisted Software Development: Defect Taxonomy, Controlled Ablation, and Process-Over-Capability Evidence
summary: Autonomous coding agents produce output that passes syntactic checks -- compilation, type safety, CI -- at high velocity. Yet syntactic correctness does not imply semantic correctness: design boundaries, security invariants, and maintainability contracts remain structurally invisible to automated pipelines. This paper makes four contributions toward closing this gap. First, we present a defect-class taxonomy grounded in five AI agent permission and governance modules, distinguishing defects structurally detectable by static analysis from those requiring semantic review. Second, we describe a runtime-decoupled governance gate -- a file-based protocol that reads generator output and emits a structured verdict without API coupling, making it portable across code-generation tools. Third, we formalize methodology-as-code: expressing a verification protocol as a version-controlled, executable, cross-platform artifact with a two-layer architecture separating portable methodology from host-specific automation. Fourth, we report a controlled ablation experiment (E-ablation, N=5 artifacts, 8-item independent ground truth) comparing harness-structured review against a token-matched unstructured review prompt on the same artifacts. The structured condition records 62% lenient ground-truth recall against 50% for the unstructured condition, with 25% strict recall against 0%, and applies more consistent severity grades where the unstructured condition inflates severity. Both conditions miss document-quality defects identified by a human QA reviewer, indicating a complementarity between structured AI review and human process inspection. Within the bounds of this sample, the results are consistent with the thesis that review-process design, rather than reviewer-model capability, is the dominant factor in critical-defect coverage for AI-assisted software development.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对AI自主编码代理仅通过语法检查但难以保障语义正确性的问题，提出了缺陷分类法、运行时解耦的治理门控、方法即代码（methodology-as-code）形式化框架，以及对比结构化与非结构化审查的消融实验，强调审查流程设计是AI辅助软件质量保障的主导因素。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理以高速度产出通过编译、类型检查与CI的代码，但设计边界、安全不变式与可维护性契约等语义层面的缺陷对现有自动化流水线不可见，需弥合语法正确性与语义正确性之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 基于五个AI代理权限与治理模块构建缺陷分类法；2) 设计基于文件协议的运行时解耦治理门控（读取生成器输出并输出结构化判定，不与API耦合）；3) 将验证协议形式化为版本可控、可执行、跨平台的"方法即代码"制品，采用便携方法层与宿主自动化层分离的双层架构；4) 实施受控消融实验E-ablation（N=5工件，8项独立真值），对比基于框架的结构化审查与token匹配的非结构化审查在相同工件上的表现。
AI.result: 结构化审查条件在宽松真值召回率上达62%，非结构化为50%；严格召回率25% vs 0%；结构化条件在严重性评级上更一致，而非结构化条件倾向于夸大严重等级。两种条件均遗漏了人类QA评审员识别的文档质量类缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 在该样本范围内，结果支持以下论点：对于AI辅助软件开发，审查流程的设计（而非评审模型能力）是关键缺陷覆盖能力的主导因素；结构化AI审查与人工流程检查存在互补关系。

title: Large Language Models for Fuzz Testing in Microservices: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: Microservice systems (MSS) increasingly rely on heterogeneous APIs whose combinatorial input space and stateful dependencies challenge traditional fuzz testing. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently been introduced to enhance fuzzing with semantic reasoning over specifications, inputs, and runtime feedback. This paper presents a systematic literature review (SLR) of LLM-assisted fuzz testing for microservices to synthesise how LLMs are applied, evaluated, and what challenges remain. Following established SLR guidelines, we analyze 20 primary studies published between 2024 and 2026. Results show LLMs are mainly used as semantic input generators in black-box fuzzing, with a growing shift towards agent-based and retrieval-augmented architectures, improving valid input generation and modestly increasing coverage and vulnerability detection. However, evaluation remains heterogeneous, with limited benchmark standardization, scarce cost reporting, and a bias toward single-service experiments, highlighting a gap with real-world multi-service systems. This review provides a taxonomy of LLM roles and integrations, a consolidated view of evaluation practices, and a mapping of open challenges to research directions, supporting the design and deployment of LLM-driven fuzzing in microservices.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇系统文献综述（SLR），聚焦于2024–2026年间将大语言模型（LLMs）应用于微服务系统（MSS）模糊测试的20项主要研究。文章系统梳理了LLM在模糊测试中的角色分类、集成范式、评估实践及未来研究方向，揭示了当前领域在基准标准化、成本感知评估、多服务现实性等方面的关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 微服务系统依赖异构API，其组合输入空间与有状态依赖使传统模糊测试面临挑战；同时LLM在规范推理、输入生成和运行时反馈分析方面展现出增强模糊测试的潜力。然而，现有研究分散在不同领域、技术与评估环境中，且缺乏LLM辅助模糊测试与微服务系统交叉点的系统性梳理。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 遵循Kitchenham等人的系统综述指南，并结合Wohlin的滚雪球方法。研究流程包括五个阶段：（1）研究问题定义；（2）搜索策略与数据源选择（IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、Scopus、Web of Science及arXiv）；（3）基于明确纳入/排除标准的双人筛选+第三方仲裁；（4）基于DARE框架的四维质量评估（阈值6/12）；（5）数据提取与综合分析。研究问题包括RQ1（LLM如何应用）、RQ2（如何评估及效果如何）、RQ3（开放挑战与未来方向）。
AI.result: 共纳入20项主要研究（2024年2篇、2025年13篇、2026年5篇）。核心发现包括：（1）GPT系列模型应用最广，但开源/小模型（Llama、DeepSeek、Mistral等）使用日益增多；（2）LLM主要在黑盒模糊测试中充当语义输入生成器（16项研究），而作为变异算子和预言机的使用明显不足；（3）多智能体与RAG增强架构呈现增长趋势；（4）评估实践呈现异质性，仅11/20（55%）提供复现包，少数研究（3项）与人工编写的测试套件或专家基线对比；（5）实验普遍偏向单服务REST API，对GraphQL、RPC等范式及真实多服务集群覆盖不足；（6）有效性指标虽有改善（有效输入生成、覆盖率与漏洞检测适度提升），但成本报告稀缺（不足半数）。
AI.conclusion: 研究领域正汇聚于三条未来方向：（1）采用更小、量化或领域专用模型以提升部署可行性；（2）混合LLM与程序分析（静态/符号执行、依赖图、运行时反馈、跨API推理）；（3）建立标准化、成本感知的多服务基准测试框架。当前LLM驱动的微服务模糊测试虽显著提升有效输入生成能力，但在可扩展性、可复现性与工业部署成熟度方面仍有较大差距，需从单纯添加LLM转向微服务感知、成本感知与正确性感知的生成方法。

title: Robustness and Trade-offs for Code LLMs on Protected Code
summary: Code large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used on software artifacts that may be intentionally obfuscated for intellectual-property protection, reverse-engineering resistance, or controlled access. In reverse engineering and security analysis, deobfuscation is commonly treated as the preprocessing step before downstream analysis or inference, yet its utility for code LLM pipelines has not been systematically validated across models and protection methods. We present an execution-based study of seven code LLMs on protected-code translation and completion, spanning source programs from C++, Go, Java, and JavaScript, five obfuscation methods, and three inference protocols: plain, obfuscated, and deobfuscated. Our results show that direct inference on obfuscated code often matches or exceeds inference on restored code. In this controlled benchmark, higher-capability models such as GPT-4.1 and Qwen3-Coder-30B retain about 90% Pass@1 on obfuscated translation inputs, indicating that explicit restoration is often unnecessary. Same-model restoration does recover some obfuscation-induced failures, but it also degrades many cases that already succeed, with lower-capability models showing the largest net losses. Across settings, model capability is the primary factor, while source language and obfuscation method have secondary but consistent effects. Overall, our findings support model-aware pipeline design and indicate that protected-code workflows should be evaluated primarily with execution-based metrics rather than static similarity alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对代码大语言模型在受保护（混淆）代码上的鲁棒性进行了系统的执行基准研究。研究覆盖7个代码LLM、4种源语言、5种混淆方法和3种推理协议，发现直接对混淆代码进行推理往往匹配甚至优于反混淆后推理，模型能力是最主要因素，70% plain Pass@1是一个实践阈值。
AI.motivation: 现有实践中常假设在LLM处理受保护代码前进行反混淆（去混淆）会提升下游任务表现，但这一假设未在多模型、多混淆方法、多语言间被系统验证。论文旨在填补这一空白，将反混淆重新定位为"救援-退化"权衡而非无条件收益。
AI.method: 基于HumanEval风格函数级基准（164实例/配置），评估7个代码LLM（CodeLlama-7B/70B、DeepSeek-Coder-V2、DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-14B、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、Qwen3-Coder-30B、GPT-4.1），在C++/Go/Java/JavaScript到Python的翻译任务上，对5种混淆方法（Identifier Rename、Dead Branch Injection、Remove Symbols、Random、CodeCipher）执行3种推理协议（Plain/Obfuscated/Deobfuscated，同模型反混淆）。采用零样本贪心解码，主要指标为Pass@1，并定义Rescue Rate与Degradation Rate两个条件指标，同时报告CodeBLEU、编辑距离、AST距离、Halstead、CodeBERT相似度等辅助信号。
AI.result: GPT-4.1和Qwen3-Coder-30B在混淆输入下分别保持90.0%和90.5% Pass@1（plain分别为92.9%和88.3%），表明高能力模型可直接处理受保护代码。7个模型中6个经同模型反混淆后准确率下降，仅Qwen2.5-Coder-14B微升2.2个百分点；CodeLlama-70B从15.2%暴跌至3.8%（74.8%相对下降）。78%的（模型,混淆方法）点位于Plain-Deobfuscated对角线下方。Rescue Rate范围32.2%-69.8%，Degradation Rate范围5.7%-95.2%；净效应为正的三个模型plain均>70%。语言层面Go的退化率最高（34.4%），Java最稳定（24.5%）。CodeCipher救援率最低（31.2%）但行为更可预测。静态指标（CodeBLEU、EditDist）与执行结果常不一致（翻译任务Pass@1有利率仅19.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 反混淆并非对所有模型和场景均有益。论文提出"模型感知"管道设计原则：能力>80%的模型直接处理受保护代码即可；50-80%区间建议采用混淆优先+验证触发回退的自适应路由；<50%应避免反混淆。核心建议：使用Pass@1等执行指标作为主决策依据；将反混淆视为可观测、可路由的策略而非静态预处理；高保障场景中CodeCipher式学习型保护提供低救援率与可预测行为。局限：仅函数级任务、同模型反混淆耦合、零样本、五种混淆方法、未实现完整自适应路由策略。

title: Automated Deployment of Real-Time Tasks for Phased Execution on Scratchpad-Based Multicore Platforms
summary: The increasing throughput demands in real-time systems and the consolidation of functionality on few, high-performance platforms are driving a shift towards parallel architectures. A key challenge for multicore real-time systems is the interference from contention for access to shared memory. Phased execution approaches address this challenge by restricting shared memory access to mutually exclusive memory phases, while computation is limited to memories local to each core. However, the complexity of managing and scheduling said memory phases hinders the adoption of phased execution in real-time applications. To address this challenge, we propose a model-based deployment methodology that automates the process of adapting applications to phased execution. We present an integrated tool-based deployment process that extends the application through the necessary memory phases and provides a runtime environment to orchestrate execution on the target hardware platform. Our approach requires minimal changes to the application implementation since the deployment tool directly extracts the required information from the generated application binaries. We validate our methodology using an avionics case study on a RISC-V multicore system, showcasing its key components and principles of operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型的自动化部署方法，将实时应用适配到基于Scratchpad的多核平台上进行分阶段执行（phased execution）。该方法通过独立的二进制编译、最小化源码侵入和自动生成系统调度表，降低了分阶段执行在多核实时系统中应用的复杂性。作者在RISC-V多核FPGA平台上使用ROSACE航空电子案例研究验证了该方法。
AI.motivation: 多核实时系统面临共享内存访问竞争导致的干扰问题，影响时间可预测性。分阶段执行（如PREM/AER模型）虽能解决此问题，但其内存阶段的复杂调度与管理阻碍了在实际实时应用中的广泛采用。因此需要一种自动化的部署方法，简化应用向分阶段执行模型的适配过程。
AI.method: 提出了基于三层系统模型的部署方法：1) 硬件平台模型（核心数量、SPM地址、DMA驱动等）；2) 任务执行模型（基于LET逻辑执行时间范式，任务独立编译，包含频率、WCET和端口）；3) 调度模型（包含任务输入加载、任务加载、任务卸载、任务输出发布四类操作）。每个任务扩展为获取-执行-归还（AER）三阶段。部署过程分为任务级和应用级两步：首先生成构建配置（makefile与链接脚本），然后从二进制中提取段地址/大小，结合调度注释生成系统调度表（事件序列）并验证三类约束（计算阶段不重叠、调度延迟有限、作业松弛度大于零）。运行时采用OpenSBI与Keystone框架，通过管理核协调DMA在各核SPM与主存间传输数据，利用RISC-V PMP实现任务隔离。
AI.result: 在Xilinx VCU 118 FPGA上实现了4核Rocket RISC-V系统（120KiB指令SPM、256KiB数据SPM），搭载内存到内存DMA。通过ROSACE飞控案例验证：超周期设为5ms，所有任务频率比为2:1:1，11个任务分布在3个应用核上。测量了运行时静态开销（事件最大24.89μs，任务加载操作最大11.69μs）及DMA传输时间模型（线性：10.1ns/byte + 2.15μs）。生成的执行轨迹显示各作业的计算窗口在LET内均匀分布，调度事件严格按时触发。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了实时应用向分阶段执行模型的自动化适配，其模块化特性（每个任务独立编译、运行时与任务二进制完全分离）支持多应用集成而无需源码级整合。基于二进制的符号表提取信息的方式显著降低了对应用实现的侵入性。未来工作将扩展系统模型与运行时，以支持与环境端口（外部传感器和执行器）的交互。

title: Physics-Direct FPGA Tooth-Contact Computation for Deterministic Gear Digital Twins
summary: Gear digital twins, hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and active vibration control close a loop around the instantaneous tooth-contact state, demanding a solver that is real-time, deterministic, and embeddable -- properties that loaded tooth contact analysis (LTCA), a data-dependent linear complementarity problem (LCP) costing seconds per mesh phase in fp64, structurally lacks; learned surrogates infer fast but spend one full LTCA solve per training sample and offer no guarantee beyond their training envelope. We instead compress the closed-form contact physics -- contact-point localization, principal-curvature extraction, and the elliptical Hertz solution -- directly into a branch-free fixed-point FPGA datapath, termed physics-direct, realized through the fully open-source openXC7 flow (no vendor tools, no floating-point IP) and validated on retired XC7K480T silicon. Four SoCs -- geometry, Hertz, and two fused paths -- pass bit-exact JTAG readback against a golden model. The on-chip preview tracks LCP body pressure to within -22% and loaded transmission error (LTE) peak-to-peak to -19%, preserving the exact $W^{1/3}$ law; with zero training it extrapolates in load more accurately than a trained network (18.9% versus 20.3%). Latency is a compile-time constant ($\sigma = 0$ jitter), and the DSP-bound geometry kernel saturates the fabric near 63 lanes. Physics-direct is an interpretable, deterministic alternative to neural surrogacy for embedded tooth-contact estimation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种名为 **physics-direct** 的固定点 FPGA 求解路径，将齿轮接触点定位、主曲率提取和椭圆 Hertz 解直接固化为无分支定点数据通路。借助开源 openXC7 流程在退役 XC7K480T 芯片上实现后，系统通过 JTAG 实现了位级精确验证，并在无训练条件下获得实时、确定性的齿面接触压力与传动误差预览；其负载外推精度优于文中训练后的神经网络。
AI.motivation: 齿轮数字孪生、硬件在环试验和主动振动控制需要在每个啮合相位内获得瞬时齿面接触状态。传统 LTCA 虽准确，但属于依赖数据的线性互补问题，在 fp64 下每个网格相位需要数秒，无法满足实时性；神经网络推理快，但每个训练样本仍需一次完整 LTCA 求解，且训练域外缺乏可靠性保证。作者因此希望把解析接触物理直接部署到 FPGA，以同时获得可解释性、确定性、低延迟和训练无关的外推能力。
AI.method: 作者将封闭形式的接触物理直接压缩成无分支、固定点的 FPGA 数据通路，即 physics-direct 架构；计算链包括接触点定位、主曲率提取及椭圆 Hertz 解。实现使用完全开源的 openXC7 流程，不依赖厂商工具或浮点 IP，并在退役 XC7K480T 硅片上完成硬件验证。研究构造四种 SoC 配置：几何、Hertz 以及两种融合路径，通过 JTAG 回读与黄金模型进行位精确比较。系统采用编译期固定流水延迟，测量标准差为 0；还评估了压力、LTE、W^(1/3) 标度律、负载外推精度、吞吐瓶颈和 FPGA 资源占用。
AI.result: 四个 SoC 均通过与黄金模型的 JTAG 位精确回读验证。片上预览对 LCP 接触压力的误差约为 22%，对加载传动误差峰峰值的误差约为 19%，并保持精确的 W^(1/3) 关系。在零训练条件下，其负载外推误差为 18.9%，优于文中训练网络报告的 20.3%。延迟为编译期固定常数，抖动 σ=0；几何核受 DSP 资源限制，在接近 63 条并行计算通道时达到器件饱和。
AI.conclusion: physics-direct 是神经代理模型之外的一种可解释嵌入式方案。它不依赖数据训练、不会继承 LTCA 的秒级计算成本，并能以确定性的恒定延迟实时估计齿面接触压力和 LTE。不过，当前结果仍是有限硬件资源下的估计器：其绝对精度约为 20% 量级，后续需要研究定点误差预算、精度—延迟—面积权衡，以及与完整 LTCA 的更广泛工况对比。

title: Reviewer Capability Governs Rejection Targeting, Not Repair Skill: Evidence from LLM Execute-Review-Revise Pipelines
comment: 6 pages, 5 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Multi-agent LLM pipelines increasingly assign roles, including execution and verification, to models of different capability tiers. This is done because running a flagship model at every stage is expensive. Previous literature has established that verification stages are not always beneficial, but holds reviewer capability roughly fixed relative to the executor. We vary it. We replace the reviewer with models spanning a capability range down to one that cannot solve the problems at all, and measure the outcome of every individual rejection. This is done across a constant set of 100 olympiad mathematics problems. A cross-family mid-tier reviewer improves final accuracy by 12 percentage points, from 52 to 64 percent (p = 0.0005), with zero damaged answers. Same-model self-review attains the highest error-detection rate of any condition (0.85 recall) yet yields no significant gain: it rejects 2.1 times as often for a third the repair rate (15 against 43 percent, p = 0.0074) and falsely rejects 35 percent of its own correct answers against 2 percent for the cross-family reviewer (paired p = 0.000015). The low damage rate of self-review proves to be an artifact of revision inertia rather than reviewer quality: of 18 falsely rejected correct answers, the three where the executor complied all became wrong, while the fifteen it ignored survived unchanged. Below a capability floor the role becomes inert: our weakest reviewer changed zero of 100 final answers while doubling token cost. These findings describe a single executor-reviewer configuration on 100 problems and should be read as a controlled pilot rather than a general claim about verification stages.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在100道奥数题上系统性地变化LLM多智能体流水线中评审者的能力层级，提出"拒绝结果分解"框架（修复/损害/无变化/错误修正），发现评审者的能力主要决定拒绝的精准度（targeting），而非修复技能（repair skill）。跨家族中等能力评审者带来12个百分点的准确率提升且零损害；同模型自评审虽检测率最高（0.85），但准确率无显著提升，因其修复率低（15% vs 43%）且错误拒绝率极高（35% vs 2%）；低于能力下限的评审者完全惰性化（0/100改动但token成本翻倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM流水线中，执行和验证角色常被分配给不同能力层级的模型以节省成本。已有研究指出验证阶段并不总是有益（"有检测无修正"现象），但这些研究通常将评审者能力与执行者固定相对。本文将评审者能力作为变量系统性地变化，以揭示能力层级如何影响每个拒绝的实际后果。
AI.method: 采用两阶段执行-评审-修订流水线（无规划器）：固定的执行者（Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite）在100道Omni-MATH难度5.0-6.0的数值答案奥数题上解题，然后由四种条件的评审者评判：(C0)无评审；(C1)同模型自评审；(C2)跨家族中等能力评审者gpt-oss-20b；(C3)弱评审者Llama-3.1-8B。配对设计使每道题的初始解A₀相同，差异完全归因于评审者。将每个拒绝结果分为四类：修复（错→对）、损害（对→错）、无变化、错误修正（错→另一错）。使用精确McNemar检验和Fisher精确检验进行统计推断。
AI.result: 最终准确率：C0=52%、C1=58%（ns，p=0.146）、C2=64%（+12pp，p=0.0005）、C3=52%。C3在100题中未改变任何最终答案（惰性化），token成本却翻倍。检测方面：C1召回率0.85（最高）但错误拒绝率35%；C2召回率0.56但错误拒绝率仅2%。拒绝后果：C1修复率15% vs C2修复率43%（p=0.0074）；C1有18个错误拒绝，其中执行者遵从的3个全部变错，剩余15个因执行者忽略而保持正确（"修订惯性"掩盖了评审者错误）。若执行者完全遵从C1的全部错误拒绝，其准确率将低于无评审基线。成本上，C1和C2每获得一个额外正确答案约需24,000-26,000 token，接近；但C2以相似成本实现了两倍的准确率提升且零损害。
AI.conclusion: 评审者的能力主要决定拒绝的精准度（targeting），而非修复技能（repair skill）。检测率和效用呈反向关系——拒绝最多的评审者并非带来最大收益者。"有检测无修正"现象的表达依赖于评审者能力，但决定因素是哪些答案被拒绝以及批评是否被执行，而非修正质量。"修订惯性"可使无能评审者显得安全（低损害率是执行者保守的结果，而非评审者准确）。存在一个能力下限，低于该下限评审角色完全惰性化，纯属浪费。实践建议：评审者选择应优先考虑精确度（precision）而非检测率（detection rate）。研究为受控试点（100题、单基准、单执行者、单轮修订），结论不宜外推至一般验证阶段。

title: Integrating Crash Report Mining and LLMs for Bug Localization and Repair: An Industrial Report
summary: Analyzing crash-report bugs in large-scale industrial software systems requires substantial maintenance effort, particularly in production environments where developers must handle large volumes of crash reports and source code artifacts to localize and fix their root causes. While recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can assist with maintenance tasks, little is known about their effectiveness in supporting developers in analyzing crash-report bugs and repairing bugs associated with groups of crash reports in industrial settings. To address this gap, we investigate whether integrating crash report mining techniques---specifically stack trace clustering and suspicious file and method ranking---with LLMs can support crash localization and repair in production environments. We conduct a retrospective evaluation of five LLMs under four prompt configurations. After that, we chose the best model to run on 38 crash bugs collected from two large Java enterprise systems. We further analyze the structural characteristics and explanatory patterns of LLM-generated responses and assess localization and repair effectiveness through manual validation. Our results show that the best-performing configuration localizes up to 71% and correctly repairs 52% of crash bugs on the full dataset. These findings provide empirical evidence that combining crash report mining with LLM-based repair can effectively support debugging activities in industrial maintenance workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个将崩溃报告挖掘技术与大语言模型（LLM）相集成的工业级调试流水线，用于Java企业级系统中的崩溃故障定位与自动修复。最佳配置在完整数据集（38个crash bug）上实现了71%的定位准确率和52%的修复准确率。
AI.motivation: 在工业级大规模生产环境中，开发者需要处理海量崩溃报告和源代码工件来定位和修复崩溃根因，成本高昂。虽然LLM在软件维护任务中展现了潜力，但其在工业场景下分析崩溃报告并修复相关bug的有效性尚未被系统研究。同时，受限于知识产权、成本和上下文窗口，将完整代码库提供给LLM不切实际。因此，需要一种方法能为LLM提供结构化、优先级化的上下文信息，以缩小搜索空间并保持相关性。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线：(1) 崩溃报告分组——基于四级累积式策略（identical stack trace → equivalent signature → crash type signature → top frame file）对具有相似堆栈轨迹的崩溃报告进行聚类；(2) 可疑文件与方法排序——采用Wu等人方法的文件级改编版本，使用IAD（Inverse Average Distance）、IBF（Inverse Bucket Frequency）、FF（File Frequency）三指标相乘评分；(3) LLM补丁生成——构建包含角色设定、可疑文件源代码、堆栈信息、排序信息、修复请求的五部分零样本提示。评估了5个LLM（Claude-3.5-sonnet, Gemini-1.5-pro, GPT-4o-mini, Mistral-large, Llama3-405b）和4种提示组合（SCoSF+ST、SCoSF+ST+RoSFM、SCoSF+SM、SCoSF+SM+RoSFM），在SmallDS（8个bug）上进行模型选择，在FullDS（38个bug，来自SIGAA和SIGRH两个Java企业系统）上验证最佳模型。评价指标包括Localization@response、Repair@response、Localization@bug、Repair@bug，采用开发者修正commit作为ground truth进行人工验证。
AI.result: 在SmallDS上，Claude-3.5-sonnet表现最佳，定位准确率82.5%（SCoSF+ST+RoSFM）、修复准确率52.5%（SCoSF+SM+RoSFM）；在FullDS上，SCoSF+ST配置表现最优，定位准确率71.05%、修复准确率52.63%。研究发现：响应结构异质性高（最常见为单类单片段，占34%）；LLM频繁违反"仅返回源代码"的指令（45.5%外部解释、37.73%内部注释）；最严格的Gemini反而表现最差，而最倾向解释的Claude表现最佳；RoSFM对SM配置有显著帮助但对ST配置帮助有限甚至有负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 将崩溃报告挖掘（堆栈轨迹聚类与可疑文件方法排序）与LLM修复能力相结合，可有效支持工业维护工作流中的调试活动。最佳模型Claude-3.5-sonnet结合SCoSF+ST提示在完整数据集上实现了71%的定位准确率和52%的修复准确率，验证了该集成方法在工业环境下的实用价值。LLM响应的结构异质性和指令遵从性问题使得自动补丁提取仍然具有挑战性。

title: An Empirical Analysis of CodeQL False Positives and Query Refinements for Java Vulnerabilities
summary: Static application security testing (SAST) tools help developers find vulnerabilities before deployment, but false positives create substantial triage effort. We study whether CodeQL false positives in Java security analysis form recurring, explainable patterns that can be reduced by refining the analysis. We run CodeQL's Java security query suite on 167 CVE instances from 110 projects, focusing on the ten queries with the highest false positive rates. We manually review 500 sampled false positive paths and locations and construct a source-level taxonomy. The five categories are Missed Path Constraint or Sanitization (36.6%), Benign Execution Context (29.4%), Missing Trust Boundary Modeling (27.6%), Imprecise Concurrency Modeling (5%), and Imprecise Sink Modeling (1.4%). Guided by these findings, we implement CodeQL refinements that detect and filter recurring false positive patterns at the query level. The refinements remove 81.8% of reviewed false positives. Across the full selected-query dataset, they remove 15.8% of reported paths and locations while retaining 7 of 8 true positives. This shows that many false positives can be reduced in the analysis, although fixed refinements often depend on project-specific context. To address this generalization gap, we evaluate whether agentic coding tools can adapt refinement patterns to new projects. Given our patterns as templates, the two tools succeed on 56% and 62% of tasks, with query compile-pass rates above 90%. Without this guidance, both succeed on only 28%, while compile rates fall to 30-36%. These results support a refinement-oriented SAST workflow in which recurring false positives are modeled in CodeQL queries and automatically adapted to different project contexts, reducing repeated triage.

AI.tldr: 本文对 CodeQL 在 Java 安全分析中的误报进行系统性实证研究，构建了五类误报根因分类法，并实现了可执行的查询精化策略，结合 LLM 代理实现项目自适应的误报抑制工作流。
AI.motivation: SAST 工具（如 CodeQL）在 Java 安全扫描中产生大量误报，给开发者带来沉重的审查负担并阻碍工具落地。现有研究多关注告警后处理（排序、过滤、LLM 判别），但缺少从源码层面将误报根因反馈到查询逻辑本身的系统性方法，也未探索这些经验驱动的精化策略能否跨项目自动化适配。
AI.method: 基于 CWE-Bench-Java 数据集（167 个 CVE / 110 个项目），在 10 个高误报率 CodeQL 查询上采样 500 个误报路径/位置进行人工归纳编码，构建分层误报分类法；据此设计 CodeQL 查询精化谓词并在完整数据集上评估；进一步构建 50 个项目级精化任务，对比 Codex（GPT 5.5）与 Claude Code（Opus 4.5）在有/无 RQ2 精化模板引导下的表现。
AI.result: RQ1：构建五类误报根因——漏报路径约束/净化（36.6%）、良性执行上下文（29.4%）、缺失信任边界建模（27.6%）、并发建模不精确（5%）、汇点建模不精确（1.4%）。RQ2：精化策略去重后消除 409/500（81.8%）已审查误报，完整数据集上消除 15.8% 报告路径/位置，保留 7/8（87.5%）真实正例。RQ3：无引导时代理成功率仅 28%，编译通过率 30–36%；提供 RQ2 精化模板后，Codex 与 Claude Code 成功率分别提升至 56% 和 62%，编译通过率超过 90%。
AI.conclusion: CodeQL Java 误报存在可解释、可复现的源码层模式，可被建模为查询精化谓词以直接消除大量误报；但固定精化策略受项目上下文限制而泛化能力有限。以经验驱动的精化模式作为模板，由 LLM 代理进行项目级适配，可显著提升误报抑制效率，支持"精化导向"的 SAST 工作流。

title: Software Engineering in the Agent Era From Trustworthy Change to Human Agent Software Organizations
summary: Software agents make digital execution elastic: repository analysis, code generation, testing, migration, tool use, and operations can be replicated and parallelized without proportional human headcount. Problem framing, semantic commitment, verification, integration, attention, and residual-risk acceptance remain bounded by human cognition, organizational authority, and economic capacity. How should scalable execution be governed so organizations can accept and sustain its changes? Our testable framework has two constructs and one execution abstraction. Trustworthy Change (TC) is the engineering object moving from intent through delegated execution, verification, integration, acceptance, and operation. Responsibility Topology classifies organizations by the distribution of independent residual-risk acceptance authority. A single-center topology has one final baseline responsibility anchor; a multi-anchor topology requires joint acceptance across independently governed domains. The Human-Agent Cell (HAC) produces candidates, proposals, and evidence; execution grants no acceptance authority. As execution and authority scale differently, distributed HACs create context-coherence and invalidation pressures, while multi-anchor governance adds joint acceptance and explicit responsibility closure. Responsibility, accountability, change management, specification, verification, and human oversight predate this work; our claim is only that agent-scaled execution changes how they fit together. We make that authority an explicit classification axis and derive consequences for change state, shared engineering facts, verification, and flow control. Progressive Specification and bounded-capacity analysis remain hypotheses to test, not laws. We contribute theory construction and operationalization; empirical validity remains open to controlled, longitudinal, and field studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体软件工程"（Agent SE）理论框架，核心主张是：随着AI智能体使数字执行变得弹性可扩展，软件工程的核心治理对象应从"人类过程控制"转向"可信变更治理"（Trusted Change Governance），并以"独立残余风险接受权的分布"作为组织分类的新轴线。
AI.motivation: 软件智能体大幅降低了代码生成、测试、迁移等数字执行的成本，但问题定义、语义承诺、验证、集成、注意力分配和残余风险接受仍受限于人类认知和组织权威。执行能力与接受权威的"不对称扩展"产生了核心治理问题：组织应如何治理可扩展执行以产出可接受且可持续维护的软件变更？传统SE理论以稀缺的人类执行能力为前提，需在智能体时代重新组织。
AI.method: 构建可测试的理论框架，包含两大理论构件和一个执行抽象：(1) 可信变更（Trustworthy Change, TC）——跨越意图→委托执行→验证→集成→接受→运行全生命周期的工程对象，具有六维闭合维度（意图/规约、委托/资源、变更/溯源、证据、集成/运行、责任）和三态生命周期（候选→合格→已接受TC）；(2) 责任拓扑（Responsibility Topology）——以"独立残余风险接受权的分布"为轴的组织分类，区分单中心（single-center）与多锚点（multi-anchor）两种基本形态；(3) 人-智能体单元（Human–Agent Cell, HAC）——以单个人类执行主体为中心，组合其智能体、上下文、工具、权限和预算的最小执行边界。配套提出渐进式规约（Progressive Specification）、权威工程状态与上下文失效（Authoritative State/Context Invalidation）、有界能力智能体SE（Bounded-Capacity Agent SE）、增强Conway效应假设等派生机制。
AI.result: 形式化了：(a) TC候选→合格→已接受状态机及R1–R6不合格条件（意图/规约失败、委托/资源失败、变更/溯源失败、证据失败、集成/运行失败、责任失败）；(b) 责任拓扑的判定规则与可操作化路径（需结合法定治理、技术执行、实际实践三类证据）；(c) 单中心与多锚点下的吞吐量上界和协调机制差异（单中心并发受限于min(分解度,集成带宽,验证带宽,经济容量)，多锚点并发还受跨单元带宽和架构带宽约束）；(d) 通过订单状态枚举变更案例贯穿展示相同工件变更在两种拓扑下具有不同的闭合条件；(e) 提出可证伪命题P1–P8（最低充分规约区、验证能力约束、证据独立性、变更局部性、上下文失效、责任拓扑独立解释力等）及对应观测变量。给出三层参考工具架构（HAC/团队/组织）与现有智能体开发基础设施（AGENTS.md、MCP、sandbox、CODEOWNERS等）的映射，表明理论对象可在现有基础上实现。
AI.conclusion: 智能体时代软件工程的核心结论是：执行能力与责任接受权威沿不同维度扩展，分布式HAC执行产生上下文一致性与失效压力，多锚点治理额外引入联合接受与显式责任闭合要求。软件工程治理对象从"人类过程控制"转向"可信变更治理"，控制单元从人员/任务/提交上升为可信变更（TC）。组织价值越来越取决于异质性（独立知识、上下文、证据、接受权）而非人头数。本框架处于概念化与操作化阶段，经验有效性尚待受控实验、纵向研究和田野研究检验。核心判别需经验证据：责任拓扑是否在校正团队规模后仍具独立解释力、最低充分规约区是否存在、上下文失效是否真正降低陈旧上下文逃逸率、已接受TC会计是否能改善智能体软件工作测量。

title: How Developers Discuss Generative AI: A Longitudinal Study of the Visual Studio Code Community
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at 34th IEEE/ACIS SNPD 2026
summary: Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and coding agents have rapidly become part of everyday software development, yet little is known about how mainstream open source communities discuss them in practice. This paper presents a longitudinal analysis of generative-AI-related discussions in the Visual Studio Code (VS Code) GitHub repository, using 43,806 candidate issues created between January 2021 and June 2026. To improve corpus quality, we combined keyword retrieval with semantic relevance filtering, yielding a filtered corpus of 25,227 AI-related issues. We applied BERTopic to the retrieved corpus to identify discussion topics, using the filtered corpus for theme validation and a robustness re-clustering, and analyzed their evolution over time using monthly prevalence and Mann-Kendall trend tests. The results show that developer discussions are dominated by practical concerns regarding the operation of AI-assisted development environments, including agent management, configuration, reliability, authentication, and billing, whereas risks frequently emphasized in survey-based studies, such as hallucination and licensing, rarely surface in this venue. This suggests that discussions of generative AI in the VS Code issue tracker primarily focus on operational aspects of AI-assisted software development. Furthermore, discussions evolved from AI-assisted code completion toward conversational and agent-based development, reflecting the increasing integration of generative AI into software development workflows. These findings suggest that GitHub Issues provide a practical, workflow-oriented perspective on generative AI that complements survey-based studies of developer perceptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文对VS Code GitHub仓库中2021年1月至2026年6月期间的生成式AI相关讨论进行了纵向分析，使用关键词检索与语义相关性过滤从43,806个候选issues中筛选出25,227个AI相关issues，采用BERTopic主题建模与Mann-Kendall趋势检验，发现开发者讨论主要聚焦于AI辅助开发环境的操作层面（如代理管理、配置、认证、计费），而非调查研究中常强调的幻觉与许可等风险；讨论从AI辅助代码补全逐步演变为对话式与代理式开发。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多依赖调查或聚焦AI专业社区（如AI专项仓库、ChatGPT相关项目），缺乏对主流开源社区在生成式AI快速演进过程中实际讨论内容的纵向刻画；调查数据与issue tracker数据所揭示的开发者关注点是否存在差异尚不清楚。
AI.method: 数据收集：使用GitHub Search API以12个关键词按月分窗口抓取microsoft/vscode issues，经去重与预处理得到43,761篇关键词语料；构建基于MiniLM嵌入+逻辑回归的语义相关性分类器（5折CV精度0.79、召回0.84）筛得25,227篇AI相关语料。主题建模：以BERTopic（all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + UMAP + HDBSCAN + c-TF-IDF）为主，LDA为对比；通过Cv/CNPMI、主题多样性与单标注人工检验（含300篇盲重复标注的Cohen κ=0.73）评估质量；时序分析采用Barua法计算主题月度占比，并以Mann-Kendall检验+Sen斜率估计趋势；同时在过滤语料上重新聚类作为稳健性检验。
AI.result: BERTopic识别125个主题，Cv=0.628、CNPMI=0.205，均优于LDA基线；过滤语料上重新聚类得到86个主题，Cv=0.648、CNPMI=0.220。讨论以操作为主：Bug修复49.1%、生产力/工作流20.7%、安全8.9%，而幻觉仅2.4%、许可0.6%、代码审查缺失。显著上升主题包括代理/聊天会话管理、文件上下文、安装验证、内联聊天与Copilot in WSL；显著下降主题为鼠标光标、内联补全、终端、Jupyter与快捷键（相对占比效应，稳健性重聚类中无主题显著下降）。讨论经历三阶段：2021–2022 Copilot补全、2023–2024 Copilot Chat、2025起代理模式主导。
AI.conclusion: GitHub Issues提供与调查互补的、操作与工作流导向的生成式AI开发者视角；VS Code社区主要讨论AI助手的部署与运维（配置、认证、计费、可靠性），而非代码质量层面的概念性风险；讨论已从代码补全转向对话式与代理式开发。局限在于：单标注者研究（需第二独立标注者）、单一Microsoft仓库（含Copilot一等公民特性）、关键词召回与分类器偏差；未来工作将跨更多OSS项目验证，并引入情感分析等方法。

title: An Empirical Study on Learning Paths and Gender Dynamics in Scrum Master Roles
summary: Context: Agile development methodology has been widely adopted by industry and the demand for experienced professionals in Agile-related roles is persistently high. Objectives: We focus on the learning path for a Scrum Master role in multicultural software companies and investigate the role in relation to team size, together with the learning process for a career path, and how companies monitor soft skills development. Method: We conducted our study in two phases, two qualitative surveys (interview studies) and performed a qualitative and quantitative data analysis of the results. Conclusions: Our results identified that the need for a Scrum Master (SM) depends on the size of the team, with our study indicating a six-member limit. There is no overall standardized process for soft skills learning or metrics to measure progress. Some companies measure soft skills based on feedback received from the client or from the team, and other companies are taking both types of feedback into consideration. Many learning initiatives, especially on soft skills for an SM role, were based on actions of the employees. The version of Record of this contribution is published in Software Engineering and Advanced Applications. SEAA 2025. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16083. Springer, Cham. and available online at: check DOI.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两阶段定性访谈（32人+12人女性）及焦点小组，探究跨国软件公司中Scrum Master（SM）角色的学习路径、团队规模与角色需求的关系、软技能评估方式及性别动态。主要结论：团队规模超过6人时普遍需要专职SM；学习途径以互动式为主（课程、辅导、社区学习），且多由员工自发发起；公司普遍缺乏软技能标准化评估指标，主要依赖客户或团队反馈；男性在SM角色中占主导（57.14% vs 女性29.41%）。
AI.motivation: 敏捷开发在业界广泛采用，Scrum Master需求旺盛，但关于该角色学习路径的研究较少，且女性在技术性角色中代表性不足。已有研究表明女性更倾向于强调软技能的职位，因此探究SM学习路径与性别动态具有理论与实践意义。
AI.method: 采用两阶段定性调查方法：第一阶段对14家公司的32位有5年以上领导经验的从业者（含14名女性、18名男性）进行半结构化访谈，并组织3小时焦点小组；第二阶段对12名女性SM进行访谈。通过Teams录音、第三方交叉核对转录，采用主题分析（thematic analysis）进行定性分析，并辅以定量统计。
AI.result: （1）团队规模≤6的团队通常不需要专职SM，规模>6则普遍配置SM（仅一例例外）；（2）女性担任SM比例为29.41%，男性为57.14%；（3）女性学习路径多样（技术、商业、工程、欧洲研究等背景），互动式学习（课程、指导、社区）占50%以上，但认证并非关键（仅4/11获得认证）；（4）多数软技能评估依赖反馈（53.12%），31.25%受访者表示无标准化流程，公司普遍缺乏针对沟通、会议主持、谈判、冲突解决等具体软技能的量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了SM角色需求与团队规模的阈值关系（六人），强调了SM学习的高度个性化与员工自驱性，指出软技能评估在行业内缺乏标准化，并凸显了SM角色中的性别失衡问题。未来工作将扩展到敏捷团队其他角色的学习过程研究。

title: T(r)opical Islands: Visualizing & Understanding Socio-Technical Artifacts
comment: 12 pages, 11 figures, 1 table, accepted at ICSME 2026
summary: Projects hosted on collaborative software development platforms, such as GitHub, include many non-code artifacts documenting the project's lifecycle, with its challenges, plans, design, and even community. These socio-technical artifacts include, for example, bug reports, feature requests, and forum posts, offering a useful prospect on the project's evolution. However, these artifacts are dispersed over multiple communication channels and written in natural language, making their analysis difficult, as they are fragmented and with considerable noise. We present a 3D visualization approach mapping topics found across a project's socio-technical artifacts onto vegetation-covered islands, where the individual artifacts are depicted as trees of various types. The topic islands rise out of the ocean as they become discussed, to sink again when they are no longer so. We built a prototype implementing the entire visualization pipeline, from data mining to interactive rendering, leveraging machine learning techniques to cluster the artifacts and extract their topics. We present, through several case studies, the insights that our approach elicits about discussions of development topics throughout a project's history. The user study we conducted (N=34) further strengthens our conclusions about its suitability for understanding socio-technical artifacts and their evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"T(r)opical Islands"——一种3D可视化方法，将GitHub项目中的社会技术制品（Issues、PRs、Discussions）映射为植被覆盖的"主题岛屿"，其中话题活跃度通过岛屿的升降来表现，并实现了完整的工具原型Ritgard。
AI.motivation: GitHub等协作开发平台上的Issues、PRs、Discussions等社会技术制品（STAs）虽然记录了项目演化的重要信息，但它们分散在不同沟通渠道、以自然语言撰写且含有大量噪声，难以进行系统性分析。现有可视化方法缺乏对这些制品整体景观及其时间演化维度的综合性表征。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）通过GitHub REST和GraphQL API挖掘STAs并预处理为纯文本；（2）使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B模型生成文本嵌入，UMAP降维，HDBSCAN*聚类，基于BERTopic的class-based TF-IDF提取关键词；（3）使用LLM（GPT-OSS-120B）通过few-shot prompt为每个聚类生成主题名称；（4）采用岛屿隐喻进行3D可视化：每个主题=一座岛屿，每个STA=一棵树（体素字形），树的二维位置由UMAP确定反映语义相似性，岛屿高度通过滑动窗口内STA评论数计算代表话题活跃度，地图面积对应代码库变更行数。工具基于Godot游戏引擎实现。
AI.result: 通过对Lume、JetUML、Git for Windows三个案例项目的分析，展示了该方法能从静态快照和演化两个角度提供项目洞察——包括识别热门话题、追踪话题兴衰、发现被忽视的STAs（如未回复的Discussion）、展现社区参与模式等。N=34的用户研究显示：解读努力度低（识别任务M=1.89，比较任务M=2.09），分析问题平均准确率89%（显著高于随机），趣味性评分M=5.52，有用性M=4.11，64%的用户认为趣味性设计未损害可读性。68%的用户认为Ritgard与GitHub原生UI互补。但大型项目（如Git for Windows）可读性显著下降，且聚类质量存在边界情况（如主题相似但实际无关的STA可能被聚集在一起）。
AI.conclusion: 该可视化方法通过岛屿隐喻有效呈现了GitHub社会技术制品及其演化趋势，平衡了可读性与趣味性，适合不同利益相关者（开发者、新成员、维护者、项目经理、用户）使用。Ritgard作为概念验证原型，为软件项目的多维度分析提供了新途径。局限性包括：对聚类质量的依赖、嵌入模型的计算需求、模板噪声、Discussion线程缺失、渲染性能限制以及用户研究中样本偏差。未来工作将改进时间线控件、多级聚合、平台扩展（GitLab等）以及与源代码的关联。

title: Ritgard: T(r)opical Islands of Socio-Technical Artifacts on GitHub
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, tool demo paper accepted at VISSOFT 2026
summary: A software project is more than just code. Non-code artifacts often document the human processes and decisions behind source code. The rationale behind a library change, an architectural decision, a problem encountered by a user are all examples of information typically present in socio-technical artifacts (STAs), created and persisted in channels separate from the repository itself (yet sometimes very close---e.g., GitHub Issues with GitHub repositories). These STAs are a trove of information about the project's architecture and its evolution, containing details and insights that code alone cannot provide. Unfortunately, this information is not easily extracted and explored as STAs are frequently fragmented over different communication channels, and are written in natural language. We present Ritgard, a tool that mines GitHub repositories for their STAs, namely Issues, Pull Requests, and Discussions, and visualizes them as 3D islands covered with trees. Each tree represents a single artifact and each island is a topic extracted from the artifacts through a combination of text embedding and text summarization. The terrain of the islands rises out of the ocean as the topic becomes active and sinks back in when it becomes stale, thus depicting the evolution of features and concerns throughout the project's lifetime. We describe the tool's usage and implementation, showing the numerous technical challenges behind Ritgard's visualization.

AI.tldr: Ritgard是一款可视化GitHub社交技术工件(STAs)的工具，将Issue、Pull Request、Discussion挖掘后通过主题建模与3D可视化呈现为树木与岛屿的景观，用以直观展现项目的演进。
AI.motivation: 软件项目中非代码工件（Issues、PRs、Discussions）蕴含大量架构决策、用户反馈和演进信息，但因分散于多个自然语言渠道，难以获取全局视角。需要一种工具来提炼并可视化这些社交技术工件（STAs），帮助开发者、用户、项目管理者理解项目生命周期中的非代码信息。
AI.method: 采用三阶段流水线：1) 通过GitHub REST与GraphQL API采集STAs；2) 数据处理——使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B进行文本嵌入，UMAP降维，HDBSCAN*聚类，结合BERTopic与LLM生成主题名称，再通过Delaunay三角剖分生成地形高度图；3) 在Godot游戏引擎中进行3D渲染与交互。岛屿代表主题，树木代表工件，地形高度反映随时间滑窗的活动度。
AI.result: 通过四个项目示例的可视化对比，展示了Ritgard能够直观呈现不同项目STA的活跃度与主题分布差异，例如项目A年轻活跃、项目D以PR为主等。整体表明该工具能有效将分散的自然语言STA聚合为高层次的3D景观视图，并支持通过滑窗动画浏览项目演进历史。
AI.conclusion: Ritgard证明主题建模与3D可视化结合可以为GitHub项目STA提供有效的高层概览与演进视图。计划扩展元数据维度、重构为客户端-服务器架构以降低使用门槛，并探索更小更轻量的嵌入模型与LLM以提升可及性。

title: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
summary: Latent world models have become increasingly popular as a method to predict and plan in latent space rather than pixel space. Recent architectures, such as LeWorldModel (LeWM), jointly train the encoder and predictor using regularization techniques like SIGReg to prevent representation collapse. Even with such regularization preventing representation collapse, we identify a new world model failure mode of \textit{physical representation laziness}, particularly noted in highly dynamic environments. For these lazy cases, the learned latent states do not collapse but nonetheless fail to represent key physical properties, causing ubiquitous downstream planning failure. To resolve this issue, we propose training-time auxiliary supervision with a lightweight "Fourier auxiliary head", which enforces physically-informed structuring of the latent space with no additional inference-time cost and can be generalized to any environment. Experimentally, we show that the auxiliary head substantially improves planning success rates in dynamic environments where the baseline LeWM exhibits physical representation laziness. It also leads to modest improvements in other environments, even when the baseline does not exhibit physical representation laziness. We further observe superior planning performance being accompanied by higher latent space correlations with key physical properties, indicating both the ability of our method to physically structure latent states and the potential planning-side benefit to the learned representation being physically structured. We also see in low-data regimes, auxiliary supervision is particularly impactful in increasing success rate. These findings support the use of our Fourier auxiliary head method to improve both overall success rate and data efficiency, while avoiding representation laziness in latent world models.

AI.tldr: 本文针对JEPA风格潜在世界模型在动态环境中存在的"物理表示懒惰"（physical representation laziness）问题，提出了一种基于傅里叶辅助头的训练时监督方法，通过轻量级的几何结构化潜在空间，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了规划成功率与数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA风格世界模型（如LeWM）虽使用SIGReg等正则化防止表示坍缩，但在高度动态环境中仍存在新发现的"物理表示懒惰"故障模式：潜在状态未坍缩但未能保留关键物理属性，导致下游规划普遍失败。这表明避免表示坍缩是必要的，但不足以保证物理信息的保留。
AI.method: 提出Fourier辅助头（2层MLP），对编码和预测的潜在状态施加训练时辅助监督。利用有向边界框和语义分割掩模构造8维几何状态向量，对视觉上不可区分的交换对象通过傅里叶特征映射与求和构造置换不变的频谱目标，使潜在空间结构化反映物理属性。该辅助头仅在训练时使用，推理时可移除。同时探讨了与SIGReg（优于VISReg）的协同及在CEM规划中作为物理约束的扩展应用。
AI.result: 在n球环境中，规划成功率提升62.7%-88.8%（H=4），控制球位置相关性从近零提升至约0.4；在Push-T、Two Room、OG-Bench Cube等环境中也有适度提升（成功率2.8%-4.2%）。低数据（250k样本）下Push-T性能提升达1.53倍。线性/MLP探针实验进一步证实潜在空间更好地编码了物理量。
AI.conclusion: 避免表示坍缩是必要的，但不足以构建可靠的规划世界模型。傅里叶辅助头通过廉价的几何监督为JEPA风格世界模型提供了物理结构化的潜在表示，显著提高了规划成功率与数据效率，尤其在数据受限的动态环境中效果突出，为任意JEPA风格世界模型提供了一种通用、可推广的改进方案。

title: ProToMEx: Rapid, Interpretable Explanations via Structured Representations
summary: Existing post-hoc explainers for machine learning classifiers primarily focus on feature attribution, assigning importance scores to individual features. While valuable, this approach struggles to articulate the complex, combinatorial patterns that often drive a model's decision-making process. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProToMEx, a new paradigm for explainability that leverages Probabilistic Topic Models (PTMs). Our model-agnostic framework learns latent ''topics'' that represent distinct, high-level reasons for a classification, moving beyond simple feature importance to reveal underlying semantic structures. ProToMEx naturally provides both global explanations of a model's overall behaviour and local explanations that can disentangle multiple co-existing reasons for a specific prediction. We demonstrate empirically that ProToMEx not only produces explanations of comparable fidelity to popular methods like SHAP and LIME but also drastically reduces the amortised computational cost of generating local explanations, making it highly suitable for real-time applications. Specifically, we show that ProToMEx is ~30-40x faster than SHAP and LIME over standardised tabular datasets and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: ProToMEx提出了一种基于概率主题模型（PTM/LDA）的后置解释框架，将结构化表格数据转换为加权词袋语料库，通过学习潜在"主题"来揭示分类器决策背后的语义化、可解释的组合模式。该方法天然支持全局与局部解释，并能解耦同一预测背后的多重理由。相比SHAP和LIME，ProToMEx在保真度相当的同时，将单实例局部解释速度提升约30-40倍，适合实时应用。
AI.motivation: 现有主流后置解释方法（SHAP、LIME等）以特征归因为核心，输出的是各特征的重要性权重列表。这种方式难以揭示驱动模型决策的复杂组合模式（即"为什么这些特征共同起作用"）。此外，一个预测可能由多重独立理由支撑（如贷款被拒可能源于"低收入+高负债"或"就业不稳定"），特征归因会将这些不同理由混为一谈。同时，SHAP的计算开销随特征数指数增长，难以满足实时解释需求。
AI.method: ProToMEx采用两阶段框架：（1）离线阶段：对黑盒分类器进行采样生成合成数据，对每个类别-特征组合计算类条件概率质量函数并离散化为δ个区间中心，构建由类别标签词和"feat_i_c"特征值词组成的词表V；将每个实例-标签对通过TranslateToDocument转换为加权词袋文档——根据特征值在类条件分布中的秩将其放入|B|个权重箱并重复相应次数，类标签词重复|B|次以强调其重要性；用Gensim的LDA在所得语料上训练得到K个主题-词分布Φ。（2）在线阶段：对新实例x'，获取预测标签后转换为文档，推理其主题混合分布θ_{d'}，取概率超过阈值ε的主题集合作为局部解释，每个主题即一条独立理由。全局解释则通过查找对类标签词概率超过阈值ε'的主题得到。
AI.result: 在9个合成数据集（特征数8-15、类别2-3、模式数4-20）和4个公开数据集（Loan、Lungs、Wine、Air）上，以5层ReLU神经网络为黑盒模型，与SHAP和LIME对比100次随机实验。结果显示：（1）效率：单实例解释速度比SHAP快约25-40倍，比LIME快约20倍；在Loan数据集上解释2600个实例后即可抵消离线开销，Lungs仅需90个实例；（2）保真度：ProToMEx在75%的实例上遗漏的SHAP识别的影响力特征少于2个，遗漏数通常不超过3；（3）模式恢复：在合成数据上所学主题与生成模式的平均相似度≥0.62，能有效恢复数据背后的潜在模式；（4）鲁棒性：即使强制SHAP"漏采样"Top-3特征（Poor Sampling SHAP），ProToMEx仍能识别出更多影响力特征。
AI.conclusion: ProToMEx首次将概率主题模型成功适配到黑盒分类器的后置解释任务中，通过将结构化表格数据巧妙转化为加权词袋文档，突破了PTM与表格数据之间的壁垒。它提供了一种超越简单特征归因、能够揭示多重共现理由的全新解释范式，在解释质量和计算效率上均具竞争力。未来工作将开展用户研究以正式评估主题式解释的人类可解释性和实用性。

title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
summary: Aerodynamic surrogate models trained on high-fidelity CFD data reproduce numerical predictions of both scalar outputs and entire fields accurately, yet their predictive fidelity is limited by systematic discrepancies between CFD and experimental observations. We present an experimentally grounded correction framework that adapts a CFD-trained deep learning surrogate using wind-tunnel PSP measurements. A Geotransolver surrogate trained on 2,300 high-fidelity CFD simulations of the NASA CRM wing-body configuration, spanning geometric variation, Mach 0.70-0.85, and angles of attack 0 to 4 degrees, reproduces the CFD integrated aerodynamic forces and pitching moment to R2 > 0.99 but does not match the experimental data. To incorporate experimental information without retraining the surrogate, a correction network is trained on spatially registered PSP measurements at two freestream Mach numbers (0.70 and 0.85) across the same angle-of-attack range, learning the discrepancy between the surrogate-predicted and experimentally measured surface-pressure distributions. At Mach 0.85 the correction substantially improves agreement with PSP, particularly at the wing suction peak, shock location, and subsequent pressure recovery, reducing both the magnitude of the prediction error and the fraction of wetted surface on which it exceeds 0.05 in Cp, and it does so from a limited experimental dataset without modifying the pretrained surrogate parameters. On held-out angles of attack the grounded surrogate agrees with measurement to within 2.3-2.7% of the measured Cp range, and outperforms direct interpolation between the measured conditions at every state tested. Experimental measurements can therefore ground a large-scale simulation-trained surrogate by learning systematic CFD-to-experiment discrepancies while preserving its generalization capability and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数据融合框架，利用风洞PSP（压力敏感涂料）测量数据对CFD训练的Geotransolver代理模型进行实验校正。通过冻结预训练代理模型，仅训练轻量级MLP校正头来学习CFD与实验之间的系统差异，无需重新训练整个代理模型即可将仿真预测与物理观测对齐。
AI.motivation: CFD训练的代理模型能高保真地复现数值预测（R²>0.99），但无法捕捉CFD与物理实验之间的系统偏差（如激波位置、吸力峰、气动弹性变形等效应）。实验数据稀缺且昂贵，无法单独用于训练深度代理模型。因此需要一种方法融合大规模CFD覆盖范围与实验物理保真度。
AI.method: 1) 使用2,300个高保真RANS仿真（NASA CRM翼身构型，跨几何变化、Mach 0.70-0.85、迎角0°-4°）训练Geotransolver基线代理模型；2) 冻结预训练模型参数；3) 将风洞PSP测量数据通过坐标重建、逆距离加权插值和高斯过程校正三阶段配准到CFD表面网格；4) 训练一个轻量级MLP校正头（140,289参数，结构为386→256→128→64→1，SiLU激活），输入为冻结的384维潜变量拼接归一化流动条件，输出实验压力系数；5) 仅在14个实验工况上训练，保留4个工况（1.5°和3.0°，两个Mach数）用于测试。
AI.result: 基线代理模型在CFD上R²>0.99（升力、阻力、俯仰力矩），但与PSP存在局部偏差。校正后，在保留测试工况上：归一化误差为测量Cp范围的2.3-2.7%，R²=0.922-0.966；在所有保留工况上均优于直接插值；在强跨音速工况（M=0.85, AoA=3.0°），校正后R²=0.952，而插值仅R²=0.756，差距达0.196。校正显著改善了吸力峰、激波位置和压力恢复区的吻合度，且未修改预训练代理模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明有限的实验数据能有效将仿真训练的代理模型锚定到物理系统，通过学习系统性的CFD-实验偏差，同时保留原始模型的泛化能力和计算效率。主要局限性在于：校正仅在两个Mach数上拟合评估、外推未经验证；PSP数据仅对应单一构型，跨几何迁移性未知；校正为经验性的，未分离各物理机理（如气动弹性变形）的独立贡献。

title: Quantum-Assisted Memory-Efficient Training for Parameter-Intensive Wi-Fi-Based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition (HAR) has become an important part of integrated sensing and communications, paving the way for a range of context-aware services. However, most existing Wi-Fi-based HAR systems rely on deep learning (DL) models that are computationally and memory intensive in both training and inference, which poses significant challenges for real-world deployment. Conventional training requires simultaneous updates of millions of parameters, leading to prohibitive memory consumption. In this paper, we propose a novel quantum-assisted memory-efficient training framework (Q-MET) designed to improve efficiency in both training and inference. Q-MET utilizes a hybrid quantum classical neural network to indirectly generate parameters for HAR models, significantly reducing the trainable parameter count compared to direct optimization. To further support the deployment on resource-constrained devices, we integrate structured pruning during the training phase. Experimental results demonstrate that Q-MET achieves a 90% to 95% reduction in trainable parameters compared with conventional backpropagation-based DL training while maintaining or even exceeding classical classification accuracy. Additionally, Q-MET supports lightweight inference through structured pruning, achieving 75% to 85% model sparsity with less than 2% loss in classification accuracy. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first quantum-assisted approach to simultaneously tackle memory inefficiencies in both the training and inference stages of HAR systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Q-MET（Quantum-assisted Memory-Efficient Training）框架，通过混合量子-经典神经网络间接生成Wi-Fi人体活动识别（HAR）模型的参数，将结构化剪枝集成到训练过程中，同时降低训练和推理阶段的内存开销。实验表明，Q-MET在UT-HAR和Widar3.0两个数据集上可减少90%-95%的可训练参数，并在75%-85%稀疏度下保持分类精度损失小于2%。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi HAR系统依赖深度学习模型，但常规训练需要同时更新百万级参数，导致训练阶段内存消耗过高；现有的模型压缩方法（量化、剪枝）主要针对推理阶段，且通常需要先训练完整模型再压缩，训练阶段的内存瓶颈仍未解决。量子辅助训练（QuantumTrain）虽已在图像分类等领域展现参数高效性，但尚未应用于HAR场景，也未联合解决推理效率问题。
AI.method: Q-MET框架由量子参数生成器（QPG）和经典目标网络（ResNet-18）构成。QPG包含：参数化量子电路（PQC，采用U3和CU3门构建环形纠缠结构，参数总量为6Nq）、正弦嵌入层（将量子测量概率向量映射为紧凑标识符）和经典映射网络（内-外两层MLP结构）。训练流程为三阶段：预热训练（warm-up）→ 基于LAMP（Layer-Adaptive Magnitude-based Pruning）分数的结构化通道剪枝 → 剪枝后的最优结构继续由Q-MET训练生成参数。QPG动态生成活跃通道的参数，注入ResNet-18的功能化层。损失梯度通过链式法则经QPG反向传播。
AI.result: 在UT-HAR数据集上，Q-MET（7 qubits）将可训练参数从1160万降至约5%（约54.7万），准确率从98.08%提升至99.08%；在Widar3.0上，Q-MET（6 qubits）将参数降至约10%（约52.9万），准确率从71.29%略降至70.61%。剪枝方面，UT-HAR上剪枝比0.8可达到约85%稀疏度，准确率仅损失约1%；Widar3.0上剪枝比0.6可达到约75%稀疏度，准确率损失约1.42%。与轻量级ResNet-18和静态超网络对比，Q-MET均展现更优精度；与训练后剪枝（TTP）对比，Q-MET在所有剪枝比下均更稳定且精度更高，特别是在高剪枝比（0.9）下优势显著。训练时间每epoch增加18%-36%。
AI.conclusion: Q-MET是首个同时解决HAR系统训练与推理阶段内存效率问题的量子辅助框架。通过将结构化剪枝集成到QT训练流程中而非后处理，Q-MET有效避免了训练后剪枝带来的容量损失。实验验证了框架在参数效率、精度保持和部署实用性方面的优势。框架与任何压缩技术兼容，未来可与量化、剪枝-量化混合方法结合进一步降低成本；此外，可结合联邦学习等隐私保护机制扩展至隐私敏感场景，并需研究信道级对抗扰动下的鲁棒性。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Forced Outage Risk Prediction: Benefits and Comparison to Machine Learning
summary: This study examines the ability of large language models (LLMs) to predict the risk of weather-related forced outages in the distribution grid in a zero-shot framework, without labeled training data. The problem is formulated as a binary severity classification task across three forecast horizons (3h, 6h, 12h), using six years of outage records and high-resolution weather data for a utility service area in central Texas. Four zero-shot LLMs are benchmarked against two supervised classifiers across two input configurations: one using current weather observations and the other using weather forecast data. Results show that supervised models outperform LLMs on macro-F1 and precision, while newer LLM generations achieve competitive scores. Beyond accuracy, LLMs offer complementary strengths in actionable reasoning and geographic scalability, suggesting that combining them with supervised models may be the best practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次将大语言模型（LLM）以零样本方式应用于配电网天气相关强迫停运风险预测，与监督式机器学习模型（逻辑回归、LightGBM）进行系统比较，得出两者各有优势、应互补使用的结论。
AI.motivation: 传统ML方法需要大量标注数据、复杂特征工程和周期性再训练，部署到新区域时需从头构建，成本高且迁移性差。LLM凭借预训练的气象与基础设施风险知识，有望在零样本条件下提供具有可解释性的风险预测，降低实施成本。
AI.method: 将问题建模为二元严重程度分类任务（高/低风险），预测3h/6h/12h三个时间窗口；使用德州中部某电力公司6年停电记录与Open-Meteo 10×10网格小时级天气数据，通过NOAA风暴事件数据库统计验证天气-停电因果关系；评估4个零样本LLM（GPT-4o/4o-mini/4.1/4.1-mini）与2个监督ML模型（逻辑回归、LightGBM），采用留一年交叉验证，在"含天气预报"和"仅当前观测"两种输入配置下比较Macro-F1、精确率与召回率。
AI.result: 监督ML模型在Macro-F1和精确率上全面优于LLM（最佳ML Macro-F1达0.73-0.74，最佳LLM为0.60-0.63）；ML模型随预测时长增加性能下降更明显，LLM则较稳定；天气预测特征对ML帮助更大，对LLM增益有限；GPT-4o系列召回率高但精确率极低（倾向于过度预警），GPT-4.1系列则召回率低而精确率较高；LLM可输出自然语言推理依据，提供可操作的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: LLM在零样本条件下具备竞争力的预测能力，并在迁移性、可扩展性和可解释性方面提供ML不具备的互补优势；建议将ML的高精度预测与LLM的自然语言解释相结合，而非视为互斥方案；未来方向包括丰富提示信息（结合观测与预报、地理标识、历史停电上下文）、引入开源模型（LLaMA、Mistral）以保护数据隐私，以及探索智能体式AI框架。

title: BER-PEF: Unified Human Mobility Predictability Evaluation via Bayes Error Rate Estimation
summary: Human mobility predictability concerns the best prediction performance attainable from a given target and input information, but its ground truth is not directly observable on real mobility data. We present BER-PEF, a Bayes-error-rate-based framework that converts BER estimation into mobility predictability estimation and provides a unified protocol for comparing estimators without observable ground truth.
