The framework maps symbolic sequences, numeric trajectories, contextual features, and learned representations into a common feature--label space, then evaluates estimator outputs along controlled perturbation curves against a shared predictability reference interval by measuring deviations below the interval, above the interval, and across the full interval. Experiments on Foursquare NYC and TKY, GeoLife, and T-Drive show that several BER-based estimators achieve lower reference discrepancy than existing predictability methods on symbolic sequences and numeric trajectories, while their estimates track changes in empirical prediction performance under perturbation. Additional analyses show that contextual inputs and multiple structured representations can be evaluated under the same protocol, and that aggregating evidence across multiple perturbation levels provides a more reliable basis for estimator selection than relying on a single unperturbed observation. BER-PEF therefore offers a unified and verifiable path for evaluating predictability estimators on heterogeneous mobility data when ground-truth predictability is unavailable.

AI.tldr: BER-PEF是一个基于贝叶斯错误率(BER)估计的人类移动性可预测性评估框架，通过统一表征层将异构移动数据映射到公共特征-标签空间，并利用受控扰动曲线和参考区间在无真实可预测性标签的情况下比较不同估计器的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在真实移动数据中，可预测性的真实上限不可直接观测，且现有方法（如基于熵的方法、压缩方法、排列等）依赖不同假设和数据形式，难以统一比较；同时，真实移动数据包含符号序列、连续轨迹、上下文特征和学习表征等多种异构形式，缺乏统一的评估协议。
AI.method: （1）将移动可预测性定义为给定表征空间中贝叶斯最优错误率的补集，建立可预测性 ↔ BER的等价关系；（2）统一表征层通过适配器将符号序列、数值轨迹、上下文特征映射为公共数值特征（主成分UniMob基于GRU+均值-末态聚合）；（3）在受控扰动曲线上应用BER估计器族（1NN、kNN、kNN-LOO等）输出下界和上界可预测性曲线；（4）定义由SOTA精度和随机猜测精度插值的参考区间，通过归一化面积偏差(LD/UD/Total)评估估计器在整个扰动区间内的一致性。
AI.result: 在Foursquare NYC/TKY、GeoLife、T-Drive四个数据集上：（1）BER估计器（KDE、KDE-kNN-LOO、GHP、kNN-LOO等）的参考偏差低于现有可预测性方法（如LZ-Fano、Reachability-Fano、PermEnt-2D）；（2）BER-kNN在四个数据集上对经验最佳算法包络的平均绝对差距为0.0193，排名第一，Pearson相关0.995-0.999；（3）八点多点评估相比原点单点评估将选择遗憾从0.000727降至0.000130，oracle top-1恢复率从0.567提升至0.887；（4）框架支持上下文特征和多表征的统一评估，且对SOTA参考因子扰动稳健。
AI.conclusion: BER-PEF为真实移动数据上的可预测性估计提供了统一、可比较、可验证的评估路径；它通过将可预测性转化为BER估计问题，并结合受控扰动协议和共享参考区间，使不同估计器可在异构移动数据上进行可靠性比较，而无需依赖不可观测的真实可预测性标签。

title: Modular Deep Recurrent Neural Network: Application to Quadrotors
summary: A modular deep Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is introduced to facilitate the process of deploying various architectures of RNNs, and to automatically compute derivatives for gradient-based learning methods. The modularity leads to a set of new architectures, one of which includes feedforward inter-layer connections. By adding feedforward inter-layer connections in a multi-layer RNN, it is observed that the capability of the RNN to learn and model high-order dynamics and nonlinearities is significantly improved. The problem of vanishing/exploding gradient in space for a multilayer RNN is also alleviated using feedforward connections. These results are demonstrated using a quadrotor case study, for which a model of the altitude dynamics is learned with our particular network structure, while existing methods are unable to generalize as quickly or at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模块化深度循环神经网络（MODERNN），通过引入层间前馈连接缓解多层RNN的空间梯度消失/爆炸问题，并基于Levenberg-Marquardt算法实现模块化Jacobian计算与训练，最终在四旋翼高度动力学建模任务上显著优于NARX和RMLP。
AI.motivation: 多层RNN虽具有建模高阶非线性动力学的能力，但因空间域梯度消失/爆炸问题导致训练困难；同时，针对四旋翼无人机等复杂非线性系统，基于物理建模难以全面捕捉气动、传感及执行器不确定性，亟需一种能有效训练且泛化能力强的数据驱动建模方法。
AI.method: 1）提出MODERNN架构：以局部循环层G_i为基本模块，通过(L+2)×L连接矩阵C灵活定义任意层间连接拓扑（包括前馈、跨层连接等）；2）推导模块化输出Jacobian解析计算方法（式9-17），便于梯度优化；3）采用基于L-M算法的四重嵌套循环批学习策略（含n_v折交叉验证），以SSE为损失函数离线训练；4）通过仿真四旋翼高度动力学（含地面效应、噪声）对比MODERNN、RMLP与NARX的建模性能与Hessian条件数。
AI.result: 在四旋翼高度建模仿真中，MODERNN（2层、48权重）在n_tr=5的最小批次下即可成功训练，而NARX和RMLP在相同条件下均失败；最佳配置（3层、195权重、n_tr=20）误差E_m=0.088；训练时间约0.5小时，远低于RMLP（5.5h）和NARX（7.5h）；Hessian条件数分析表明前馈连接显著降低了Jacobian的病态程度。
AI.conclusion: MODERNN通过模块化设计与层间前馈连接，有效缓解了多层RNN的空间梯度消失/爆炸问题，使得基于二阶优化的LM算法可直接用于深度RNN训练；该架构通用灵活，可涵盖RMLP等多种已知RNN结构，并在四旋翼动力学建模中展现出快速收敛、参数高效及强泛化能力的优势。

title: SharedSAE: One Feature Dictionary Across Language Models
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret language model activations, but SAE training and latent labelling are typically repeated for every model. Here, we show that a single shared SAE can replace a collection of dedicated per-model SAEs. Our method, SharedSAE, combines a shared dictionary with model-specific encoder-decoder pairs. Unlike the closest prior method, which discards activation magnitudes and requires all models at inference, SharedSAE instead normalizes only selection scores, preserving magnitudes, and uses model dropout for single-model inference. We train SharedSAE on four 1B-scale base language models spanning distinct families and tokenizers. Despite sharing its latents across models, SharedSAE retains 96.6% of dedicated SAEs' mean explained variance; its latent activations exhibit cross-model correlations 1.8 times as high as separate SAEs aligned post-hoc, and its latent descriptions transfer across models. After the dictionary is frozen, new models can be efficiently adapted to it, achieving near-dedicated-SAE reconstruction quality while reusing the shared latent descriptions.

AI.tldr: SharedSAE trains a single sparse autoencoder dictionary shared across multiple heterogeneous language models, achieving near-dedicated reconstruction quality while enabling cross-model latent alignment and transferable semantic descriptions.
AI.motivation: Existing SAE interpretability pipelines must be repeated for each new model, incurring redundant training and labeling costs. The authors aim to show that one shared dictionary can replace a collection of dedicated per-model SAEs.
AI.method: SharedSAE combines a shared dictionary of L latents with per-model encoder–decoder pairs. An N-way tokenizer aligner matches activation windows across models. Latent selection is done by a joint TopK over normalized votes (with vote-source dropout p=0.5 for solo inference), preserving activation magnitudes. A cross-stream rescale and cross-reconstruction loss tie latent indices to the same feature across models. After joint training, new models are adapted by training only their encoder/decoder/biases against the frozen dictionary.
AI.result: Trained on four 1B-scale base models (Qwen3, Llama-3.2, OLMo-2, Gemma-3) at ~85% depth: SharedSAE retains 96.6% of dedicated SAEs' mean explained variance; its solo-TopK latents show cross-model value correlations ~1.8× higher than post-hoc matched dedicated SAEs; 88 of 90 blind-labeled shared latents receive the same concept from all four models. Adaptation works for leave-one-out folds, a hybrid architecture (Qwen3.5-2B), a post-trained model (Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct), and a cross-lab transformer (Hunyuan-1.8B), each achieving ~0.97–1.01 of its own dedicated SAE's FVE while reusing frozen latent descriptions.
AI.conclusion: A Shared Linear Concept Space across heterogeneous LLMs is obtainable: the dictionary reconstructs each stream within a few percent of dedicated ceilings, models choose the same latents with correlated magnitudes and aligned meanings, and new models can be efficiently attached to the frozen vocabulary. Functional alignment is partial—shared latents provide a common intervention handle while model-specific downstream use remains.

title: A Quantum Variational Approach to Prototypical Recurrent Unit
summary: We introduce a lightweight Quantum Prototypical Recurrent Unit (QPRU) that requires significantly fewer parameters than both classical recurrent architectures, such as Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and quantum variants, including Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) and Quantum GRU (QGRU). Despite its compact design, the QPRU achieves competitive forecasting performance, matching state-of-the-art baselines while offering important structural and practical advantages, including enhanced scalability and a reduced number of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量化的量子循环单元QPRU，在保持预测性能的同时大幅减少参数量，适用于NISQ时代量子设备。
AI.motivation: 现有量子循环架构（QLSTM、QGRU）参数较多、电路复杂，在NISQ设备上训练困难，需要一种更轻量、参数高效的量子循环单元。
AI.method: 基于经典PRU（Prototypical Recurrent Unit），用变分量子电路（VQC）作为非线性变换，仅使用2个VQC（更新门和输出门各一个），配合共享的经典FC层，构建混合量子-经典循环单元。隐藏状态更新采用 $s_t = (1-u_t)\odot s_{t-1} + u_t \odot o_t$。
AI.result: 在正弦波合成数据和AAPL股票数据两个时间序列预测任务上，QPRU均取得最低的ℓ₁、ℓ₂、ℓ∞误差，量子参数比QLSTM减少50%、比QGRU减少33%，但统计检验显示与基线方法无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: QPRU以更少的参数和更浅的电路实现了与现有量子及经典循环模型相当的预测性能，更适合NISQ设备；未来工作包括多变量时间序列扩展、替代编码策略和在真实量子硬件上的测试。

title: On the Abundance of Critical Points of the t-SNE Energy
summary: This paper considers the energy landscape of the t-SNE algorithm. While this algorithm has enjoyed broad adoption, the non-convexity of the associated energy has made it difficult to rigorously understand what the algorithm captures in many settings. In particular, a number of well-known numerical examples, several of which are reproduced in this article, suggest a complicated energy landscape with many local minimizers that do not respect the topology or clustering structure of the underlying data. This work seeks to provide first steps towards a rigorous explanation of these phenomena. Specifically, for a general family of energies, which include both the original t-SNE algorithm and recently identified large data limits, and for densities in feature space which obey a continuous symmetry, we construct infinite families of distinct critical points. These critical points are based upon identifying pairs of discrete symmetries, one in the original feature space and the other in the target embedding space, which are preserved under gradient dynamics. These critical configurations exhibit many characteristics, such as topology breaking and spurious clustering, which are often observed empirically. Finally, numerical and analytical examples are given throughout as a means of illustrating the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究t-SNE能量函数的临界点问题。通过构造离散对称对（特征空间和嵌入空间各一个），证明在满足连续对称性的数据密度下，t-SNE能量函数存在无穷多个不同的临界点，揭示了t-SNE能量景观的内在复杂性。
AI.motivation: t-SNE是广泛使用的高维数据降维方法，但其能量函数的非凸性使得理论上难以严格理解算法的行为。大量经验观察（如"spaghetti plots"、网格扭曲等）表明t-SNE的嵌入结果常常出现拓扑破坏和虚假聚类等现象，但缺乏严格的理论解释。本文旨在为这些现象提供严格的数学解释。
AI.method:
1. 提出一般化的t-SNE能量框架，涵盖原始离散算法、Auffinger-Fletcher的大数据极限（耦合规划）以及Murray-Pickarski的弱非局部极限（映射形式），适用于黎曼流形上的特征空间和嵌入空间。
2. 定义"对称不变耦合"的概念：给定特征空间的有限等距群G_X和嵌入空间的有限等距群G_Y及其群同构映射G，如果耦合π满足π(A×B) = π(g(A)×G[g](B))，则称π在该对称元组下不变。
3. 定义"互斥"对称对：若任何在(g_X, g_Y)下不变的映射T都与任何在(g̃_X, g̃_Y)下不变的映射T̃不等价（除去常值映射），则称两对称对互斥。
4. 证明梯度下降保持对称不变性（定理23）：通过交换子估计和Gronwall不等式，证明对称不变的初始耦合在梯度流下始终保持对称不变。
5. 证明梯度流的适定性（命题30）：利用Picard不动点定理，结合引理28给出的I^{-1}的先验界，证明解的唯一存在性。
6. 构造互斥对称对：在圆环/球面上，取不同的旋转/旋转反射生成元可构造无穷多互斥对称对（例17、例20）。
7. 证明常值映射不是局部极小（命题36）：通过二阶变分构造扰动方向τ，利用局部s(x)≤1和核Ψ的正定性证明能量可以降低。
8. 综合得主要定理（定理37）：在径向对称数据和适当假设下，t-SNE能量存在无穷多个不同临界点。
AI.result:
1. 推广了t-SNE能量函数到黎曼流形上的耦合规划形式（公式2.4-2.6），统一了原始算法和已知的两个连续极限。
2. 证明了梯度流保持对称不变性（定理23），从而对称不变耦合在梯度下降下保持不变。
3. 证明了梯度流的整体适定性（命题30）和紧性论证下对称不变临界点的存在性（定理33）。
4. 在欧氏设置中证明了常值映射不是局部极小（命题36），通过构造具有负二阶变分的对称扰动。
5. 数值实验验证了：vanilla梯度下降保持对称不变（误差~10^{-15}），而openTSNE因近似而破坏对称但达到更低能量。
6. 主要定理37：在径向对称数据下，存在无穷多个不同的t-SNE能量临界点。
AI.conclusion: 本文为t-SNE能量景观的复杂性提供了第一个严格的数学解释。通过对称性分析框架，证明了对于具有连续对称性的数据，t-SNE能量函数不可避免地拥有无穷多个本质上不同的临界点，这些临界点表现出拓扑破坏和虚假聚类等经验观察中常见的特征。该结果揭示了t-SNE应用中常见的非稳定行为背后的结构原因，并为未来关于维度约简算法的理论研究提供了新方向。两个关键猜想（紧致性矩有界性和流到映射的松弛）仍待解决。

title: Disentangling Attention in Deep Operator Learning: A Controlled Study of Data-Driven and Physics-Informed Architectures
summary: Deep neural operators learn mappings between input functions and complete PDE solution fields, enabling forward evaluations of new problem instances orders of magnitude faster than conventional numerical solvers. Attention mechanisms have recently been introduced into neural operators, but most studies change several architectural components at once, making it difficult to identify what actually improves accuracy. This work presents a controlled and systematic study of five deep operator network (DeepONet) variants with distinct attention mechanisms, trained under both data-driven and physics-informed regimes, to isolate the effects of cross-attention, self-attention, tokenization, and attention depth. We evaluate them on a source-driven transient one-dimensional nonlinear diffusion-reaction equation, a transient one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation with variable initial conditions, and a two-dimensional Poisson heat-conduction problem with heterogeneous source fields. Per-sensor tokenization with cross-attention reduces the mean relative L_2 error of the classical DeepONet in all benchmark-training combinations by factors of 2.4-28.0, while the best attention configurations reach 3.5-32.3. Branch self-attention paired only with dot-product fusion is inconsistent, degrading the one-dimensional problems while helping the more complex two-dimensional source field; added on top of cross-attention it improves all six cases, though by less than cross-attention fusion alone. Global pre-mixing provides no consistent benefit. Increasing cross-attention depth further improves accuracy, but with diminishing returns and a substantially higher cost under physics-informed training. Overall, query-dependent cross-attention is the most reliable mechanism, whereas branch self-attention is most useful for large, spatially complex functional inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对DeepONet及其物理信息变体，系统地解耦了注意力机制中交叉注意力（cross-attention）、自注意力（self-attention）、逐传感器分词（per-sensor tokenization）、全局预混合（global pre-mixing）以及交叉注意力深度（cross-attention depth）这四个组件的独立贡献。在三个具有代表性的PDE基准（一维非线性扩散反应、一维粘性Burgers、二维异质源Poisson）上，比较了五种DeepONet变体在数据驱动和物理信息训练两种范式下的表现（共30组实验）。核心结论是：基于查询的交叉注意力是跨所有基准-训练组合中最稳定且最显著的精度提升来源，而分支自注意力只有在输入函数足够大且空间结构复杂（如二维Poisson的1024个传感器）时才有价值。全局预混合未带来一致收益。增加交叉注意力深度虽能进一步降低误差，但收益递减，物理信息训练下计算开销显著增加。
AI.motivation: 近年来注意力机制被引入神经算子（neural operators），但现有研究通常同时改变多个架构组件（如交叉注意力、自注意力、分词方式、位置编码、网络深度/宽度等），使得无法明确归因精度提升究竟来自哪个具体设计。此外，物理信息训练会通过注意力改变自动微分路径，并与PDE残差/边界损失权重产生交互，归属问题更加严重。本文旨在填补这一方法论空白，提供一个受控、可配对的比较框架，将注意力的各个子机制逐一隔离出来进行评估。
AI.method: 本文设计了五种DeepONet架构变体V1–V5，共享相同的潜在维度p=128、4个注意力头、4×128 trunk隐藏层、tanh激活、Adam优化器及分组采样策略等设置，通过一次改变一个核心组件来实现受控消融：(1) V1：经典DeepONet基线（MLP branch + 点积融合）；(2) V2：逐传感器分词 + 交叉注意力融合（隔离分词+交叉注意力联合效应）；(3) V3：分支自注意力 + 点积融合（隔离分支自注意力）；(4) V4：全局MLP分支注入每个token + 交叉注意力（隔离全局预混合）；(5) V5：分支自注意力 + 交叉注意力（完整注意力架构）。在数据驱动和物理信息两种训练范式下对三个PDE基准进行评估，并进一步对V2进行交叉注意力深度扫描（N=1,2,4,8）。位置编码根据基准定制（正弦、傅立叶谐波或整数索引），但未在基准内系统变化。实验在NVIDIA GH200 GPU上进行JAX实现。
AI.result: 在全部六组基准-训练组合中，V2（分词+交叉注意力）相比V1基线将平均相对L2误差降低2.4–28.0倍，最佳配置提升3.5–32.3倍。V5在三个数据驱动问题和物理信息Poisson上取得最低误差；V4在物理信息的瞬态扩散反应和Burgers上最优。具体而言：扩散反应DD：V1=1.38e-2 → V5=3.19e-3（4.3×）；PI：V1=7.64e-3 → V4=2.21e-3（3.5×）。Burgers DD：V1=4.06e-2 → V5=5.27e-3（7.7×）；PI：V1=1.24e-1 → V4=7.04e-3（17.6×）。Poisson DD：V1=2.95e-1 → V5=9.13e-3（32.3×）；PI：V1=3.34e-1 → V5=2.88e-2（11.6×）。V3（自注意力+点积）在1D问题上一致劣于V1，但在二维Poisson（1024个传感器的粗糙高斯随机场输入）上分别改善7.7×（DD）和8.4×（PI）。深度扫描显示，从N=1到N=8，误差仅降低2.1×（DD）和1.8×（PI），但参数增加2.9×、推理时间增加3.2×；物理信息训练下N=4已使训练时间增加2.49×，而精度增益迅速饱和。成本方面，所有模型单次全场推理均小于12ms；从V1到V5，DD训练时间增加4.82×，PI训练时间增加6.37×，后者因自动微分需穿过注意力层而代价更高。
AI.conclusion: 基于查询的交叉注意力是DeepONet中最稳定且最关键的注意力机制，能将误差降低一个数量级。分支自注意力是输入场编码的有益补充，但其有效性取决于输入的规模和空间复杂度：仅在传感器数量大且输入结构复杂（如1024传感器的二维异质源）时才显示出独立价值；在约100个光滑变化的传感器条件下反而有害。全局预混合不提供一致增益，应被视为问题依赖的可选项。增加交叉注意力深度的收益递减，单块已捕获大部分增益，物理信息训练下额外深度带来的计算成本过高。这项工作为在实际工程算子学习任务中选择注意力机制提供了基于配对比较的实用指导，并指出未来工作方向：3D不规则域、位置编码的系统比较、PINTO式编码设计、序列与几何依赖算子，以及将类似受控方法扩展到FNO家族（其中无branch-trunk分离，交叉注意力无融合步骤可作用于）。

title: Beyond a Universal Forecasting Selector: Demand-Conditioned Model Selection across Demand Patterns and Horizons
summary: Forecasting-model selection remains difficult in heterogeneous demand because the most suitable decision rule may vary with demand structure, data availability, and forecasting horizon. This study examines whether the selector itself should be treated as a context-dependent component of the forecasting process. Five selection mechanisms - RMSSE, ERA, OWA, CCG-AHSC, and CCG-AHSCD - are compared across 24 optimized forecasting models, nine datasets, three training-testing partitions, and horizons from 1 to 12 cycles. Selector performance is evaluated ex post using Global Relative Accuracy (GRA), statistical tests, and a best-attainable-model reference. No selector dominates across all conditions. CCG-AHSC and CCG-AHSCD are more competitive for Smooth demand and several Erratic configurations, whereas OWA and ERA perform better in Intermittent and Lumpy settings. Selector suitability also changes with historical data availability and horizon, supporting a context-dependent rather than universal approach to forecasting-model selection.

AI.tldr: 在异构需求情境下，研究五种预测模型选择机制（RMSSE、ERA、OWA、CCG-AHSC、CCG-AHSCD）在24个优化模型、9个数据集、三种训练-测试划分及1-12周期预测范围下的表现，发现不存在普遍占优的选择器，提出选择器本身应作为预测过程中依赖于情境的组成部分。
AI.motivation: 在异构需求环境下，不同的需求结构（如平滑、间歇、块状等）、数据可用性和预测周期会影响最合适的预测模型选择规则；现有研究多假设存在通用最优选择器，但缺乏对其情境依赖性的系统验证。
AI.method: 在M3竞赛的9个数据集上，使用24个优化预测模型、3种训练-测试划分和1-12个周期预测范围，比较五种选择机制（RMSSE、ERA、OWA、CCG-AHSC、CCG-AHSCD）的表现；采用事后评估方法，包括全局相对准确度（GRA）、统计检验和最佳可达模型参考基准。
AI.result: 没有选择器在所有条件下占优：CCG-AHSC和CCG-AHSCD在平滑需求及部分不规则配置中更具竞争力，而OWA和ERA在间歇性和块状需求设置中表现更好；选择器的适用性随历史数据可用性和预测周期的变化而改变。
AI.conclusion: 预测模型选择器应被视为依赖于情境的预测过程组成部分，而非追求通用最优规则；实际应用中需根据需求结构、数据可用性和预测周期灵活选择合适的选择机制。

title: A Repeated-Measurement Study for Cultural Analytics of English Song Lyrics Using Five Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate cultural texts at scales that are impractical for human coders. However, before their outputs are treated as measurements of latent social constructs, it is necessary to establish whether those measurements are reliable. This study evaluates five LLMs as zero-shot annotators of four social constructs expressed in English song lyrics: self-esteem, self-control, seeking belonging, and seeking recognition. Using repeated annotations of a large lyric corpus, we examine three properties of LLM-based measurement: consistency across repeated runs, convergence across models, and transferability of consensus labels to supervised classification. The findings show that LLM-based measurement is not uniformly reliable across constructs. Self-esteem exhibits the strongest repeated-measurement reliability across models, while seeking recognition is generally less stable; self-control and seeking belonging show intermediate but model-dependent reliability. Downstream classification further indicates that consensus LLM labels contain learnable signal, although transferability does not itself establish construct validity. Repeated-measurement stability and cross-model convergence should therefore be reported before LLM annotations are treated as scalable measurements in cultural analytics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了五个大型语言模型（GPT-4o-mini、o3-mini、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、DeepSeek-R1、Gemini 2.0 Flash）作为零样本标注器，对英文歌曲歌词中四种潜在社会构念（自尊、自控、寻求归属、寻求认可）进行标注的可靠性。研究通过重复测量、跨模型一致性分析和下游监督分类实验三个维度，系统检验了LLM作为文化分析测量工具的可靠性，发现其可靠性具有显著的构念依赖性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被越来越多地用于大规模文化文本的自动化标注，其输出是否可被视为潜在社会构念的可靠测量工具尚不明确。现有研究将LLM标注视为可扩展的测量手段，但忽视了重复测量稳定性和跨模型一致性等基本可靠性问题。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估LLM标注作为文化分析测量仪器的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于Music4All语料库，经英语筛选后获得69,130首歌词。五个前沿LLM在零样本条件下，使用PNACSS框架（基于时间性需求威胁模型）进行三轮重复标注，每首歌词按四个二元维度（自尊H/L、自控H/L、归属P/N、认可P/N）编码为16类组合之一。通过Fleiss' κ（模型内重复可靠性）和跨模型一致性分析可靠性，并使用BigBird-RoBERTa-base进行下游迁移学习实验（960样本联合训练+各构念1000样本二元分类），在1,572首人工验证歌词上评估外部泛化性能。
AI.result: 模型内可靠性存在显著的构念依赖性：自尊在各模型中κ值范围0.717-0.826（最强），寻求认可为0.467-0.683（最弱），自控和寻求归属呈中等且模型依赖性的稳定性。跨模型一致性整体弱于模型内可靠性，自尊κ≈0.605-0.608最强，寻求认可κ≈0.419-0.421最弱。Gemini与GPT-4o-mini直接比较显示自尊κ=0.816（几乎完美）而寻求归属κ=0.337（一般）。下游分类中二元分类器宏F1达0.684-0.732，但在自然类别不平衡的外部验证集上呈现严重正类过预测，特别是寻求认可（精确率仅0.207，召回率0.886）。联合16类模型宏F1仅0.659，4位精确匹配准确率仅0.104。
AI.conclusion: LLM文化分析标注的可靠性具有构念依赖性和模型依赖性，单一聚合统计量不足以表征标注质量。模型内可重复性并不保证跨模型测量一致性，表明不同LLM可能并未恢复同一测量结果。银标签虽含可学习信号，但其迁移性不构成构念效度证据。研究者应在将LLM标注视为语料库级证据之前，报告模型版本、提示配置、重复测量可靠性、跨模型收敛性、数据来源及独立验证结果。

title: Conformity Breaks Conformal Prediction
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: A conformal certificate can be valid when an LLM answers alone and invalid when the same LLM sees peers that unanimously assert a wrong answer. The question is unchanged; the model's score for the correct answer changes. We call this a score-mechanism shift: clean calibration certifies how the model scores answers alone, but not how it scores them under peer pressure. We show that this shift silently breaks conformal prediction in multi-agent LLM systems. Across open-weight models and multiple-choice QA tasks, coverage falls from a calibrated 90% to 74% under unanimous-wrong peers at the standard alpha = 0.10 operating point. The average hides a sharper failure: by targeting the low-confidence items the certificate still covers, an attacker nearly halves coverage on that subgroup, from 87% to 47%, while the monitored average remains much higher. The failure also reaches the decision layer: a system that should escalate when uncertain can instead become confident enough to act on the attacker's wrong answer. Standard conformal fixes do not solve the problem, because the question distribution has not changed; the model's scoring behavior has.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了一种针对多智能体大语言模型系统的对抗性漏洞：社会从众效应（social conformity）会使原本有效的共形预测（conformal prediction）覆盖保证失效。在清洁数据上校准的共形证书，在面对一致给出错误答案的"同伴"时会被静默地破坏——输入不变，但模型对正确答案的得分发生变化。作者将这种现象命名为"得分机制漂移"（score-mechanism shift），并证明这种漂移无法通过加权共形预测或Mondrian逐模型校准等标准方法修复。
AI.motivation: 共形预测（CP）为模型提供形式化的覆盖率保证，但其前提是校准数据与测试数据可交换（exchangeable）。多智能体LLM系统打破了这一假设——模型单独回答时校准，部署中却暴露在同伴答案的影响下。作者旨在揭示并形式化这一被忽视的内生性失效机制，特别是当一致性错误共识构成一种可控的攻击向量时，这直接关系到使用CP作为安全关键可靠性保证的部署场景。
AI.method:
1. **实验设计**：在四个开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Gemma-2-9B）上，针对ARC-Challenge和TruthfulQA等多项选择题任务，构造六种同伴压力条件（一致错误/混合/一致正确，每种带或不带权威暗示），向模型注入六轮伪造的同伴回答。
2. **共形预测设置**：使用split-conformal LAC（非歧义最小分类器）得分，校准于清洁的solo数据，测试于同伴压力条件下。
3. **理论分析**：定义"得分机制漂移"（输入分布不变但条件得分律改变），并通过阈值跨越流的命题量化覆盖损失。
4. **攻击者分析**：模拟三种无需答案密钥的对手（基于部署置信度、预测集大小或外部模型排名选择攻击目标）。
5. **防御评估**：复制Wang等人(2026)的act-vs-escalate机制，在一致错误同伴条件下测试其失效程度。
AI.result:
**主要结果**：
- **边际覆盖崩溃**：在α=0.10时，覆盖率从校准的90.0%降至一致错误同伴条件下的73.9%（差距-16.1pp），在α=0.05时下降8.6pp，而在α=0.01时几乎无影响（集合近乎空）。
- **条件覆盖隐藏崩溃**：在被攻击目标子群（校准阈值上方十分位）上，池化预测器的覆盖率从87.3%降至47.4%，尽管监测的边际覆盖率维持在76%。仅攻击10%的项目就能造成40pp的子群损失，而整体平均仅移动4pp。
- **Act-vs-escalate防御失效**：对于池化预测器，在被翻转的项目中有12.1%的清洁校准安全层承诺了攻击者的错误答案；Qwen2.5-7B达28.7%，Qwen2.5-32B更高达71.4%。
- **修复无效**：加权共形预测因权重恒为1而退化为恒等映射；Mondrian逐模型校准在α=0.10时仍使三个模型失败；唯一有效的修复（条件感知重新校准）需要压力标签，并通过扩大集合使决策层基本完全升级。
- **漏洞可测**：答案翻转率（answer-flip rate）作为压力测试指标，能在任务间迁移，跨任务排序的Spearman相关系数中位数为-0.49，符号检验p<10⁻⁵。
- **模型差异**：Gemma-9B表现出显著稳健性（p_gt仅下降0.151），而Qwen-7B严重脆弱（p_gt下降0.747）；静态属性（solo置信度、清洁准确率）无法预测漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 该工作识别并形式化了"得分机制漂移"——一种使清洁校准共形预测在多智能体LLM系统中失效的内生性偏移。关键论点是：共形证书认证的是模型单独回答时的行为，而非在社会压力下的行为。攻击者可控制同伴消息通道，在校准完成后、推理时触发此漂移，且无需访问权重或答案密钥。标准修复（加权CP、Mondrian校准、更严格的α）均无法闭合漏洞，因为问题不在输入分布，而在模型自身的得分行为；唯一有效的修复需要攻击者刻意隐瞒的压力标签，并通过激进扩大预测集来购买覆盖率，等于放弃自主决策。论文建议在部署前使用答案翻转压力测试对候选模型排序，同时在同伴影响通道存在时抑制对单例集的自主行动。

title: On-board ML for Trace Gas detection in Imaging Spectroscopy data
comment: 2 pages; presented as a short (2 pages) paper at the IEEE HPEC26
summary: Data collected during aerial and spaceborne imaging spectroscopy campaigns enables the detection of transient events such as trace gas emissions. However, current processing pipelines depend on slow, on-the-ground processing, which delays the time to information of each detected event and prohibits immediate follow-up actions. During the Tokyo Field Campaign of March 2026, we explored on-board processing of Imaging Spectroscopy data from the equipped AVIRIS-5 sensor. Due to communication bottlenecks, full datacubes cannot be downlinked immediately during the flight. Instead we downlink the potential events predicted by our efficient and small machine learning model. We show the first on-board detection of methane point source emission with Imaging Spectroscopy data using Edge ML.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在航空成像光谱仪（AVIRIS-5）上部署小型机器学习模型，实现飞行中实时检测甲烷点源排放。通过东京野外飞行活动（Tokyo-FC 2026年3月）验证了首个基于边缘机器学习的机载甲烷泄漏实时检测方案。
AI.motivation: 传统成像光谱数据依赖地面处理，延迟了瞬态事件（如痕量气体排放）的信息获取，无法支持即时响应行动。受限于下行链路带宽，全量数据立方体无法实时回传，亟需在机载平台部署轻量化模型实现近实时检测。
AI.method: 1) 基于EMIT任务L1B处理流程进行精简（去除OSF等步骤），将L1A转L1B处理从2088秒降至2.61秒（CPU）/0.46秒（GPU）。2) 计算匹配滤波器（MF）增强产品。3) 部署轻量ML模型：端到端方案使用HyperEfficientViT（ConvUp）变体处理辐射亮度数据；MF依赖方案使用U-Net架构。4) 测试平台为Jetson Orin Nano Super，机载平台为Intel Xeon Gold 6342 + RTX A4000。5) 数据按67.5秒/场景分块，输入填充至1248×2016像素。
AI.result: 1) 测试平台：完整L1A→L1B处理2088.45秒 vs 精简版2.61秒（CPU）/0.46秒（GPU）；MF计算76.78-122.85秒/场景；ML推理1.84-2.15秒/场景。2) 机载实测：ML推理2.59±0.93秒/场景，满足67.5秒数据采集周期的实时要求。3) 2026年3月11日川崎市电厂上空成功检测到甲烷点源排放事件，据作者所知这是首次在真实任务中基于ML实现机载痕量气体检测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在低计算资源、有限通信带宽的真实航空任务场景中，机载机器学习模型用于痕量气体检测的可行性，为未来仪器自主化和全自动数据处理迈出了重要一步。未来工作将探索多痕量气体（CH4、NH3、NO2、CO）联合检测模型。

title: Nested Inductive Bias Framework for SPD Manifold Learning
summary: In Geometric Deep Learning, inductive biases serve two primary functions: enforcing manifold constraints and embedding relational priors. Currently, representation learning on SPD manifolds frequently relies on pullback Euclidean metrics, such as the Log-Euclidean Metric, to satisfy the former. While computationally efficient in avoiding domain boundary violations, these metrics induce a flat geometry that may fail to capture the intrinsic relational priors of datasets. While metrics such as the Poincaré metric are widely utilized to induce domain-aligned relational priors, generalizing them from standard vector representations to the SPD manifold has remained a challenge. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Nested Inductive Bias framework that utilizes a two-stage diffeomorphic composition to formally pull back non-Euclidean target geometries onto the SPD manifold. This framework enables the construction of curvature-aligned Riemannian classifiers that simultaneously respect matrix constraints and the latent relational geometry of the data. Empirical evaluations on kinematic and signal processing benchmarks, together with synthetic experiments, demonstrate that deep manifold networks experience degradation in class separability unless the metric curvature aligns with the intrinsic data distribution. Furthermore, for standard vectorized architectures, we propose the Rational Conformal Metric (RCM), designed to establish state-of-the-art geometric robustness against outliers by bounding the representation space.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“嵌套归纳偏置”框架，将 SPD 流形上的对数欧氏映射与双曲、球面或有理共形几何复合，从而在保持矩阵正定约束的同时，为 SPD 矩阵显式赋予非欧几里得曲率和关系结构。主要结果包括：嵌套双曲度量 NHM、嵌套球面度量 NSM，以及通过切空间映射实现的 RCM。论文认为，度量曲率应与数据内在几何匹配，并在 FPHA、Radar 及合成数据上验证：双曲结构更适合这些负曲率数据，球面结构在匹配正曲率合成数据时有效，但在不匹配时性能明显下降。RCM 通过径向压缩将表示限制在半径 1/α 的开球内，实验中显著提高对极端空间离群点的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在弥补几何深度学习中“保证数据域约束”和“编码潜在关系结构”之间的不足。传统 LEM 虽计算高效并保持 SPD 约束，但其平坦几何难以表示层级或环形等潜在结构；而 AIRM 可能带来较高计算成本，且其固定的非正曲率未必适合所有数据分布。作者因此希望将双曲、球面和有理共形等非欧几里得几何系统地引入 SPD 流形。
AI.method: 方法基于两阶段微分同胚：先将 SPD 矩阵经主矩阵对数和 half-vectorization 映射到单位元切空间，再利用目标流形的黎曼指数映射将该欧氏向量映射到 Poincaré ball、投影球面或 RCM 空间；目标度量通过复合映射拉回 SPD 流形。由此构造 NHM、NSM 和 RCM，并使用相应几何中的 RMLR 或切空间线性分类。作者用 FPHA 63×63 运动协方差数据和 Radar 20×20 协方差数据，对比 LEM、AIRM、NHM、NSM，在 Linear Probe、SPDNet 和 RResNet 上测试；同时通过改变合成球面信号尺度构造正/负曲率数据，并设计三类空间离群点测试 RCM。
AI.result: 论文的主要实验结论是：NHM 在 FPHA 和 Radar 数据的 RMLR 设置中整体表现最佳，尤其在 FPHA RResNet 上达到 0.8643，相比 LEM 提升 0.0991；NSM 在负曲率真实数据上严重失效，例如 FPHA RResNet 仅 0.0435。合成实验中，正曲率条件下 NSM 达到 1.0000，而负曲率条件下 NHM 达到 0.8000、NSM 为 0.6875。RCM 在干净数据上与 LEM 相当或略优，在离群实验中将核心准确率从 22.5%、75.0%、75.9% 分别提升至 100%、100%、100%。
AI.conclusion: 论文的总体结论是：SPD 流形学习不能只满足于正定约束或盲目使用固定曲率，而应使度量曲率与数据的内在几何相匹配。两阶段微分同胚为在 SPD 矩阵上引入双曲、球面及其他弯曲几何提供了统一机制；RCM 则为仍使用欧氏分类器的系统提供了一种无需显式过滤离群点的空间正则化方法。作者指出，未来可将该嵌套结构扩展到隐藏层，构建端到端保持特定非欧曲率的黎曼网络。

title: An Energy-Based Conservative-Dissipative Latent Neural Evolution Operator for Magnetization Dynamics
summary: We develop an energy-based reduced-order model for micromagnetic magnetization dynamics that couples a convolutional autoencoder to a structured latent neural ordinary differential equation. Motivated by the precessional-dissipative structure of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, the latent vector field is generated from the gradient of a learned scalar potential through an antisymmetric operator and a symmetric positive-semidefinite dissipative operator. This potential is learned in nonunique latent coordinates and is not identified with the Gibbs free energy, but decreases monotonically along autonomous continuous-time solutions, while the antisymmetric component permits motion along its level sets. The encoder, decoder, latent energy, and operators are trained jointly on short trajectory windows using latent and decoded-rollout losses alone, without time-derivative supervision, physical-energy labels, or dissipation penalties. At inference, an initial state is encoded once, evolved in latent space, and decoded only at the requested output times, enabling substantially cheaper trajectory prediction than the micromagnetic solver used to generate the training data. We compare quadratic, deep, and additive deep-quadratic latent energies on two datasets parameterized by field amplitude and generated for the two applied-field directions of the NIST $\mu$MAG Standard Problem 4. Dissipative-only and antisymmetric-dissipative models achieve comparable accuracy on short training-style windows but differ substantially on uninterrupted rollouts, for which the antisymmetric-dissipative models provide markedly more accurate trajectory predictions. The deep-quadratic energy gives the best overall accuracy for both field directions and exhibits slower error growth when rollouts are extended to twice the training horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于微磁学磁化动力学模拟的降阶模型，将卷积自编码器与结构化潜在神经ODE耦合。潜在向量场由学习标量势的梯度通过反对称算子与对称半正定耗散算子生成，保持自治连续时间解中潜在能量的单调递减。在NIST μMAG标准问题4的两个数据集上验证，antiderivative-dissipative（A-D）深度-二次能量模型表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 微磁学中Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程的数值求解是参数研究、优化和反演设计中的计算瓶颈。传统数值求解器在处理高维空间离散化时效率低下，即使解位于低维非线性流形上。需要一种非线性降阶模型来加速轨迹预测，同时保持物理动力学的关键结构特性（如能量耗散与进动）。
AI.method:
方法核心是一个能量引导的潜在神经ODE：
1. 自编码器：将高维磁化状态m∈ℝ^(N×3)编码到潜在空间z∈ℝ^d。
2. 标量势g_η(z,p)：学习标量能量函数，输入为潜在状态和物理参数。
3. 结构化向量场：ż = (J - R)∇_z g_η，其中J为反对称算子（J^T = -J），R为对称半正定算子（R^T = R, R⪰0）。
4. 训练目标：仅使用潜在损失和解码rollout损失，无需时间导数监督、物理能量标签或耗散惩罚。窗口大小k=5，联合训练所有参数。
5. 数值方法：Diffrax的Tsit5自适应Runge-Kutta，递归检查点伴随法。
6. 三种能量模型比较：二次型、深度型、深度-二次型组合；两种向量场：纯耗散（D）与反对称-耗散（A-D），共六种模型配置。
AI.result:
在NIST μMAG标准问题4的两个数据集（场方向170°和190°，各200个场幅）上的结果：
- A-D深度-二次模型在两个场方向上RMSE最小：场1为0.0459，场2为0.2929。
- 纯耗散模型在短窗口上误差与A-D模型相当，但在无中断长rollout上表现显著较差。
- A-D模型相比参考求解器（场1需要0.349s和1034步）大幅降低了计算成本（场1约0.073s，50步）。
- 1ns训练horizon外推至2ns时，深度-二次模型在两个场方向上误差增长更慢，对场1表现出对训练horizon外的良好泛化能力。
- 学到的潜在能量沿轨迹单调递减（所有模型），但与Gibbs能量不重合。
- 反对称算子J的特征值跨越更宽的虚轴范围，表明其在学习演化中起更重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了基于能量守恒-耗散分解的潜在神经演化算子用于微磁学磁化动力学。关键贡献包括：(i) 空间潜在张量编解码耦合逐点保守-耗散动力学；(ii) 自治连续时间耗散恒等式；(iii) 仅含潜在和解码rollout损失的联合快照窗口目标；(iv) 六种模型配置的对比。结论表明，反对称算子是准确学习条件潜在能量梯度ODE的必要条件；二次能量贡献为长时演化提供了有价值的归纳偏置。深度-二次模型在两个场方向上整体精度最佳，且在训练horizon之外表现出更稳健的泛化能力。

title: Distilled Continuous Diffusion Language Models Can Write Code in Few Steps---or One
comment: Code and model checkpoints: this https URL
summary: Language generation is almost universally treated as a sequential process: autoregressive models emit one token at a time, while diffusion language models replace token-level seriality with a long trajectory of iterative refinement. In this work, we introduce PlaidQ, a 0.7B continuous diffusion language model for code generation, and show that its trajectory can be aggressively distilled into only a few denoising steps---or even one, enabling efficient code generation. PlaidQ repurposes a pretrained autoregressive model as a bidirectional denoiser over continuous token embeddings. We distill PlaidQ with distribution matching for few-step generation and paired-trajectory supervision for one-step generation. At matched model scale, PlaidQ is competitive with discrete diffusion language models on code generation. Distillation then shifts the quality--compute frontier: a 16-step student reaches 31.78 and 40.49 pass@10 on HumanEval and MBPP+, surpassing the same PlaidQ teacher sampled for 512 steps. At the extreme, paired-trajectory distillation achieves 7.07 pass@1 on HumanEval with a single denoising step, producing functionally correct programs. Together, these results establish continuous diffusion as a viable path to few-step and one-step code generation. Broadly, continuous diffusion is not merely another representation for language: it provides an interface through which language models can inherit the acceleration and distillation machinery of continuous diffusion modeling. Training and inference code and model checkpoints are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PlaidQ是一个0.7B参数的连续扩散语言模型，通过将预训练的自回归模型改造为连续token嵌入空间的双向去噪器，实现了代码生成的少步乃至单步推理，并通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）和配对轨迹蒸馏将多步去噪压缩到4/8/16步乃至1步，同时在HumanEval和MBPP+上保持了具有竞争力的功能正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言生成方法无论是自回归还是离散扩散，都需要顺序生成或长迭代轨迹，无法从根本上减少生成步骤数；作者希望探索连续扩散能否将语言生成压缩到极少步数（乃至单步）并保持代码功能正确性。
AI.method: 将预训练的自回归Qwen3-0.6B模型改造为双向注意力+AdaLN噪声条件化的Plaid式连续扩散去噪器，复用预训练词表头并施加一位移对齐；提出SWVR流式内核解决大词表的分类重构显存瓶颈；采用Muon+AdamW混合优化器；少步生成使用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），单步生成使用配对轨迹蒸馏（共享初始噪声的师生轨迹监督），并推导了步数相关的分数温度规则以保证极大步长的反向过程稳定性。
AI.result: 在HumanEval和MBPP+上：128步PlaidQ+CFG达到39.87和44.79 pass@10；16步蒸馏学生PlaidQ-D16达到31.78和40.49 pass@10，超越512步教师；4步时DMD将pass@10从7.90提升至15.85（HumanEval）；单步PlaidQ-D1达到7.07 pass@1和8.53 pass@10（HumanEval），证明了单步去噪即可产生功能正确的程序。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散为代码生成提供了可行的少步和单步路径；连续token空间使语言模型能够继承连续扩散模型的加速与蒸馏工具链；未来需要将该范式扩展到更大模型和更广泛的语言任务，并探索更多连续生成蒸馏技术。

title: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
comment: 38 pages. Model weights, inference and fine-tuning code, and evaluation results: this https URL
summary: We introduce Mitra-v2, a tabular foundation model that delivers state-of-the-art performance on real-world classification and regression problems, from credit-risk scoring and clinical prediction to equipment-failure detection and house-price estimation. Mitra-v2 is trained only on synthetic data, with a pretraining distribution that is much larger and more diverse than Mitra-v1's. Built on a small 2D Transformer backbone, Mitra-v2 supports longer contexts and larger feature spaces. Improved optimization lets it learn from this larger task distribution. We evaluate Mitra-v2 on the TabArena and TALENT benchmarks, comprising more than 300 real-world datasets under two evaluation protocols. On the full TabArena benchmark, Mitra-v2 delivers state-of-the-art performance at the level of the industry-scale TabFM and EXAONE Tabular models, while surpassing TabPFN-3 by a wide margin in both classification and regression. Mitra-v2 matches the 1.6B-parameter TabFM with only 5% of its size (77M parameters), delivering frontier performance at a fraction of the cost. On TALENT, Mitra-v2 remains among the leading models, clearly outperforming TabPFN-3 and TabICLv2. It also ranks first on classification tasks with more than ten classes, even though it was pretrained only on tasks with at most ten classes. These results make Mitra-v2 one of the strongest and most broadly applicable open tabular foundation models released to date. We release the model weights, the inference and fine-tuning code, and our evaluation results under the Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: Mitra-v2 是一个仅基于合成数据预训练的表格基础模型，采用 12 层 2D Transformer 骨干（约 77M 参数），通过扩大合成任务分布和优化器改进，在 TabArena 和 TALENT 基准上取得与 TabFM、EXAONE Tabular 相当的领先水平，大幅超越 TabPFN-3，并以仅 5% 的参数量匹配 1.6B 参数的 TabFM。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models）将表格监督学习重构为摊销推理，单一模型在大量预测任务上预训练，部署时条件于新数据集的标注行。该方向自 TabPFN 起受到关注，但如何不加深网络而通过扩展合成任务分布和优化策略提升性能仍是开放问题。Mitra-v1 已证明 SCM 与树生成器混合先验的有效性，Mitra-v2 旨在探索这一方案的极限。
AI.method: 1) 保持 Mitra-v1 的 12 层 2D Transformer 骨干（隐藏维度 512，四头注意力，行/列轴分解注意力），不增加深度；2) 大幅扩展合成预训练分布：支持集从 512 增至 5,120 行，查询行从 128 增至 1,280，特征数从 16 增至 50；3) 引入新先验 Hybrid SCM：在单个因果 DAG 内组合 MLP、决策树、ExtraTrees、随机森林、1D 卷积、高斯过程（RFF）、向量自回归等多种机制族，使用向量值节点与残差式线性投影；4) 回归头改为 1,000 箱分布交叉熵头；5) 用 Muon 优化器替换 AdamW（用于 2D 权重矩阵，其余参数仍用 AdamW），32 个分布式 rank，bfloat16 训练，约 28.7M（分类）/34.8M（回归）名义合成任务；6) 部署时通过训练集内特征选择（256 维预算）和平衡分层分解（将 >10 类拆分为 ≤10 类的树形子问题）扩展原生能力上限。
AI.result: 在 TabArena（51 个数据集，816 单元，一小时协议）：Mitra-v2 总体 Elo 1,774.6，与 TabFM（1,773.5）、EXAONE Tabular（1,749.4）统计上平局，超越 TabPFN-3（1,637.5）约 137 Elo，仅以 77M 参数匹配 1.6B 参数的 TabFM。分类（38 数据集）三者为统计平局。回归（13 数据集）Mitra-v2 Elo 1,985.6，领先 EXAONE 106 Elo，并列 TabFM，是其最大代际进步；13 个数据集中 3.6 个为绝对最佳（无其他模型更多）。在 TALENT（main274 预设）：Mitra-v2 处于领先组，与 TabFM、EXAONE 不可区分；在 >10 类分类子集上以 2,070.1–2,204.2 Elo 排名第一（TabFM 无法运行该子集）。支持上限（in-context support cap）的提升是回归大型数据收益的主因（32,768 行带来 87.5 Elo）。
AI.conclusion: 在不加深 Transformer、不增加参数量的前提下，通过扩展合成任务分布（更大支持集/查询集/特征数、Hybrid SCM 先验）与优化器升级（Muon），可获得与行业规模表格基础模型相当的领先水平。Mitra-v2 是目前最强、最通用的开源表格基础模型之一，77M 参数即可匹配 1.6B 参数的 TabFM。主要限制：依赖微调与 8-fold bagging（非零样本），计算开销显著高于前向推理模型；预训练改动同时进行，未做消融分离各因素贡献；预测时间未单独记录；超大表格（>32k 行）仍存在提升空间。

title: Fast Surrogate Modeling of Excitable and Oscillatory FitzHugh-Nagumo Dynamics with Parametric Neural Operators
comment: Human Brain & AI @ International Joint Conferences on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2026
summary: The FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) system serves as a simplified model of neuronal voltage dynamics, capturing the activator-inhibitor structure behind both isolated action potentials and the rhythmic spiking seen across the brain. Exploring its 5D physiological parameter space is important for neuromodulation and mapping voltage recordings back to biophysics, yet classical finite-difference solvers make rapid parameter sweeps expensive. We train parameter-conditioned Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) as fast, differentiable surrogates for the FHN voltage and recovery fields on a one-dimensional spatial domain, conditioning each Fourier layer on the parameter vector $\lambda = (D_u, D_v, a, b, \tau)$ via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). We apply a single bifurcation analysis that delimits the two distinct regimes the model spans, oscillatory (tonic firing) and excitable (action-potential propagation), and we train one operator in each. In the oscillatory regime the surrogate attains sub-$0.1\%$ relative $L^2$ error on both fields, runs nearly three orders of magnitude faster than the finite-difference baseline, generalizes uniformly across the parameter space, and extrapolates to low single-digit percentage errors outside of the training bounds. In the excitable regime the same operator accurately reproduces the firing threshold and the $c \propto \sqrt{D_u}$ conduction-velocity law and replicates full traveling pulses, fully capturing the excitable bifurcation structure rather than just smoothly interpolating fields.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用参数条件化傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为 FitzHugh-Nagumo 神经元电压动力学模型的快速可微替代求解器，通过 FiLM 调制处理五维生理参数空间，并在振荡与可激发两种分支机制下分别训练，实现了高效准确的参数扫描与外推。
AI.motivation: FHN 模型能模拟神经元动作电位与节律性放电，但经典有限差分求解器在五维生理参数空间中进行快速参数扫描成本高昂，限制了神经调控与电压记录反演生物物理参数的研究。
AI.method: 在一维空间域上训练参数条件化 FNO 作为 FHN 电压与恢复变量的快速可微替代模型；通过特征线性调制（FiLM）在每个傅里叶层对参数向量 λ=(D_u, D_v, a, b, τ) 进行条件化；先进行一次分支分析划分振荡（强直放电）与可激发（动作电位传播）两种机制，然后在每种机制下分别训练一个算子。
AI.result: 振荡机制下，替代模型在两个场上相对 L² 误差低于 0.1%，比有限差分基线快近三个数量级，在参数空间内均匀泛化，训练范围外低个位数百分误差；可激发机制下，同一算子准确复现发放阈值和 c∝√D_u 传导速度定律，并完整重建行波脉冲，捕获了完整的可激发分支结构。
AI.conclusion: 参数条件化 FNO 可作为 FHN 系统的高保真快速可微替代模型，支持高效分支分析与参数外推，为神经动力学的多参数扫描与生物物理反演提供了可扩展的计算工具。

title: Optimizer Memory Schedules for Outscaling the Overtraining Axis
summary: We investigate how optimizers scale across the overtraining axis and show that relative optimizer performance and optimal hyperparameters change substantially with training horizon. In particular, we study how matrix-preconditioned methods (Muon and SOAP) and a momentum-scheduled method (ADANA) scale relative to AdamW. We compare these four optimizers across models from 51M to 253M parameters and overtraining (OT) factors from 1x to 256x, sweeping the base learning rate at every setting. The preferred learning rate schedule can reverse across the overtraining axis, the best weight decay coefficient scales approximately as sqrt(OT), and longer horizons generally favor longer fixed memory. ADANA's scaling advantage over AdamW persists after tuning AdamW's fixed memory separately at each horizon. Log-time weight decay and momentum cooldown provide substantial gains for ADANA that compound as training increases. With this treatment, ADANA outscales AdamW with an exponent advantage close to that predicted by DANA theory on power-law random features. Muon and SOAP instead provide roughly constant token-efficiency advantages over AdamW across most of the measured range, although SOAP may gain further at the highest overtraining factors. ADANA begins behind both matrix-preconditioned optimizers but closes the gaps as training increases, surpassing Muon and becoming competitive with SOAP at our highest OT factors. These results establish training horizon as an essential axis for optimizer evaluation and design.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了四种优化器（AdamW、ADANA、Muon、SOAP）在过训练轴上的可扩展性，发现训练时长是关键的设计维度：优化器排名和最优超参数随训练时长显著变化，ADANA结合对数时间权重衰减与动量冷却后能以接近DANA理论预测的2−κ斜率超越AdamW。
AI.motivation: 现有优化器基准测试通常在单一训练时长或固定的token-参数比下选择超参数和比较方法，忽略了训练时长本身对优化器排名和最优超参数选择的影响；而实际部署的语言模型常常在远超过Chinchilla最优的训练量下进行过训练，因此需要将训练时长作为优化器评估和设计的核心维度。
AI.method: 在51M–253M参数模型上，对AdamW、ADANA、Muon和SOAP四种优化器，在1×到256×过训练因子范围内，每种设置独立扫描基础学习率；提出动量冷却（momentum cooldown）规则以限制ADANA对数时间记忆在终端学习率衰减期间的记忆时长；使用Skaling函数形式（共享模型指数m）进行联合模型-token损失拟合，通过等效OT因子和token乘数衡量相对效率。
AI.result: 关键发现包括：(1) 偏好的学习率调度可随过训练轴反转，最佳权重衰减系数近似按√f缩放；(2) 更长训练时长通常偏好更长固定记忆；(3) ADANA结合对数时间权重衰减与动量冷却后，相对AdamW的等效OT斜率在1.15–1.20之间，接近DANA理论在幂律随机特征上的2−κ=1.15预测；(4) Muon和SOAP相对AdamW在大部分测量范围内提供近似恒定的token效率优势（约1.3×–1.7×），SOAP在最高过训练因子下可能进一步提升；(5) ADANA初始落后于矩阵预处理优化器，但随训练时长增加缩小差距，在最高OT因子下超越Muon并与SOAP具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 训练时长应被视为优化器评估和设计的必要实验维度；在过训练轴上，ADANA的调度记忆策略展现出超越AdamW的"外扩缩放"（outscaling）行为，其优势源于token衰减指数的改善；矩阵预处理优化器提供大但近似恒定的优势；未来的优化器评估需在更大模型、更长训练时长和不同架构上验证这些结论，并需要完全控制的批量大小研究。

title: Representation Redundancy and Structural Complexity in Finite-Field Inversion
summary: The representation chosen for a mathematical operation can affect both its algebraic form and its empirical learning difficulty. We study this phenomenon for inversion over \(\mathbb F_{2^n}\), with field elements expressed in varying ordered \(\mathbb F_2\)-bases. We prove that two ordered bases induce the same coordinate inversion map if and only if they belong to the same Galois orbit. Since every orbit has size \(n\), the correspondence between ordered bases and distinct inversion maps is exactly \(n\)-to-one. We then analyze three Boolean formulations of inversion. The reference formulation has algebraic degree \(n-1\) and joint ANF leap \(1\), the mixed representation formulation has degree \(2(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap \(2\), and the complete raw formulation has degree at most \(3(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap at least \(n\). Exhaustive computations agree with the theoretical results and bounds in the cases considered. Controlled experiments with multilayer perceptrons show the same ordering in learning difficulty, while Galois orbit redundancy provides only a limited generalization benefit under the tested conditions. These results show that exact redundancy among representations can coexist with changes in Boolean structure and learning behavior when the representation is exposed as part of the input.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了有限域 𝔽_{2ⁿ} 上乘法逆运算在不同有序 𝔽₂-基下的表示选择问题，从两个角度分析：(1) 精确表示冗余性，证明两个有序基诱导相同坐标逆映射当且仅当它们属于同一 Galois 轨道，从而得到 n-to-1 的精确冗余比；(2) 代数结构复杂度，定义了"联合 ANF leap" 衡量指标，分析了参考、混合表示和完全原始三种布尔公式化下的代数次数和联合 ANF leap。理论分析与 n=3,4 的穷举计算及 MLP 实验结果一致，表明精确冗余可与布尔结构变化及学习难度差异共存。
AI.motivation: 数学运算的坐标表示选择会同时影响其代数形式和经验学习难度。等变学习研究表明利用对称性和表示冗余可提高样本效率和泛化能力，但这些工作通常预设已知的变换结构或架构约束。本文旨在有限且可精确枚举的设定中，将表示冗余与代数结构作为两个可独立分析的问题来研究。
AI.method: 研究方法分理论和实验两部分。理论方面：(1) 通过 Galois 群（Frobenius 自同构）对有序基的作用，利用 Hua 定理证明任务等价性，建立 n-to-1 冗余；(2) 利用代数范式（ANF）和代数次数度量，结合新引入的"联合 ANF leap"指标（将 Abbe 等人的 leap/staircase 思想从 Fourier 支撑适配到向量值布尔映射的联合 ANF 支撑），分析三种公式化下的结构。实验方面：(a) 对 n=3,4 进行穷举 ANF 计算验证理论；(b) 使用 MLP（3 层 ReLU 隐藏层，宽度 256，AdamW 优化器）在三种公式化下对比学习难度；(c) 随机基划分 vs Galois 轨道不相交划分下的泛化对比；(d) 缩放实验改变训练数据量和模型宽度。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 两个有序基诱导相同坐标逆映射 iff 同一 Galois 轨道，每个轨道恰含 n 个基，冗余比精确为 n。(2) 参考公式 deg = n-1，混合表示 deg = 2(n-1)，完全原始 deg ≤ 3(n-1)；联合 ANF leap 分别为 1, 2, ≥n。(3) n=3,4 穷举验证界均可达。(4) MLP 实验显示学习难度与 ANF 排序一致：参考 > 混合 > 原始。(5) 缩放实验中混合表示从 128→512 宽度准确率从 66.9% 升至 95.5%，而原始仅从 16.6% 升至 25.7%。(6) Galois 轨道冗余仅在 n=3 提供有限泛化益处，n=4 无明显效果。
AI.conclusion: 精确表示冗余可与联合映射的学习难度共存。不同基可能表示同一任务，但这种等价性对标准 MLP 而言并不容易识别或利用。代数次数和联合 ANF leap 与实验中观察到的学习难度排序一致，可作为表示暴露引入结构的描述符。但这两种度量单独不能决定神经网络性能，且 ANF 分析在多项式扩展上进行，而学习实验限制在可逆矩阵上。未来工作包括证明一般 n 下原始 ANF 精确值、分离联合 ANF leap 与代数次数的效应、研究显式利用 Galois 作用的模型。

title: GNN-Guided Graph Coarsening and Adaptive QUBO Penalties for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows on a Quantum Annealer
summary: Graph coarsening reduces the large Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) formulations arising when vehicle-routing problems are solved by quantum annealing. Nearby customers with compatible time windows are merged into super-nodes, the reduced problem is solved, and the solution is expanded to the original graph. For the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW), existing coarsening heuristics require family-specific tuning and remain unreliable on random instances. We address these limitations on the Solomon benchmark using simulated annealing and a D-Wave Advantage2 processor. We first introduce adaptive penalty calibration. Uniform penalty scaling has little effect, whereas controlling the internal coefficient range substantially improves raw samples. Removing non-binding constraints, normalising binding ones, and scaling the remaining penalties reduces mean raw constraint violations from 33.0 to 0.06 at the same solver budget (p=3.7e-11, n=56). A variable-count-preserving control attributes this gain to conditioning rather than problem size. Second, we replace the hand-tuned merge score with a graph neural network (GNN) using one configuration across all families. At N=10, it achieves 100% feasibility across all Solomon families, including R-type (100% vs. 80% for the tuned heuristic). Across N=10,...,100, feasibility is 83% vs. 69%, with the GNN better or tied on 85/90 instance-size pairs. At N=80,100, the difference is significant (p=0.002; 25/25 pairs), while the QUBO remains approximately 5-6 times smaller. Finally, hardware experiments reproduce the conditioning effect at fixed logical variable count: feasible samples increase from 0.02% to 39% across 13 instances. Classical repair with local search remains a reference bound for end-to-end solution cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题(CVRPTW)的量子退火求解，提出两项关键技术：(1)自适应惩罚校准——通过移除非绑定约束并归一化绑定约束的系数范围来改善QUBO条件；(2)基于图神经网络(GNN)的引导图粗化策略——使用单一配置替代手工调参的合并启发式，无需逐家族调优。在Solomon基准上使用模拟退火和D-Wave Advantage2处理器验证，两项技术分别显著改善了原始采样质量和可行性保持能力。
AI.motivation: CVRPTW在量子退火器上求解时面临两大瓶颈：(1)直接的QUBO编码规模增长迅速，难以嵌入当前硬件；(2)现有粗化启发式(如Özyılmaz提出的时空合并度量)需要针对不同实例家族(clustered/random/mixed)分别调参，且在随机型(R)实例上表现不可靠。论文旨在解决这两大局限性：提升QUBO公式的数值条件，并消除对家族特定调参的依赖。
AI.method:
方法包含两大核心组件：

**1. 自适应惩罚校准**：分析发现QUBO内部系数动态范围(由容量约束的log-slack项主导，耦合可达(2^m)²量级)是影响采样质量的关键杠杆，而非统一的惩罚缩放。具体策略：(a)对总需求≤Q的实例直接删除非绑定的容量约束(同时移除其slack变量)；(b)对绑定实例，按(2^⌊log₂Q⌋)²对容量惩罚权重进行归一化，恢复约束层级。同时引入变量数保持的控制组(cap-crush)以分离"条件改善"与"问题规模缩小"的贡献。

**2. GNN引导的粗化**：以GraphSAGE为主干(对比GAT/GCN的消融实验)，输入11维节点特征与8维边特征，输出边的合并概率。采用专家迭代(expert iteration)训练：标签来自启发式扫描池与当前模型随机采样rollouts中奖励最高者；奖励函数r = 2[feasible] + [pre-feasible] - 0.5·min(gap,2) - 0.02·min(v,50)。单一固定配置跨家族使用，无需调参。

QUBO公式采用Borowski等人的位置编码(FQS/APS)，约束包括访问唯一性、容量、自环、时间窗、连续性；距离目标采用Clarke-Wright节约值。求解后通过经典修复(去重、贪心插入、2-opt/relocate局部搜索)解码。
AI.result:
**自适应惩罚校准(56实例×5种子)**：预修复违规从33.0降至0.06(p=3.7×10⁻¹¹)，预修复可行性从0.7%升至94.8%，QUBO变量从131降至101。cap-crush控制(保持131变量)达到0.06违规/94.6%可行性，证实改善源于条件而非规模缩小。QPU上重复：静态2.7×10¹⁰压缩因子→0.02%可行性；cap-crush 1.7×10⁵→39.4%可行性(同变量数)。

**GNN引导粗化**：N=10时跨所有家族达100%可行性(R型100% vs. 启发式80%)。N∈{10,...,100}总体可行性83.3% vs. 68.9%(85/90对占优，p=3.4×10⁻⁴)；N=80,100时74.7% vs. 56.0%(25/25对，p=0.002)。QUBO保持约5-6倍压缩(N=100时2,577 vs. 15,450变量)，N=100下保持可解、N=20下保持可嵌入(Zephyr图上链长≤11)。边排序AUC约0.98。

**消融实验**：GraphSAGE/GAT/GCN主干无可一致优势；奖励系数仅在移除尾部项时显著改变选择，且端到端性能不变。粗化深度停止规则以可行性换成本，未占优固定深度。

**端到端成本**：所有量子管线变体的最终成本均高于OR-Tools基准；经典修复+局部搜索(5-19%差距)未被打败。N=10,15,20时GNN管线成本差距为35.8%/52.4%/64.9%。

**替代编码**：路径激活(arc-based)在N=20时可行性仅55.6-66.7%；集合划分(set partitioning)因在列中编码可行性，无需slack，预修复可行性达96-97%，但路径池由经典方法生成。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是QUBO公式化与预处理层面的改进：(1)识别并解决了CVRPTW位置编码中log-slack引起的系数动态范围问题，通过条件校准而非统一缩放改善采样质量(违规降低3个数量级)，并在量子硬件上以变量数保持的控制验证了该机制；(2)使用单一配置的GNN合并评分器替代家族特定调参的启发式，在N=10-100范围内更好地保持可行性，且优势随规模扩大而增长。局限性在于：(a)端到端路径成本未被量子管线超越，经典修复+局部搜索仍是参考基准；(b)量子硬件上模拟退火仍优于退火器本身(N=10时79% vs. 43%预修复可行性)；(c)硬件可嵌入范围仅N≈10-20，N=40时无嵌入方案；(d)集合划分编码显示出避开slack负担的潜力，是未来硬件评估的有前景方向。

title: Too Rare to Learn: Prescribed Cyclone Tracks Degrade a Bay of Bengal Ocean Emulator
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures. In review at the NeurIPS 2026 Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning workshop
summary: Neural ocean emulators are being proposed for regional forecasting in cyclone-exposed coastal seas, and a natural design choice is to hand the network the cyclone as a prescribed input. We test that choice in the Bay of Bengal and find it harmful. We withhold 15 whole cyclones spanning 65 to 150 kt from GLORYS12 reanalysis and compare two U-Nets that are identical except for four prescribed cyclone-track channels. Across three seeds the ocean-only model beats persistence in every run and the storm-conditioned model loses to it in every run, with the two skill ranges disjoint (p = 3.1e-5, paired across storms). The cause is exposure frequency rather than signal content: the channels are non-zero on only 7.9% of training days, so they are out of distribution the moment they activate. The extra error falls inside the prescribed storm footprint, and replacing the real cyclone map with a no-storm map at inference improves held-out storm forecasts by 7.5 to 16.4% in every seed. The conditioned network has learned a response to a rare signal that is confidently wrong.

AI.tldr: 在孟加拉湾区域海洋模拟任务中，向 U-Net 输入四个额外的预设气旋风场通道（位置、强度、运动）反而损害了模型性能。原因是这些通道仅在 7.9% 的训练日上非零，处于分布外状态。去掉气旋输入的"海洋-only"模型在所有三个随机种子和两种检查点策略上都优于持续性（persistence），而加入气旋输入的"风暴条件"模型则在所有六个运行中均低于持续性。推理时用"无风暴"图替代真实气旋图，可改善 7.5–16.4% 的预测误差。
AI.motivation: 近年研究界提出用神经网络作为热带气旋影响海域的区域海洋预报工具，自然的设计思路是把气旋作为预设输入喂给网络。然而已有研究（Sun et al.; Cui et al.）未在"气旋通道有信息但稀疏"这一中间场景下系统测试。本文正是要填补这一空白：在孟加拉湾条件下，使用事件不重叠（event-disjoint）的留出协议，测量一个介于"全风暴数据集"与"完全不告知风暴"之间的运行场景。
AI.method: 数据：GLORYS12V1 日均再分析资料，0.25° 重网格，覆盖 5–25°N, 80–99.75°E，时间 1993–2026 年 6 月。状态为表层温度（SST）和盐度（SSS）。气旋轨迹取自 IBTrACS，每个定位点用 σ=2° 的高斯核渲染成 4 个日通道：存在性、强度、两个运动分量。  留出协议：按强度三分位与季节（pre/post 季）轮转方式确定 15 个完整气旋（含两侧 7 天缓冲），共 272 个评估窗口；检查点选取使用 33 个无风暴的 21 天块，避免把风暴信息泄漏进评估。  架构：相同 U-Net，1 层下采样，宽度 24，3 天历史 → 1 天预报。海洋-only 6 通道共 100,706 参数；风暴条件 10 通道共 101,570 参数（差 0.9%）。  训练：掩码 MSE（仅海洋格点）、AdamW、30 epoch、三种子；评估指标为对比持续性的技能 S=1−RMSE_model/RMSE_pers。  诊断：(1) 按天气状况分离的成本（calm vs storm 天）；(2) 把气旋通道在推理时替换为"无风暴"值的干预实验；(3) 把风暴天拆为预设气旋足迹内/外的 RMSE；(4) 通道占用统计。
AI.result: 1. 性能反转：海洋-only 在 3 种子 × 2 检查点 = 6 个运行中技能均 [ +0.048, +0.161 ]；风暴条件在 6 个运行中均 [ −0.477, −0.075 ]，两区间不重叠。按 15 个气旋配对的 Wilcoxon 检验 p=3.1×10⁻⁵。  2. 通道占用：训练日中 7.9%（885/11,195）非零，且 542 天峰值风速 <30 kt，仅 5 天 >120 kt。  3. 按天气分离：条件化（conditioning）在 calm 天稍微有益，在 storm 天明显有害（seed 1：calm −0.026 vs storm +0.123）。  4. 推理干预：用"无风暴"图替代真实气旋图，在 held-out 风暴天上 RMSE 改善 15.3%、16.4%、7.5%（每种子都成立）。  5. 空间分布：盐度 RMSE 的额外惩罚在气旋足迹内比外侧高 2.1–11.3 倍。  6. 全部可恢复技能在盐度：海洋-only 在 SSS 上优于持续性 0.036 PSU；风暴条件在 SSS 上无改进；两臂在 SST 上都不如持续性。
AI.conclusion: 预设稀疏信号会损害神经网络海洋模拟器，性能下降由信号暴露频率驱动而非信号内容本身。设计准则应为：评估条件输入时不仅看其信息量，还要看它在训练中"被锻炼"的频率。本文结果限于一日预报时长、由轨迹导出的条件输入，下一步将加入 ERA5 强迫输入与多日滚动预报。

title: SMILE: Bridging Continuous Optimization and Discrete Symbolic Recovery
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers closed-form mathematical expressions from data, offering interpretability beyond black-box models. Existing methods suffer from slow convergence in combinatorial search spaces and lack mechanisms to exploit compositional structure in the data. We introduce SMILE (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential), a hybrid framework that unifies continuous gradient-based optimization with discrete symbolic recovery through three stages: structural analysis of the data to identify the compositional hierarchy of the target expression, continuous optimization to learn parameters of a network that encodes the target expression using interpretable activations, and symbolic recovery through structured pruning, coefficient optimization, and rounding. This final stage distills the learned network into a compact expression with exact symbolic constants. We evaluate SMILE on SRBench across ground-truth and black-box datasets, with ablation studies validating each component. SMILE achieves the highest symbolic solution rate at the largest noise levels, demonstrating strong robustness where competing methods degrade substantially. It consistently lies on the Pareto front of accuracy versus complexity, recovering significantly simpler expressions in a fraction of the time required by the competing methods.

AI.tldr: SMILE是一种混合符号回归框架,通过结合结构分析、连续梯度优化和符号恢复三个阶段,从数据中发现紧凑且可解释的数学表达式。其在SRBench数据集上展现出最强的鲁棒性和最优的精度-复杂度折中。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法在组合搜索空间中收敛缓慢,且缺乏利用数据组合结构的机制,需要一种能兼顾收敛效率、可解释性和抗噪性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出SMILE框架,包含三个阶段:(1)对数据进行结构分析,识别目标表达式的组合层次结构;(2)使用可解释激活函数的神经网络进行连续梯度优化以学习参数;(3)通过结构化剪枝、系数优化和取整,将网络蒸馏为包含精确符号常量的紧凑表达式。
AI.result: 在SRBench的ground-truth和黑盒数据集上的评估表明,SMILE在高噪声水平下取得最高的符号求解率,鲁棒性优于现有方法;同时始终位于精度-复杂度的Pareto前沿上,能在远短于竞争对手的时间内恢复显著更简洁的表达式。消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SMILE通过统一连续优化与离散符号恢复,显著提升了符号回归在高噪声场景下的鲁棒性,并在表达式简洁性和计算效率方面均具有明显优势,为可解释建模提供了有效途径。

title: Interpretability for Turing Machines
comment: 75 pages, 31 figures, 3 tables. Interactive companion: this https URL . Code and data: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22205895
summary: We show that susceptibilities, an interpretability technique developed for neural networks, can identify the presence of algorithmic structure in Turing machines by probing the local loss landscape of a learning problem for noisy Turing machines introduced by Murfet and Troiani ( arXiv:2504.08075 ). We prove that symmetries and path separation in the algorithm implemented by a Turing machine induce permutation symmetries and low-rank blocks in its susceptibility matrix. We study this empirically on a set of deterministic finite automata (DFAs) and demonstrate that algorithmic features can be recovered by principal component analysis and clustering methods in susceptibility space.

AI.tldr: 该论文将神经网络可解释性中的"磁化率"（susceptibilities）方法推广到图灵机，证明了图灵机算法的内部结构（路径分离与重编码对称性）会引发磁化率矩阵的低秩块与置换对称性，并通过38,019个确定性有限自动机（DFA）的实验验证了理论结果可在算法层面恢复出可解释的特征。
AI.motivation: 将神经网络可解释性技术应用于算法结构已知的图灵机，在Singular Learning Theory框架下建立"程序内部结构可从损失函数局部几何恢复"这一假设的实例。动机是验证：当真值模型是含噪声的图灵机时，其磁化率能揭示算法结构而非黑箱行为。
AI.method: 方法核心是基于Gibbs分布的线性响应（磁化率），定义为χ_x^C([M]) = (1/β) ∂_ε E_{p_β^ε}[φ_C]|_{ε=0} = -Cov_{p_β}[φ_C, h_x² - H]。两个主定理：(1) 路径分离分区A⊔R产生磁化率矩阵的分块X_{acc,R}和X_{rej,A}秩≤2；(2) 重编码对称性g=(a,s)使磁化率矩阵满足χ_{g·x}^{g·C}([M]) = χ_x^C([M])。实验使用lookup UTM和staged UTM的平滑松弛，GRLD采样器（β=30, γ=1, α=0.01），在语言L_{A,0}的38,019个经典解DFA上验证。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 理论证明路径分离分区约束秩≤2，重编码对称性约束置换不变性；(2) 在38,019个DFA上验证PSV_min=0 ⟺ PSR(ψ̂([M]))≤2（精确双条件），零例外；(3) UMAP和PCA显示磁化率空间中路径可分离DFA形成明显聚类；(4) 重编码表现为PCA中的镜像反射（PC₂×PC₃平面），固定点位于对称轴上；(5) 算法对称性可用线性SVM从磁化率数据恢复（PSV_min六类分类准确率0.99）；(6) 38,019个DFA中重编码缺陷中位数显著低于非对称机器。
AI.conclusion: 该论文证实了"学习程序的内部结构反映在引导其合成的损失函数的局部几何中"这一假设在图灵机设置下的实例。磁化率不仅能检测路径分离和重编码对称性，还能恢复更细微的结构（如停机时间），为算法的可解释性提供了基于损失景观几何的新工具。理论框架优雅地统一了神经网络可解释性与算法结构识别。

title: WEECFP-SuRGE: Wide Embedded Extended Connectivity Fingerprint with Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding
summary: We introduce WEECFP, a parameter-free 1024-dimensional continuous molecular fingerprint that scatters each Morgan substructure across roughly thirty-two signed positions of a single vector, and WEECFP-SuRGE, a transformer architecture whose self-attention applies SuRGE (Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding) -- a RoPE-like rotation parameterized by molecular shortest-path graph distance -- to WEECFP substructure tokens. A 7-model blend of this architecture (the WEECFP-SuRGE Blend) achieves the lowest average regression rank on the TDC ADMET leaderboard; is #2 overall on the TDC ADMET leaderboard (behind only pretrained MapLight+GNN), and is #1 overall among methods that use no external pretraining; takes leaderboard #1 finishes on Pgp, Lipophilicity, CYP2D6 Substrate, Clearance Microsome, and LD50 (with the WEECFP-NoSuRGE Blend separately reaching #1 on HIA) across the full 22-benchmark suite -- without any external pretraining. On MoleculeNet, WEECFP-SuRGE beats every classical-fingerprint baseline on 3 of 4 regression tasks (ESOL, Lipophilicity, QM9). We further show that WEECFP tokenization is near-lossless: a greedy overlap reconstruction recovers the exact canonical SMILES of 99.9% of in-distribution molecules across 9 MoleculeNet datasets and 98.93% of molecules in a cross-dataset holdout (HIV->Lipophilicity), and that a three-reference farthest-first encoding of graph distance correlates at Pearson r = 0.901 with the true pairwise distance, enabling O(S) positional memory at matching accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WEECFP-SuRGE，一种无参数 1024 维连续分子指纹 WEECFP 与图距离旋转编码 SuRGE 相结合的方法，在 TDC ADMET 排行榜上取得无预训练方法中最佳排名，并在多个分子性质预测基准上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 现有分子表示存在两类局限：传统 ECFP 缺乏子结构的位置信息且难以与神经网络配合；而预训练 GNN/Transformer 依赖大规模数据。该研究旨在同时解决这两个问题，提出无需预训练即可与神经网络良好兼容的固定维度连续指纹和图结构感知的旋转位置编码。
AI.method: 方法分三部分：(1) WEECFP-S 指纹——枚举 Morgan 子结构，将每个子结构通过双 MD5 哈希以约 32 个有符号写入分散到 1024 维连续向量中，结合原子属性块和邻居键合块；(2) SuRGE——将 RoPE 旋转推广到分子图，相位由最短路径图距离参数化（均值距离 md 或三参考 ref3），可在输入层或每层应用；(3) 7 模型 Blend 集成（4 个 Transformer + 1 个 MLP + 2 个 CNN），对每个 TDC 种子独立训练后取算术平均。
AI.result: 在 TDC ADMET 22 个基准上，WEECFP-SuRGE Blend 在 9 个回归任务上平均排名 3.9（全场最低），5 个任务取得 #1（Pgp、亲脂性、CYP2D6 Substrate、Clearance Microsome、LD50），在无预训练方法中总体排名第 1（22 项平均 5.1）。在 MoleculeNet 上击败所有经典指纹基线，在 4 个回归任务中 3 个胜出（ESOL、亲脂性、QM9）。WEECFP-Scatter token 化具有近无损可逆性（分布内 99.9%、跨数据集 98.93% 精确还原 SMILES），三参考 ref3 编码与真实图距离 Pearson r=0.901，以 O(S) 内存实现全对距离相当的注意力效果。
AI.conclusion: WEECFP-SuRGE 证明了无预训练的轻量 3 层 Transformer 配合良好的特征化可在 ADMET 回归任务上与预训练大规模模型竞争。其连续有符号指纹更适合神经网络优化，而 SuRGE 将图拓扑结构注入注意力机制。局限性在于分类任务仍落后于预训练模型、大环分子截断、FreeSolv 等小数据集上过参数化、以及缺乏立体化学和 3D 几何信息。

title: Locating and Steering Refusal Beyond Attention
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 26 tables; 10-page main text plus technical appendix
summary: Where inside a language model does refusal live, and does that place change when the architecture does? In a transformer, refusal is governed by a single direction in the residual stream, a finding that safety and interpretability tooling now depend on. State-space models (SSMs) route information through a recurrent update instead of attention, sharing no token-mixing mechanism with a transformer. Does the same safety representation survive this shift, or must it be rediscovered per architecture? It survives. A single rigid rotation, which can only reorient a space and not reshape it, aligns one model's representation space with another's, so the two genuinely share the representation. A harm probe trained on a transformer then flags an SSM's harmful inputs, and removing the aligned direction makes a model answer attacks it would otherwise refuse, while a random direction of the same size does far less. What is architecture-specific is not where the direction is steered but where it must be read. Each layer computes a fresh output that is then added into the residual stream, and harm is cleanly readable at this output, the write site, before the addition. A control that holds the intervention's strength fixed shows that what matters is where the direction is estimated, not where it is applied. Applied through a detector-triggered gate, this direction lowers jailbreak success in all four architecture families we test (SSM, transformer, recurrent, hybrid), and on the SSM it holds against an attacker that tunes its prompt against the defense. The gate only matches a trivial rule that returns a fixed refusal whenever the same detector fires, so what transfers across architectures is the direction itself, not defense strength. Safety tooling built on refusal therefore ports to a new architecture by re-estimating the direction at that architecture's write site, not by rebuilding it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拒绝行为（refusal）在不同架构语言模型中的表征是否共享。研究发现：拒绝方向在 transformer、SSM（Mamba）、循环（RNN）和混合架构中本质上是同一表征，可通过一个刚体旋转（Procrustes）将一个模型的表示空间映射到另一个。但每个架构读取该方向的"写入点"（write site）是架构特定的——即每个层计算的新输出在加入残差流之前的那个位置。重要的是读取方向的位置，而非施加干预的位置。基于此，提出一个检测-门控机制（detector-triggered gate），在四个架构家族上均能降低越狱成功率，同时保持零额外过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全工具栈（如拒绝方向检测与引导）主要在 transformer 上开发，依赖于注意力机制的信息路由方式。状态空间模型（SSM，如 Mamba）通过循环更新而非注意力来路由信息，不共享任何 token 混合机制。如果拒绝是 transformer 架构的特有属性，那么每种新架构都需要重新发现安全工具栈。核心问题：拒绝是架构的属性，还是所有模型学习的同一功能？其表征究竟位于模型内部何处？
AI.method: 1. **威胁模型**：对手控制输入提示，可针对冻结检测器进行自适应优化；防御者在推理时运行检测器和门控。2. **检测器与门控循环**：在路由层（write-site 层）训练线性探针作为检测器，对每个提示评分一次；有害概率超过阈值时，在架构的 write site 处对整个生成过程放大拒绝方向。3. **Write site 定义**：在 transformer 中为注意力输出投影；在 SSM 中为选择性扫描块输出；在 RWKV 中为 time-mix 输出；在混合模型中为 Mamba 或注意力输出。4. **跨架构映射**：通过标准化 Procrustes 旋转（刚体旋转）将源模型的拒绝方向映射到目标模型。5. **拒绝方向**：有害与良性激活的均值差方向，而非检测器的判别方向。6. **方法论控制**：使用匹配绝对幅度的控制实验隔离位置与方向估计的因果效应；使用随机方向对照验证特异性。
AI.result: **核心结果**：1. **拒绝表征跨架构共享**：单一刚体旋转可将 transformer 的表示空间对齐到 SSM；从 transformer 映射的探针在 SSM 上达到 AUROC 1.00；移除映射方向使 SSM 被越狱（44.0% vs 基线 10.5%），而随机方向无效（9.0%）。2. **写入点原则**：拒绝方向必须在各架构的"新写入点"（fresh write）读取，而非累积残差；在写入点估计的方向可控制拒绝，在残差估计的方向则退化为不连贯输出。匹配幅度的控制显示，重要的是方向估计的位置，而非干预施加的位置。3. **四架构防御**：检测-门控机制在 SSM（98.0%→5.0%）、transformer（98.0%→14.0%/25.0%→0.0%）、RWKV（47.5%→27.5%）和混合模型（31.7%→0.0%/5.0%）上均降低前缀注入攻击成功率，过度拒绝增量为零。4. **自适应攻击鲁棒**：在 SSM 上，针对门控本身优化的 GCG 后缀攻击成功率仅从 15.0% 上升到仍受控的水平（出族法官评分下保持防御）。5. **数据稀缺场景**：当目标标签稀缺时，传输方向比从相同标签从头拟合的方向多检测 11.4 个百分点的有害提示（5.0% 误报率下）。6. **Δ 是读取点而非控制点**：选择性扫描步长 Δ 可解码但不可控制拒绝；冻结 Δ 不改变拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝行为在架构间是同一表征（架构无关），但其可读位置（write site）是架构特定的。安全工具栈移植到新架构只需在新架构的写入点重新估计拒绝方向，而非完全重建。具体操作手册：（1）找到写入点；（2）通过保持可解码性选择层；（3）拟合探针和均值拒绝方向；（4）校准增益至连贯性边界以下；（5）闭环部署。门控机制仅匹配朴素的"检测后拒绝"基线，因此其价值在于方向的可移植性，而非防御强度本身。该规则在 SSM、transformer、循环和混合架构四类中均成立。

title: Training Large Language Models for Small-Molecule Design with Synthetic Task Scaling
summary: Designing viable drug candidates requires searching a combinatorially large and rugged chemical space for molecules that satisfy multiple, often competing, objectives. Large language models (LLMs) provide a useful generative prior for this problem because of their representational capacity, reasoning ability, and flexibility when incorporating information from the external environment. While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can be used to improve the capabilities of LLMs, many chemically relevant scoring functions require hours or even days per evaluation, making them prohibitively expensive to use directly during online training. Here, we investigate whether LLMs can learn molecular design strategies from cheaper synthetic tasks that generalize to expensive molecular lead optimization settings. We find that curriculum-based training recipes that gradually incorporate more challenging synthetic design tasks enable strong performance that surpasses that of much larger frontier models on structure-based lead optimization. Our results suggest that scaling post-training using synthetic tasks is an effective strategy for adapting LLMs to high-cost experimental scenarios that are too expensive to directly train on.

AI.tldr: 本文针对药物发现中昂贵的高保真化学评分函数（如SQM半经验量子力学评分）难以直接用于LLM在线强化学习训练的问题，提出了一种基于合成任务的课程学习后训练策略。研究使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B基础模型，设计了两层合成任务（Tier-1使用RDKit/OpenEye的廉价化学描述符；Tier-2使用Chemgauss4对接评分作为SQM的廉价类比），通过课程式训练（先廉价任务后昂贵任务）使小型LLM在结构基础的先导优化任务上超越Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol等远大于它的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 药物分子设计需要在巨大且崎岖的化学空间中搜索满足多目标的分子。许多化学评分函数（如FEP）耗时极长，无法直接用于LLM的在线强化学习后训练（RLVR）。核心动机在于：能否让LLM通过在廉价合成任务上学习，泛化到昂贵的真实分子先导优化场景。
AI.method: 1) 构建两层合成任务：Tier-1使用200,000个基于RDKit/OpenEye描述符的廉价性质优化任务；Tier-2使用Chemgauss4（基于POSIT对接）作为SQM2.20评分函数的廉价类比，基于PLINDER数据集的999个配体-受体对。2) 采用异步强化学习（prime-rl框架）与IPO损失函数，使用Dr. GRPO风格的优势估计。3) 探索多种课程学习策略：T1(a)–T2(b)（先Tier-1后纯Tier-2）和T1(a)–Mix(b)（先Tier-1后25:75的Tier-1:Tier-2混合）。4) 以Qwen3.6-35B-A3B为基础模型进行500步后训练，使用32块B200 GPU。
AI.result: 1) 最佳模型T1(400)–T2(100)在40个SQM评估系统上的相对结合亲和力改善比T1(500)基线高+3.18 kcal/mol，多个课程训练模型表现优于所有前沿模型（Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol等）。2) 训练后的模型设计效率显著更高：平均7-12轮即提交设计，而前沿模型需13-18轮，且几乎无格式错误。3) 纯Tier-2训练导致模式坍缩，模型退化为单轮提交策略。4) 化学分析显示训练模型倾向于收缩分子、较少卤化、更激进地去除阴离子基团（特别是对阴离子起始分子）。5) 未观察到清晰的训练成本-性能缩放定律。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的合成任务课程学习策略能够有效将LLM适配到成本过高的实验/计算场景，使小型LLM在分子先导优化上超越远大于它的前沿模型。该方法为昂贵场景下的LLM后训练提供了可推广的范式。未来工作可探索监督微调、on-policy蒸馏以及将策略推广到湿实验高通量-高保真场景。

title: A Fairness Audit of the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern Method: Format-Specific and Gender-Differential Bias, with an Interpretable Calibration Layer for Cricket Target Revision
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Quantitative Analysis in Sports (JQAS); forthcoming
summary: The Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method has been the international standard for revising target scores in rain-interrupted limited-overs cricket since 1999. Despite over two decades of operational use, no large-scale empirical audit of its prediction bias has been published. We conduct such an audit on 8,150 international matches (3,095 ODIs, 5,055 T20Is) from Cricsheet, generating 233,550 synthetic interruption scenarios with temporal splits. We document two structured biases. First, DLS prediction error spans a 137-run range across (overs-remaining, wickets-lost) match-state buckets. Second, DLS exhibits a gender-differential bias on ODIs that has not previously been quantified: on the training split, mean over-prediction is +1.51 runs for men but +7.63 runs for women, a gap of +6.13 runs (F = 195.16, p < 10^-43). We benchmark DLS against five modern alternatives: Bi-LSTM, XGBoost, an enriched XGBoost variant, a deep context-aware model, and a stacking ensemble, and propose DLS-Cal, a lightweight interpretable calibration layer (27K parameters) outputting a state-conditioned correction added to DLS. DLS-Cal reduces absolute bias by 31% on ODI and 19% on T20I, and a gender-aware variant reduces women's ODI residual bias from +6.19 to +0.65 runs while leaving men's calibration unchanged. We release code, models, and data.

AI.tldr: 本文对国际板球中用于雨中断重设目标的 Duckworth-Lewis-Stern（DLS）方法进行了首次大规模经验审计,基于 Cricsheet 的 8,150 场国际比赛数据（ODI 和 T20I）生成 233,550 个合成中断场景,发现 DLS 存在两类结构化偏差:（1）比赛状态相关的格式特异性偏差,跨越 137 分的范围;（2）ODI 比赛中未被量化的性别差异偏差（女性比赛平均过预测高出男性 +6.13 分）。作者提出 DLS-Cal（一个轻量级、可解释的校准层,27K 参数）以及性别感知变体,显著降低了偏差,且不改变 DLS 框架本身。
AI.motivation: DLS 自 1999 年起被 ICC 采用为官方目标修订方法,但缺乏大规模经验性的偏差审计。此外,同一资源表被用于男女比赛,而女性板球的得分模式与男性明显不同,引发了关于 DLS 是否对女性比赛系统性错误校准的公平性疑问。
AI.method: 使用 Cricsheet 公开的逐球数据（2,781,465 条记录）,对每局抽取 30 个合成中断点,采用时间划分（训练至 2022.12.31,验证 2023,测试 2024–2026.3）。通过双线性插值重建 DLS 资源表,并在 (overs remaining, wickets lost) 网格上审计偏差。对比 5 种现代学习方法（Bi-LSTM, XGBoost, XGBoost-Plus, CAP-Net v2, Stacking Ensemble）和 DLS 的 3 种变体。提出 DLS-Cal:一个 4 层 MLP（27K 参数）,以 DLS 预测为输入输出加性残差,并训练性别感知版本。引入 Win-Flip Rate（WFR）作为公平性导向的阈值误差指标。使用比赛级块自助法（2,000 重采样）做聚类推断。
AI.result: 主要发现:（1）DLS 偏差在比赛状态桶间跨越 137 分,ODI 高估末段 T20、低估 ODI 崩溃场景;（2）ODI 性别差距在训练集上为 +6.13 分（男性 +1.51,女性 +7.63）,在 Full Member 对阵中仍为 +6.72 分,跨时间窗口保持稳定,但 T20I 性别差距在聚类推断下不显著;（3）DLS-Cal 将 ODI 绝对偏差降低 31%,T20I 降低 19%;（4）性别感知 DLS-Cal 将女性 ODI 残差偏差从 +6.19 降至 +0.65 分,男性校准不变;（5）在 417 场真实雨中断比赛上的保留评估证实了偏差结构。Stacking Ensemble 在 RMSE 上最佳（21.49）,但 DLS-Cal 在 ODI WFR₅ 上最优（83.0%）,且具备完全可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统量化了 DLS 在规模上的结构性偏差,包括一种此前未被记录的、跨聚类推断、球队实力分层和时间窗口稳健的 ODI 性别差异偏差。DLS-Cal 作为一个轻量级、可解释且无需改变 DLS 框架的校准层,提供了务实的缓解路径。性别感知变体能几乎消除女性 ODI 残差偏差,可作为治理机构评估的透明校准层。作者发布了代码、模型和数据以支持可复现研究。

title: A Robust Watermark-based Fingerprint Framework for GNNs Ownership Verification
summary: The high training cost of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) has raised growing concerns regarding model ownership infringement, such as model stealing and unauthorized misuse. To verify model ownership and prevent significant economic losses, two groups of GNN Ownership Verification (OV) methods have been proposed: watermark-based methods and fingerprint-based methods. However, these methods typically face three limitations: (1) the performance degradation of protected models caused by out-of-distribution (OOD) watermark graphs with respect to the training set; (2) the unrealistic assumption that surrogate models have been trained on a watermark-containing training set; and (3) over-reliance on specific output levels for fingerprint extraction. In this paper, we propose a Robust watErMArk-based fingeRprint frameworK for GNNs, named REMARK. REMARK first generates carefully crafted in-distribution watermark graphs that maximize output differences between GNN models, thus mitigating OOD-induced performance degradation. REMARK then extracts robust fingerprints from these output differences to verify GNN ownership, thereby removing the assumptions that surrogate models must be trained on a watermark-containing dataset or expose specific output levels. Extensive experiments across widely used real-world datasets and GNN architectures demonstrate that REMARK achieves state-of-the-art OV accuracy and robustness while preserving the utility of protected models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REMARK框架，一种面向图神经网络(GNN)所有权验证的鲁棒水印-指纹混合方法，通过生成分布内水印图来放大不同GNN模型间的输出差异，从而实现无需水印训练集且跨输出层级的可靠所有权验证，在6个数据集和4种GNN架构上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: GNN训练成本高昂，易遭受模型窃取等知识产权侵权。现有GNN所有权验证(OV)方法分为水印法和指纹法两类，但均存在三大局限：(1) 随机生成的水印图与训练集分布不一致(OOD)，导致受保护模型在下游任务上性能下降；(2) 假设替代模型在含水印的数据集上训练，实际中水印通常不公开，该假设不成立；(3) 指纹法过度依赖单一输出层级(节点嵌入或logit)，不同层级上分布重叠程度不同，假设难以满足。
AI.method: REMARK框架包含四个模块：(1) **水印特征生成器(WFG)**：先利用基于互信息的GNN解释器提取反映受保护模型决策逻辑的解释子图，再通过动态图聚类(DGC)确定水印节点数(基于最近邻链NNC方法)，最后用多头注意力(MHA)生成与输入图节点特征分布对齐的水印特征；(2) **水印结构生成器(WSG)**：在完全连接图上以MMD损失指导解释器提取拓扑结构，确保水印图与解释子图分布一致；(3) **水印附加模块(WAM)**：在原图中选择中等重要性的节点作为连接节点，添加桥接边注入水印，避免对原任务造成过大干扰；(4) **指纹分类模块(FCM)**：拼接候选GNN在原图和带水印图上的输出(嵌入或logit)作为指纹，用两层MLP进行二分类验证，采用二元交叉熵损失训练。
AI.result: 在Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed、CS、Computers和ogbn-arxiv六个数据集以及GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE、GIN四种GNN架构上的实验表明：(1) REMARK生成的水印图MMD接近零(如CS/GraphSAGE上为0)，有效解决OOD问题；(2) 在嵌入层级上REMARK指纹验证准确率普遍达100%；(3) 在logit层级上平均准确率98.92%(±0.09)，优于GNNFingers(96.58%)和Canary(95.28%)；(4) 在40%剪枝率下REMARK平均保持93.81%准确率，优于基线；(5) 面对自适应攻击仍保持≥89.06%的准确率；(6) 消融实验验证了WFG、WSG和解释器模块各自的必要性。
AI.conclusion: REMARK通过将传统水印与指纹技术融合，生成与训练集同分布的水印图以放大GNN模型间的决策逻辑差异，有效解决了现有OV方法中OOD性能退化、依赖水印训练集的假设以及对单一输出层级的依赖三大局限，在准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性方面均达到当前最优水平，同时保持了受保护模型的效用。

title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms: Guarantees, Construction Mechanisms, and System-Level Implications
summary: Learning-augmented algorithms use fallible predictions while retaining formal performance guarantees. This survey synthesizes prediction interfaces, error measures, consistency--robustness trade-offs, and five representative construction mechanisms across online optimization, caching, learned data structures, graph problems, and mechanism design. An orthogonal theorem-level axis distinguishes achieved upper bounds from matched asymptotic dependence. Formal guarantees are separated from empirical systems evidence, with explicit treatment of prediction cost, feedback, and composition. The resulting synthesis states sufficient conditions for limited end-to-end reasoning and delineates open problems in cost-aware prediction, endogenous error, semantic predictors, and benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于"学习增强算法"（Learning-Augmented Algorithms, LAA）的综述性论文。它系统地综合了该领域的预测接口、误差度量、一致性-鲁棒性权衡，以及五类代表性构造机制（覆盖在线优化、缓存、学习数据结构、图问题和机制设计）。论文提出了一个二维分类法：构造机制轴（P1-P5）与定理级匹配下界状态轴（E0/E1），并将形式化保证与经验系统证据严格区分。该综述明确论述了预测代价、内生误差、语义预测与基准测试等开放问题，并提出了若干有限端到端推理的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 学习增强算法形式化结合了不可靠预测与最坏情况保证，弥合了保守的无预测算法与缺乏鲁棒性保证的学习启发式之间的鸿沟。然而该领域文献分散于不同预测类型、应用域与机制中，且预测成本、反馈和组件组合等问题常被遗漏。论文旨在通过严格的二维分类、跨域综合与系统级审视，为该领域提供组织框架并明确开放挑战。
AI.method: 方法包含：(1) 通过引文雪球法与目标检索构建语料库（截止2026年9月3日），明确审计追踪；(2) 提出二维分类法——轴A（P1-P5：信任组合P1、预测引导原始-对偶P2、敏感松弛+舍入P3、预测访问与组合P4、分布引导规则P5）与轴B（E0/E1定理级匹配下界状态）；(3) 统一形式化框架，包括一致性c(λ)、鲁棒性r(λ)、平滑性fλ(η)定义及信任参数λ；(4) 引入"学习增强系统"（LAS）视角作为系统级审视工具；(5) 提出组合推理图（inference graph）的充分条件命题（加性、级联、误差传播）；(6) 定义κ-增强竞争比以建模预测代价。
AI.result: 论文综合呈现：(1) 形式化框架明确了smoothness不等同于robustness，信任参数λ与误差η不可独立解释；(2) 双轴分类暴露了P1-P5机制的非穷尽性，并分离了E0（仅上界）与E1（匹配依赖）定理记录；(3) 滑雪租赁的确定性保证曲线(1+λ, 1+1/λ)被识别为渐近Pareto最优，缓存中的1-一致性与鲁棒性权衡得到系统比较；(4) 机制设计域中策略性误差成为内生对象的洞察；(5) 语义预测的四种集成模式（预测器、适配器、策略合成器、解释器）及其校准问题；(6) 系统级案例研究（LRB、Parrot、PGM、ALEX等）通过LAS会计视角统一审视。
AI.conclusion: 学习增强算法提供定理特定的一致性、鲁棒性、误差依赖保证；二维分类法分离了已证前沿、已达成上界与经验系统证据。预测成本（Definition 8.1）、策略依赖反馈、内生误差以及跨组件组合（Propositions 6.2-6.4）需要显式目标、基准、状态与误差关系的建模。语义预测（特别是LLM）当前仅为条件性证据——无综述工作能无条件验证特定语言模型满足定理前提或将通用LAA保证转移至自由形式输出。开放问题包括成本感知预测、内生/策略性误差、语义预测器与可复现基准测试。

title: How Faithful Is Attribution for Sales Forecasting? A Counterfactual Study
summary: Deep models for sales forecasting, such as WaveNet-style dilated convolutional networks, are accurate but opaque: when a single model predicts sales for one of many series, it offers no account of why. We add a post-hoc, architecture-agnostic counterfactual interpretability layer to a multi-series WaveNet forecaster trained on the full Corporacion Favorita grocery dataset (174,685 series over 1,688 days). The method decomposes each forecast into contributions that sum exactly to the predicted value, avoiding the allocation artifacts we observed with additive SHAP-style attribution. We evaluate faithfulness with a deletion/insertion protocol and find a statistically significant effect on both tests (deletion gap 0.22, p<0.001; insertion gap 0.27, p<0.01; robust across five background-sampling seeds), establishing that the attributions reflect genuine model behavior rather than plausible-looking artifacts. We then characterize, honestly, where attribution is and is not informative: reliance on the promotion signal is heterogeneous across series (median ratio approximately 1.0, with roughly 20% of series showing a strong effect), and the model captures the shape of the weekly sales cycle (day-of-week r=0.78) while systematically under-predicting its amplitude. Our contribution is not improved accuracy but an interpretability layer with a rigorous faithfulness evaluation and a candid account of its limits.

AI.tldr: 本文为多序列WaveNet销售预测模型添加了一个事后、与架构无关的反事实可解释性层，使用Corporación Favorita杂货数据集(174,685个序列,1,688天)进行训练。通过删除/插入测试验证了归因的忠实度(删除间隔0.22, p<0.001;插入间隔0.27, p<0.01,五个背景采样种子均稳健),并诚实刻画了归因有效与无效的场景:促销信号依赖度在序列间异质(中位数比≈1.0,仅约20%序列显示强效应),模型捕捉了周销售周期的形状(r=0.78)但系统性地低估其振幅。贡献在于可信赖的可解释性,而非精度提升。
AI.motivation: 深度销售预测模型虽然准确但缺乏可解释性,当预测驱动补货等关键业务决策时,从业者不仅需要"预测多少",更需要"为什么"。现有可解释性架构(N-BEATS、TFT等)要求重新训练并切换模型,代价高昂。本文旨在为已部署的预测器提供事后、与架构无关的反事实归因层,并严格评估其忠实度。
AI.method: 1) 多序列WaveNet骨干:8层扩张因果卷积(dilation 1-128),门控激活tanh·σ,32滤波器/层,核大小3,感受野覆盖全部90天输入窗口;每序列学习8维嵌入,输入含销售通道与onpromotion协变量(C=1);在log(1+x)空间以NWRMSLE对齐目标训练,直接输出16天全horizon预测。2) 反事实归因:将输入位置划分为有序组(如季节模式、近期趋势、促销),从完全基线输入开始按顺序揭示各组,每组贡献=f(m_k)-f(m_{k-1}),贡献精确求和等于预测值(避免SHAP式加性分配的归零伪影)。3) 忠实度评估:采用Petsiuk等(2018)的删除/插入协议,对30个序列按归因重要性排序扰动输入,衡量与随机排序的间隔并进行单样本t检验。
AI.result: 1) 预测精度:加入onpromotion协变量使NWRMSLE从0.6137降至0.6102(单模型对比,60个epoch,epoch 43选为检查点)。2) 忠实度:30个序列上删除间隔均值0.217(t=4.95, p=2.9e-5),插入间隔均值0.271(t=3.29, p=2.7e-3);五个背景采样种子下删除p均<0.001,插入p均<0.01;但序列间异质性大(删除SD=0.24,插入SD=0.44)。3) 促销依赖度异质:40个序列中位比1.02,均值2.70受长尾拉动,仅约20%序列比>2。4) 周周期捕捉:300个序列聚合下日类型轮廓r=0.78(p=0.04),形状恢复但振幅系统性衰减,谷底错位于周四而非实际周四低点。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献不是精度提升,而是为已部署的多序列预测器提供了经过严格忠实度验证的事后可解释性层。反事实构造确保贡献精确求和等于预测值,删除/插入测试以高显著性证实归因反映真实模型行为而非表观合理的人工制品。诚实刻画了方法的边界:归因仅对少数序列信息丰富,促销依赖度在序列间高度异质,模型对周周期形状恢复良好但振幅受训练目标(回归到均值)与90天窗口结构性限制而衰减。未来工作包括扩展至其他数据集/预测器及引入已知未来协变量。归因应被理解为关于模型行为的陈述而非关于世界的因果主张。

title: Federated Attack Campaign Detection via Contrastive Encoding of Threat Indicators in Gradient Updates
comment: Accepted to ECML-PKDD 2026, 4th Workshop on Advancements in Federated Learning - Towards Trustworthy Federated Learning
summary: Detecting orchestrated cyberattack campaigns that span multiple organizations traditionally requires sharing sensitive telemetry and threat intelligence across institutional boundaries and country borders, a barrier that Federated Learning removes by training shared threat detectors directly on local data. We propose FedIoC, a modular framework in which clients fold locally available structured threat indicators into their gradient updates; we instantiate the client-side encoder with a supervised contrastive loss over IoC-matched flows. Within each training batch, flows that match any known indicator pattern form the positive set; the contrastive objective pulls their learned embeddings together and pushes non-IoC embeddings away, so that campaign-relevant structure is, by design, expressed in the gradient direction. Clients sharing indicators for the same attack campaign then produce aligned gradient components, which the server clusters by the cosine similarity of their updates to recover global campaign patterns without any direct IoC transmission. We evaluate FedIoC on two public threat-detection benchmarks distributed across FL clients that each observe only a fragment of every active campaign and hold disjoint indicator sets derived from their local telemetry. In this regime the FL server recovers cross-organizational campaign cohorts directly from gradient geometry. We contribute FedIoC as a modular framework for this setting, and use it to pinpoint the non-IID gradient structure as the main driver of recovery and to define the open problem of designing encoders that improve on it.

AI.tldr: 提出FedIoC，一种联邦学习框架，通过在客户端使用监督对比损失将IoC知识编码到梯度更新中，服务器通过余弦相似度聚类梯度来恢复跨组织攻击活动，而无需传输原始威胁指标。
AI.motivation: 跨组织的协同网络攻击检测因隐私、法规和组织边界而无法共享敏感遥测和威胁情报。现有联邦学习威胁检测系统仅将IoC视为训练标签，丢弃了STIX元数据中丰富的活动关联信号，未能利用梯度空间传递活动归属信息的能力。
AI.method: 1) 客户端两阶段训练：Phase I执行交叉熵分类任务，Phase II从相同初始权重出发执行IoC加权的监督对比损失（SupCon变体），两阶段伪梯度相加形成传输更新；2) 客户端使用STIX Indicator对象进行样本匹配，置信度作为锚点权重；3) 服务器计算客户端梯度的成对余弦相似度，使用完全链接的凝聚层次聚类（阈值ε）恢复活动分区；4) 与FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD等梯度传输型FL方法兼容。
AI.result: 在CTU-13和UNSW-NB15两个公开基准上，服务器能直接从梯度几何恢复活动群组（CTU-13上Peak ARI达0.97），但IoC加权目标并未带来显著优于标签对比控制和纯FedAvg的提升，提示恢复能力主要源自non-IID梯度结构本身而非IoC特异性编码。分类性能（F1≈0.50）不受IoC编码影响但也未获改善，SCAFFOLD组合不稳定。
AI.conclusion: FedIoC为该问题提供了模块化框架基础，部分肯定地回答了主研究问题：服务器可在不交换原始IoC的前提下通过梯度聚类检测活动群组。然而研究表明该恢复能力主要来自non-IID梯度结构，IoC-身份编码与简单的标签对比控制难以区分。文章定义了一个开放问题：设计能真正优于non-IID基线的IoC编码器。未来工作包括评估更有效的梯度编码方法、任务无关性、流式活动协议以及差分隐私保证。

title: Communication-Efficient Personalized Federated Learning via Layer-Wise Multi-Threshold Random Sketching
summary: Personalized federated learning (PFL) is a promising paradigm for collaborative learning over distributed devices, where edge nodes collaboratively train personalized models without sharing raw data. Although PFL addresses data heterogeneity by learning client-specific models, it still suffers from substantial uplink and downlink communication costs when exchanging high-dimensional parameters in bandwidth-constrained systems. Recent one-bit methods achieve extreme compression, but they usually rely on a single thresholding rule applied to the whole model. This design has two limitations. First, it overlooks layer-wise differences in parameter distributions and quantization sensitivities. Second, a single threshold provides only coarse binary information and cannot capture fine-grained variations in parameter distributions. To address these issues, we propose a communication-efficient PFL framework via layer-wise multi-threshold random sketching. In the proposed method, each layer is assigned its own set of quantization thresholds, so that the compressed representation can adapt to layer-specific statistics while using multiple intervals to provide a finer low-bit description of sketched parameters. The proposed method supports bidirectional communication using compact low-bit sketches and improves the communication-accuracy tradeoff compared with existing one-bit compression approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出pFedLMS，一种面向个性化联邦学习（PFL）的通信高效框架。其核心是分层多阈值随机草图（LMTRS）机制：为每一层神经网络独立分配一组量化阈值（而非全模型使用单一阈值），通过多个区间对草图参数进行更精细的低比特描述。客户端将草图编码为(T+1)进制符号并以二进制流上传，服务端通过加权多数投票聚合后同样以低比特形式下行广播。理论分析了非凸随机优化框架的收敛性，实验在五个数据集上验证了在极端带宽受限下通信开销降低约98%的同时保持个性化精度。
AI.motivation: 个性化联邦学习虽然通过学习客户端特定模型缓解了数据异构性，但在带宽受限的边缘系统中反复交换高维模型参数仍造成巨大的上下行通信开销。现有一比特压缩方法（如pFed1BS）通常对整个模型施加单一的全局阈值规则，存在两大局限：(1) 忽略了不同网络层之间参数分布和量化敏感性的显著差异；(2) 单一阈值仅能提供粗粒度的二元信息，无法捕捉参数分布的细粒度变化。因此需要一种层感知且更精细的低比特压缩方案。
