AI.method: 方法名为pFedLMS（personalized Federated Learning via Layer-wise Multi-threshold random Sketching）。关键技术包括：(1) 分层随机草图：为每一层ℓ分配独立草图算子Φℓ（维度mℓ≪nℓ，如归一化Hadamard投影）和T个有序量化阈值τℓ,1<…<τℓ,T；(2) 多阈值量化：客户端计算sign(Φℓθk,ℓ−τℓ,t·1)得到T个±1比较向量bℓ,tk，整合为(T+1)进制符号qk,ℓ∈{0,…,T}mℓ；(3) 紧凑双向通信协议：通过base-(T+1)编码将qk,ℓ转为二进制流上传，每层开销为⌈mℓ log₂(T+1)⌉比特；服务端经加权多数投票生成一致信号V（Lemma 1证明为加权不一致目标J的闭式最优解），同样以低比特广播；(4) 阈值自适应更新：服务端基于各客户端上传的草图均值与方差聚合层级高斯分布参数，按分位数q_t=t/(T+1)动态生成下一轮阈值；(5) 多阈值对齐正则化器ℛ(θk;V)与Nesterov平滑近似R̃ρ用于客户端本地训练，其诱导区间一致性（Lemma 2-3：聚合符号序列将实数轴划分为(T+1)个区间，内部区间宽度随T增大以O(1/T)细化）。
AI.result: 在MNIST、FMNIST、SVHN、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100五个数据集上以20客户端、Dirichlet非IID设置（α=0.1和0.5）对比FedAvg、OBDA、OBCSAA、FedProto、EDEN、zSignFed、pFed1MS等基线。pFedLMS（T=7，默认3比特/坐标）相对FedAvg通信开销降低约98.3%-98.8%（CIFAR-100由1495.34MB降至25.05MB）。在α=0.5下CIFAR-10/100分别超越pFed1BS 9.17%和13.49%；在α=0.1下CIFAR-100超越pFed1BS 10.85%。消融实验（SVHN/CIFAR-10）证实层感知设计（+0.51%/+1.21%）与多阈值设计（+1.61%/+2.49%）互补，T从1增至7精度单调提升但增益递减。理论证明平均梯度范数上界为O(1/(ηER))+L_Fησ²+2λβ^r/(ηER)，包含随机梯度噪声项和由共识、阈值、草图算子跨轮变化引起的漂移项β^r（Lemma 7界定）。
AI.conclusion: pFedLMS通过分层多阈值随机草图机制突破了传统单阈值一比特压缩的局限，在保持个性化精度的同时大幅降低联邦学习上下行通信成本。该框架首次为PFL提供了结构感知且分辨率可调的低比特双向通信方案，理论收敛性分析和实验结果均表明其在通信-精度权衡上优于现有代表性基线，特别适合带宽受限的边缘智能场景。未来的工作可探索自适应阈值数量T与不同网络架构间的协同优化。

title: PACE: Propagation-Aware Collaborative Correction for One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning
summary: Client heterogeneity creates both an opportunity and a risk in personalized federated graph learning. Knowledge held by other subgraphs may complement a receiver's Local model, but an incompatible transfer can override reliable predictions. One-shot communication sharpens this tension because an unsuitable server return cannot be corrected later. We introduce PACE, which treats collaborative knowledge as a compact correction to a complete Local predictor rather than as its replacement. Each client uploads a rank-r update carrier and a diagonal sketch of propagated message moments. The server uses them to construct a propagation-aware, receiver-anchored correction, while the receiver retains its full Local model. Convex negative-log-likelihood calibration (CNLL) then selects one coefficient between Local and External logits using validation nodes; model parameters remain fixed and no feedback is sent. At Rank-6, personalized returns occupy 9.6-17.6% of dense tensor bytes across the six evaluated datasets. The correction receives nonzero weight and improves both Accuracy and weighted-F1 over Local on five datasets; on ogbn-arxiv, CNLL assigns zero predictive weight to the correction and preserves Local predictions exactly. Applying the same CNLL rule to matched baselines on three citation datasets does not account for these gains. The central result is therefore that a small transported correction can augment a complete Local model when receiver evidence supports it while leaving the Local prediction unchanged otherwise.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE方法：通过传播感知的低秩修正和接收端CNLL校准，在一次性通信的个性化联邦图学习中，以紧凑通信量实现对完整本地模型的选择性增强。
AI.motivation: 客户端异构性既带来机会也带来风险——其他子图的互补知识可能有益，但不适配的传输会覆盖可靠的本地预测；一次性通信下无后续修正机会，因此需要一种既能传输共享知识又能让接收端控制其影响的机制。
AI.method: PACE包含两个阶段：(1) 传输阶段——客户端上传秩-r更新载体和传播消息的二阶矩对角草图，服务端通过自包含RegMean共识生成接收端锚定的低秩修正；(2) 校准阶段——接收端通过凸负对数似然校准（CNLL）在本地与外部logits之间选择单一凸系数α，不更新参数且无反馈通信。
AI.result: 在六个图基准数据集上，秩-6个性化回传仅占稠密张量字节的9.6-17.6%；五个数据集上PACE在准确率和加权F1上均优于本地模型，ogbn-arxiv上CNLL选择α=0完全保留本地预测；匹配校准控制表明PACE增益不能仅由CNLL解释。
AI.conclusion: 小型传输修正可以在接收端证据支持时增强完整本地模型，在不支持时保持本地预测不变——核心贡献是这种接收端依赖的紧凑修正接口，而非通用性能优势。

title: KVMem: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on a Consumer GPU
summary: Modern LLM agents operate in persistent workspaces whose accumulated history can exceed both GPU KV capacity and the model's native context window. Existing systems typically compact older context into summaries or retrieve it later as text, either losing fine-grained execution evidence or repeatedly prefilling content that the model has already processed. We present KVMem, a KV-context virtualization system that preserves overflowed workspace history as paged KV state across GPU memory, host memory, and NVMe. KVMem uses lightweight, model-native attention-space indexes to select relevant historical blocks and materializes a query-dependent execution view bounded by the model's native context window. Extensive evaluations on long-context agent benchmarks spanning histories up to one million tokens, including LongMemEval, MemoryAgentBench, and AgentLongBench, show that KVMem generally achieves higher task utility and greater inference efficiency than compaction-based approaches, the de facto standard for handling context overflow. In the DeepSWE long-context test with Qwen3.8-27B, KVMem improves task success from 43.8% with compaction-only context management to 48.4%. In our local-deployment evaluation, KVMem runs Qwen3.6/3.8-27B NVFP4 with MTP on an off-the-shelf laptop equipped with a 24\,GB RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, virtualizing agent workspaces of up to 1M tokens-four times the model's native 256K-token context window. In a single-session setting, KVMem generates $\sim$50 tokens/s, providing interactive responsiveness for local agent execution. More broadly, by decoupling addressable workspace size from the LLM's native context window, KVMem provides a practical path toward long-running agents whose workspaces can grow beyond that window.

AI.tldr: KVMem提出了一种KV上下文虚拟化系统，将LLM智能体的工作空间历史作为分页KV块保存在GPU、主机内存和NVMe中，通过模型原生注意力空间的轻量级索引选择相关历史块，并在模型原生上下文窗口内构建查询相关的执行视图，从而将可寻址工作空间大小与GPU实际驻留的KV容量以及模型的原生上下文窗口解耦。该系统在消费级RTX 5090笔记本GPU上实现了百万token级工作空间（约50 tokens/s），并在DeepSWE长时软件工程任务上将Pass@1从43.8%提升至48.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在处理持续增长的工作空间历史时，主要采用压缩（compaction）或文本检索方式，但压缩会丢失细粒度执行证据，而检索需要重新prefill已计算过的内容，造成固定效率与保真度之间的张力。现有系统将历史处理为文本，而非保留可复用的KV计算结果，导致上下文管理成为长时智能体的核心瓶颈。
AI.method: KVMem包含三大核心机制：（1）步级记忆调度（Step-level memory scheduling），基于相邻agent步骤间注意力分布KL散度（约37倍跳跃）的观察，在prefill之后、解码之前进行一次工作集更新；（2）查询条件KV检索（Query-conditioned KV retrieval），使用去除RoPE后的Mean-K紧凑表示对每个32-token逻辑块建立索引，并在模型的注意力空间中直接打分；（3）分层KV管理（Tiered KV management），分离仓库视图与执行视图，通过主动stage-out、基于检索频率的分层复用以及打包流水线化的KV重映射实现高效恢复。系统基于自研QW3推理引擎实现，支持重新RoPE（re-RoPE）以保证位置一致性。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-S上KVMem达到85.6%准确率（接近Full Context的86.6%）；在MemoryAgentBench（>256K）上KVMem总体得分40.99%，优于Compact+RAG（34.80%）；在AgentLongBench（≤256K）上以60.87%的任务成功率超越Full Context（59.54%）。DeepSWE v1.1前16个任务中，KVMem使Qwen3.8-27B的Pass@1从43.8%提升至48.4%，Pass@4从81.3%提升至93.8%，同时agent耗时降低12.8%、prefill时间减少55.1%。消费级RTX 5090笔记本上可支持1M token虚拟工作空间与80K执行视图，单会话约50 tokens/s；服务器平台上可将工作空间扩展至10M token，TTFT仅1.6s。
AI.conclusion: KVMem通过KV上下文虚拟化将智能体可寻址工作空间与GPU实际KV容量及模型原生上下文窗口解耦，使得长时智能体的工作空间可在消费级硬件上扩展到百万甚至千万token级，同时保持高任务效用与低推理开销，为长运行智能体提供了实用路径。

title: When Genomic Masking Priors Fail to Transfer: Strong Variant Prediction, Weak Functional Generation
summary: Bidirectional discrete diffusion model appears naturally suited to genomic modeling because it can reconstruct missing sequence from both flanks. We developed GenDA (Genomic Density-optimized Absorbing Diffusion) under the additional hypothesis that entropy-guided span placement would concentrate reconstruction pressure on compositionally complex regions, improving both downstream variant-effect prediction and functional sequence generation. Our results only partially support this premise. After supervised fine-tuning, the 202M-parameter GenDA model reaches a pooled ClinVar SNV AUROC of 0.774, exceeding a similarly scaled autoregressive model by 0.103. However, a matched random-span variant reaches 0.777, providing no evidence that entropy guidance causes the ClinVar improvement. More unexpectedly, GenDA fails a zero-shot functional inpainting stress test: across promoters, enhancers, exon boundaries, and intron boundaries, it does not consistently outperform a control that shuffles the native gap while exactly preserving 3-mer composition. Failure is already present for 50--500-bp gaps, although enhancer degradation worsens at longer gaps. Diagnostics identify several boundary conditions: entropy measures local sequence complexity rather than functional importance; 1-mer tokenization limits physical context; training spans are capped at 300 bp; and high absolute AlphaGenome fidelity can coexist with negative control-normalized restoration. These results show that strong fine-tuned variant prediction, a plausible corruption prior, and functional generation are distinct claims that require separate validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenDA（基因组密度优化吸收扩散）模型，测试双向离散扩散+熵引导片段掩码是否能同时提升变异预测与功能生成。结论是：微调后变异预测强（ClinVar AUROC 0.774，超越AR基线），但熵引导先验并不优于随机片段，且零样本功能修复（基于AlphaGenome）全面失败，无法持续击败保留成分的对照洗牌。
AI.motivation: 基因组基础模型通常以似然、变异预测或下游基准评估，但这些并不等同于模型能生成保持位点特异性分子功能的序列。双向掩码扩散天然适合基因组修复；作者进一步假设"熵引导片段放置"能将重建压力集中于组成复杂区域，从而提升预测与生成。然而该先验是否成立、是否可迁移到生成任务，尚未验证。
AI.method: GenDA：基于ModernBERT（202M参数）的吸收离散扩散；片段掩码以局部香农熵H_i与核苷酸密度D_i的乘积D_i·H_i²为权重偏置采样起点；片段长度服从裁剪泊松分布（λ=100，上限300bp）；采用三阶段渐进掩码课程；迭代解码采用sin((t+1)/T·π/2)置信度保留调度；基线为同规模自回归Llama（151M）。评估包含ClinVar SNV AUROC以及AlphaGenome驱动的零样本修复（promoter CAGE、enhancer H3K27ac、剪接位点使用），引入3-mer保留的洗牌对照计算修复增益RG。
AI.result: 鉴别能力：GenDA微调后pooled ClinVar AUROC 0.774，超自回归基线0.103；但随机片段变体达到0.777，熵引导并无统一优势。功能生成：在50–3500bp gap下，GenDA、AR Llama、Evo 2、D3LM均无法持续超过3-mer保留对照；promoter/enhancer RG全部为负；GenDA增强子RG极差（−130.8，长gap达−277.9）。GenDA+BioCheck启发式可改善增强子但损害启动子。1-mer分词+4096上下文+300bp片段上限形成评估中数千bp gap的"几何失配"。
AI.conclusion: 强鉴别性能、可信的破坏先验与功能性生成是三个独立命题，需分别验证。序列复杂度≠功能重要性；强fine-tuned预测不能证明模型学到了有用的条件生成分布。作者提出五项评估建议：报告成分保留对照、区分绝对保真与对照归一化修复、按训练corruption尺度分层、单独评估鉴别与生成能力、将生物学引导视为多目标权衡。本研究为基因组生成器提供了可证伪的诊断协议而非通用保证。

title: From Deep to Shallow: Unconstrained and Efficient Layer Merging Strategy
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, accepted at the ITEM Workshop at ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Although Deep Neural Networks have become foundational in many areas of Machine Learning, high computational demands limit their application in resource-constrained environments. To address this issue, depth compression methods have been proposed to identify and linearize redundant activation functions, thereby allowing for the merging of layers without intermediate non-linearities. However, these methods face two key challenges: they cannot be directly applied to convolutions with padding due to the absence of an analytical solution for merging these layers, and they typically increase the kernel size of merged layers, thus limiting speed-up gains. To overcome these limitations, we propose an efficient strategy that enables merging of layers without an existing analytical solution, and also without increasing kernel size. We validate our approach across multiple architectures and datasets, and measure inference speed-up gains on real embedded platforms. We publicly released the code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于学习的层合并策略，用于深度压缩神经网络，解决了传统解析合并方法在卷积含padding时无闭式解以及合并后核尺寸增大导致推理加速受限两大问题。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在资源受限设备上部署困难；现有深度压缩方法通过线性化激活函数合并相邻线性层，但解析合并方案在卷积含非零padding时无闭式解，且合并后核尺寸增大（5×5）会抵消加速收益。
AI.method: 提出一种基于损失的层合并策略：从已线性化的参考模型出发，将连续线性层块替换为单一可训练层（卷积或全连接层），通过组合损失（交叉熵损失+蒸馏损失+激活图对齐损失）进行微调，仅优化合并层而冻结其余参数。该方法适用于任意padding、stride、dilation配置，且允许选择比解析合并更紧凑的核尺寸（如保持3×3或采用深度可分离卷积）。
AI.result: 在ResNet18/50、MobileNetv2、Swin-T等架构及CIFAR-10/ImageNet-1k数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持（或略超）参考模型精度的同时，在RTX 2080 Ti、Jetson Orin、树莓派5等平台上均实现了推理加速。例如ResNet18在ImageNet上精度从63.10%提升至64.20%，树莓派5上加速17ms；保持3×3核尺寸比解析合并所需的5×5核在边缘设备上获得更显著的加速（1.12–1.17× vs 0.74–1.01×）；微调收敛时间仅14分钟，远快于全量微调（43分钟）。消融实验验证了三个损失项的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为在资源受限设备上部署压缩深度网络提供了一种通用解决方案，能够将激活函数线性化有效转化为实际推理加速，且不依赖于特定的线性化算法。

title: Fast Gauss Sums via Flash Attention
summary: Gaussian kernel sums are the computational core of maximum mean discrepancies (MMDs), kernel gradient flows, Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), and many other kernel methods. At the same time, softmax attention has received an extraordinary amount of hardware-aware code engineering, culminating in flash attention. We show that Gauss kernel sums with arbitrary, signed weights can be evaluated via flash attention: two small input augmentations turn the normalized softmax reduction into the unnormalized Gauss sum, without writing a single line of custom GPU code. For feature dimension D>8 in fp16, this approach beats compiled PyTorch code as well as PyKeOps kernels (often significantly) in speed, memory-overhead and accuracy. Indeed, its memory scaling remains linear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过 Flash Attention 高效计算高斯核和（带任意带符号权重），无需编写自定义 GPU 代码。在 fp16 且特征维度 D>8 时，速度、内存和精度均优于编译版 PyTorch 和 PyKeOps。
AI.motivation: 高斯核和是 MMD、核梯度流、SVGD 等核方法的核心计算瓶颈。直接计算复杂度为 O(MN(C+D))，内存 O(MN)。虽然 Flash Attention 已通过硬件感知优化极大加速了 softmax 注意力，但目前缺乏利用此优化来加速未归一化高斯核和的统一方法。
AI.method: 提出两种输入增广方法将高斯核和归约为 Flash Attention：(1) "prescale" 方法通过修改 value 向量并利用注意力后端返回的 logits 进行补偿；(2) "reweight" 方法通过在 query 和 key 中附加额外维度构造稳定的比率形式 κα/β，无需访问 logits，从而支持 PyTorch 自动微分及反向传播。还分析了 fp16 精度下的稳定性边界（Proposition 1）。
AI.result: 在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上的 benchmark 显示：在 fp16、D>8 时，Flash 变体比 PyKeOps 前向快 2–21 倍、带梯度时快 3–10 倍，误差最多低 7 倍，内存开销呈线性。在 D=3、C=1 低维情形下 PyKeOps 仍具优势；但在 D≥16 时 Flash 变体全面胜出。fp32 下由于 Flash 不可用，PyKeOps 仍为最优。
AI.conclusion: 两种 Flash Attention 增广方法为带符号权重的高斯核和提供了快速、内存高效的 drop-in 替代方案，在 fp16 下表现卓越。未来工作方向是将常数级加速与次二次近似相结合。

title: Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints for Scalable Power Grid Graph Classification
comment: power system, power system security, cascading failures, graph classification, random walk fingerprints, physics-aware features
summary: Recent benchmarks such as PowerGraph provide large collections of power-grid graphs for cascading-failure classification. Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on this task, but typically require end-to-end training and model-specific tuning, while their latent representations can be difficult to relate to physically meaningful propagation patterns. Random Walk Fingerprints (RWF) offer a scalable and interpretable alternative, but existing variants primarily emphasise topology and node-level information, leaving grid-relevant operational edge states in the walk dynamics. We propose Multi-Channel Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints (MC-PA-RWF) for power systems, a lightweight graph-level representation framework that introduces physical edge states into random-walk propagation. The method constructs multiple edge-weighted channels from domain-relevant attributes, extracts a channel-specific fingerprint from each weighted graph, and concatenates the resulting vectors into a compact representation. Experiments on three \textit{PowerGraph} benchmark systems show substantial improvements over topology-only RWF and competitive balanced accuracy against strong GNN baselines, including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), Graph Attention Networks (GAT), Graph Isomorphism Networks with edge features (GINE), and Transformer-based Graph Convolutional Networks (TransformerConv). At the largest evaluated settings, the node-edge extension MC-PA-RWF+ achieves around 98.04% - 99.32% balanced accuracy and improves failure-class F1 over the strongest GNN baseline by 1.60 -- 5.84 percentage points, with statistically significant gains across all three systems.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-PA-RWF，一种将电力系统物理边状态（潮流强度、容量裕度、耦合强度、过载严重程度）融入随机游走指纹的轻量级图分类框架，在PowerGraph基准上以非神经网络方法匹配或超越强GNN基线，并在失效类别F1上取得统计显著的提升。
AI.motivation: 电网级联故障分类中，拓扑信息和节点特征不足以区分具有相同结构但不同运行状态的线路；现有RWF方法主要由拓扑驱动，缺乏对物理边状态的显式建模。GNN虽有效但训练复杂且表征难以物理解释。因此需要一个可扩展、可解释且能融合物理边状态的图表示方法。
AI.method: 构建多种物理边加权通道（FI、CM、CS、OS四组），从有向/符号边属性导出非负对称权重并做中位数缩放与裁剪；在每个通道上做对称归一化随机游走矩阵，提取基于度的结构分组与多步游走统计（loop、within-group、cross-group），将各通道指纹拼接为图级向量；MC-PA-RWF+进一步拼接RWF-D-feature块融合节点属性；分类器使用SVM。
AI.result: 在IEEE24、IEEE39、UK三个PowerGraph系统上，MC-PA-RWF+在最大数据集规模下平衡准确率达98.04%–99.32%；相比最强GNN基线TransformerConv，失效类F1提升1.60–5.84个百分点（p<0.05，统计显著）；通道分析显示FI/CM/OS贡献大，CS单独使用信息量有限；多通道融合提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模边状态依赖的传播能同时提升整体分类性能和关键失效场景识别能力；动态边属性比静态属性更具判别力；MC-PA-RWF是面向电网的可扩展、透明替代方案，保持关于图数量的线性复杂度。

title: Fractal basins trap latent reasoning
summary: Reasoning allows artificial intelligence models to revisit and correct their mistakes, enabling recent frontier advances in mathematical theorem solving, software engineering, and autonomous task planning. Reasoning models are widely observed to reason for longer on harder tasks, but the general mechanism responsible for these slowdowns is unknown. Here, we show that reasoning models exhibit transient chaos, a physical consequence of the computational complexity of difficult tasks. As a consequence, we show that diverse leading reasoning models are dynamical systems with fractal basins, with fractality increasing with task difficulty across diverse tasks like Sudoku and maze solving, visual puzzles, and mathematical logic. We show that transient chaos emerges due to reasoning becoming trapped for extended durations near saddle points, which we show correspond to nearly-correct attempted solutions of the underlying problem. Our results show that reasoning slowdowns are an inevitable consequence of problem hardness in modern artificial intelligence models, and establish reasoning traces as a rich new class of dynamical system.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示现代AI推理模型在解决困难任务时展现出与动力系统中瞬态混沌相关的分形吸引盆地结构,提出推理慢速化是问题难度的必然物理后果。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在困难任务上常出现"过度思考"现象(推理时间显著延长但准确率不提升),现有解释仅停留在"需要探索更大解空间"的直觉层面,缺乏对其内在动力学机制的理解。本研究旨在从动力系统理论角度,为推理慢速化提供物理层面的机制性解释。
AI.method: 将循环推理模型视为由任务和权重参数化的离散时间动力系统,通过在二维随机切片上系统扫描初始潜状态来探测收敛时间盆地。采用盆地熵、不确定性指数等指标量化分形程度;使用快速Lyapunov指标(λ_F)定位鞍点边界;通过PCA投影和解码潜状态识别鞍点对应的"几乎正确但错误"的中间解;训练小型循环Transformer求解整数线性系统以追踪训练过程中的分叉动力学,并计算有限时间Lyapunov指数谱分析不稳定方向。
AI.result: 1) 在Sudoku、迷宫、ARC-AGI视觉谜题、Countdown数学逻辑等多种任务及多种架构(EqR、FPRM、Parcae、Tiny Recursive Model)中均观察到分形盆地,且分形度随任务难度单调增加;2) 分形盆地源于瞬态混沌——轨迹在弱不稳定鞍点(对应"几乎正确"的尝试解,如数独中重复数字的网格、迷宫中的死胡同)附近长时间徘徊后被散射;3) 训练过程中存在分叉点:模型从多稳态(多个错误解)转变为单一正确吸引子,错误解失稳成为鞍点,同时盆地熵和鞍点逃逸方向数骤增,正Lyapunov指数仅出现在需要多步高斯消元的"核心变量"上;4) 不同模型可能产生"真分形"或"slim fractal"(尺度依赖),后者对应耗散系统中的双重瞬态混沌。
AI.conclusion: 推理慢速化是现代AI模型处理计算复杂性问题时不可避免的物理后果;推理轨迹构成了一类全新的动力系统;模型能力与其逃逸错误解鞍点的能力直接相关。该工作将非线性动力系统经典物理与AI离散符号推理联系起来,支持将计算视为物理过程、将复杂度视为物理量的传统观点。

title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve superior problem-solving through extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, but the resulting key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and creates severe memory bottlenecks, often exceeding GPU capacity for long reasoning traces. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on recent queries to estimate future token importance, implicitly assuming these serve as reliable proxies for future attention patterns. We demonstrate that this assumption fails in long-horizon reasoning: certain decoding steps generate Thought Revisiting Tokens (TRT) that re-attend to distant previous context, such as task-solving plans formulated early in the trace. Through systematic analysis, we discover that queries corresponding to the TRT cluster into a small number of similarity groups in the embedding space. Based on this insight, we propose BeaconKV, a training-free KV cache compression method that maintains beacon queries, compact representatives for each global query cluster, to anticipate which KV pairs will be revisited without storing the entire query history. Across four open-source LRMs and diverse reasoning benchmarks, BeaconKV generally outperforms existing compression methods, achieving up to $5.8\times$ memory reduction while nearly preserving full cache accuracy and improving throughput by over $4.3\times$.

AI.tldr: BeaconKV 是一种针对大型推理模型（LRM）的免训练 KV Cache 压缩方法。它通过维护“信标查询”（beacon queries）——即从历史全局查询的聚类中选取的几何代表性查询——来预测远端关键 KV 对被回访的可能性，从而在长链思维推理中以低内存开销保留重要上下文。
AI.motivation: LRM 在长 CoT 推理过程中产生极长的序列，导致 KV Cache 线性增长并耗尽 GPU 显存。现有压缩方法（如 RPC、R-KV）仅依赖"最近查询"来估计未来的注意力模式，但这一假设在长程推理中会失效：模型会生成"思维回访标记"（Thought Revisiting Tokens, TRT），这些标记会重新关注推理早期建立的远端上下文（如解题计划），而基于最近查询的方法会过早驱逐这些关键 KV 对。
AI.method: 1) 提出 TRT 现象：分析发现全局查询在 pre-RoPE 嵌入空间中聚成少量相似簇。2) 设计 BeaconKV：用"持续最远点采样"（Continual FPS）从累积的查询历史中持续维护一组紧凑的"信标查询"（每簇代表），与最近查询一起作为观测查询集。3) 关键设计：信标查询对齐到当前解码步 t 以模拟全局回访；最近查询保留原始位置；采用 max 聚合而非 mean 聚合以保留 TRT 的稀疏高幅信号；周期性触发 KV Cache 驱逐。4) 维持 prefix 和最新 token，剩余预算按分数 top-K 填充。
AI.result: 在 R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/8B、Qwen3-4B/14B 四个模型上，对 AIME24、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench 四个推理基准进行评估：相比 RPC、R-KV、SnapKV 等基线，BeaconKV 在同等内存预算下准确率最高，低预算时最大领先 31.7 个百分点；峰值显存降低最高 5.8×（77GB→13.3GB），吞吐量提升超过 4.3×（82.3→356.4 tokens/s）；16 个最近查询 + 16 个信标查询为最佳配置，max 聚合优于 mean。
AI.conclusion: BeaconKV 是一种无需训练的 KV Cache 压缩框架，通过挖掘查询嵌入空间的几何结构（信标查询）来识别长 CoT 中将被思维回访标记重新关注的远端 KV 对。它在大幅降低显存（最高 5.8×）和提升吞吐（4.3×）的同时，保留了接近完整 KV 推理的精度，显著优于依赖最近查询的现有压缩方法，可有效推动 LRM 在受限 GPU 资源下的部署。局限：对非推理长上下文任务评估不足，超参数为固定值，未来可探索自适应压缩策略。

title: Beyond Homoscedasticity: Decoupled Uncertainty Optimization for Deep Imbalanced Regression
comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). Main paper with supplementary material
summary: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) is pervasive in continuous prediction tasks across diverse modalities, such as age estimation, depth prediction, and protein mutation activity prediction, where label-scarce tail samples often carry higher practical value. However, most existing methods still learn deterministic point mappings under mean squared error or its simple variants, implicitly assuming a uniform uncertainty level across all samples and thereby overlooking the instance-wise heteroscedasticity that is widespread in long-tailed data. We further point out that even heteroscedastic negative log-likelihood suffers from a gradient coupling issue, which, under DIR scenarios, weakens the learning signal of hard tail samples and leads to optimization inertia as well as tail underfitting. To address this, we propose DUO, an uncertainty-aware long-tailed regression framework. Specifically, the proposed method models the regression target as a conditional Gaussian distribution to explicitly characterize instance-level predictive uncertainty, and transforms uncertainty into a dynamic enhancement signal for tail samples through decoupled mean-variance optimization. Furthermore, we design a distribution-guided contrastive learning mechanism that adaptively constructs positive and negative pairs based on the overlap between sample distributions, thereby alleviating feature looseness and cross-label semantic entanglement. Across visual and biological DIR benchmarks, DUO achieves the best few-shot bMAE and GM on IMDB-WIKI-DIR, AgeDB-DIR, and AAV2-DIR while remaining competitive on few-shot MAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUO框架,通过条件高斯建模和均值-方差解耦优化,解决深度不平衡回归中传统MSE损失假设同方差性而忽略实例级异方差性的问题,结合基于Bhattacharyya系数的分布引导对比学习缓解尾部样本特征纠缠。
AI.motivation: 深度不平衡回归(DIR)中,标签呈长尾分布,尾部稀缺样本具有重要实际价值。现有方法普遍采用MSE损失,隐含同方差假设,忽略了长尾数据中广泛存在的实例级异方差性。此外,即使采用异方差负对数似然(NLL),也面临梯度耦合问题——尾部难样本需要最大修正却获得最弱学习信号,导致优化惯性和尾部欠拟合。
AI.method: DUO框架包含三大组件:(1)将回归目标建模为条件高斯分布,通过双分支头同时预测均值μ̂(x)和不确定性σ̂(x);(2)解耦均值-方差优化:使用stop-gradient算子,均值损失以动态难度权重γ=(1+w(y)·sg[σ̂(x)])放大尾部样本梯度,方差损失以固定残差为目标优化σ̂;(3)基于Bhattacharyya系数的分布引导对比学习:以预测方差构建标签锚定代理分布,动态划分正负样本对,并对语义不相容负样本施加逆BC权重以增强排斥。训练采用warm-up策略,先优化均值和方差损失,再激活对比对齐损失。
AI.result: 在IMDB-WIKI-DIR、AgeDB-DIR、NYUD2-DIR和AAV2-DIR四个基准上,DUO在few-shot区域的bMAE和GM均达到最优,在AAV2-DIR上few-shot MAE/bMAE/GM分别为4.106/4.329/3.777,均最佳。消融实验验证了解耦目标和对比学习各自的有效性,超参数λ=1.0为最佳。配对实验表明DUO可作为插件提升LDS、FDS、Balanced MSE等基线方法。t-SNE可视化显示DUO产生更连续、纠缠更少的特征流形。
AI.conclusion: DUO通过将样本级不确定性建模与解耦优化及分布引导对比学习相结合,为深度不平衡回归提供了有效解决方案。实验证明实例级不确定性可作为长尾回归中鲁棒学习的有效信号,在尾部稀缺区域取得显著提升,代价是某些整体或many-shot指标的轻微权衡。

title: Confounding-Valid Conformal Inference for Counterfactual KPIs in Wireless Networks
summary: Conformal counterfactual inference enables network operators to use logged telemetry to reliably answer 'what-if' questions about network operation. These answers typically take the form of prediction sets that contain, with a user-defined probability, the key performance indicators (KPIs) that would have been observed under alternative control actions. A key challenge is that logged telemetry may omit variables used by the controller, resulting in hidden confounding and invalidating the statistical guarantees of counterfactual analysis. In principle, this issue can be addressed using randomized telemetry, collected by assigning control actions independently of the network state. However, because such randomization may disrupt normal operation, randomized telemetry is typically scarce, causing counterfactual analysis based solely on it to produce uninformative prediction sets. To address these challenges, we propose Confounding-Valid Counterfactual Conformal Inference (CV-CCI), which combines abundant, potentially confounded observational telemetry with limited randomized data through the General Synthetic-Powered Inference (GESPI) principle. CV-CCI leverages observational data to improve efficiency while using randomized data to retain finite-sample coverage guarantees under arbitrary hidden confounding. Experiments on two representative radio access network (RAN) control tasks show that CV-CCI remains valid under hidden confounding while producing more efficient prediction sets than state-of-the-art confounding-valid baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CV-CCI方法，通过结合少量随机化遥测与大量可能含隐藏混杂的观测遥测，为无线网络反事实KPI推断构建有限样本覆盖保证的预测集合。
AI.motivation: 无线网络控制器依据完整上下文（包括未记录于遥测中的隐变量U）选择动作，但分析师仅能观测到部分上下文X̃，导致隐藏混杂问题，使得仅依赖观测遥测的反事实推断覆盖保证失效。而随机化遥测虽能保证有效性，但因干扰正常运行而稀缺，导致预测集合信息量不足。需要在有效性与信息量之间取得平衡。
AI.method: CV-CCI基于GESPI（通用合成驱动推断）框架，将加权共形预测（WCP）作为基础推断程序。算法构造三个预测集合：仅基于随机化数据的集合、基于观测与随机化混合池化数据的集合（通过似然比加权）、以及保护性集合（guardrail，在放松水平α+ε下基于随机化数据）。最终集合通过公式 Γ^CV-CCI = Γ^rnd ∩ (Γ^pool ∪ Γ^guard) 聚合，保证 Γ^guard ⊆ Γ^CV-CCI ⊆ Γ^rnd。
AI.result: 在MAC层调度与切换两个RAN控制任务上的实验表明：随着混杂强度λ增加，CCKE和wSCP-DR Inexact的覆盖率从约0.91降至0.67-0.78（违反名义水平0.90），而CV-CCI在所有λ值下保持接近名义水平的覆盖（≥0.90），且预测区间显著窄于wSCP-DR Exact。CV-CCI的经验失败概率（如26%）也远低于Guardrail基线（如41%），表明其在有限随机化样本下变异性更低。
AI.conclusion: CV-CCI成功地在隐藏混杂下构建了既有效又高效的反事实KPI预测集合，无需观测或建模隐藏混杂变量。未来工作将扩展至序贯/在线反事实推断、干扰感知的多控制器场景以及自适应主动干预策略。

title: Deep Microcompression: Structured Pruning and Bit-packed Quantization for Microcontrollers
comment: Presented at the Global South ML Workshop at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea
summary: This paper introduces Deep Microcompression (DMC), a hardware-aware pipeline for deep learning inference on bare-metal microcontrollers. DMC integrates structured pruning, quantization-aware training, and fixed-length bit-packing to achieve a 55.8$\times$ weight compression ratio on LeNet-5 (98.77\% accuracy), generating a dependency-free C library with deterministic latency. On the RP2040 (Cortex-M0+), DMC reduces binary size by 3$\times$ versus TensorFlow Lite while matching its accuracy. Critically, DMC enables the first documented deployment of a standard CNN on the ATmega328P, a device constrained to 2KB SRAM, previously considered infeasible for CNN inference.

AI.tldr: Deep Microcompression (DMC) 是一个面向裸机微控制器的硬件感知深度学习压缩流水线，通过结合结构化剪枝、量化感知训练和定长位打包，实现了 LeNet-5 模型 55.8× 的权重压缩比，并首次在仅有 2KB SRAM 的 ATmega328P 上成功部署标准 CNN。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络与微控制器硬件资源之间存在日益扩大的鸿沟；现有压缩方法（如 Deep Compression 的 Huffman 编码、非结构化剪枝）依赖可变长解码或稀疏库，无法满足裸机 MCU 的确定性延迟要求。论文特别关注全球南方地区广泛部署的低成本 8 位 MCU（如 Arduino Uno），希望消除云依赖，使本地离线 AI 推理成为可能。
AI.method: DMC 流水线分三阶段：(1) 结构化剪枝——基于 L2 范数准则对卷积层滤波器、全连接层神经元进行通道级剪枝，保留密集内存布局以兼容标准矩阵运算核；(2) 量化感知训练（QAT）——采用静态对称量化，预计算缩放因子，训练阶段模拟离散化噪声以适应低精度约束；(3) 硬件感知定长位打包——将多个低比特权重（如 4 个 2-bit 权重）打包进 uint8 中，反解压通过编译期计算的移位与掩码实现 O(1) 常数时间操作，避免 Huffman 等可变长方案的非确定性延迟。运行时全部使用整数运算，软最大值等非线性通过 Flash 中的查找表近似。
AI.result: 在 LeNet-5/MNIST 上：DMC-Ultra 实现 55.8× 权重压缩（2.66KB vs 145KB），精度仅下降 0.65%（98.77%）；DMC-Tiny 通过激进早期剪枝将峰值激活内存压至 1.27KB，首次在 ATmega328P（2KB SRAM, 32KB Flash）上部署标准 CNN，精度 98.17%。在 RP2040 上对比 TFLite Micro：二进制大小减少 3×（168.5KB），RAM 减少 1.4×，但延迟略高（因未使用 CMSIS-NN）。消融实验显示 -Os 优化相比 -O0 代码大小减少 38.7%，4-bit 打包相比 8-bit 减少 56% 权重存储但增加 20× BOPs，延迟增加 46%。
AI.conclusion: DMC 证明通过结构化剪枝、QAT 与定长位打包的协同设计，可在 8 位裸机 MCU 上实现标准 CNN 推理，填补了深度压缩理论与裸机部署之间的空白。其核心代价是放弃硬件专用加速（如 CMSIS-NN）以换取架构普适性与最小化二进制占用。未来工作将扩展至 Transformer 架构，并继续面向低资源社区提供本地化 AI 解决方案。

title: A Comparative Study of Counterfactual Explainers for Graph Neural Networks Enabling Multiple Types of Graph Edit
summary: Counterfactual explanations for graph-structured data seek to determine minimal and realistic modifications required in an input graph to alter a model's prediction to a predefined output. Although counterfactual explainers that support modifying the graph by both adding and removing edges have recently emerged, there is still a lack of general and efficient methods, especially when considering the quality of the generated explanations. Moreover, the problem remains far from solved, as existing methods exhibit different strengths and weaknesses, often trading off between explanation size, coverage and quality. For this reason, it is important to identify where each method performs well and where it falls short, so as to guide future research in the field. Thus, our study compares six state-of-the-art (SOTA) models on a diverse set of real-world and synthetic datasets, covering both binary and multi-class graph and node classification tasks, and evaluates their performance using diverse quantitative and qualitative metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇针对图神经网络（GNN）反事实解释器的系统比较研究，重点评估了支持边添加与删除操作的最新方法在图分类和节点分类任务上的性能差异，覆盖有效性、保真度、解释大小、最小性、模体接近度及计算效率等多个维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的GNN反事实解释器多局限于边删除操作，生成子图式解释，信息量有限且常导致分布外解释；尽管近期出现支持边增删的新方法，但缺乏统一比较与深入评估，难以判断各方法优劣及适用场景。
AI.method: 研究在多种真实与合成数据集（BA-Motifs系列、BBBP、Graph-SST5、Twitter、Cora、PubMed等）上，对六种SOTA反事实解释器（CF²、D4Explainer、RSGG-CE、GIST、GCFExplainer、CF-GNNExplainer）以及随机基线进行系统比较，采用有效性、保真度、解释大小、最小性、模体接近度等定量指标，并结合训练与推理时间进行综合评估。
AI.result: 结果显示各方法在不同指标间存在显著权衡：RSGG-CE训练与推理时间最短，在合成数据上具有较高有效性和紧凑解释；D4Explainer在真实数据上表现强但计算成本极高；CF²倾向于生成最小解释但有效性和保真度较低；GIST解释过大且生成质量欠佳；GCFExplainer覆盖率高但解释质量差；CF-GNNExplainer仅支持边删除但在节点分类中简单有效。没有一种方法在所有维度上最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了反事实GNN解释器在有效性、效率、解释大小、最小性和模体接近度之间难以兼顾的固有矛盾，强调需开发更通用、高效且质量可靠的方法，并呼吁建立标准化基准评测协议，以推动该新兴领域的未来发展。

title: Single-Query Black-Box Calibration Auditing via Logit Bias
summary: Evaluating the calibration of Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical for their safe deployment as zero-shot classifiers. Yet, commercial API providers increasingly hide the continuous output probabilities required by standard calibration metrics. To bypass this opacity, we demonstrate that any LLM API exposing a logit\_bias parameter can be mathematically manipulated to evaluate exact probability thresholds using strictly one query per sample. Leveraging this mechanism, we introduce a novel and provably consistent estimator of the True Calibration Error for binary tasks. Our approach therefore provides an efficient framework for auditing black-box foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用logit_bias参数的二值分类校准审计方法，通过单次API查询即可评估精确的概率阈值，从而在黑箱条件下一致地估计真实校准误差（TCE）。
AI.motivation: 商业LLM API隐藏连续输出概率（logprobs），使得标准ECE等校准指标无法计算，亟需一种仅需黑箱访问即可审计模型校准的可行方案。
AI.method: 通过logit_bias参数对正负token的logit施加偏置b = -ln(t/(1-t))，将API转化为精确的概率阈值判定器；将数据集随机划分为M个不相交子集，每个子集在相邻bin上分别评估上下界阈值指标，以替代连续概率计算ECE_blind；并严格证明其MSE上界为O(M³/N + 1/M²)，在M∝N^α (0<α<1/3)时渐近一致。
AI.result: 在BoolQ和二值化MMLU上对四个开源模型(Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B)的实验中，单次查询的ECE_blind在多个配置下接近白盒Oracle精度，匹配4-5次迭代logit提取的性能，并显著优于口语化置信度和采样方法；同时提供可视化的盲校准曲线。
AI.conclusion: ECE_blind为黑箱LLM校准审计提供了一种数学严谨、查询高效的新框架，但受限于logit_bias参数的存在性、仅适用于二值任务以及需要较大数据集等局限。

title: Coarse-Graining Hidden Representations: Unsupervised Neuron Selection via Mapping Entropy
summary: Overparameterized neural networks carry far more hidden units than a task nominally requires, raising the question of which neurons are essential and whether that distinction is legible in the representation itself, without labels or gradients. We cast neuron selection as the problem of coarse-graining the hidden layer by retaining a subset of its neurons, and score each putative selection by the mapping entropy (ME). This quantity measures the loss of discriminatory power inherent in discarding part of the network neurons, and the selection that minimises the ME is taken as particularly informative. This criterion is fully unsupervised, in that it depends only on hidden-activation statistics. In teacher-student networks, ME optimisation recovers the minimal teacher-consistent representation and retains extra units in proportion to the hidden layer's residual variability; in a non-linear Gaussian process task, it selects coherent functional-class mappings whose preferred class shifts across training. On this task and on translation-augmented MNIST, ME-selected subnetworks outperform random subsets of equal size, most clearly under strong compression - linking configurational distinguishability to predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于映射熵（Mapping Entropy, ME）的无监督神经元选择方法，通过将隐藏层粗粒化来识别过参数化神经网络中最具信息量的神经元子集。该方法完全依赖隐藏激活统计量，无需标签或梯度信息，在教师-学生网络、非线性高斯过程分类任务以及平移增强的MNIST任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 过参数化神经网络包含远超任务所需数量的隐藏单元，现有剪枝方法多依赖有监督信号（如权重幅度、灵敏度、梯度重要性等），而本文旨在探讨能否仅从隐藏表征的内部统计结构本身，识别出功能上关键且具有区分力的神经元子集，从而为模型压缩和可解释性提供无监督的替代方案。
AI.method: 核心方法为映射熵优化工作流（MEOW）。将隐藏层视为由网络在数据集上生成的构型空间，对隐藏激活进行二值化（取符号），通过选取神经元子集实现粗粒化。映射熵定义为原始微观分布与粗粒化后回映射分布之间的KL散度，衡量粗粒化造成的信息损失。通过穷举搜索或模拟退火最小化映射熵，识别最优神经元子集。同时采用Wang-Landau采样表征映射空间的状态密度。在教师-学生框架中引入失配参数η控制复制对齐程度；在非线性高斯过程任务中，通过逆参与比（IPR）将神经元分为"局域型"和"振荡型"两类功能类别。
AI.result: （1）在教师-学生网络中，当η=0（精确复制）时，ME最小化恢复出最小的教师一致表征（每组一个代表）；随失配增大，达到平衡映射Δ=1所需的保留神经元数n_cg单调增加，该增加量直接量化隐藏层的残差变异性。训练网络与解析构造高度一致。（2）在NLGP任务中，ME选择不倾向于混合映射，而是选择来自同一功能类别（局域型或振荡型）的连贯子集；训练过程中优选类别发生切换（早期偏好局域型，后期偏好振荡型），Wang-Landau分析揭示了映射空间中双峰结构的出现。（3）剪枝性能：在NLGP和MNIST（1 vs 7，平移增强）任务上，ME选定的子网络在强压缩条件下（n_cg较小）系统性地优于同等大小的随机子集，压缩越强优势越明显。
AI.conclusion: 映射熵最小化提供了一种纯无监督的剪枝准则，能够仅从隐藏激活统计中识别结构性和功能上有意义的神经元子集。在控制设置中，它能恢复教师一致表征并探测表征的功能异质性；在剪枝实验中，ME选定的子集在强压缩下优于随机基线，建立了构型可区分性与预测性能之间的联系。该方法与基于权重大小、灵敏度或有监督重要性度量的标准剪枝方法互补。未来方向包括：扩展到更大规模网络及lazy-to-rich转变诊断、深度网络的迭代剪枝、注意力机制/Transformer架构，以及鲁棒性与对抗脆弱性研究。

title: MomentQuant: an even more minimalist interval method with linear time complexity for time series classification
summary: Time series data is very common in many real-world applications and in numerous domains, with increasing interest for automated information extraction using machine learning. One of these subfields is time series classification, which consists in assigning a label to each new, unseen time series. Many algorithms have been developed over the past decades, with the trade-off between predictive performance and computational cost being consistently discussed. Quant, an interval-based algorithm extracting quantiles from recursive, fixed, dyadic intervals, was shown to achieve high accuracy, while being very fast. We propose two changes to make this algorithm even faster. The first one is a better optimized implementation of the exact same algorithm. The second one is to derive approximate quantiles, using the Cornish-Fisher expansion, instead of exact quantiles. This change removes the necessity to sort the time series, leading to a smaller computational complexity. We call this novel algorithm MomentQuant. We provide evidence that our implementation of Quant is faster than the original one, and that MomentQuant is even faster than our implementation of Quant, at the cost of a tiny decrease in predictive performance. These improvements are especially relevant for real-life applications, where inference is performed much more often than training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MomentQuant 算法，通过优化实现（精确模式）和基于 Cornish-Fisher 展开的矩估计近似分位数（近似模式），在保持可接受预测精度的前提下，使时间序列分类算法 Quant 变得更快，达到线性时间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类算法需要在预测精度和计算成本之间权衡。Quant 算法虽然已很快，但其参考实现采用固定计算结构，在短序列（调度开销主导）和长序列（排序成本主导）上均存在效率问题。本文旨在从理论和实践两方面进一步优化 Quant 的推理时间。
AI.method: 1. 精确模式：用 NumPy/Numba 重新实现 Quant，优化循环顺序（区间外层 vs 样本外层），通过自动调度启发式选择实现策略。2. 近似模式：利用 Welford-Pebay 在线算法计算每个区间的四阶中心矩（均值、方差、偏度、峰度），再通过 Cornish-Fisher 展开估计分位数，避免排序。3. 提供完整的理论成本模型，包含详细定理证明，并通过 142 个 UCR 数据集实验验证。
AI.result: 精确模式：单线程下比 QuantFloat64 快约 2 倍（来自 PyTorch vs NumPy 差异及 numpy.quantile 的次优分区）。近似模式：在 142 个 UCR 数据集上比 QuantFloat64 快 2.7-3.1 倍，比最优精确模式还快 1.7-1.8 倍。近似模式准确率仅下降不到 0.5 个百分点（0.8505 vs 0.8551），且在 1/3 以上数据集上仍然获胜。推理阶段加速效果最显著。理论成本模型在 holdout 验证中误差仅 1.5%-15.4%。
AI.conclusion: 原则性的小规模近似（Cornish-Fisher 矩估计分位数）在成本最低、收益最大的地方（长序列、推理阶段）应用，是使已快速的时间序列分类方法变得更快的一种实用方式。MomentQuant 将 Quant 的变换复杂度从 O(l·log(l)) 降至 O(l)，对长序列场景尤具意义。遗留问题包括：未强制执行 Cornish-Fisher 展开的有效域检查、计数排序优化、多变量扩展等。

title: From 80x to 385x: A Best-Matching-Unit Search at the L2 Roof, Measured Against a Symmetrically Tuned Baseline
comment: 15 pages, 8 tables, 3 figures. Companion to arXiv:2608.24067 . Both implementations were tuned symmetrically; cuSPARSE became 2-3x faster in the process. Code, data and frozen results: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22245712 (tag v2.0)
summary: Comparisons between GPU implementations are usually asymmetric: one side is tuned by its author, the other is run as found. I report a programme that tuned both a novel SOM algorithm (SparseBin) and the baseline algorithm it was being compared to (cuSPARSE). The best-matching-unit search that dominates self-organizing map training was tuned through four levers - tile size, tile-membership clustering, neuron-axis chunking and vectorised loads - reaching 5.6-10.1x per epoch over the previously published configuration at map sizes from 32x32 to 512x512, and lifting the margin over the CUDA implementation behind our earlier MEDLINE atlases from ~80x to ~385x. cuSPARSE, the implementation SparseBin is compared against, received every lever with an analogue on its side, and became 2-3x faster in the process. The tuned kernel pressed the L2 bandwidth roof at 77% of peak with every other unit at 40-65%, bounding any further lever at ~1.3x - a terminal result rather than a waypoint, and every untested lever was either capped by that bound by construction or measured null.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对自组织映射(SOM)训练中占主导地位的最佳匹配单元(BMU)搜索,提出并验证了一种对称调优方法论。通过四个核心优化杠杆(tile size、tile-membership clustering、neuron-axis chunking、vectorised loads)对新型SparseBin算法和cuSPARSE基线进行公平调优,实现了每epoch 5.6-10.1倍加速,将稀疏SOM相对于MedSOM的优势从约80倍提升至约385倍,并证明了性能上限已被L2带宽天花板锁定,进一步优化空间仅约1.3倍。
AI.motivation: GPU算法对比中普遍存在不对称调优现象——作者只优化自己实现的算法而基线保持原始状态,导致性能比较失真。该研究的核心动机是建立对称调优协议,通过同时优化SparseBin和cuSPARSE来获得真正公平的性能比较,并通过逼近硬件带宽天花板来确定性能极限。
AI.method: 1. 四条协议规则:双向调优、将调优cuSPARSE视为成功、空结果与正结果同等记录、预测先于测量。2. 四个优化杠杆:tile size扫描(tile 2-32)、执行排序→tile-membership聚类(基于罕见描述符)→神经元轴chunking(分块大小C=1-16)、向量化加载(__half2)。3. cuSPARSE对称调优:warp-per-row归约、向量化加载、批大小、算法选择(ALG3)的全因子扫描。4. roofline分析确定L2带宽为绑定资源,L1/shared memory分割扫描测试剩余杠杆。5. 128²为引用的主指标(保持与前文连续性),但最佳性能边界出现在256²。
AI.result: SparseBin在32²-512²所有映射尺寸上达到5.6-10.1倍每epoch加速(128²最佳达10.1倍)。在256²处,cuSPARSE基线从47.3s/epoch通过warp归约+向量化加载加速至3.8s/epoch(12.5倍)。最终调优后的SparseBin相对于MedSOM的边际优势:128²为385倍(原文80倍)、256²为422倍;相对于somoclu的边际优势:128²为2994倍、256²为3643倍。调优后的kernel达到L2带宽峰值的77%(3.85 TB/s),DRAM仅41%,占用率66%,LSU管道49%,确立L2带宽为唯一瓶颈资源。L1 carveout扫描在所有map尺寸上均为负结果,最大L1配置比默认慢2.4%-10.3%。7项预注册预测中:3项确认、2项失败、1项分割确认/拒绝、1项被驳回。
AI.conclusion: 对称调优使算法对比从'变量'变为'可测量',该案例中cuSPARSE获得2-3倍加速。L2带宽天花板将任何进一步杠杆限制在约1.3倍以内(512²实测1.29倍、32²实测1.19倍),这是一个终止性结果而非中途节点。该方法论具有跨硬件的可迁移性:具体数值依赖单张RTX 4090,但'分母也是变量'的观察、报告分母调优所付出的努力约为基础工作三分之一的事实,具有普遍意义。代码、数据、剖面捕获全部公开发布,可从干净克隆复现表1的7/10个数据点。

title: Dimension-Adaptive Batched Lipschitz Narrowing Without Knowing the Zooming Dimension
summary: The Appropriately Combined Edge-length (ACE) sequence in A-BLiN depends on the zooming dimension $d_z$. This note removes that dependence. The next edge length is selected from the number of cubes that survive the preceding elimination. The resulting Count-Adaptive BLiN algorithm does not use $d_z$ or the zooming constant $C_z$, yet it attains $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_d(T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)})$ regret with $\mathcal O_d(\log\log T)$ batches. Together with the adaptive-grid lower bound in Theorem 10 of the original paper, the optimal batch complexity remains $\Theta_d(\log\log T)$ when $d_z$ is unknown.

AI.tldr: 本文针对A-BLiN算法中ACE序列依赖zooming维度的问题，提出Count-Adaptive BLiN (CA-BLiN)算法，通过让边长选择依赖于存活立方体数量而非$d_z$和$C_z$，实现了在未知zooming维度下仍达到最优$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}_d(T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)})$遗憾和$\mathcal{O}_d(\log\log T)$批复杂度的结果。
AI.motivation: 原始的A-BLiN算法中，ACE序列的构造依赖于zooming维度$d_z$和zooming常数$C_z$。然而在实际应用中，这些参数通常是未知的。本文的核心动机是：能否设计一个不依赖这些未知参数的算法，仍然达到相同的最优遗憾和批复杂度？
AI.method: 本文提出CA-BLiN算法，核心思想是将下一阶段的边长$r_m$选择从数据中自适应地确定，而非预设。具体而言：通过计算$\gamma_{m-1} = HK_{m-1}/(Tr_{m-1}^2)$，利用$\bar{r}_m = r_{m-1}\gamma_{m-1}^{1/[2(d+2)]}$确定新的边长，再通过dyadic函数取整。同时定义硬上限$B_0 = \lceil\log\log T/\log\frac{d+2}{d+1}\rceil$，确保批次数有限。证明分为四个步骤：(1) 证明自适应尺度下的浓度不等式；(2) 证明最优臂存活和幸存立方体的高奖励性质；(3) 证明每个完成的细化批次的遗憾上界；(4) 证明尺度收缩使得$B_0$次细化后$r_{B_0} \leq \sqrt{e}\rho$。
AI.result: 主要结果（定理1）：在固定环境维度$d$下，CA-BLiN算法以至少$1-2T^{-7}$的概率达到遗憾上界$R(T) \leq 2^{d+6}(B_0+1)T\rho$，等价地$R(T) \leq 2^{d+6}(B_0+1)C_z^{1/(d_z+2)}T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)}(16\log T)^{1/(d_z+2)}$，总批次数不超过$B_0+1 = \mathcal{O}_d(\log\log T)$。结合原论文的下界定理，得出未知$d_z$时的最优批复杂度仍为$\Theta_d(\log\log T)$。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功去除了A-BLiN算法对zooming维度$d_z$和常数$C_z$的依赖，所提出的CA-BLiN算法在未知这些参数的情况下仍能达到最优的$T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)}$遗憾指数和$\Theta_d(\log\log T)$批复杂度。这一结果完善了批处理Lipschitz赌博问题的理论框架，证明参数未知不会带来额外的性能损失。

title: FedDRAW: Federated Dual Reputation Annealing Weighting for Heterogeneous Multi-Institutional Chest Radiograph Classification
summary: Artificial intelligence models are promising for medical diagnosis, but they require large numbers of unbiased data, which in medicine are distributed across hospitals and cannot be centralized to protect patient privacy. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this, since hospitals train one shared diagnostic model while patient data remain local. Training proceeds in communication rounds, in which each hospital trains the shared model locally and returns it to the server for merging by weighted average. This aggregation weight determines whose institutional knowledge shapes the result. Federated averaging (FedAvg) sets it in proportion to local sample count, so a small but informative hospital is permanently assigned a small influence, andl argest clients could dominate the global model even when they are less informative. We propose Federated Dual Reputation Annealing Weighting (FedDRAW), a server-side aggregation method that combines a data-size prior with the cosine similarity between client and global parameters under two coupled annealing schedules. An inner schedule shifts client reputation from the size prior towards similarity. An outer, deferred annealing schedule on the softmax inverse temperature keeps the weighting selective in the early and middle rounds and relaxes it to uniformity at convergence. We evaluate FedDRAW on 12 simulated client-partition scenarios of two chest radiograph datasets (CheXpert and ChestMNIST), against seven federated baselines under identical local training settings. FedDRAW achieved the highest average rank among all eight methods under both AUC and the geometric mean (GM) of sensitivity and specificity, which a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis confirmed to be a statistically significant difference between the methods. Scheduling two signals, rather than fixing the weights by sample count alone, could enable less biased diagnostic models.

AI.tldr: FedDRAW 是一种面向多机构胸部 X 光分类的联邦学习服务器端聚合方法，通过两个耦合的退火调度（内部调度控制数据量先验与相似度的混合，外部调度控制 softmax 逆温度的集中度），在 12 种异构客户端划分场景的 CheXpert 和 ChestMNIST 数据集上，以 AUC 和 GM 为指标，取得了 8 种方法中最优的平均排名（Friedman 检验 + Nemenyi 事后检验显著优于多个基线）。
AI.motivation: FedAvg 按样本量比例分配聚合权重，导致小型但信息量大的医院被永久边缘化；同时现有方法（包括 FedAdp 等基于相似度的方法）要么在整个训练中固定权重准则不随阶段调整，要么无法控制权重集中度，存在冷启动与一致性偏好问题。本文要解决的核心问题是：如何在训练过程中协同数据量与模型相似度两个信号，使其可靠性随阶段变化，同时避免任一客户端在最终模型中获得不成比例的影响力。
AI.method:
1. 数据集：CheXpert（191,027 张正面 X 光片，五种胸腔病理）和 ChestMNIST（78,468 张），均做 5 类多标签分类，DenseNet121 + ImageNet 预训练。
2. 聚合权重公式：声誉分 ξ_i^t = γ_t · p_i + (1 − γ_t) · s_i^t，其中 p_i 为静态数据量先验，s_i^t 为客户端-全局最后一层余弦相似度。
3. 内部退火调度：γ_t = e^{−ηt}（η=0.4），将声誉从纯数据量先验逐渐过渡到相似度。
4. 外部退火调度：β_t = β_max (1 − e^{−λ(T−t)})（λ=0.2，β_max=3），作为 softmax 逆温度，末轮 β_T=0 强制权重均匀。
5. 训练设置：T=15 通信轮，每轮 E=2 局部 epoch，Adam，学习率 1e-5，batch size 64，5 次独立运行。
6. 评估：AUC 与在验证集上逐类阈值选取的 GM（敏感度与特异度几何均值），共 12 种划分（CHX-1–7、CHM-1–5）。
7. 基线：FedAvg、FedNova、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、MOON、FedDyn、FedAdp（7 种）。
AI.result:
1. CheXpert：FedDRAW 在 7 个场景中 GM 均最优，AUC 在 5/7 场景最优；CHX-1 提升最显著（AUC +1.69 pp，GM +2.75 pp）；CHX-4（9 大 1 小，小客户端仅 2.7%）GM 达 77.35%，超过 FedAvg 1.74 pp；同构 CHX-7 仍保持最佳 GM。
2. ChestMNIST：在 4 个异构场景 GM 均最优；CHM-2 AUC 提升 2.77 pp，GM 提升 2.64 pp；CHM-4（类别富集小型客户端）GM +1.81 pp。
3. 统计检验：Friedman 检验 AUC（χ²=58.61）与 GM（χ²=63.50）均 p<0.001；平均排名 AUC 1.50、GM 1.17；Nemenyi 检验（CD=2.78，α=0.10）下 FedDRAW 显著优于 SCAFFOLD、FedDyn、MOON 等多个基线。
4. 聚合动态：在 CHX-4 中，2.7% 的小客户端在第 6 轮权重达到 0.1037，超过每个大客户端；同尺寸客户端间存在 ~1e-4 量级的差异区分；最末轮权重严格均匀。
AI.conclusion: FedDRAW 通过阶段感知的双重退火调度，将数据量与相似度按训练阶段匹配，并通过延迟均匀化实现聚合层面的平等对待公平性；在异构多机构胸部 X 光分类上稳定优于 7 种联邦基线，尤其在小型但信息丰富的客户端被 FedAvg 边缘化的场景中增益最显著。未来工作将权重从客户端级扩展到类别级，以实现按病理的差异化贡献。

title: Hessian-based molecular conformation augmentation for a scalable and efficient strategy of machine learning interatomic potentials
comment: 45 pages including Supporting Information, with 6 figures and 9 tables in the main text
summary: While machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have successfully learned potential energy surfaces (PES) and atomic forces, many practical applications, such as vibrational analysis and transition state search, rely heavily on the PES Hessian. Yet, standard MLIPs tend to be trained on energy and forces alone, leaving Hessian information largely unexploited. Meanwhile, existing methods that explicitly incorporate the Hessian into training objectives require architectural modifications and introduce significant computational and memory overheads due to higher-order backpropagation. To address these limitations, we propose two Hessian-derived data augmentation schemes: isotropic Gaussian displacement (\textbf{UniAug}) and normal mode-weighted displacement (\textbf{ModeAug}). Both methods utilize simple Taylor expansions, achieving effective augmentation without altering training objectives or extending the autograd graph. This allows seamless, plug-and-play integration with existing architectures and training pipelines. Comprehensive evaluations across non-equilibrium and equilibrium datasets demonstrate that our approach enhances model accuracy while providing practical, task-specific guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于分子Hessian的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）数据增强方案——UniAug（各向同性高斯位移）和ModeAug（基于简正模加权位移），通过二阶Taylor展开从单个参考Hessian生成新构型及其对应的能量和力标签，无需修改训练目标或网络架构，也无需高阶自动微分。两种方案在HORM（非平衡）、HessianQM9（平衡）和MD17（动力学）三个基准上均稳定提升预测精度，并能显著恢复势能面曲率信息，同时保持标准能量-力训练的零额外计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有MLIP主要基于能量和力训练，对势能面Hessian（二阶导数）信息利用不足，而许多实际应用（如振动分析、过渡态搜索）依赖Hessian。将Hessian显式纳入损失函数需要高阶自动微分，带来显著的架构修改、计算和内存开销。本文旨在以数据增强的方式高效注入曲率信息，避免上述瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 二阶Taylor展开标签合成：基于参考构型的力F和Hessian H，通过ΔE = -F⊤δX + ½δX⊤HδX 和 ΔF = -HδX 解析生成扰动构型的能量和力标签，无需额外的量子化学计算。2. UniAug：在笛卡尔空间中对随机原子子集施加各向同性高斯扰动 δX_i ~ N(0, σ²I₃)。3. ModeAug：对质量加权Hessian进行对角化获得特征模，按能量均分原则以权重 |λ_k|^(-1/2) 在简正模空间采样位移。4. 两种方法均在autograd图外完成数据预处理，保持训练目标和模型架构不变，可与任何MLIP即插即用结合。5. 在HORM、HessianQM9和MD17三个基准上以EquiformerV2为骨干模型进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 数据有效性：t-SNE和力偏移分布分析表明，两种方案生成的扰动结构与DFT参考一致，且占据互补的构型空间。2. HORM（直接力训练，域内）：UniAug (σ=0.05Å) 力MAE达0.0099 eV/Å，优于显式Hessian监督基线(E-F-H)的0.016 eV/Å。3. HORM（RGD1零样本OOD）：ModeAug力MAE降至0.1017 eV/Å，优于无增强基线。4. HessianQM9：ModeAug在真空和甲苯中力预测误差低于⟨|F|⟩阈值，较无增强降低3.6–6.2%。5. MD17零样本迁移：ModeAug在8个分子上平均力MAE最佳(0.1842)；在NVT模拟中UniAug轨迹完成率最佳(20/20)，ModeAug在结构分布保真度上最优(h(r) MAE 0.0050)。6. 曲率恢复：增强训练将Hessian和特征值MAE降至无增强模型的20–30%，接近但未达显式Hessian监督水平。7. 计算成本：UniAug/ModeAug需0次额外反向传播、零额外反向传播内存，而完整Hessian监督需3N次额外反向传播和O(N²)额外内存。8. UniAug在能量精度和长程动力学稳定性上更优；ModeAug在曲率恢复和OOD泛化上更优。
AI.conclusion: UniAug和ModeAug是两种模型无关、即插即用的Hessian数据增强方案，通过二阶Taylor展开在数据层面注入曲率信息，无需修改训练目标或架构，无需高阶自动微分，零额外训练开销。在多个基准上一致提升MLIP精度并显著恢复PES曲率。两种方案具有互补优势：UniAug擅长能量预测和动力学稳定性，ModeAug擅长曲率重建和OOD泛化。本工作为有效利用现有Hessian数据提供了实用指南，并可应用于预训练MLIP基础模型的微调。局限在于：最优增强模式和尺度σ需先验启发式确定；对近零力的平衡构型增益有限；仅适用于小位移局部的PES增强。

title: GLASS: Graph-Language Alignment with Spherical Scoring for Transferable Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
comment: Preprint. This work and project were done in Apr. 2026. This work was included in Xudong Wang's Ph.D. thesis (Defense Passed on 13 Apr. 2026), "Principled and Effective Graph Representation Learning with Application to Anomaly Detection," deposited with The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen Library
summary: We introduce GLASS, a framework for graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) that achieves robust cross-domain transferability through graph-language alignment on the unit hypersphere. GLASS builds a unified representation space by aligning a structure-aware graph encoder with an instruction-aware text embedding via a multi-slice soft cosine objective. Our framework serializes local, global, and semantic graph properties into a compact Graph Descriptor Prompt (GraphDP), creating a text bridge that enables domain-agnostic anomaly scoring. By enforcing multi-scale consistency through Matryoshka representation slices, the model captures anomalous deviations at multiple levels of granularity. For scoring, we formulate anomaly detection as density estimation on the aligned hypersphere and introduce Spherical Multi-Modal Scoring (SMS), which instantiates von Mises-Fisher kernel density estimators in both graph and text embedding spaces. This probabilistic formulation recovers angular k-nearest-neighbor scoring as a high-concentration limiting case and provides a principled fusion of structural and semantic anomaly signals. The shared text embedding space further serves as a cross-domain bridge: by encoding a target domain's GraphDP without target-domain training data, GLASS performs zero-shot anomaly detection, and with only a handful of normal examples, few-shot adaptation via reference-set calibration. Across twelve benchmarks and three meta-domains, GLASS obtains the best average AUROC and rank compared with recent advanced GLAD baselines and enables effective cross-domain transfer.

AI.tldr: GLASS提出了一种图-语言对齐框架，用于跨域可迁移的图级异常检测（GLAD）。核心思想是将图结构序列化为紧凑的GraphDP文本提示，通过冻结的指令感知文本编码器在单位超球面上构建统一的图-语言表示空间，并使用基于von Mises-Fisher核密度估计的球面评分（SMS）进行异常检测。该方法支持单域、零样本和少样本三种部署模式，无需改变架构。
AI.motivation: 现有GLAD方法通常针对单一数据集训练，假设目标域有充足的正常图数据。然而在实际场景中，新领域往往仅有少量甚至没有正常训练数据。核心挑战在于不同图族（分子、蛋白、社交）之间缺乏可互操作的表示和统一的异常评分原则。论文观察到，虽然原始节点特征不可比，但所有图都可以通过结构语言（图大小、密度、度分布、聚类、模体、连通性、核结构、谱摘要）来描述，这为可迁移GLAD提供了一条可行路径。
AI.method: 1. **局部拓扑描述符（LTD）**：计算节点的度分布、聚类系数、k-core指数、三角形和4-环估计等结构统计量，在原始属性缺失时仍能提供稳定的结构证据。2. **图描述符提示（GraphDP）**：将图的局部、全局和谱性质序列化为紧凑的键值对文本提示（不包含标签信息）。3. **双编码器**：使用GIN图编码器提取图表示，使用冻结的Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B文本编码器嵌入GraphDP。4. **多切片软余弦对齐**：利用Qwen3的原生Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）能力，通过前缀截取获得多分辨率文本锚点（64/128/256/512维），图侧投影到对应球面空间进行对齐。5. **维度自适应Gram正则化**：稳定不同维度的投影矩阵。6. **球面原型密度整形**：训练时用K个vMF原型方向塑造正常图嵌入的紧凑模式。7. **球面多模态评分（SMS）**：基于vMF核密度估计的球面评分，在高浓度极限下退化为角k近邻评分，通过融合图和文本两个通道的密度估计得到最终异常分数。8. **正常参考集可靠性加权**：根据留一紧致度、跨视图邻域一致性和对齐残差自动估计切片和模态权重。
AI.result: 在12个基准数据集（6个分子、3个蛋白、3个社交）和3个元域上，GLASS取得了最佳平均AUROC（79.85%）和最佳平均排名（1.75），在7个数据集上排名第一。零样本跨域迁移显示分子→蛋白转移增益显著（PROTEINS +2.9pp，D&D +4.6pp），但生物→社交转移损失较大（REDDIT-B -15~-20pp）。少样本校准在PROTEINS上仅需32个目标正常样本即可接近单域性能。消融实验验证了冻结文本锚点优于LoRA适配，且0.6B编码器在大多数数据集上优于更大模型。理论分析证明了vMF KDE评分在高浓度极限下收敛于角k近邻评分。
AI.conclusion: GLASS提供了一个统一的、原则性的图级异常检测框架，通过图-语言对齐在超球面上实现密度估计，支持单域、零样本和少样本三种部署模式。实验表明，当源域和目标域共享结构语言证据时（尤其是分子和蛋白域之间），该框架能有效实现跨域迁移。对于语义差异较大的迁移场景（如生物到社交），需要更丰富的GraphDP词汇表和源参考加权策略。总体而言，该工作将图异常检测从"数据集特定"范式转向"结构语言驱动"的可迁移范式。

title: How to Speculate about Uncertainty in Agentic Coding? A Draft-Model Gate Method
summary: LLM agents deployed for software engineering fail expensively: they act confidently wrong, and bad actions are recognized only after costly execution and retry. We present Speculative Uncertainty (SU), a method that recovers a predictive failure signal for a black-box agent from its output tokens alone, with no access to logits, weights, activations, or repeated sampling. Inverting speculative decoding, a small open-weight draft model scores the agent's already-generated trajectory in a single forward pass. From these speculative cross-likelihoods we extract phase-aware features by separating the reasoning and action spans, and calibrate them against a verifiable objective. SU produces a failure-likelihood score that any downstream policy, such as routing, human intervention, or extra test-time compute, can consume directly. To show the signal is actionable, we instantiate one such policy, a pre-execution veto gate, on software engineering agents Qwen3-Coder-480B and closed-source Claude 3.5 Sonnet, cutting execution error rate by 6-8 percentage points and token cost by 14-19% in deployment, transferring to out-of-distribution benchmarks without retraining, and generalizing across agent models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"投机不确定性"(Speculative Uncertainty, SU)方法，通过小型开放权重草稿模型对黑盒LLM智能体生成的轨迹进行评分，从输出token中恢复预测性失败信号，无需访问logits、权重或多次采样。结合推理与动作阶段的感知特征和轻量校准器，SU能在执行前预测代码执行是否成功。在SWE-Bench Verified和DA-Code上部署预执行否决门后，每次调用的执行错误率降低6-8个百分点，令牌成本降低14-19%，并能零样本迁移到分布外基准。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中部署的LLM智能体常"自信地犯错"，即提出错误动作后直到环境执行时才暴露错误，导致昂贵的重试循环和API成本浪费。现有不确定性量化方法存在两大局限：(1)需要白盒访问(logits/权重)，但最强智能体多为闭源API模型；(2)基于采样的方法在智能体长视野任务中成本过高。因此亟需一种适用于黑盒智能体、可在执行前预测失败的低成本方法。
AI.method: SU方法的核心思想是"反转投机解码"：不利用小模型为大型目标模型提出token加速推理，而是利用小开放权重草稿模型对智能体已生成的轨迹做教师强制交叉似然评分。具体包括：(1)对轨迹每个token计算三种投机信号——投机惊奇度(surprisal)、投机差距(gap)、投机熵(entropy)；(2)识别智能体轨迹中"推理"与"动作"两个阶段的熵结构差异，分别提取阶段感知特征(每阶段8种统计量×3种信号=48维，加2维长度共50维)；(3)用L1正则化逻辑回归校准器将特征映射为动作通过可验证目标的校准概率。作为下游策略之一，引入"执行前否决门"——当预测成功率低于阈值τ时，触发廉价重规划而非昂贵的执行-失败-重试循环。
AI.result: 在SWE-rebench上训练，使用Qwen3-Coder-480B和闭源Claude 3.5 Sonnet作为智能体，Qwen3-4B作为草稿模型。关键结果：(1)失败预测质量：SU (SFT)在SWE-Bench Verified达0.76 AUROC，DA-Code达0.77 AUROC，相比口头化置信度(0.57)大幅提升，接近白盒基线HTC(0.82)；(2)部署效果：否决门使SWE-Bench Verified错误率从21%降至15%，DA-Code从14%降至6%，令牌消耗降低14-19%；(3)零样本迁移：在DA-Code(完全未微调)上保持6 pp错误率降低；(4)跨智能体迁移：在Qwen上训练的草稿迁移到Claude达0.69 AUROC，远高于未训练基线(0.60)。阶段分离带来+5-6 AUROC增益。
AI.conclusion: SU证明可以仅从智能体输出轨迹中恢复失败信号并在执行前采取行动。两个关键设计选择成就了这种能力：(1)通过独立草稿模型而非智能体内部信号进行评分；(2)尊重推理-动作两阶段的生成结构，单独提取特征。部署上，将4B蒸馏草稿模型与线性校准器配对，可在每步仅增加一次前向传播的前提下显著降低错误率和成本。该框架原则上可推广到任何具备"推理-行动"两阶段结构且有可验证二元目标的智能体场景(如SQL、网页、工具编排智能体)，但当前仅在代码执行场景中得到定量验证，存在校准精度、单一目标域、单次运行估计等局限性。

title: Learning from VAE Errors to support ECG-based Differential Diagnosis of Myocardial Scar
comment: Accepted at the PharML Workshop, ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Late Gadolinium Enhancement (LGE) on cardiac magnetic resonance is a key marker of myocardial scar, but its limited accessibility motivates routine ECG-based screening. We evaluated whether $\beta$-variational autoencoder (VAE)-derived ECG representations can discriminate LGE+ from LGE- cardiomyopathic patients in a local cohort of 300 subjects. We compared 32-dimensional features from the foundation this http URL model with those from a shallower $\beta$-VAE trained on normal PTB-XL ECGs, evaluating downstream classification and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based reconstruction errors. this http URL reached an area under ROC of 0.686 with Random Forest, while the proposed $\beta$-VAE reached 0.577 with sensitivity of 0.775 with Gradient Boosting. Notably, DTW-reconstruction errors significantly differed between classes in 10 out of 12 leads according to Mann-Whitney U test and help in classification, leading to an area under ROC of 0.643 with Logistic Regression, supporting their potential as markers of scar-related ECG alterations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对心肌瘢痕（通过CMR-LGE定义）的ECG筛查问题，比较了预训练基础模型ECGx.AI与作者提出的浅层β-VAE在DCM/NDLVC患者队列中提取的32维潜在表示的分类能力，并创新性地提出利用DTW重建误差作为分类特征，验证了误差特征在LGE+/LGE-鉴别中的判别价值。
AI.motivation: 心肌瘢痕（LGE+）是DCM和NDLVC的关键诊断标志物，但CMR成本高、可及性差；标准12导联ECG廉价易得且能反映瘢痕引起的电生理改变，但既往ECG-AI方法多为有监督的黑盒模型，需要大量标注数据，且无监督表征学习在LGE预测中的应用仍不充分，特别是在小样本本地队列中。
AI.method: （1）数据：300例本地DCM/NDLVC患者（174 LGE+，126 LGE-）+ PTB-XL公共数据集（3000例正常ECG）；（2）两个特征提取器：ECGx.AI（7层卷积β-VAE，110万ECGs预训练，概率高斯解码器）与自研浅层β-VAE（4层确定性解码器，仅用正常ECG训练，β=0.0001）；（3）三种输入表征：ECGx.AI的32维latent、浅层β-VAE的32维latent、12维lead-wise DTW重建误差；（4）5种分类器（ET/RF/GB/LR/SVM）×3种交叉验证（LOSO/20×5-fold/200×80-20）；（5）Mann-Whitney U检验评估DTW误差的类间差异显著性。
AI.result: ECGx.AI最佳性能：RF+5-fold CV，AUROC=0.686±0.053，敏感性0.852，特异性0.389；浅层β-VAE latent最佳性能：GB+LOSO，AUROC=0.577±0.034，敏感性0.775；浅层β-VAE+DTW误差：LR+80/20分割，AUROC=0.643±0.068，敏感性高达0.885；Mann-Whitney U检验显示12个导联中有10个的DTW误差在LGE+/LGE-两组间存在显著差异。重建质量方面，浅层β-VAE在正常PTB-XL验证集上r=0.94±0.09，在病理队列上骤降至r=0.36±0.04（LGE+ r=0.35 vs LGE- r=0.38），DTW重建误差均值为5.557±2.705。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型ECGx.AI的潜在特征具有更强的判别力（AUROC 0.686 vs 0.577），但仅用正常ECG训练的极轻量浅层β-VAE的DTW重建误差也能有效区分LGE+/LGE-（AUROC 0.643），且在10/12导联上有显著类间差异，揭示了重建-分类目标间的权衡关系。误差驱动表征学习提供了一种紧凑、可解释的筛查替代方案，但仍需多中心外部验证、临床变量融合及重建-分类目标的平衡策略以提升临床实用性。

title: Optimal Rates for Agentic Networked Information Aggregation
comment: Initial version submitted to SODA 2027 on July 9, 2026
summary: Building on the pioneering paper of Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA'26), we study information aggregation in a networked learning model. The model captures a central pattern in agentic AI: each agent sees only part of the data and passes on only its own conclusion. Their model considers a linear regression problem with the mean squared error (MSE) loss. Agents sit in a DAG and each sees only a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor, and passes only its prediction forward. The benchmark is the full-feature learner that sees all raw features. A path of depth $D$ is $M$-covered if every block of $M$ consecutive agents collectively sees all raw features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu proved that the excess mean squared error of the last agent on such a path is $O(M/\sqrt D)$, and gave a cyclic instance with excess error $\Omega(M/D)$ for $D<M^2$. We close this gap: the correct rate is constant up to depth $M^2$, and $\Theta(M^2/D)$ beyond it. We first give a sharper analysis of the cyclic instance and improve its lower bound to $\Omega(\sqrt{M/D})$ for $D<M^2$. We then construct, for every depth $D\ge M^2$, an $M$-covered path of depth $D$ with excess error $\Omega(M^2/D)$. The same instance gives the constant lower bound for all $D < M^2$. We also show that for any fixed distribution the excess error contracts geometrically along the path, ruling out any single instance that witnesses any polynomial lower bound at every depth. Finally, we prove the same optimal rate for logistic classification in the logit-passing model of Bateni et al., which considers the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss. The same improved upper bound of $O(M^2/D)$ holds, and we transfer all the regression lower bounds by showing that on those examples the logistic path follows the least-squares path up to rescaling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络化学习模型（受Kearns、Roth、Ryu启发）中的信息聚合问题，其中每个智能体仅看到部分特征并传递自身预测给后继。作者闭合了线性回归MSE损失的上下界间隙，确定最优速率为：D<M²时为常数，D≥M²时为Θ(M²/D)。同时将该最优速率推广至逻辑分类（BCE损失）场景。
AI.motivation: Kearns、Roth、Ryu (SODA'26) 在线性回归MSE模型中证明了M-覆盖路径上末端智能体的 excess MSE 上界为 O(M/√D)，并给出 Ω(M/D) 的循环实例下界（适用于 D<M²）。该上下界之间存在显著间隙，激励本文确定正确的最优速率。
AI.method: 1. 对循环实例进行更精细的分析，将下界改进至 Ω(√(M/D))（D<M²）。2. 为每个 D≥M² 构造深度为D的M-覆盖路径，使其 excess error 达到 Ω(M²/D)；同一实例在 D<M² 时提供常数下界。3. 证明对任意固定分布，excess error 沿路径几何收缩，从而排除任何能在所有深度上见证多项式下界的单一实例。4. 通过证明逻辑路径在那些下界实例上与最小二乘路径经缩放后一致，将回归结果迁移至Bateni等人的logit-passing逻辑分类模型，并给出 O(M²/D) 的改进上界。
AI.result: 闭合了线性回归中 excess MSE 的间隙：D<M² 时 excess error 为 Θ(1)（常数级），D≥M² 时为 Θ(M²/D)。否定了仅依赖单一循环实例在所有深度上获得多项式下界的可能性。将同一最优速率 Θ(M²/D) 推广至logit-passing下的逻辑分类（BCE损失）。
AI.conclusion: 本文确定了网络化DAG学习中信息聚合的最优速率：在 MSE 回归和 BCE 逻辑分类两种损失下，沿M-覆盖路径的excess error 在深度 D<M² 时为常数，在 D≥M² 时以 Θ(M²/D) 衰减。该结果闭合了先前 O(M/√D) 上界与 Ω(M/D) 下界之间的间隙，并对分布式/智能体AI学习系统的统计效率提供了紧致刻画。

title: Embedded Graph Flows for Categorical Graph Generation
summary: Generating categorical graphs requires choosing node and edge types that form a coherent structure without depending on node order. Many graph generators encode categories as fixed one-hot vectors, which can impose an artificial geometry in which categories are equidistant. We propose Embedded Graph Flows (EGF), a generative model that learns continuous embeddings for node and unordered-edge categories and transports Gaussian noise towards these learnt endpoints using a permutation-equivariant graph transformer. A terminal readout maps the embeddings back to discrete graph categories. Across molecular benchmarks, EGF achieved competitive performance. On QM9, EGF gives the best result on all four reported metrics among the three methods, including a Fréchet ChemNet Distance (FCD) of 0.150, compared with 0.717 for the categorical-diffusion baseline DiGress and 0.812 for the bridge-based baseline GruM. When applied to larger molecules in ZINC250k, EGF retains the lowest maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) using the neighbourhood subgraph pairwise distance kernel (NSPDK), indicating close agreement with the local substructures of the reference molecules. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EGF（Embedded Graph Flows）是一种用于类别型图生成的生成模型，通过学习节点和边的连续类别嵌入，使用排列等变的图变换器将高斯噪声传输到这些学习到的端点，并通过终端读出映射回离散类别。在QM9和ZINC250k分子基准上表现出竞争力，在QM9上四项指标均达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的图生成器通常使用固定的one-hot向量编码类别，这会引入类别等距的虚假几何结构。需要一种能够学习类别几何形状、保持排列对称性并处理填充的类别型图生成方法。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 为节点和边类别学习可训练的连续嵌入锚点；(2) 使用整流流的直线条件路径在嵌入空间中传输高斯噪声；(3) 使用排列等变的图变换器预测路径上的干净嵌入；(4) 通过双分支训练（去噪分支和终端解码分支）优化模型；(5) 掩码处理填充，对称化无向边状态；(6) 终端解码将连续表示映射回离散类别。
AI.result: 在QM9基准上，EGF在所有四个指标上均达到最优：有效性99.87%、FCD为0.150、NSPDK MMD为0.0019、支架相似度为0.9936，均优于DiGress和GruM。在ZINC250k上，NSPDK MMD最低（0.0024），但FCD和有效性低于GruM。
AI.conclusion: EGF通过学习端点几何形状生成分类图，在小分子图（QM9）上同时捕获局部图结构和更广泛的分子分布特性。在更大的分子（ZINC250k）上，匹配子结构并不能保证更广泛的分布一致性或化学有效性。未来工作包括使用更丰富的上下文相关端点嵌入、扩展到更大的图容量，以及支持立体化学和同位素等额外类别。

title: Variational Continuation for Double Pendulum Periodic Orbits
summary: We present a Hessian-based approach to numerically continue periodic orbits in dynamical systems. A loop (periodic orbit candidate) is parametrized as a Fourier series; a loss function is defined based on the deviation of the loop from the physical differential equations. Unlike previous work relying on hand-derived Jacobians, our method automates the process by leveraging automatic differentiation, a common machine learning technique. The continuation direction can be determined by the flat directions of the loss landscapes (directions with zero eigenvalues), making the search of periodic orbits efficient and guided. Our method is integrator-free, precisely initializes oscillations around unstable fixed points, and efficiently detects orbit family intersections and subharmonic bifurcations. As a demonstration, we present full continuations of periodic double pendulum oscillations from fixed points, showing bifurcations along orbit families and categorizing branches of periodic orbits. In particular, we find periodic orbits where both pendulum masses are never simultaneously at rest, which to our knowledge has been missing in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Hessian的变分延拓方法，用于在动力系统中高效寻找和追踪周期轨道。该方法利用Fourier级数参数化轨道回路，通过自动微分计算Hessian矩阵，利用零特征值方向确定延拓方向，实现无需数值积分器的周期轨道搜索。以理想双摆为示例，完整地延拓了从固定点出发的周期轨道族，检测了分岔点，并发现了两摆锤质量永不同时静止的新型周期轨道。
AI.motivation: 传统周期轨道搜索方法（如打靶法）存在两大局限：(1) 依赖手推导的Jacobian矩阵，难以推广；(2) 混沌系统中相邻轨道的指数发散导致长周期轨道收敛困难甚至不可能。此外，传统的延拓方法需要对Jacobian进行积分，计算昂贵且数值不稳定。作者希望利用现代机器学习工具（尤其是自动微分技术）重新审视延拓问题，实现更高效的周期轨道族映射。
AI.method: 1. **变分回路设置**：将周期轨道候选表示为Fourier级数，定义损失函数为回路与物理微分方程偏差的平方积分。损失为零即对应周期轨道。2. **Hessian分析**：利用PyTorch自动微分计算损失函数对参数的Hessian矩阵。在周期轨道处，Hessian半正定，零特征值对应的特征向量即为延拓方向（保持零损失的扰动方向）。3. **固定点分析**：通过扫描周期T并监测Hessian最小特征值下降，精确发现不稳定固定点附近的小振幅周期轨道。4. **延拓与分岔检测**：沿零特征值方向进行伪弧长延拓；通过检测额外零特征值（同周期和倍周期）发现轨道族交叉和分岔点。5. **实现**：使用PyTorch float64精度，Rprop优化器，结合对称性约束减半参数，必要时加倍频率截断K，使用线性外推加速收敛。
AI.result: 1. 成功从双摆各固定点出发延拓出四条轨道族（In-Phase、Out-Phase、Down-Up、Up-Down），直至周期发散。2. 精确识别出正常模对应的周期（T≈3.39、5.28、8.21），并提供了不稳定固定点附近高精度初始条件。3. 发现了多个分岔点（同周期交叉和倍周期分岔），并延拓出分岔分支（ID1、ID2、OD1、OD2、OB、OD1B等）。4. 关键发现：识别出两摆锤质量永不同时处于静止状态的周期轨道，这类轨道在文献中此前未被报道。5. 方法在长周期轨道上优于积分器方法（积分器误差指数发散，变分方法保持低损失）。6. 受Rprop算法扩展性限制，全Hessian计算成本较高，但可与其他变分方法结合或使用Hessian近似。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Hessian变分延拓方法为动力系统周期轨道的系统化搜索提供了新范式。核心贡献在于将周期轨道族结构纳入搜索过程，从发现孤立轨道提升到映射整个轨道谱结构。该方法在理想双摆上实现了首次完整的周期轨道谱调查，包括正常模延拓和分岔分支分类。未来方向包括：推广至其他动力系统（如PCR3BP）、结合更先进的机器学习优化器、以及用约简参数表示或Hessian近似处理高维系统。机器学习方法在物理系统问题中的适用性得到了验证。

title: Distill Globally, Adapt Locally: Reasoning Distillation and Product-Type Test-Time Training for Scalable Trade-Up Recommendation
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Agentic and Generative AI for E-Commerce (GenAIECommerce 2026), co-located with ACM RecSys 2026
summary: Trade-up recommendation identifies higher-quality alternatives that preserve a customer's purchase intent while offering upgraded benefits. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such distinctions, but applying them directly to hundreds of millions of product pairs is operationally impractical. We introduce a two-level framework that distills LLM reasoning into an efficient non-generative student and adapts its decision boundary to product-type-specific trade-up criteria. At Level 1, a retrieval-augmented few-shot LLM teacher generates structured relation labels and natural-language rationales. These rationales supervise a compact embedding-pair classifier through alignment and contrastive objectives; at inference, the student uses only two precomputed 768-dimensional product embeddings, with no LLM calls or text generation. On a fixed human-annotated benchmark of 8,352 pairs, a 15.5M-parameter four-class reasoning-distilled student achieves AUC 0.924 (95% CI [0.918, 0.929]), compared with 0.912 for the four-class label-only student. At Level 2, product-type test-time training (PT-TTT) uses few-shot demonstrations to optimize lightweight category-specific adapters over the frozen student. PT-TTT improves AUC from 0.924 to 0.941 and average precision from 0.920 to 0.940. On a 100K-pair proxy catalog, the distilled student on a single eight-GPU machine is approximately 5,000x faster and 10,000x lower in estimated cost than direct LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两级框架用于电商场景中的可扩展"升级推荐"（trade-up recommendation）任务。Level 1 通过推理蒸馏将黑盒LLM教师模型的结构化标签和自然语言推理理由迁移到一个轻量级的非生成式嵌入对学生模型中；Level 2 引入产品类型测试时训练（PT-TTT），通过少量专家标注样本对冻结学生模型上的轻量级LoRA适配器进行有监督少样本适配，以捕捉品类特定的升级判别标准。实验表明该方法在人类标注基准上达到AUC 0.941，相对直接LLM推理实现约5000倍加速和10000倍成本降低。
AI.motivation: 在电商目录规模（数亿对商品对）下识别"升级替代品"——即保留用户购物意图但提供更优配方/认证/品牌定位等附加价值的商品。LLM具备语义推理能力但推理成本过高，无法在线服务；需要一种可扩展的蒸馏方案，在保留LLM语义判断力的同时实现高效的目录级打分。
AI.method: 两级框架：(1) Level 1 推理蒸馏——检索增强的few-shot LLM教师为商品对生成四类关系标签和自然语言推理理由；学生模型基于预计算的768维商品嵌入对，采用三分支结构（独立base/candidate分支+有序base-to-candidate交叉注意力分支）拼接后经MLP分类；训练时通过理由对齐损失（学生投影→教师理由嵌入的MSE）、InfoNCE对比损失和关系KL损失进行蒸馏，这些辅助模块在推理时丢弃。(2) Level 2 产品类型测试时训练（PT-TTT）——在冻结的全局学生模型上，为每个产品类型独立拟合轻量级LoRA适配器（rank=8），使用类别平衡的少量专家标注支持集进行50步梯度优化，推理时每个类别共用一个适配器（而非每查询一次）。
AI.result: 在8352对人类标注黄金基准上：浅层15.5M参数的四类推理蒸馏学生达到AUC 0.924（95%CI [0.918,0.929]），优于同架构的纯标签学生（0.912）和65.9M的深层学生（0.911）；PT-TTT（K=32）将AUC进一步提升至0.941（+0.017），AP从0.920提升至0.940。消融实验表明推理理由监督仅在与四类标签粒度结合时才带来显著增益（与二分类结合时增益消失）；产品类型特异适配优于类别无关的池化LoRA适配（0.940 vs 0.929），且宏平均产品类型内AUC从0.910提升至0.925，证明增益来源于类型内判别能力提升而非跨类别分数重缩放。在10万对代理目录上，相对直接LLM推理实现约5000倍加速和10000倍成本降低。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了将黑盒LLM监督用于大规模目录打分的可行路径。两级框架呈现清晰的分工：理由引导的全局蒸馏在塑造共享配对表示时最有效，而产品类型特定的专家监督贡献了大部分适配增益。推理理由监督的价值依赖于保留教师模型的细粒度关系标签结构；适配阶段的标签仅与理由引导变体性能接近，表明Level 2增益主要来自品类特异化而非理由信号复用。该方法无需服务时LLM推理即可实现LLM级别的语义判断，适用于电商目录级升级推荐的工程化部署。

title: Scale-QLoRA: Code-Invariant Adapter Merging for Native 4-bit Microscaling LLMs
summary: Merging a LoRA adapter into its base model is standard deployment practice: it removes the runtime adapter's per-forward overhead and leaves a single standalone checkpoint any serving stack can load. On a native 4-bit microscaling checkpoint (NVFP4, MXFP4) that step stops being free. The merged weights must be written back through a quantizer, which re-derives the checkpoint's discrete E2M1 code plane (roughly 90% of the artifact's bytes), so the deployed artifact becomes coupled to one quantization convention, and every later code-touching event in its lifecycle can move it. Done naively the step is worse than fragile: it deletes the adaptation, by up to 39 pp, because against an already-on-grid base the reconstruction optimum is that base. Scale-QLoRA instead adapts only the native per-block scale field, trains those scales on the deployment grid, and freezes every E2M1 code. Within a fixed native format, scale grid, block layout and code plane, merging is then a bit-exact identity and the merged artifact is code-invariant. Across four models and four tasks, Scale-QLoRA and merge-aware QAT-LoRA are both accuracy-lossless, so we claim no accuracy ordering between them; they differ structurally, in that QAT-LoRA re-derives the code plane through a quantizer while Scale-QLoRA preserves it exactly. That difference is what the lifecycle prices: nearest-rounding implementations disagree by about a point on the measured task, and more extreme rule mismatches can drive the weight-space artifact to ~0%, which we report as a sensitivity bound rather than a deployment frequency. Preserving the code plane also drops the weight-space straight-through estimator from training (3.9x per step on the dense 8B model) and enables exact rollback, code-plane deduplication, and a ~125x faster scale-only task swap.

AI.tldr: Scale-QLoRA通过冻结E2M1码字、仅适配原生4-bit微缩量化(MS)检查点的逐块缩放因子,并在原生硬件尺度网格上训练,实现了与基础检查点位完全相同的位精确合并。代码不变性带来五个生命周期收益,但论文明确声明不声称与QAT-LoRA存在准确度差异。
AI.motivation: 在原生NVFP4/MXFP4量化检查点上将LoRA适配器合并到基础模型时,朴素的"反量化→加法→再量化"路径会对E2M1码平面(约占字节90%)重新量化。由于基础权重已经在网格上,重建最优解就是未适配的基础本身,因此该步骤实际上会删除适配(在NVFP4模型上损失最高达39个百分点)。QAT-LoRA通过在原生网格上使用直通估计器(STE)解决了这一问题,但合并仍需重新推导每个码字,需要部署端的量化器与训练规则精确匹配。论文提出Scale-QLoRA,以实现与基础码平面的位精确、量化器无关的合并。
AI.method: Scale-QLoRA学习一个针对每块缩放场的低秩修正 ΔS = BA(α/r),其中B:[out,r]且A:[r,G]为块级;冻结每个E2M1码。引入量化感知缩放训练(QAST),在前向传播中将有效缩放在原生网格(E4M3对应NVFP4,E8M0对应MXFP4)上舍入,并使用直通梯度。由于训练时已在网格上,合并直接写出该舍入后的缩放字节并逐字复制码字,在固定原生格式内实现位精确( max|ΔW|=0 )、量化器无关的合并。实施细节包括:fp32下尺度算术(避免bf16溢出)、MoE的批量分组专家bmm核、E4M3天花板处的 min(eff,448·ws2) 钳位以实现MoE数值稳定性、验证早停的单设置学习率选择,以及合并路径复用QAST前向的网格与钳位逻辑。
AI.result: 在四个模型(Llama-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、gpt-oss-120B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash)和四个任务(Banking77、AGNews、CLINC150、Spider)上,Scale-QLoRA和QAT-LoRA都是准确度无损的(合并损失 |Δ| ≤ 0.2 pp),因此论文声明两者之间不存在准确度排序。Scale-QLoRA的合并是逐位精确( max|ΔW|=0 ,码字逐字复制),而QAT-LoRA并非如此( max|ΔW|~3×10⁻³ )。两个合并感知方法都被朴素的再量化合并所击败,在NVFP4上后者最高损失39.4 pp。代码不变性带来:(1)在vLLM 0.23.0 NVFP4堆栈上跨五个舍入规则的部署扫描,Scale-QLoRA跨数据集展平为0.0 pp,而QAT-LoRA在LLM上展平91.6–97.6 pp;(2)多适配器服务,共享逐位相同的码平面(M=4时存储共享3.0×);(3)通过减去合并应用的在线格缩放增量实现精确回滚;(4)压缩分发增量21.1×小,64 KiB块级去重9.0×;(5)与基础逐字节审计。训练加速3.9×(密集)/2.2×(MoE),因为移除了权重空间的STE。论文诚实地声明其证据的层级结构——结构性(数学)结果最强,经验代码平面收益为"有限经验",~0%的QAT-LoRA敏感性是边界而非频率——并标记多个开放问题,包括NVFP4舍入单元上权重探测与准确度之间的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 合并LoRA适配器到原生4-bit MS检查点对工件具有生命周期影响,朴素的再量化路径在NVFP4上最高删除39.4 pp的适配增益。Scale-QLoRA冻结E2M1码字,仅训练硬件量级上的逐块缩放,使得合并在固定原生格式内为逐位精确,合并后的工件与基础具有相同的码平面。代码不变性提供五种生命周期收益(部署规则平坦性、多适配器共享、精确回滚、去重、字节级审计),这些收益在码字被重新推导时全部丧失。论文的核心贡献是目标网格感知的原生MS字节低秩适配,加上生命周期分析,而不是准确度优势——显式声明在两个合并感知方法之间不存在准确度排序。

title: MURAL: Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning
summary: Multimodal Graph Neural Networks have become standard for recommendation by augmenting sparse interaction data with content features. Yet current architectures face two bottlenecks: structural rigidity, from a reliance on static precomputed similarity graphs that cannot adapt to evolving preferences; and semantic fragility, where noisy modality signals are indiscriminately fused, distorting the collaborative signal. We propose MURAL (Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning), a unified framework that shifts multimodal recommendation from fixed structural augmentation to dynamic topology discovery. To address structural rigidity, an Adaptive Edge Learner combines a differentiable retrieval-augmented strategy with an approximate nearest neighbor search to discover latent item-item correlations that are both semantically adaptive and computationally scalable (O(NlogN)). To address semantic fragility, an Uncertainty-Aware Fusion module models the aleatoric uncertainty of heterogeneous modalities, dynamically down-weighting unreliable features while prioritizing high-confidence signals as a defense against cross-modal noise. We further employ a contrastive teacher-student alignment that anchors modality-specific representations to stable behavioral signals, ensuring optimization stability without gradient leakage. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks including TikTok and Amazon show that MURAL significantly surpasses both structural and generative state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior accuracy while offering interpretability through domain-specific modality dominance and robustness under extreme data corruption.

AI.tldr: MURAL提出了一种统一的多模态推荐框架，通过自适应边学习器（AEL）动态发现物品拓扑结构，以及不确定性感知融合模块（UAF）建模各模态的偶然不确定性，在TikTok、Amazon-Baby和Amazon-Sports三个基准上显著优于现有结构学习和生成式推荐方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GNN的多模态推荐系统面临两大瓶颈：(1) 结构刚性——依赖静态预计算的相似度图，无法适应不断演化的用户偏好；(2) 语义脆弱性——对噪声模态信号进行无差别融合，扭曲协同信号。作者旨在将多模态推荐从固定结构增强转变为动态拓扑发现。
AI.method: 方法包含三大核心模块：(1) 自适应边学习器（AEL）：结合HNSW近似最近邻检索与可学习MLP评分函数，对候选邻居进行动态重加权，构建模态特定的稀疏邻接矩阵；(2) 不确定性感知融合（UAF）：为每个物品的每个模态学习偶然不确定性σ和注意力权重α，通过逆方差加权动态抑制不可靠特征；(3) 行为-语义锚定：使用stopgrad机制解耦结构发现与特征对齐，并采用双对比损失（行为-模态对齐L_BM和跨模态对齐L_MM）。整体复杂度为O(N log N)。
AI.result: 在TikTok、Amazon-Baby、Amazon-Sports三个数据集上，MURAL的Recall@20分别达到0.1221、0.1068、0.1173，NDCG@20分别达到0.0541、0.0502、0.0543，均显著优于MMSSL、DiffMM、DiffCL、MMGSL、AlignRec等最新基线（p<0.01）。消融实验验证了AEL、UAF、对比损失和stopgrad机制的必要性；噪声注入实验证明UAF能自适应提升被损坏模态的σ值以抑制其影响。
AI.conclusion: MURAL通过动态拓扑学习和可靠性感知融合，解决了多模态推荐中的结构刚性与语义脆弱性问题，实现了可扩展、可解释且对极端数据损坏具有鲁棒性的推荐。论文还提出了未来方向：用户侧不确定性建模、时序动态分析等。

title: Latent-Aligned Reasoning for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in cross-modal understanding, yet a fundamental challenge persists when applying them to recommendation: as representations propagate through multi-step reasoning, both visual and textual signals progressively attenuate - a phenomenon we term cross-modal dilution. To address this, we propose LARK (Latent-Aligned Reasoning frameworK), a two-stage latent reasoning framework with complementary alignment mechanisms within a single VLM. In the first stage, learnable latent tokens are interleaved with multi-step chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and explicitly aligned with a frozen vision encoder, serving as visual checkpoints that preserve perceptual details throughout the reasoning chain. In the second stage, the latent representations are projected via a bridge MLP and trained with item-to-item contrastive learning; to prevent the reasoning semantics from fading, intermediate features are aligned with the CoT hidden states from the first stage, anchoring the final embeddings to the model's own reasoning output. Experiments on three public benchmarks and one industrial dataset show that LARK achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple recommendation architectures, with controlled ablations confirming the distinct contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: LARK提出一种两阶段潜在推理框架，在单一VLM内通过视觉对齐（阶段一）和推理-文本对齐（阶段二）的双重对齐机制，解决多模态推荐中跨模态稀释问题，在四个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态推荐中，VLM进行多步推理时，视觉和文本信号会逐步衰减（跨模态稀释现象），导致密集表征质量下降。现有潜在推理方法仅针对文本生成任务，且仅处理视觉信号，无法直接应用于需要同时保留双模态的推荐场景。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段一在固定模板中交错可学习潜在token与多步CoT推理，将潜在组与冻结视觉编码器进行patch级余弦对齐（ℒ_vision）；阶段二通过Bridge MLP投影潜在表征，结合Swing协同信号进行item-to-item对比学习，并将中间特征与阶段一CoT隐藏状态对齐（ℒ_text）。总损失为ℒ_i2i + λ_cot·ℒ_cot + λ_align·(ℒ_vision + ℒ_text)。基于Qwen2.5-VL-3B，使用Gemini-2.5-Flash生成CoT标注。
AI.result: 在Baby、Sports、Clothing三个Amazon公开子集及一个工业级In-House数据集（85万用户、43万物品、1200万交互）上，LARK+DeepFM/LightGCN/SASRec均一致优于所有基线。在In-House上R@20相对AlignRec提升10.0%；作为drop-in特征替换时最高提升15.1%；消融实验证实双重对齐、CoT监督和潜在推理各自独立贡献；注意力分析和CKA分析证实该方法有效缓解跨模态稀释（图像注意力衰减从45%降至12%，文本从38%降至9%）。
AI.conclusion: LARK通过在单一VLM内进行潜在推理并施加双重对齐，有效缓解了多模态推荐中的跨模态稀释问题，生成的item embedding具有架构无关性，可作为通用encoder部署。未来工作将进行在线A/B测试，并将框架扩展到用户侧建模。

title: LexFlip: A Dissociation Diagnostic for Legal Meaning Preservation Metrics
summary: Does a simplified legal clause still say what the original said? The checks in current use cannot establish that it does: requiring an identical pair to score highest and an unrelated pair lowest moves lexical overlap and legal force together, so any monotone function of token overlap satisfies both. Our remedy is a dissociation, an item holding surface form fixed while legal force moves. We release LexFlip, 373 minimal perturbations of Quebec statutory French that reverse legal force while preserving 0.93 of the tokens, with a harness scoring metrics, regressors and prompted judges alike. The seven embedding and BERTScore metrics we test spend only 0.022 to 0.039 of their identical-to-unrelated range on such an edit, against 0.670 for bidirectional NLI, the one family the identical-pair check would disqualify. On FrJudge, against a measured human ceiling of r=0.597, a bare length feature outscores every semantic metric and has the lowest margin we measure.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法律文本简化中衡量"法律意义保留"的自动评估指标提出诊断工具 LexFlip，揭示现有基于"相同对-无关对"的校验方法无法区分词面重叠与法律效力，导致几乎所有常用语义相似度指标失效，且发现单纯的长度特征在人工标注基准上击败所有语义指标。
AI.motivation: 法律文本自动简化存在严重错误风险（如 Moffatt v. Air Canada 案），现有自动评估指标依赖"相同句对得分最高、无关句对得分最低"两项检查，但这两项检查将词面重叠与法律效力混为一谈，任何词重叠的单调函数都能同时满足，因此无法真正验证指标是否在测量"法律意义"。此外，当前唯一的人工标注资源 FrJudge 的评分机制导致标注结果高度可由长度特征预测，掩盖了语义指标的真正表现。
AI.method: 核心方法是构建"解离"（dissociation）诊断集 LexFlip：在魁北克成文法法语中，对原始条款做最小扰动以反转其法律效力（如 doit→peut 把义务变为许可），同时保持平均 93% 的 token 不变。共 373 对扰动，覆盖 6 类法律效应家族（情态、当事方、极性、数量、范围、时间）。提出"margin fraction"指标衡量：metric 在相同句对与无关句对之间的有效范围内，有多少比例被这一法律性编辑所消耗。同时提出四项校验要求（R1–R4）：人类天花板（R1）、等距监督（R2）、表层特征对照（R3）、解离检验（R4）。在 LexFlip 和 FrJudge（297 条保险条款、5 位法律学生 1–10 分标注）上对 13 个评分器进行统一评测，包括 7 个嵌入/BERTScore 类、双向 NLI（mDeBERTa-XNLI）、token Jaccard、表层特征 ridge 回归，以及以 deepseek-chat 作为提示式法官。
AI.result: （1）LexFlip 诊断：7 个嵌入与 BERTScore 类指标仅消耗其相同-无关范围的 0.022–0.039，行为几乎等同于 token Jaccard（0.079）；双向 NLI 消耗 0.670 的范围，93.3% 项目正确排序；提示式法官消耗 0.370；但在 doit↔peut 上呈现不对称（4.72 vs 8.02），表明其衡量的是"法律严重程度"而非"法律等价性"。（2）FrJudge 评测：人类天花板 r=0.597；单纯长度差特征 r=0.641，超过所有语义指标（最高 BERTScore-FlauBERT r=0.482）；deepseek-chat 法官 r=0.755。（3）排序与诊断结果之间的 Spearman 相关仅 ρ=0.24，校准后相关性高的指标未必对法律性编辑敏感。图 2 右上空区（高相关性+高敏感度）无任何指标占据。结论：现有两项检查（相同/无关）应扩展为三项，加入 LexFlip 式解离检验；双向 NLI 是唯一家族既满足传统检查又对法律效力敏感，但优势可能源于对扰动形式的熟悉而非法律敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 衡量法律意义保留的指标应报告三项检查而非两项：相同对（饱和度）、无关对（底值）、以及 LexFlip（法律变动时是否变动）。前两项可由词面重叠联合满足，第三项不能。法律敏感性不能通过标度校准获得，需基于修正的蕴含目标构建。指标应作为人工审查的"分流排序"工具而非"认证"工具：无法区分 doit 与 peut 的指标不应被用于决定简化条款能否安全发布。研究局限：标签为定义式而非标注式；扰动形式单一且接近 NLI 训练分布，NLI 优势可能反映形式熟悉而非法律敏感性；LexFlip 与 FrJudge 基于不同文本；法官结果依赖单一模型与重构评分细则。

title: Online Change-point Detection for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. This is the original pre-peer-review manuscript submitted to PAAMS 2026. Following peer review and minor revisions, the paper was accepted for the main track of PAAMS 2026 and will be presented in October 2026
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems rely on past experience for learning coordinated behaviour, but this experience may become unreliable if the environment or task objective changes during training. In such cases, agents first need a way to recognize that the situation has changed before deciding how to adapt. This paper studies online change-point detection for cooperative MARL using reward-derived signals. We propose \emph{Patterns of Past Rewards} (PPR), a lightweight algorithm-agnostic detector that smooths agents' return streams, highlights recent changes, and applies a statistical drift detector to flag significant shifts. We evaluate PPR in a custom Speaker-Listener environment based on the Multi-Agent Particle Environment under two controlled non-stationarity scenarios. Our results show a trade-off between detection speed and alarm stability. A smoothed-return baseline detects earlier but produces many repeated alarms. In contrast, applying the detector directly to raw returns often misses the shift. PPR offers a more balanced approach by limiting redundant detections while still identifying the controlled shifts. These findings highlight PPR as a lightweight, reward-based monitoring tool that enables cooperative MARL systems to reliably identify major changes during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PPR（Patterns of Past Rewards），一种轻量级、算法无关的在线变点检测方法，用于在合作型多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练过程中基于奖励信号检测环境或任务目标的非平稳变化。
AI.motivation: 合作型MARL系统依赖历史经验进行协调学习，但当环境或任务目标发生变化时，历史经验可能变得不可靠。现有研究多关注如何适应非平稳性，而非如何检测变化本身。然而，检测是适应的前提——智能体需要先知道何时应不再信任旧经验。因此，本文将变点检测视为合作MARL中值得独立研究的基础问题。
