AI.method: 基于Alpaca Cleaned（51,760条），构建四阶段流水线：(1) 用Gemma-4-31B（8-bit量化）做语义标注（任务+领域）；(2) 样本级路由r(x)∈{mt, loc}，对依赖源语言形式的任务直接走任务级本地化；(3) 对MT路由样本做字段级策略p_f∈{translate, preserve}，使用NLLB-3.3B翻译需翻译字段，其余字段保留；(4) 一致性校验与目标语言强制执行。European-IFEval整合三类来源（人工策划、Marco-Bench-MIF、MultiIFEval）并统一为通用评分格式，用GlotLID-M检测响应语言。实验采用4个3-4B多语言LLM × 50语言 × 3监督条件 = 600次LoRA微调，对比Direct MT / Task-Preserved / EuroAlpaca三个条件，并在Aya Evaluation Suite（参考相似度）与European-IFEval（可验证指令遵循）上评测。
AI.result: 主结果：Direct MT在Aya ROUGE-L/F-BERT上提升，但在European-IFEval上相对基线下降29.8%（绝对值从0.309降至0.217）；EuroAlpaca则在所有指标上均最高——Aya ROUGE-L 0.223（+0.099）、F-BERT 0.870（+0.035）、European-IFEval准确率0.349（+0.040），并在200/200模型-语言对中全面优于Direct MT。消融分析显示：样本级路由+字段保留+任务级本地化贡献主要提升（IFAcc从0.217→0.312），最终一致性校验再额外贡献+0.037。与外部资源对比：在共享语言子集上EuroAlpaca优于Okapi（IFAcc +0.020）和MITS（+0.070），Bactrian-X在20语子集上IFAcc略高（0.401 vs 0.385）但Aya分数较低；跨语言嵌入相似度与Okapi相当（0.860 vs 0.867）。
AI.conclusion: 多语言指令数据不应仅追求目标语言流畅与句子级语义等价，而必须以"任务保持"为首要目标。直接MT会系统性地破坏依赖语言形式的任务，导致可验证指令遵循能力的隐性退化，而参考相似度指标的提升具有误导性。建议结合参考相似度（Aya类）与约束型可验证基准（IFEval类）联合评估多语言指令数据。EuroAlpaca流水线、European-IFEval基准以及完整标注（任务/领域标签、样本级与字段级策略、验证元数据）将在论文接收后开源。

title: Influence Score and Transformers interpretability: Measure of the Effective Impact of Attention Heads at inference time
summary: We propose an influence score to quantify the contribution of attention heads to classification decisions in Transformer-based models designed for prompt injection detection. The score combines directional influence on the logits with structural contribution within the residual stream, enabling a multi-scale analysis at the head, layer, and network levels. Applied to a DeBERTa model specialized for prompt injection detection, our framework reveals distinct decision behaviours between correct and erroneous predictions. Our method provides an effective compromise between fine-grained circuit analysis and global output-based methods, and offers a systematic way to study decision mechanisms in Transformer classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文针对DeBERTa提示注入检测分类器,提出一种注意力头影响力评分,将头部对logit的方向性影响与在残差流中的结构贡献相结合,实现头/层/网络多尺度可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: Transformer分类器(尤其用于提示注入检测)虽性能优异,但其内部决策机制不透明。现有可解释性方法要么粒度过细(如电路分析)成本高,要么仅基于输出(如LIME/SHAP)无法揭示内部组件作用,缺乏连接内部机制与最终分类决策的折中框架。
AI.method: 提出影响力评分 S_{k,h}(x) = Δ_{k,h}(x) · C_{k,h}(x) · α_k(x),其中Δ_{k,h}为注意力头激活在正负类logit差方向上的投影(方向性影响),C_{k,h}基于ALTI的几何邻近度度量(残差流内相对贡献),α_k为层级的归一化权重。该评分支持头级、层级和网络级聚合分析。
AI.result: 在DeBERTa-v3-base提示注入检测模型上(30k样本):TP决策稳定集中,TN呈三模态分布(对应不同文本长度/类型的内部策略),FP在深层出现对Injection类的过度激活,FN则在深层出现Benign信号的过强补偿;消融实验证实综合评分选择的头部比单独使用方向性投影或贡献度导致更大的性能下降(F1降幅0.014),验证了因果作用。
AI.conclusion: 该评分在细粒度电路分析与全局输出方法之间提供了有效折中,可系统揭示Transformer分类器的决策机制;正确预测依赖更分布的贡献平衡,错误则源于深层信号失衡;模型存在功能冗余/过参数化倾向;未来方向包括引入tuned lens式的层级投影变换及渐进剪枝验证。

title: Improving Language Identification for Code-Switched Utterances with Integer Linear Programming
summary: Automatic identification of code-switched (CS) utterances remains a challenge for language identification (LID) systems, causing such texts to be underrepresented in the training data of Large Language Models. In this paper, we revisit MaskLID, a state-of-the art approach for CS identification, which requires no training and detects arbitrary language combinations. We make three main contributions: (a) we reveal, and address, a major issue of MaskLID: its overreliance on word-level language association scores; (b) we reformulate the underlying optimization algorithm as an Integer Linear Program, enabling us to experiment with a large set of clear and interpretable constraints; (c) each of these improvements vastly improves the baseline system, as we illustrate in experiments involving 10~diverse languages, where we observe a strong boost in performance on CS benchmarks. We release our code and data for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MaskLID在代码转换(CS)语言识别中的两大缺陷，提出两项改进：构建词级LID（LiteLID）和将优化问题重新建模为整数线性规划(ILP4LID)。在10种语言的CS基准测试上，精确匹配率相对提升达+100%，平均EM从0.54提升至0.71。
AI.motivation: 代码转换(CS)文本在LLM训练数据中代表性不足，根源在于现有语言识别(LID)系统难以可靠地识别句内多语言混杂现象。MaskLID作为当前最优CS-LID方法虽免训练且支持任意语言组合，但其过度依赖不可靠的词级语言关联分数，且采用贪婪迭代策略，缺乏全局最优性。
AI.method: (1) 构建LiteLID：在125种拉丁语系标签上微调FastText，加入单词级训练实例，使词级预测概率从0.31提升至0.50；(2) ILP4LID：将CS-LID形式化为整数线性规划，定义二元变量y_{l,t}表示词-语言分配，引入核心约束C1(每词至多一种语言)、C2(句子至多K种语言)，扩展约束C3(最小长度τ)、C4/C5(top-M掩码)、C6(语言切换数≤S)，并通过语言权重α和惩罚P控制单语与双语分配的权衡；(3) 求解采用Gurobi，以HiGHS为开源替代。
AI.result: 在10种语言(含土耳其语-英语、印地语-英语、巴斯克语-西班牙语等8对CS语对)的测试集上：CS子集EM从0.30(GlotLID+MaskLID)提升至0.67(ILP4LID-CS)；AVG配置综合EM从0.54提升至0.71；土耳其-英语EM绝对提升+0.44，尼泊尔-英语+0.35。ILP4LID仅对97%的词进行分配(而MaskLID为77%)，词级F1平均0.88(对0.82)，但计算开销增加约10-20倍。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明MaskLID的核心缺陷（词级评分不可靠和贪婪搜索次优）可通过两项互补改进得到有效缓解。ILP框架为CS-LID提供了灵活、可解释的约束表达方式，是处理非正式多语言文本的重要进展。未来工作包括：校准更好的后验概率、扩展非拉丁文字语言、加速ILP求解。

title: NS-ST-GraphRAG: Neuro-Symbolic Spatio-Temporal GraphRAG for Literary Knowledge Processing
comment: Submitted to Information Processing and Management
summary: Long-form literary narratives pose a distinctive information-processing challenge for retrieval-augmented generation: relevant evidence is distributed across chapters, relations evolve over narrative time, and correct answers may depend jointly on temporal, spatial, and relational constraints. We propose NS-ST-GraphRAG, a neuro-symbolic spatio-temporal GraphRAG framework that integrates ontology-guided extraction, deterministic constraint checking, dual temporal coordinates, spatial scene attributes, and dynamic sub-graph retrieval. Instead of retrieving from a single corpus-level graph, the framework selects the graph state valid for the temporal and spatial scope of a query and grounds generated answers in traceable evidence. We further introduce Red-Chamber-QA, to our knowledge the first open multi-hop question-answering benchmark for classical Chinese literature, with time-, space-, and general-question categories, per-part evidence spans, and deterministic shortcut controls. On a 120-question held-out split, NS-ST-GraphRAG achieves mechanical answer reproduction of 0.733 versus 0.675 for the frozen window baseline and 0.083 for a closed-book model (McNemar exact p = 0.092, directionally favorable but not significant); semantic-judge accuracy is 0.866 versus 0.850. The pre-specified constrained-category condition of H2 is not supported by the delivered comparison. These results show how temporal graph representation, constrained extraction, and auditable evaluation integrate into a unified framework for verifiable knowledge processing over long-form narrative.

AI.tldr: NS-ST-GraphRAG 是一个面向长篇文学叙事的神经-符号时空知识处理框架，配套发布了首个古典中文文学多跳问答基准 Red-Chamber-QA。在120题留出测试集上，其机械答案复现率为0.733（窗口基线0.675，闭卷模型0.083），但与基线的差异未达统计显著水平，且预设的受限类别假设H2未被支持。
AI.motivation: 长篇叙事（如《红楼梦》120章）中的多跳问答需要联合考虑时间、空间和关系约束，而现有RAG（基于向量分块的检索增强生成）和GraphRAG（基于图谱的检索增强生成）的图表示缺乏叙事情节的有效性时间区间，无法将查询路由到正确的子图，导致时间/空间受限问题无法被现有管道准确回答。此外，文学文本的隐喻与间接指代易使无约束的大语言模型抽取产生违反故事内部逻辑的虚假关系（幻觉），且古典中文文学缺乏开放的多跳问答基准。
AI.method: 框架由三个耦合模块组成：(1) 本体引导抽取+神经符号约束层（OGE+NSCL），通过LLM（大语言模型）抽取候选三元组后，由领域本体（谱系、主仆、称谓性别等硬规则+软约束）进行确定性过滤与有界修复；(2) 时空图构建（STGC），采用章节索引（粗粒度）与叙事情节时间区间（细粒度）双时间坐标，并附加空间场景属性，支持按时间/空间切片检索；(3) 动态子图检索（DSGR），轻量级解析查询中的时空约束，通过索引查找匹配切片并保留最短路径以保证多跳链完整性，生成可溯源答案。同时构建了Red-Chamber-QA基准（104题预发布+120题留出测试），采用机械+语义双轨评分协议与确定性捷径控制。
AI.result: 在120题留出测试集上：NS-ST-GraphRAG的DPC-mech（双重部分完成度-机械匹配）为0.733，对比冻结窗口基线MVP v6的0.675和闭卷模型的0.083（McNemar精确检验p=0.092，方向有利但不显著）；DPC-judge（语义判定）为0.866 vs 0.850 vs 0.274；引用忠实度（CF）为0.825 vs 0.817 vs 0.025。预设假设H2（受限类别增益大于一般类别）未被支持（Space-Constrained增益为0）。开发集上R5配置DPC-mech达0.510（基线0.413），但语义判定0.824低于基线0.919。抽取层面，约束层完全消除了坐标复制错误（44/44），但当前规则族未标记出黄金标注中的10处违反中的任何一处。跨体裁采样（《骆驼祥子》3章）经25-35分钟专家适配后，严格幻觉率为0%。
AI.conclusion: 论文展示了如何将时间图表示、受约束抽取和可审计评估整合为长篇叙事可验证知识处理的统一框架。核心贡献包括：约束修复层完全消除坐标类错误；时空双坐标机制在开发集单例上证明可避免不相关场景检索；双轨评分协议暴露了语义正确性与机械复现之间68.4个百分点的差距。但交付的留出实验未能支持关键假设H2，系统与窗口基线的差异在统计上不显著，多跳与难题上仍有显著缺口。作者明确披露了这些限制，并将四项基线比较、消融实验、效率与构建成本指标等推迟至完整发布版本。

title: From Vision to Language: Investigating Causal Information Flow in Multimodal Decision-Making
summary: Vision-Language Models are commonly evaluated through their final predictions, but understanding whether these decisions are grounded in visual evidence requires tracing how visual information contributes to language-based decisions. With this purpose in mind, we investigate cross-modal information flow in a video-based generative multiple-choice-like setting by applying a layer-wise causal intervention on video-text attention pathways. We target spatial, causal, and temporal visual reasoning. Our results show that visual information is mainly integrated while the model processes the candidate answer options, which serve as the primary textual grounding sites for the final decision. We further show that nouns play an important role as semantic anchors during multimodal enrichment, while verbs are more relevant when temporal relations are processed. Finally, we identify a distinct pattern in temporal reasoning, suggesting that VLMs struggle to reconstruct sequential information across video frames, but we remark that such fragility may also reflect linguistic biases associated with specific temporal expressions used for defining the relation between events within a scene.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过层级注意力阻断（Attention Knockout）方法，在视频-文本多模态决策任务中因果性地追踪视觉信息如何流入语言表征，揭示候选答案选项是多模态融合的核心区域，名词充当语义锚点，时间推理存在明显脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM评测仅依赖最终预测，无法揭示视觉信息是否真正被模型用于决策，尤其在视频理解中容易出现单模态坍塌。需要从行为评估转向机制性解释，追踪视觉证据如何在内部计算中支撑语言决策。
AI.method: 基于MAIA基准的意大利语caption-foil配对数据集（空间、因果、时间三个子集，各1600对），对Qwen2.5-VL 7B和LLaVA-OneVision 7B进行视频-文本注意力通路的层级因果干预。通过在pre-softmax注意力分数上设置-∞掩码，阻断特定文本区域（问题、选项A/B、助手内容）对视觉token的注意力，并使用logit-lens进行逐层读出与强制目标打分。进一步在token级别按POS（名词、动词、介词、类别关键token）进行细粒度干预。
AI.result: （1）视觉信息主要在模型处理候选答案选项时整合，选项区域是跨模态融合的核心站点，而非任务指令或助手响应区域；（2）名词充当视觉接地实体的语义锚点，时间推理中动词更受视觉信息影响，类别关键token在LLaVA-OneVision中尤为突出；（3）空间和因果推理呈现相似的层级处理动态，而时间推理更为脆弱，模型难以跨视频帧重建序列信息，叠加特定时间标记（如While、When）的语言偏见后出现低于随机水平的性能。英语翻译数据上的鲁棒性检验总体确认了上述趋势。
AI.conclusion: 候选选项是多模态融合的核心文本区域，名词是主要的语义锚点。视觉信息通过视觉增强的文本表征间接传递，而非直接从视频流向响应。时间推理的困难部分源于视频序列信息的重建挑战，部分源于时间标记相关的语言偏见。

title: Compression Beyond the Uncompressed: A Two-Stage Training Recipe for Soft Context Compression in RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances language models with external knowledge, but the lengthy retrieved context inflates the input and degrades inference efficiency. Soft context compression encodes each document into a substantially shorter embedding sequence. However, most existing approaches are trained by distilling outputs from uncompressed RAG systems, inherently limiting their performance relative to the original model. To address this limitation, we propose DEX-Comp, a two-stage training recipe: Pure Distillation warm-starts the compression model on the uncompressed RAG's correct responses only, and Hard Exploration then runs reinforcement learning solely on queries the uncompressed RAG fails, forcing the model to explore computation patterns better suited to compressed representations. On five open-domain QA benchmarks at retrieval depths from top-5 to top-30, DEX-Comp compresses retrieved contexts by $16\times$ and accelerates inference by $4\times$--$24\times$, while achieving performance comparable to or exceeding the uncompressed RAG baseline across retrieval depths. Ablations and evaluations across diverse datasets and backbones further confirm the contribution of each stage and the generalization of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEX-Comp，一种用于RAG软上下文压缩的两阶段训练方法（纯蒸馏+硬探索），首次实现查询无关软压缩在多个检索深度下超越未压缩RAG基线，同时实现16×压缩率和最高23.7×推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有软上下文压缩方法通过蒸馏未压缩RAG的输出来训练，导致其性能被未压缩模型上限所限制。研究者认为这一差距部分源于：压缩模型继承了基于离散token推理的计算范式，而该范式对于压缩后的稠密嵌入表示而言并非最优。
AI.method: DEX-Comp采用两阶段训练：Stage I（纯蒸馏，PD）仅在未压缩RAG回答正确的样本S⁺上进行KL散度蒸馏，冷启动压缩器-解码器联合系统；Stage II（硬探索，HE）在未压缩RAG回答失败的样本S⁻上使用GRPO强化学习，采用二元结果奖励和组内相对优势估计，迫使模型探索更适合压缩表示的计算模式。两阶段互补：PD提供可靠初始化，HE实现超越模仿的探索。架构上，压缩器和解码器共享Mistral-7B-Instruct骨干，各自由独立LoRA适配器实现。
AI.result: 在NQ、TriviaQA、HotpotQA、ASQA、PopQA五个开放域QA基准上，16×压缩率下DEX-Comp在所有检索深度（top-5/15/30）均超越未压缩RAG基线，平均CEM/LLM提升超过2-4分（统计显著，p<0.05）。效率方面，top-30时TTFT加速23.7×，计算量减少13.6×，显存减少4.0×。消融实验证实两个阶段均不可或缺，PD优于全量SFT，HE在困难子集上RL优于混合/正确子集RL。在不同骨干模型（Llama、Qwen）和OOD数据集（BioASQ、CovidQA、FEVER）上均展现良好的泛化性。嵌入分析显示模型在局部与全局表示间进行能力分配。
AI.conclusion: DEX-Comp是首个在多种检索深度下超越未压缩RAG的查询无关软压缩方法，证明"压缩超越未压缩"是可行的。两阶段范式（可靠模仿+定向探索）为软上下文压缩提供了新的训练思路，并在效率-精度权衡上展现了显著优势。未来工作需探索动态语料增量压缩、任务特定RL的隔离效应分析，以及忠实性和长文本生成场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Can Large Language Models Anticipate Behavioral Responses to Social Policies? A Case of Pension Enrollment Prediction among China's Flexible Workers
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures; includes supplementary material. Code and reproduction materials: this https URL
summary: Assessing the impacts of social policy changes is a widely acknowledged challenge for policymakers. Econometric methods can be unreliable when extrapolating to hypothetical scenarios, while field pilot programs are highly costly. In this paper, we propose using large language models (LLMs) as policy-assessment tools adapted from general-purpose models. We present FlexPension-LLM, the first domain-specialized large language model for a hierarchical pension-enrollment prediction task among flexible workers in China, and introduce DKI-RDistill, which injects policy-grounded cues into the prompt, including Probit-derived marginal effects and hukou-province pension rules. The method then uses LoRA/SFT to distill rationale-augmented supervision into an open-weight MoE student, with teacher errors corrected by regenerating those cases under ground-truth labels. On a CHFS 2019 blind split, FlexPension-LLM achieves 0.9316 Composite F1, surpassing its Claude Sonnet 4.5 teacher and 15 of 17 baselines, and is statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.6. Across four external surveys, it averages 0.7549 Composite F1 and shows the narrowest performance range among the strongest systems. Component analysis shows that gains come mainly from policy-grounded cue injection and error-filtered supervision, while rationales provide decision traces that can be checked against policy rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlexPension-LLM——首个面向中国灵活就业人员养老金参保预测的领域专用大语言模型，并提出 DKI-RDistill 框架，将计量先验（Probit 边际效应）与户籍省份养老金规则注入提示，并通过 LoRA/SFT 蒸馏带推理监督的开源 MoE 学生模型。在 CHFS 2019 盲测集上取得 0.9316 Composite F1，超越其教师模型 Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 17 个基线中的 15 个，并在四个外部调查上展现稳定的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 社会政策效果评估面临两难：计量经济学方法在反事实场景中外推不可靠，现场试点成本高昂。养老金参保决策（灵活就业人员是否参保、以及选择居民养老还是职工养老）涉及个人、家庭、制度等多层次信号，是一个分层、规则驱动、行为开放的预测任务，亟需一种能在个体层面模拟政策响应的工具。
AI.method: 提出 DKI-RDistill 三阶段框架：(1) 领域知识注入 (DKI)——将 Probit 边际效应与户籍省份养老金规则转化为三个提示侧指标（居民养老金负担比、职工养老金负担比、家庭养老金依赖度）；(2) 推理增强监督——以 Claude Sonnet 4.5 为教师生成结构化推理，对正确案例保留推理，对错误案例在真实标签下重新生成；(3) 学生模型适配——以 Qwen 3.5-35B-A3B 为开源 MoE 学生，通过 LoRA/SFT 将带推理的监督蒸馏到学生模型，输出结构化 JSON 决策与推理。
AI.result: 在 CHFS 2019 独立盲测集（2,350 例）上取得 Action F1=0.9271、Type F1=0.9383、Composite F1=0.9316，在 18 个评估模型中排名第 3，显著优于 15 个基线（包括其教师 Claude Sonnet 4.5，得分 +0.0107），与 Claude Opus 4.6 统计上不可区分。在 CHFS 2017、CFPS 2018、CHIP 2018、CLDS 2018 四个外部调查上平均 Composite F1=0.7549，性能区间最窄。组件分析显示：DKI 提示使教师 Composite F1 提升 +0.0668，错误过滤监督与 DKI 提示是增益主要来源。错误分析显示教师侧 DKI 使盲测错误大致减半，学生适配大幅降低零样本学生的误参保与渠道错误。27 位专家盲评中 FlexPension-LLM 在 324 次案例级选择中获得 157 次（48.5%）最高信任偏好。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过将计量先验与户籍省份养老金规则注入提示并蒸馏带推理的监督，领域专用大语言模型可以在政策敏感的社会科学分层决策任务上达到接近前沿的预测性能，并生成可对照政策规则核查的决策推理。FlexPension-LLM 仅用于群体性政策模拟与评估，不适用于个体参保建议或行政决策；其应用受限于中国养老金制度与可用调查数据，迁移需重建政策输入与验证数据。

title: Self-Supervised Lexical Representation Learning for Fast, Large-Scale Phylogenetic Inference
summary: Computational phylogenetics has become an essential tool in historical linguistics, yet its application at a global scale remains constrained by two factors: the labor-intensive manual annotation of cognacy judgments required for character-based methods and the substantial computational cost of inference on large datasets. This paper introduces a fully self-supervised contrastive learning framework that learns lexical representations directly from raw IPA-transcribed wordlists, without requiring cognacy annotations, alignments, or additional expert input. The model employs a dual contrastive objective: a word-level loss that organizes phonetically similar forms into a coherent space, and an auxiliary language-level loss that encourages the lexical space to reflect broader phonological properties of languages. From the resulting word representations, pairwise language distances are derived and used to infer a global phylogenetic tree of 3,399 language varieties. The inferred tree achieves a generalized quartet distance (GQD) to the Glottolog reference tree competitive with multiple baselines, while requiring only minutes of computation on a standard notebook GPU. Furthermore, the same representations capture diachronic concept stability: variance in pairwise distances across languages yields stability rankings that correlate significantly with established rankings. Ablation studies confirm that both the language-level objective and the use of phonetic feature vectors improved the inferred trees topology with regards to GQD. The framework thus provides a computationally efficient and fully automatic alternative for large-scale phylogenetic inference and offers a unified representation supporting downstream analyses at both the language and concept level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DualCWE——一个完全自监督的对比学习框架,可直接从原始IPA转写的词表中学习词级表征,无需同源词标注、词对齐或专家输入,能在标准笔记本GPU上以分钟级时间推断3,399种语言变体的全球系统发育树,其拓扑质量(GQD=0.0346)优于多个自动化基线,同一表征还能捕捉概念稳定性的历时信息。
AI.motivation: 计算系统发育学在历史语言学中至关重要,但全球规模应用受两大因素制约:基于字符的方法需专家手工标注同源判断(耗时、昂贵且存在偏见),且大规模数据集上的推理计算成本极高。亟需一种无需手工标注、计算高效的自动化替代方案。
AI.method: 模型DualCWE采用双层对比学习架构:(1) 词级编码器——将IPA字符编码为39维音征向量,经Transformer+相对位置编码+掩码均值池化得到词表示,使用NT-Xent对比损失让音近形式聚集;(2) 语言级编码器——聚合同一语言的词表示,通过第二个Transformer获得语言级表示,辅以对比损失(权重0.2),迫使词空间反映更广泛的语言音系特征。训练批次按32种语言×30概念构造,使用概念嵌入和语言嵌入。推理阶段从词编码器输出计算语言对的余弦距离,经BIONJ构建系统树,并以GQD对Glottolog参考树评估;概念稳定性以各概念跨语言对距离方差作为代理指标。
AI.result: 在3,399种语言、210个核心概念的Lexibank数据上:(1) DualCWE的GQD均值0.0346(5次种子SD=0.003),优于MSA基线(0.0433)、LDN(0.0468)和pHMM(0.0692),MAD定根得分0.013远优于Jäger(2026)的0.060;(2) 概念稳定性排名与7/11个已有显著相关,最强为Rama & Borin(r=0.72)、Holman et al.(r=-0.49)和Dellert & Buch(r=0.45);(3) 消融实验证实语言级目标、音征向量编码及完整概念集均显著改善拓扑;(4) 完整流程在NVIDIA 3070笔记本GPU上仅约8分钟(3分钟训练+5分钟推理),而MSA方法需144核服务器100+小时;(5) 仍存在地理信号泄漏(r=0.20)及家族内部分辨率有限(平均家族GQD约0.12)等问题。
AI.conclusion: DualCWE证明了从原始词表自监督学习词表示即可获得足够的历史语言学信号,支持全球规模的系统发育推断和概念稳定性分析,大幅降低计算成本并消除对专家标注的依赖,为大规模历史语言学及NLP下游任务提供了高效、可复现的统一表征框架;但仍有改进空间,如区分继承相似性与接触趋同、调整批量组成与超参数,以及将表征迁移至借词检测、方言测量等其他任务。

title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
summary: Recent advances in wearable sensing enable continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral signals, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether AI systems can reason over a real user's longitudinal wearable record. We introduce WearableQA, a benchmark comprising 4,084 10-option multiple-choice questions constructed from the wearable time series, blood biomarkers, and demographics of 200 real users, each with up to 500 days of daily measurements. WearableQA preserves authentic wearable distributions that include device noise and inter-individual variability. To evaluate distinct reasoning capabilities, we introduce 16 question types organized along two complementary axes: data versus health reasoning, which distinguishes computation over longitudinal measurements from physiological interpretation; and single- versus cross-signal reasoning, which separates reasoning about individual signals from the integration of multiple signals. To construct reliable questions at scale, we adopt a dual-grounding framework that combines literature-grounded physiological findings with statistically validated population-grounded physiological patterns. This enables the capture of meaningful relationships observed in real-world wearable data. Evaluation of 14 proprietary and open-source LLMs demonstrates that WearableQA effectively differentiates model capabilities, with performance ranging from 19.6% to 72.9% against a 10% chance baseline. Moreover, WearableQA remains far from solved: most models achieve accuracies below 60%. Overall, WearableQA provides a realistic and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over real-world wearable data.

AI.tldr: WearableQA 是一个面向真实用户纵向可穿戴数据的大语言模型推理评测基准，包含 4,084 道十选一选择题，源自 200 名真实用户最多 500 天的可穿戴时序、血液生物标志物和人口学数据，并提出 16 种问题类型沿数据/健康推理与单信号/跨信号两条轴展开；评估 14 个模型后，最高准确率仅 72.9%，多数模型低于 60%，表明当前 LLM 在真实纵向可穿戴数据推理上仍远未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有可穿戴数据相关评测多依赖合成或模拟信号，无法反映真实设备噪声与个体差异；同时也缺乏能区分模型在不同推理能力（数据计算 vs 健康解读、单信号 vs 多信号整合）上的系统性基准，因此无法诊断 LLM 在真实用户健康轨迹推理上的真实水平。
AI.method: 提出双锚定（dual-grounding）构建框架：一是基于 11 篇同行评审可穿戴文献（Nature Medicine、PNAS 等）的生理关系，要求至少两项独立同向研究支持；二是从大规模可穿戴队列中挖掘经过效应量（|ρ|≥0.5）、稳健性（bootstrap≥80%、留一天法、边界死区）与真实性（跨用户零检验 FDR≤0.20）三道统计门控的群体级模式。两类问题均以"发现-标注"方式在每个用户的真实数据上由确定性计算原语（滞后相关、阈值标志等）生成可复现答案，再通过三轮模型审阅与人工校验去除捷径与信息泄露，并按 2×2 推理×信号复杂度分类法组织为 16 类问题（共 4,084 题，10 选 1，答案位平衡，10% 随机基线）。
AI.result: 评测 6 个闭源与 8 个开源共 14 个 LLM：Gemini-3.1-Pro 最高 72.9%，Claude-Opus-4.6 60.2%，最佳开源 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 仅 42.5%，Llama-3.2-3B 低至 19.6%。除 Gemini-3.1-Pro 外，所有模型健康推理均显著优于数据推理（如 GPT-4o 53.5% vs 25.3%）；单信号普遍优于跨信号，强模型差距更明显。CoT 比直接回答平均提升 1.6–19.6 分。小模型存在强位置偏置（Llama-3.2-3B 直接回答时 51.5% 集中于单一选项）。在最强耦合带中，定义性信号对（如步数-活动消耗）显著高于经验性信号对（如静息心率-压力），GPT-5.4、GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro 差距超 36 分，揭示模型主要依赖先验而非从个体数据读取关联。纯文本格式（row/col/csv/markdown）差异不超 1.2 分，图像输入反而降至 34–37 分；开放 Python 工具访问（agentic fixed-repr）使 GPT-5.4 由 51.2 跃升至 71.3，去除时序输入则整体跌至 17.3%，证明基准切实依赖可穿戴测量。
AI.conclusion: WearableQA 通过保留真实设备噪声与个体差异、并以确定性计算生成答案，为评估 LLM 在个人纵向健康轨迹上的推理能力提供了真实且具诊断性的测试平台；其结果揭示了当前 LLM 在数据推理、跨信号整合及用户特异关联推断上的核心短板，并表明工具化推理远优于纯文本或图像解读，是推动面向真实可穿戴场景 LLM 健康助手的重要基准。

title: Repeated Queries Exhaust an LLM's Brand Recommendations but Not Its Sources
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, code, per-cell tables and data pointers at this http URL (research/recommendation-saturation)
summary: Whether repeated identical buying questions exhaust a language model's brand recommendations depends on retrieval. Across 300 question-engine cells (50 questions, six engines, 15 runs each, open extraction over 1,470 adjudicated organizations), the five engines answering without web search were still adding never-seen brands at run 15 in 86-92% of cells, with median repertoires of 15-31 organizations; the one retrieval-enabled engine closed its list (median 8 organizations, 64% of cells still adding), matching four earlier deep cells where web-search runs saturated by run ten. Cited-domain accumulation keeps rising at every horizon tested: four deep cells were still adding domains at run 24 with 59-84% of the Chao2 lower-bound estimate observed, and 44% of the retrieval engine's breadth cells were still adding domains at run 15. A single run shows 62-77% of the five-run brand set, and across engines the median question draws 38 organizations, of which a median of 15 appear in exactly one engine. Estimators are exact rarefaction and Chao2 richness; a parallel fixed-roster extraction reproduces flat curves on identical responses, so roster-bounded tracking manufactures plateaus that open extraction removes.

AI.tldr: 重复查询不会穷尽LLM的品牌推荐，除非启用检索（联网）。在6个LLM引擎、50个购买类问题、每题15次重复、开放抽取1470个机构的实验下，无检索的5个引擎在第15轮仍有86–92%的单元格在新增品牌（中位数15–31个），而唯一带检索的引擎（中位数8个，64%仍在增加）则趋于饱和。引用域名积累在所有测试范围（最多24轮）上仍在增长。
AI.motivation: 审计人员、品牌追踪者和研究者对LLM的商业问答回答进行采样并报告，但每个报告都隐含一个采样完备性假设——即所收集的运行已看到了模型会输出的全部内容。本文测量的是：当对同一问题重复查询时，模型推荐的品牌集合和引用域名集合随运行次数增长的累积结构（即"是否被穷尽"），而不是之前工作中测量的均值稳定性。
AI.method: 将每次运行视为一个采样单元，将品牌（或引用域名）视为物种，应用经典的物种累积工具：(1) 精确稀疏曲线 A(k)，即收集的 n 次运行中 k 次后的期望不同项数；(2) 最终稀疏增量 A(n)−A(n−1)=Q₁/n，其中 Q₁ 计数恰好在一次运行中出现的项；(3) Chao2 丰富度估计（一种下界）。两项研究：(1) Study 1 重新分析既有语料（GPT-5.2/Gemini 3 Flash/Perplexity sonar-pro，250题×5轮），加上两个深度探测（英国超市和北欧护理机构，各24轮，带检索），使用50品牌固定名册抽取；(2) Study 2 新采集4500次响应（GPT-5.6、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.7 Flash、Grok 4.5、Mistral Large、Perplexity sonar，仅后者带检索），50题×15轮×6引擎，开放抽取——将候选字符串池化后由LLM以温度0分类判定，并对平行名册分支做对照。
AI.result: 无检索的5个引擎在第15轮仍有86–92%的单元格在新增从未见过的品牌，中位数15–31个机构，单次运行占5次运行品牌集的62–72%；Chao2下界达成率86–94%。唯一的检索引擎中位数仅8个机构，64%单元格仍在增加，但已达Chao2的100%。引用域名：深度探测的4个单元格到第24轮Q₁仍为18、6、41、12，达成Chao2估计的59–84%；检索引擎50个单元格中44%在第15轮仍在增加域名。跨引擎中位每题汇集38个机构，其中15个仅出现在唯一引擎中。固定名册抽取再现平坦曲线（Study 2名册分支中位数4–5个品牌），说明Study 1的早期平台是名册造成的假象，而非模型本身属性。
AI.conclusion: 重复查询是否耗尽LLM品牌推荐是部署层面的属性，检索是开关。联网时答案集短，几次重复即可见全貌；不联网时5个厂商的引擎在第15次相同运行仍在产出从未见过的机构，规模是联网引擎的3–6倍。引用域名积累在所有实际预算范围内未封闭。对购买或销售重复查询审计的从业者，预算问题应分三路：联网品牌列表完成成本低；非联网品牌列表和引用图谱在实用预算内开放无界；这些预算都不决定推荐频率，后者需要独立设计。下一步是跨类别、语言、解码设置和更多检索配置的复现。

title: Controversy and Group Certainty Jointly Shape Everyday Moral Judgments
summary: Everyday moral life rarely resembles a trolley problem. It involves disputes about families, relationships, work, money, and care, situations in which people often encounter the judgments of others. We examined how judgments about nuanced interpersonal dilemmas respond to social information that conveys collective opinion without revealing the arguments behind it. Specifically, we studied two signals: controversy, the extent to which community judgments are divided between two opposing verdicts; and group certainty, the confidence expressed by each side. We derived these signals from 54,827 judgments on 135 dilemmas posted to Reddit's r/AmItheAsshole and presented them separately or together in a preregistered randomized experiment (N = 2,159). Relative to the control condition, all three treatments increased both weakening, a changed verdict or reduced confidence, and strengthening, increased confidence without a verdict change. Thus, aggregated social information can reshape moral judgments even without arguments. Controversy alone tripled the weakening rate, from 5.3% to 15.9%. Shown alone, certainty on either side was associated with movement toward that side. Shown alongside controversy, only like-minded certainty remained clearly associated with less weakening. This asymmetry of influence is double-edged: the confidence of like-minded others may help minorities resist majority pressure, but it may also insulate mistaken judgments from correction.

AI.tldr: 一项预注册的随机实验研究（N=2,159）考察了"争议性"和"群体确定性"两种无论证的社会信息信号如何影响人们对日常人际道德困境的判断。研究发现：仅凭简短、无论证的群体判断摘要即可改变道德判断；争议性使判断弱化率从5.3%增至15.9%；与自己立场一致方的确定性有助于抵抗多数压力，但也可能使错误判断免于纠正。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注通过论证或对话改变道德判断，而对"薄"的社会证据（即不提供理由、仅呈现集体意见分布）如何影响日常道德判断知之甚少。本研究旨在填补这一空白，考察争议性（群体内部分歧程度）和群体确定性（各方表达的信心程度）这两种可与实质内容分离的社会信号，对人们日常道德判断的影响。
AI.method: 基于Reddit的r/AmItheAsshole社区的54,827条判断构建MoralMoments数据集（135个道德困境，涵盖32个主题），从中提取两个社会信号：(1) 争议性（少数方判决占比）；(2) 群体确定性（各方表达确定性的比例）。进行预注册的随机对照实验（N=2,159名Prolific被试），将被试随机分配到四种条件：争议性、确定性、争议性+确定性、控制组（仅做话题分类）。每位被试评估两个困境，记录前/后判决（YA/NA）和信心（1-4级李克特量表）。判断变化分为三类：弱化（改变判决或降低信心）、维持、增强（不变判决且提高信心）。使用逻辑斯蒂回归进行主分析，采用10折交叉验证和贪婪前向选择确定最佳模型，并通过LLM分析被试书面解释。
AI.result: （1）总体效应：与控制组相比（弱化率5.3%），三种处理均显著提高了弱化率（确定性10.6%、争议性15.9%、联合12.1%）和增强率。（2）单独显示时，分歧度（β=4.52, p<0.001）和外群体确定性（β=2.06, p<0.001）增加弱化，内群体确定性（β=-2.46, p<0.001）减少弱化。（3）联合显示时，分歧度和内群体确定性仍保持显著预测力，但外群体确定性不再显著（β=0.49, p=0.317），呈现不对称模式。（4）少数派立场被试在联合条件下当己方确定性不低于对方时，弱化率较低（18.1% vs 20.3%），表明类似确定性可保护少数派抵抗多数压力。（5）书面解释分析显示，被试对争议性提及最多（32%），内群体确定性多于外群体确定性。（6）未发现严重程度、受影响方或弱势群体涉及与判断变化之间存在稳健关联。
AI.conclusion: 道德判断对极其微薄的社会证据具有响应性：即使无任何论证，简短的群体判断摘要亦可双向改变道德判断。争议性是最强的信号；确定性效应取决于人们是否能看到群体分歧程度以及自身处于多数还是少数地位。这一"确定性不对称"具有双刃性：同意见方的信心可帮助有根据的少数派异议抵抗多数压力，但也可能使错误判断免于纠正。研究未建立更新后的判断是否更准确或更正当，因此对社会平台和AI系统而言，应同时呈现争议性和群体确定性，而非将流行度或确定性视为道德正确性的标志。

title: On Being Prepared: Automated Vehicle Incident Management Exercise Practices
summary: Incident management (IM) has evolved over recent decades to cover an ever-expanding array of hazards and systems. Barring real-life experience, exercises are a key tool in developing an effective IM program. As part of enterprise resilience and operational readiness, IM practitioners design exercises to understand and build capabilities for efficiently and effectively responding to incidents. Combining research and policy on an emerging transportation technology, automated vehicles (AVs), with established practices for IM, we describe what makes exercises effective and how they can be used to identify gaps and develop capacity. A range of exercise types exist, from workshops, to tabletops, to drills, and to full-scale exercises. Every stage of an exercise - preparing, setting up, facilitating, closing, and assessing - is interconnected and should further the exercise's objectives. AV IM practitioners can maximize the utility of a mature exercise program through exercise quality, diversity, and volume. The need to respond to AV incidents, from collisions to natural hazards, is inevitable. This paper tailors existing practices to a series of frameworks, predicated on the unique socio-technical nature of AVs to provide first-of-its-kind guidance for AV IM exercises. Additionally, these frameworks are company-neutral to enable intercompany and inter-organization collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文将传统事件管理(IM)演习实践与自动驾驶车辆(AV)这一新兴交通技术相结合，提出针对AV事故响应的演习指导框架，涵盖演习类型选择、流程设计及协作机制。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆技术的快速发展，其事故响应需求日益迫切，但目前缺乏针对AV特性的事件管理演习指导；现有IM演习实践未能充分考虑AV独特的社会-技术属性，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 结合自动化车辆的交通运输研究、政策分析与已成熟的事件管理实践，针对演习类型（研讨会、桌面推演、演练到全面演习）及全生命周期阶段（准备、设置、引导、结束、评估），定制化构建适用于AV事件管理的系列框架，强调公司中立性以促进跨组织协作。
AI.result: 提出了首个针对自动驾驶车辆事件管理演习的指导框架，通过演习质量、多样性与数量的最大化提升成熟演习项目效用，覆盖从碰撞到自然灾害的各类AV事故响应场景。
AI.conclusion: AV事故响应不可避免，成熟的演习项目是企业韧性与运营准备的重要组成部分；本文提供的框架为AV事件管理实践者提供了具备社会-技术适应性的协作型演习设计依据。

title: Students' Perception of Big Data Engineering in Higher Education Curricula: Expectations, Interest and Ethical Implications
summary: The study investigates students' interest and expectations in a Big Data Engineering course integrated with a Master curricula, as well as ethical implications of using Big Data. An anonymous online survey was conducted with 42 of the 67 students enrolled in the Big Data course offered to Computer Science and Bioinformatics Master's programs. The responses were analyzed and interpreted using thematic analysis, highlighting interesting aspects related to students' expectations, interest, and their perspective of the ethical implications of working with Big Data. The study concludes that, even though there is significant difference in students' background, the majority are interested in learning Big Data, for practical and personal reasons related to the potential for career growth and their passion for the field. The main expectation expressed is related to enhancing their knowledge related to Big Data via practical activities. All students demonstrate awareness of potential ethical threats related to security and privacy, while Computer Science students are aware of the possibility of introducing bias in data during acquisition and analysis and of potential abusive data usage.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过匿名在线调查（42名硕士生参与），探讨学生对高校大数据工程课程的期望、兴趣及伦理意识。研究发现，尽管学生背景差异显著，但大多数出于职业发展和个人兴趣对大数据感兴趣，期望通过实践活动提升知识。所有学生都意识到安全与隐私等伦理问题，而计算机科学专业学生还关注数据采集与分析中的偏见及数据滥用问题。
AI.motivation: 大数据技术在工业4.0中日益重要，但高校课程与行业需求之间存在差距。该研究旨在从学生视角出发，了解其对大数据课程的期望、兴趣及伦理认知，为优化大数据工程教育课程设计提供依据。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，对罗马尼亚Babeş-Bolyai大学计算机科学与生物信息学硕士项目中的67名学生进行匿名在线调查（42人参与），结合定量分析与定性主题分析，对比不同专业背景学生的回答。
AI.result: （1）计算机科学学生大多有IT行业工作经验，而生物信息学学生几乎无相关经验；（2）所有学生均期望通过实践活动提升大数据知识，生物信息学学生主要出于个人兴趣，计算机科学学生则有更具体的技术期望；（3）学生兴趣主要源于实用性和职业潜力，部分源于个人热情；（4）所有学生都关注数据安全与隐私伦理问题，仅计算机科学学生意识到数据采集偏见、生态环境影响及数据滥用操纵等更深层伦理问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调大数据课程需强化实践教学、跨学科团队协作及产学研合作，并需融入伦理教育。未来将通过纵向研究追踪学生认知与职业发展的演变，进一步完善课程设计。

title: Moral Advice as Interactional Negotiation: Framing, User Pressure, and Social Position in Large Language Model Responses
summary: As conversational AI becomes a source of everyday guidance, LLMs increasingly participate in the interpretation and legitimation of morally contested choices. We examine LLM moral advice as an interactional negotiation shaped by framing, sustained user pressure, and the moral subject's social position. Using GPT-4o-mini as an illustrative case, we conducted a factorial vignette experiment with a pre-specified three-round protocol. The model received eldercare dilemmas that varied in framing and persona, followed by two user challenges. We analyzed 1,620 configuration-framing cells, each repeated three times, yielding 4,860 conversational runs. Caregiving affirmation produced near-uniform endorsement, whereas non-caregiving framing produced more variable baseline stances. When users challenged caregiving endorsement, 90.1% of configurations shifted after one round. Non-caregiving framing produced more resistant and unstable trajectories. Never (27.9%) and Late (25.6%) accommodations were more common than Early accommodations (16.5%), and only 14.32% of configurations achieved perfect trajectory consistency, compared with 62.72% under caregiving framing. Advice also varied with social position. Female personas received more support for non-caregiving decisions, while the presence of sisters increased accommodation. The GPT-4o-mini case shows that LLM moral advice can develop through a partially stable negotiation between normative response tendencies and user pressure rather than express a fixed ethical framework. The framework and design support comparative research across models and moral domains. Such instability raises social, ethical, and technical concerns, as users may treat advice that is difficult to scrutinize as objective.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因子化情境实验，研究GPT-4o-mini在养老困境中如何随框架设计、用户施压与道德主体社会地位的交互而调整道德建议，揭示其道德建议并非基于固定伦理框架，而是规范性倾向与用户压力之间动态、部分稳定协商的结果。
AI.motivation: 随着对话式AI成为日常指导来源，大语言模型日益介入对道德争议选择的解释与合法化。然而其道德建议是否稳定、是否受框架与用户压力影响尚不清晰，亟需系统性的实证考察。
AI.method: 采用因子化情境实验（factorial vignette experiment），以GPT-4o-mini为案例，设置预指定的三轮交互协议；养老困境在框架（caregiving vs. non-caregiving）与人物画像（persona，含性别、是否有姐妹等社会地位变量）上变化，并加入两轮用户挑战；共生成1,620个配置-框架单元，每单元重复三次，合计4,860次对话运行；从立场稳定性、顺从时机（Early/Late/Never accommodation）与轨迹一致性等维度进行量化分析。
AI.result: 关怀框架（caregiving framing）下模型几乎一致支持照护选择，遭遇挑战时90.1%的配置在一轮后发生立场转变；非关怀框架下基线立场更易变化且更具抵抗性。整体上Never（27.9%）与Late（25.6%）顺从多于Early（16.5%），仅14.32%的配置实现完美轨迹一致性，而关怀框架下达62.72%。社会地位方面：女性画像在非关怀决策中获得更多支持，出现"姐妹"则提升顺从率。
AI.conclusion: GPT-4o-mini的道德建议并非表达固定伦理框架，而是规范性响应倾向与用户压力之间的部分稳定协商过程；其立场在不同框架、用户挑战与社会身份条件下存在显著不稳定。研究所提出的框架与实验设计可支持跨模型、跨道德领域的比较研究。该不稳定性带来社会、伦理与技术层面的担忧——用户可能将难以审视的建议视为客观，从而影响实际决策。

title: SAGE: Semantic Attribute Graphs for Multi-Entity Visual Retrieval
summary: Dense document images often contain many fine-grained visual and textual entities whose relevance depends on a user query. Standard vision-language retrievers encode cropped regions with a single vector, which can mix distinct entity signals and obscure the evidence needed for fine-grained retrieval. We call this failure mode Semantic Dilution and quantitatively show that it degrades entity-level retrieval as a function of entity density. To mitigate it, we propose SAGE, a training-free framework that parses semantic entities from dense document images, represents them as hierarchical graph nodes with multi-vector embeddings, and retrieves query-relevant evidence through iterative entity-level subgraph matching. We also introduce DEAR, a dataset of 1,055 query--image pairs sourced from product detail pages, where each query requires retrieving and comparing multiple fine-grained entities from visually dense inputs across four question types of increasing complexity. Experiments show that SAGE substantially reduces semantic dilution and outperforms patch-level and OCR-based retrieval baselines on DEAR, achieving a Recall@3 of 0.849 and a generation score of 2.746 on multi-entity visual comparison queries. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文针对密集文档图像中多实体视觉检索的难题，提出"语义稀释"(Semantic Dilution)失败模式及其量化指标，并发布DEAR基准数据集与免训练的SAGE检索框架，通过实体中心的多向量层次图与迭代子图匹配显著缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言检索器(如ColPali、ColQwen等基于patch的模型)将密集文档图像的裁剪区域编码为单一向量，导致不同实体的语义信号相互混合，形成"语义稀释"问题——随实体密度增加，细粒度检索性能下降。同时，现有文档QA基准缺乏同时覆盖"多跳推理+密集属性+长上下文"三维度且以实体为检索单元的评测，导致该问题无法被有效诊断。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 定义语义稀释分数δ(I)为全图嵌入与各属性孤立嵌入的平均余弦相似度，定量证明密度越高稀释越严重；(2) 发布DEAR基准，包含502张产品详情页图像与1,055个查询，分Type A-D四类(单/多实体×单/多属性)，含提取型与推理型问题；(3) 提出免训练SAGE框架，五模块流水线——属性解析器(OCR+PaddleOCR将图像切分为带bbox区域，VLM为纯图像区域生成语义描述)→属性描述器→层次图构造器(LLM将相关区域聚合为实体下的叶节点，每个叶节点用Jina-CLIP-v2对复合裁剪图像、组合文本与语义描述做多向量嵌入)→检索规划器(两级粗到细检索+检查清单驱动的迭代精炼)→子图增强生成器(将检索到的实体-属性子图序列化为结构化VLM输入)。
AI.result: 在DEAR上，SAGE(配合自适应top-k)取得Recall@3 0.849与生成分数2.746(0-5量级)，显著优于ColPali(0.272)、ColQwen(0.463)、OCR+BM25(0.606)、VLM标题+DPR(0.163)等基线；在Type D(多实体多属性)上提升最显著。消融实验证明四级模块(节点聚合、子图增强、两阶段检索、迭代精炼)互补且均必要。在UniDoc-Bench和M3DocVQA上泛化同样有效(Recall@5分别0.811与0.660)。索引仅0.33 MB/图，查询延迟0.77s(标准)与1.73s(自适应)。忠实性分析显示73.3%答案完全由检索证据支撑，移除答案区域后生成分数下降50.1%。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过以语义实体而非patch或整图为检索单元，结合多向量层次图与迭代子图检索，有效缓解密集文档图像中的语义稀释问题，在DEAR及外部基准上均超越patch级与OCR级基线，且整个流程免训练、可泛化，为视觉密集文档的多实体比较检索提供了新的范式与诊断基准。

title: VizIt: A multi-view framework for exploring single-cell, spatial, and genetic data online
summary: Multi-omic studies increasingly require data to be examined from complementary biological perspectives, yet interactive exploration remains fragmented across modalities and tools. We present VizIt, an open-source framework for multi-view exploration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic, epigenomic and genetic data. VizIt connects gene-, cell type-, condition-, spatial-, genomic region- and variant-centered views, enabling seamless navigation across biological perspectives. We demonstrate VizIt through the Parkinson's Cell Atlas, a customizable interactive multi-omic resource.

AI.tldr: VizIt 是一个开源的多视角可视化框架，支持单细胞、空间转录组、表观基因组和遗传数据的交互式探索，并通过帕金森细胞图谱进行演示。
AI.motivation: 多组学研究需要在不同生物学视角下综合分析数据，但目前的交互式探索工具在不同模态和工具之间较为分散，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 VizIt，一个开源的多视角探索框架，连接基因、细胞类型、实验条件、空间、基因组区域和变异中心等多种视图，实现不同生物学视角之间的无缝导航。
AI.result: 通过帕金森细胞图谱（Parkinson's Cell Atlas）这一可定制的交互式多组学资源进行演示，验证了 VizIt 的实用性。
AI.conclusion: VizIt 为多组学数据的整合探索提供了一个统一的交互式框架，有助于跨模态生物学发现。

title: Inventory-Grounded Policy-Level Optimization for Training-Free AI Search
comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Early in deployment, an AI search system typically operates over a frequently updated product catalog, so the available items and their properties cannot be treated as stable knowledge that can be encoded in fixed prompts or strategies. Fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and static prompt patches fit poorly: labels are scarce, rewards drift with inventory, model releases are costly, and prompt fixes quickly stale. We present Inventory-Grounded Policy-Level Optimization (IGPO), a training-free approach for fixed AI search pipelines. IGPO separates policy from environment facts: it learns Policy Guidelines for acting on runtime inventory evidence rather than memorizing available items. Online, IGPO grounds each query by probing the inventory and constructing an inventory portrait, then injects relevant Policy Guidelines into the retrieval and selection prompts. Offline, stochastic rollouts are grouped by query -- mixed outcome groups directly yield contrastive signal, and an inventory-guided exploration loop distinguishes missed retrieval routes from cases where no matching support is found under the observed inventory evidence. Since May 2026, IGPO has been deployed in a commercial smart-assistant AI search system. A 14-day online A/B test of the complete IGPO treatment shows a 3.17% relative CTR lift and a 38.9% reduction in audited bad cases.

AI.tldr: IGPO提出了一种免训练、即插即用的AI搜索优化框架,将策略与库存事实解耦,在线通过库存画像与策略指南联合调控,离线通过库存引导的探索循环和回放验证更新策略指南,在商业智能助手搜索系统中实现CTR +3.17%、审核坏例-38.9%。
AI.motivation: 早期部署阶段的AI搜索系统面对频繁更新的商品目录,可用商品及其属性无法视为稳定知识。传统微调、强化学习、静态提示补丁均不适用:标签稀缺、奖励漂移、模型发布昂贵、提示易过时。核心挑战是如何在不改模型权重的前提下,让搜索策略学会依据运行时库存证据进行推理,而不是记忆当前库存中的具体商品。
AI.method: IGPO将策略(Policy Guidelines)与环境事实(库存)解耦。**在线**:通过快速向量检索探测库存,融合场景画像生成"库存画像",按场景与阶段索引选取Top-K策略指南,注入到Retrieval Planner与Selection阶段的提示中。**离线**:在固定库存快照上做随机rollout分组;混合结果组直接产生对比信号;全失败组通过库存引导的探索循环(Inventory-Guided Exploration)系统性地探测未覆盖的检索路径,区分"漏检的可行路径"与"库存中确实无支持项"。DeepSeek-V3 671B作为Judge进行rollout分类与回放对比,并提出Patch(add/revise/merge/delete)。所有候选Patch经过代码校验、单条回放与组合回放(包含目标查询、背景查询、固定回归集的胜/负/不确定阈值)后方可部署。
AI.result: **主表(Tab.1,3000查询)**：原生配置下IGPO将Cand.R@30从0.691→0.847,F1@8从0.643→0.816,FNI从30.6%→4.8%,FM从60.8%→15.2%。在DeepSeek-V3 token对齐(18M/120M)对比GEPA风格优化器时,18M预算下两者F1@8差异在运行波动范围内(0.792 vs 0.787),但IGPO的FM显著更低(34.7% vs 46.0%);120M预算下IGPO四项指标全面领先。在Qwen3-8B统一骨干下,IGPO的Cand.R@30、F1@8、FNI、FM均优于SFT与SFT+GRPO(共享与阶段特定奖励)。**跨快照分析(Tab.2)**:在库存增/删/改名/元数据/Schema五类变化下,F1@8 0.761–0.803,受影响查询FNI 8.2%、FM 23.1%。**消融(Tab.3)**:共享跨阶段规则F1@8降至0.597,移除场景条件选择使FM升至27.5%,移除探索循环使FNI/FM回升。**在线A/B(14天)**:10万对照 vs 10万实验用户,CTR +3.17%(95%CI 1.9–4.5%,p<0.001),坏例率-38.9%(95%CI 25.2–50.1%);其中复合查询CTR +7.19%、坏例-47.9%,库存-缺货查询坏例从45/128降至14/125。**部署开销**:Guidelines≤100,每阶段≤3条,平均提示+247 token(p95 +568),延迟p50+49.4 ms、p95+185.8 ms。**生产更新**:31天内9次自动批次,83候选Patch中45(54.2%)通过回放被部署,Guideline库从43增至62条。
AI.conclusion: IGPO通过"策略-环境解耦+库存画像+库存引导探索+回放验证Patch"四要素,在动态库存场景下提供了一种实用的免训练优化路径,在线A/B测试与商业部署均验证了其有效性。其价值在于让LLM搜索系统在不重训的前提下持续适应库存漂移,同时通过严格回放门控控制策略更新的回归风险。

title: Personalized Task Dependency Graphs for Mitigating Signal Erosion in Multi-Task Recommendation
summary: Optimizing multiple conversion objectives is a core challenge in industrial recommendation, often limited by signal erosion in rigid architectures. Existing Multi-Task Learning (MTL) methods typically enforce uniform dependency strengths across a static conversion funnel, overlooking how task correlations naturally vary based on item characteristics. Hierarchical message passing along these fixed chains leads to cumulative signal attenuation, which degrades performance on sparse, deep-funnel objectives. To address this, we propose the Personalized Task Dependency Graphs (PTDG). While respecting necessary physical causal constraints (e.g., Click -> Pay), PTDG dynamically "rewires" the intensity of dependency pathways for each item via low-rank approximation to ensure structural robustness. We implement a GCN-based propagation with hard causal masking to establish adaptive information shortcuts. Additionally, we introduce an Adaptive Progressive Masking (APM) strategy that decouples shared parameters according to task sparsity, helping to stabilize optimization. Experiments on KuaiRand1K and an industrial dataset show that PTDG significantly improves AUC on sparse conversion tasks by up to 1.45%, while maintaining comparable performance on dense objectives. Online A/B testing shows PTDG improves Conversion Rate (CVR) by 1.2% and effective Cost Per Mille (eCPM) by 1.9% relative to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PTDG框架，通过个性化任务依赖图解决工业多任务推荐中的信号侵蚀问题，在稀疏深度转化任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统需同时优化多个转化目标（从点击到付费）。现有MTL方法在静态漏斗结构中假设统一的依赖强度，忽视了不同物品间任务相关性的结构异质性，导致层级消息传递产生累积信号衰减，严重影响稀疏深层转化任务的性能。
AI.method: PTDG包含三个核心组件：(1) 个性化拓扑学习——通过低秩近似(A_item=Z_i^L(Z_i^R)^T)为每个物品动态构建依赖图，并融合用户-场景个性化偏置γ_{u,s}进行调制；(2) 硬因果掩码的GCN传播——在尊重物理因果约束(如Click→Pay)前提下建立自适应信息捷径；(3) 自适应渐进掩码(APM)策略——根据标签正样本率p_t自适应确定掩码率r_target，对任务t保留top-k_t参数，并以线性warm-up机制稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 在KuaiRand1K(6任务)和工业数据集(7任务)上，PTDG平均AUC均达到最优，分别为0.9081和0.8878；在稀疏深层任务上提升尤为显著（工业Task3相对PMTRec提升1.45%，KuaiRand1K follow任务相对MMoE提升1.77%）；消融实验验证各组件贡献（去除个性化模块下降1.21% AUC）。在线A/B测试在日活超1亿的应用分发平台部署两周，CVR提升1.2%、eCPM提升1.9%；推理延迟仅比MMoE增加8ms，满足工业SLA。
AI.conclusion: PTDG通过实例级动态依赖图建模，有效缓解了深度转化目标的信号衰减问题，在保持密集任务性能的同时显著提升稀疏高价值任务表现，验证了结构化MTL设计在工业场景的实用价值。未来工作将扩展至更大任务集合与跨域场景。

title: AtomRec: Evolving Atomic Memory for Agentic Recommendation
summary: Agentic recommender systems use large language models to maintain semantic memory and support evidence-aware recommendation. However, existing memory mechanisms often compress user and item information into coarse summaries and connect them with scalar collaborative links, making it difficult to preserve fine-grained preference stages or retrieve interpretable evidence as user interests evolve. We propose \textsc{AtomRec}, an agentic recommender with evolving atomic collaborative memory. \textsc{AtomRec} represents user and item memories as structured atomic units, builds semantic links across related memories, and evolves related historical fields when new interactions arrive. During recommendation, it retrieves linked memories as multi-hop evidence paths rather than isolated neighbor summaries, allowing collaborative signals to support grounded ranking. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that \textsc{AtomRec} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic and memory-augmented baselines, with around 8.5\% average relative improvement across metrics.

AI.tldr: AtomRec提出了一种基于LLM的智能体推荐系统，采用演化的原子协作记忆机制，将用户和物品记忆表示为结构化原子单元，通过语义链接构建和动态记忆演化实现细粒度、可解释的证据路径检索。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体推荐系统的记忆机制存在两个关键缺陷：1）粗粒度问题——摘要级记忆将多个偏好痕迹压缩为单一画像，难以选择性修订；2）语义可操作性受限——标量交互/相似度权重虽能衡量关联强度，但缺乏记忆间"为何相关"的证据，导致在长期推荐中偏好演变阶段易被覆盖、检索到的协作证据缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: AtomRec包含四个核心模块：1）原子协作记忆构建——将用户/物品记忆表示为包含文本内容、时间戳、关键词集、语义标签集、上下文描述、嵌入向量和链接标识符的结构化原子笔记；2）语义协作链接构建——通过嵌入相似度检索top-k近邻，再由LLM分析生成语义关系链接（共享主题、互补偏好、意图递进、偏好转移、跨域迁移）；3）动态记忆演化——当新交互到达时，根据链接归属或相似度阈值触发场级别更新（关键词强化、标签精炼、上下文重构、链接更新），保留时间戳；4）上下文感知协作检索——沿语义链接扩展多跳子图，合成多跳证据路径用于最终重排序。默认使用gpt-4o-mini作为记忆代理和推荐代理，Sentence-T5作为文本编码器。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准数据集（Books、Goodreads、MovieTV、Yelp）上，AtomRec在所有指标上均优于传统推荐器（LightGCN、SASRec）、基于LM的推荐器（P5、Vanilla LLM）和智能体/记忆增强基线（iAgent、RecBot、AgentCF、i2Agent、MemRec），平均相对提升约8.5%。消融实验证实各组件均有贡献，去除原子记忆结构下降最大（约5.45%）。偏好漂移分析显示在高漂移用户群体上增益更显著。案例研究证明原子记忆通过1-hop和2-hop证据链接成功恢复目标物品。在更大候选集（N=20）下优势依然保持。存在三个局限：1）记忆演化可能将用户兴趣过度压缩至主导子主题；2）模型可能过度强调稳定长期偏好而忽视短期探索性目标；3）协作信号可能被吸收进记忆字段而失去显式链接可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: AtomRec通过将粗粒度记忆摘要替换为结构化原子单元并配合语义证据路径，支持细粒度长期偏好建模。实验证明结构化、可链接、可演化的记忆设计是构建更具可解释性和自适应性的推荐智能体的有前景方向。

title: SAM-D2Q: Aligning Multimodal Doc2Query with Search Demand and Conversion for E-commerce
comment: Accepted by CIKM2026 Oral Full Paper
summary: E-commerce search often suffers from vocabulary mismatch between user queries and merchant-authored product titles, since short titles cannot fully cover diverse user expressions or visual product attributes. Although Doc2Query alleviates this issue by generating pseudo-queries for document expansion, traditional methods are text-only and not optimized for e-commerce business objectives. As a result, they may produce semantically plausible but commercially ineffective expansions and miss key attributes present in product images. To this end, we propose E-commerce Search-Aligned Multimodal Doc2Query (SAM-D2Q), a business-aligned multimodal document expansion framework for e-commerce search under Boolean retrieval constraints. SAM-D2Q consists of three stages: (1) task-adapted multimodal supervised fine-tuning to enhance vision-language understanding of product titles, images, and user queries; (2) multimodal data augmentation to improve perception of key visual attributes and expansion coverage; and (3) reinforcement-learning-based preference alignment toward search business objectives, encouraging the model to generate pseudo-queries that better match user intent and commercial value. Offline experiments show that SAM-D2Q substantially improves retrieval performance over traditional Doc2Query methods. Deployed in the AliExpress production search system, SAM-D2Q improves online business metrics, increasing GMV by +3.38% and Pay Count by +2.27%.

title: Embedding Surgery: Localized Updates for Adaptive Ranking Correction in Dense Retrieval
comment: Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Dense retrieval systems are core components of modern search engines, recommendation platforms, and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. They encode documents and queries into dense embeddings, enabling efficient semantic search via vector similarity. However, because document embeddings are computed offline and stored in static indexes, these systems struggle to adapt to user feedback or evolving search intent. To address this limitation, we introduce \emph{embedding surgery}, a lightweight approach for adaptive ranking correction in dense retrieval. The method applies localized, minimal updates to selected document embeddings at query time, guided by editorial feedback, user interactions, or pseudo-labels from large language models. We formulate embedding surgery as a convex optimization problem that enforces ranking constraints while minimizing modifications to the affected document representations. We integrate embedding surgery into standard dense retrieval pipelines and evaluate it on TREC Deep Learning, TREC Robust, TREC CAsT, and MS MARCO benchmarks. Results show consistent improvements (e.g., up to +60.64\% relative improvement in nDCG@10 on DL-Hard under editorial feedback), even under noisy or shifting feedback, with low computational cost and without disrupting the global structure of the embedding space. Extensive experiments show that ranking corrections propagate to semantically related queries and that embedding updates can be applied safely and efficiently to scalable Approximate Nearest Neighbor indexes via simple in-place overwriting, without requiring costly index reconstruction. Finally, embedding surgery complements query adaptation methods such as CoRocchio, yielding additional gains while being more robust to noisy feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"嵌入手术"(Embedding Surgery),一种面向稠密检索的轻量级自适应排序校正方法:在查询时对选中文档嵌入施加局部最小化更新,以满足来自编辑标注、用户点击或大语言模型(LLM)的反馈所衍生的排序约束。方法被形式化为带成对排序约束的凸二次规划问题(对单约束有闭式解,批量约束可用CVXPY高效求解),并可对HNSW、IVF等近似最近邻(ANN)索引进行原地覆盖写入,无需重建索引。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索中,文档嵌入离线预计算并以静态索引存储,难以即时融入用户反馈或演化中的检索意图;现有的微调再索引、在线学习排序(OLTR)、查询端适应(CoRocchio/CoDIME)或混合管线,要么计算代价高、需探索-利用折中,要么局限于查询侧、无法纠正共享表示空间中的特定文档排序错误。缺乏一种轻量、查询时、可直接修改文档嵌入以强制执行反馈约束并保持全局表示结构的机制。
AI.method: (1) 问题形式化:对查询q嵌入q与top-k文档嵌入d_i,以成对偏好(d_r, d_n)集合R为约束,求最小化Σ‖Δd_i‖² 的凸二次规划,使〈q, d_r+Δd_r〉≥〈q, d_n+Δd_n〉+ε;单约束有闭式解,批量约束用CVXPY求解。(2) 三种变体:对称(双向调整)、降级(只动负样本)、提升(只动正样本)。(3) 三类反馈源:编辑标注(基于Kendall Tau距离生成最小相邻交换序列作为约束)、LLM重排序(BGE/Qwen reranker)、点击反馈(反事实模拟:选择偏置、位置偏置p̂_e(k)=(1/k)^η、相关性偏置;用户模型P/N/R)。(4) 工程实现:FAISS Flat/IVF/HNSW索引,直接原地覆写;32维HNSW,efC=400,efS=256;IVF聚类数√|D|,nprobe=√|D|/10;不重新归一化嵌入;top-20截止。
AI.result: (1) RQ1整体有效性:对称变体最优。在DL-Hard上,TAS-B编辑反馈nDCG@10相对提升高达+60.64%(0.376→0.604);在Robust '04零样本场景下,E5编辑反馈提升+56.71%;四种稠密模型(Contriever/TAS-B/E5/Snowflake-Arctic)在四个基准上均稳定改善(配对t检验p<0.05,除Snowflake+LLM@DL'19外);点击反馈下即便近随机用户也不显著降低基线;LLM反馈中BGE普遍优于Qwen。(2) RQ2潜在空间影响:更新ℓ₂范数通常<0.05,呈右偏对数正态分布;5.6万MS MARCO Dev查询大规模编辑手术前后,DL'19/20/Hard nDCG与Recall变化不具统计显著性;在CAsT(仅对首轮手术)与QSharedRel上,修正可正向迁移至共享相关文档的语义邻近查询(Contriever QSharedRel 54升1降,114不变中91已RR=1)。(3) RQ3可扩展性:每约束约3.6×10⁻³–7.9×10⁻³秒;HNSW原地覆写185,006条、IVF 183,106条中仅691条(≈0.38%)改变簇归属,各基准无统计显著退化。(4) RQ4与CoRocchio互补:DL'19上Perfect/Noisy用户CoR.+Surg.均优于两者单独(0.809/0.720 vs CoR 0.799/0.699 vs Surg 0.702/0.700);近随机用户下CoR退化至0.632,Surg稳定于0.680。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入手术是一种新颖的轻量级、查询时、反馈驱动的稠密检索排序校正框架,通过凸约束优化实现对文档嵌入的局部最小修改,并保持潜在空间全局结构与ANN索引可用性。它在多种稠密模型、多种反馈源与多个基准(含零样本与困难集)上一致提升排序效果,具备对噪声鲁棒、可向语义相关查询正向迁移、与CoRocchio互补等特性,且可通过原地覆写规模化部署而无需重建索引,为生产级稠密检索提供了一种实用的自适应校正路径。未来工作包括稀疏-稠密联合嵌入、边界ε与截断敏感性分析、不一致反馈的松弛策略、真实点击日志评估及与在线排序模型的对比。

title: Computing Lewis Weights to High Precision by Fixed-Point Iteration
summary: The $\ell_p$-Lewis weights of a matrix are defined by a fixed-point equation. For $p<4$, Cohen and Peng [CP15] showed that iterating an equivalent rearrangement of this equation computes Lewis weights to high precision; for $p\geq4$, prior high-precision methods instead use optimization-based approaches. We show that the direct Lewis fixed-point iteration, appearing in the thesis of Lee [Lee16], computes Lewis weights to high precision for every $p>2$. For a matrix $\mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ partitioned into row blocks $\mathbf{A}_{[1]},\ldots,\mathbf{A}_{[k]}$, we compute, for $p>2$, coordinatewise $\varepsilon$-approximate $\ell_p$ block Lewis weights in $O\left(p\log\frac{p\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^k\operatorname{rank}(\mathbf{A}_{[i]})}}{\varepsilon}\right)$ rounds of exact leverage-score-vector computations. For ordinary Lewis weights, this becomes $O\left(p\log\frac{p\sqrt{m}}{\varepsilon}\right)$, improving the $O\left(p^2\log(m/\varepsilon)\right)$ bound of Gribling, Sidford, and Zhang [GSZ26] for $p\geq4$. Our main observation is that each direct Lewis update contracts the KL divergence to the true weights by a factor of $1-\frac{2}{p}$. We also give an alternate explanation of this contraction through volume sampling and entropic independence. Synthetic experiments closely match our predicted local contraction rates and iteration counts grow approximately linearly with $p$; real-data experiments illustrate the information-concentration tradeoff of finite-$p$ block Lewis designs.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于所有 p>2，直接Lewis不动点迭代可以在 O(p log(p√m/ε)) 轮精确杠杆分计算中高精度计算 ℓₚ-Lewis权重，改进了先前 p≥4 时 O(p²log(m/ε)) 的界。核心观察是每次直接Lewis更新使KL散度以因子 (1-2/p) 收缩。
AI.motivation: 对于 p<4，Cohen和Peng [CP15] 证明了迭代Lewis不动点方程的等价重排可高精度计算Lewis权重；但 p≥4 时该方法的分析失效，先前高精度算法转而依赖优化方法。Lee的论文中直接出现的Lewis不动点迭代是否对 p>2 都能高精度收敛，是一个自然的开放问题。本文旨在回答该问题。
AI.method: 主要方法是对Lewis不动点更新进行KL散度收缩分析：（1）证明每次Lewis更新使到真实权重的KL散度以因子 γ=1-2/p 收缩（通过Cauchy-Schwarz、Jensen不等式和Holder不等式）；（2）将KL收缩通过Bregman散度转化为谱近似界，再通过后处理得到坐标wise (1±ε) 近似；（3）通过体积采样和熵独立给出 KL 收缩的替代证明；（4）在不动点处线性化得到局部Jacobian，其谱半径预测局部渐近收敛率。实验上用高斯矩阵、结构化矩阵、ill-conditioned矩阵以及真实传感器和气象数据验证理论。
AI.result: 理论结果：对于 p>2 的分块Lewis权重，在 O(p log(p√R/ε)) 轮精确杠杆分向量计算中（其中 R=∑rank(A_[i])）得到坐标wise ε-近似；行式Lewis权重情况下界为 O(p log(p√m/ε))，改进了 Gribling-Sidford-Zhang [GSZ26] 对 p≥4 的 O(p²log(m/ε)) 界。实验上合成实验的局部收缩率与理论预测吻合，迭代次数近似随 p 线性增长；真实数据实验展示了有限p分块Lewis设计在均匀分配和D-optimal设计之间的信息-集中权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文将直接Lewis不动点迭代的有效范围从 p<4 扩展到全部 p>2，建立了几乎维度无关的 O(p) 轮高精度计算保证，同时通过体积采样/熵独立和局部线性化分析提供了收敛行为的直观和精确理解，并在多个合成与真实数据集上验证了理论结果。

title: Multiobjective Hypergraph Min-Cut in Quasi-Polynomial Time
summary: We study the multiobjective hypergraph min-cut problem: Given a hypergraph $H=(V,E)$ and $k$ cost functions $c_1, c_2, \ldots, c_k:E\to\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, the goal is to find a non-empty proper subset $U\subsetneq V$ of vertices with minimum $\max_{i\in [k]} c_i(\delta(U))$. When $k$ is part of input, the problem is NP-hard (even in graphs). We focus on fixed-constant $k$ setting (e.g., $k=1, 2, 3, \ldots$). Single-objective hypergraph min-cut as well as multiobjective graph min-cut for a constant number of objectives admit polynomial-time algorithms. In contrast to these special cases, the complexity of multiobjective hypergraph min-cut remains open even for $k=2$. Known techniques fail to extend due to structural differences between graphs and hypergraphs. For $k$-objective hypergraph min-cut when $k$ is a fixed constant, we design a randomized PTAS, and two different randomized quasi-polynomial time algorithms. As an application of our $2$-objective hypergraph min-cut results, we obtain a quasi-polynomial time approximation scheme (QPTAS) for hypergraph connectivity interdiction. AI tools were used to iterate and refine the algorithmic ideas underlying this work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了k目标超图最小割问题（固定常数k），设计了随机化准多项式时间算法和PTAS，并应用于超图连通性阻断问题。
AI.motivation: 单目标超图最小割和多目标图最小割（k为常数）均有多项式时间算法，但多目标超图最小割的复杂性长期开放。关键障碍在于：1）超图中2-近似最小割的数量可为指数级，标量化方法失效；2）多目标超图最小割的最优解数量可为指数级（与图和单目标情形截然不同）。这使得图的算法无法直接推广，且子指数时间算法无法同时解决枚举问题。
AI.method: 核心技术是基于随机收缩与删除的递归算法。将问题归约为k目标超图预算割（Budgeted-Cut）。关键创新：选择具有最大单点不可行集 I_j（对应某目标j，|I_j|≥n/k）的目标函数作为采样分布依据；在删除分支中以 |e∩I_j|/|I_j| 的概率探索（而非单目标情形的 |e|/n）。该概率选择能保证：好事件概率（采样到非割边进入收缩分支）大于坏事件概率（采样到割边且进入删除分支）。利用单点不可行集不等式（Lemma 2.1）进行充电分析。PTAS方面，借鉴Ghaffari-Karger-Panigrahi思想，对大超边进行三分支处理（删除所有大超边/按c_1采样收缩/按c_2采样收缩）。
AI.result: 1）k目标超图预算割的随机化准多项式时间算法：成功概率至少n^{-2k}，期望运行时间m^{O(k log n)}；2）PTAS：运行时间2^{O(k)}·p^{O(1)}，成功概率n^{-O(k log(k/ε))}；3）超图基数连通性阻断的(1,1)-近似准多项式时间算法m^{O(log n)}；4）超图连通性阻断的QPTAS和双标准PTAS；5）附带给出hedgegraph最小割的新结果（强准多项式时间和FPT算法）。论文公开声明使用了AI（ChatGPT 5.5 Pro）迭代和精炼算法思想。
AI.conclusion: 论文解决了多目标超图最小割（k为固定常数）这一长期开放问题，给出了首个准多项式时间算法和PTAS。核心贡献是新颖的"单点不可行集引导采样+删除分支"技术，克服了超图中近似最小割数量指数级的结构性障碍。附带结果包括对hedgegraph最小割的改进，以及超图连通性阻断问题的QPTAS。仍开放的问题：能否在多项式时间内求解？Pareto最优点的多项式界？超图阻断问题的PTAS？

title: An iterative rounding $2$-approximation for Feedback Vertex Set via AI-assisted proof of an extreme point property
summary: We consider the Feedback Vertex Set problem (FVS): the input is an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$ and the goal is to find a minimum-cardinality (or a min-cost in the weighted case) subset $S \subseteq V$ of vertices such that $G-S$ has no cycles. A $2$-approximation via the local-ratio method was developed in the mid 90's by Bafna, Berman and Fujito (1995) and by Becker and Geiger (1996), and this approximation ratio is tight under UGC. The local-ratio algorithms were later interpreted as primal-dual algorithms via an LP relaxation by Chudak, Goemans, Hochbaum, and Williamson (1998). All known $2$-approximation algorithms for FVS have been via local-ratio and primal-dual methods, and in a quest to obtain a new LP rounding algorithm, it was conjectured (Fiorini 2021) that the Strong-Density polyhedron developed by Chudak, Goemans, Hochbaum, and Williamson has an extreme point property: every basic feasible solution to the LP has a variable with value at least $1/2$. We prove this conjecture. We also consider a related Strong-Edge-Density polyhedron and show the same extreme point property. The advantage of this polyhedron is that it admits a polynomial-time separation oracle and also a compact extended formulation. These results lead to polynomial-time iterative rounding $2$-approximation algorithms. The proof of the extreme point property is of independent technical interest and key ideas in the proof were suggested by AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了 Feedback Vertex Set (FVS) 问题中 Strong-Density 凸多面体（由 Chudak, Goemans, Hochbaum 和 Williamson 提出）的极端点性质——即每个基本可行解都存在一个值至少为 1/2 的变量（Fiorini 2021 提出的猜想）。作者还引入了新的 Edge-Strong-Density 凸多面体并证明了相同的极端点性质。这些结果直接导出了基于迭代舍入的多项式时间 2-近似算法。证明中关键思想由 AI 工具（Claude 和 Gemini）协助提出。
AI.motivation: 反馈顶点集（FVS）问题的 2-近似算法长期依赖局部比率（local-ratio）和原始-对偶方法。虽然这些方法的最优性在 UGC 下已知，但寻找新的 LP 舍入算法一直是一个开放问题。Fiorini (2021) 提出猜想：强密度凸多面体的极端点具有至少 1/2 的坐标值——这将允许通过迭代舍入获得 2-近似算法。证明该猜想并设计新的迭代舍入算法是本文的核心动机。此外，作者希望 LP 方法能够提供更好的实例相关近似保证，因为可解的 LP 允许比较 LP 最优值与舍入解的值。
AI.method: 方法论包含三个主要技术贡献：(1) 证明 P_SD(G) 的极端点性质，采用反证法。利用条件超模数性（conditional supermodularity）建立 tight 集族的几乎层状（almost-laminar）基结构，通过 uncrossing 技术证明 Hasse 图形成森林，然后通过组合计数论证得出矛盾。(2) 证明 P_Edge-SD(G) 的极端点性质，采用类似但更简洁的策略——利用严格的层状（laminar）基结构。(3) 证明 Edge-Strong-Density 凸多面体与 Chandrasekaran 等人 (2024) 提出的基于定向的扩展公式等价（通过 Farkas 引理）。对于 P_SD(G)，由于缺乏已知的多项式时间分离 oracle，作者设计了"弱分离 oracle"结合椭球算法的 produce-witness 子程序，并通过 round-or-cut 方法实现迭代舍入。对于 P_Edge-SD(G)，利用次模最小化实现多项式时间分离 oracle，直接得到标准迭代舍入算法。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 证明了 Fiorini 猜想：P_SD(G) 的每个极端点都存在至少一个值 ≥ 1/2 的变量。(2) 引入新的 Edge-Strong-Density 凸多面体 P_Edge-SD(G)，证明了相同的极端点性质。(3) 证明了 P_Edge-SD(G) 与基于定向的扩展公式 Q_orient(G) 等价。(4) 基于这些结果，设计了三个多项式时间迭代舍入 2-近似算法：基于 P_SD(G)（使用椭球算法）、基于 P_Edge-SD(G)（使用次模最小化）、以及基于 Q_orient(G)（使用多项式规模 LP）。证明中的两个关键思想（几乎层状基的森林结构和精巧的组合计数引理）由 AI 工具 Claude (Opus 4.7) 和 Gemini (3.1 Pro) 协助提出。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了 FVS 问题强密度凸多面体的极端点猜想，为该经典问题提供了新的 LP 舍入算法视角。结果具有独立的技术价值，特别是证明了非 {0,1}-系数凸多面体的极端点性质——这在迭代舍入文献中很少见。AI 工具在发现几乎层状基结构的关键性质方面发挥了重要作用，展示了人机协作在理论计算机科学中的潜力。未来的研究方向包括：将方法推广到 Treewidth Deletion 和 Subset-FVS、对 LP 进行计算研究、以及寻找更快的舍入方法。UGC 下 2-近似的紧性意味着对 FVS 本身难以进一步改进，但相关问题的近似比仍有改进空间。

title: Statistics of Similarity Graphs in Node-Arrival Streams
summary: In this paper, we study several statistical problems on similarity graphs in the node-arrival streaming model, including degree moments, diversity index, degree-moment sampling, and diversity sampling. We develop constant-pass, sublinear-space streaming algorithms for these problems and establish space lower bounds that nearly match the upper bounds in their dependence on the stream length.

AI.tldr: 本文研究节点到达流模型下隐式相似图的统计问题，包括度矩、多样性指数、度矩采样和多样性采样，给出了常数趟、亚线性空间的流算法上界及与之近乎匹配的空间下界。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型等场景中，相似的非完全相同条目也应参与频率统计；经典的频率统计定义过强。需要研究基于相似性函数的相似图统计问题在节点到达流模型下的空间高效算法。
AI.method: 对流中节点基于相似函数 f 构造隐式完全加权相似图 G^σ，将问题划分为高度/低度两组：高度组通过见证集在第二趟近似估计其贡献，低度组在额外趟中采样并精确计算度数。采用拒绝采样与指数缩放法实现采样器，并通过 INDEX/DISJ 通信复杂度归约证明空间下界。
AI.result: 上界：DI 与 L_DI 采样使用 3 趟、O~(ε⁻²√n) 字空间；M_p 估计与 L_{M_p} 采样使用 2 趟、O~(ε² n^(1-1/(p+1))) 字空间。下界：单趟算法需 Ω(n) 位；常数趟算法分别需 Ω(min(√(n/ε), n))、Ω(√n)、Ω(min(ε^(-1/(p+1)) n^(1-1/(p+1)), n))、Ω(n^(1-1/(p+1))) 位空间。
AI.conclusion: 本文为节点到达流模型下隐式相似图的基本统计问题建立了近乎紧致的空间复杂度界限，排除了单趟亚线性空间算法的可能性，并表明高度/低度节点分组技术在相似图统计中的有效性。

title: A Polymatroidal Perspective on Random Contraction
summary: Karger's elegant random contraction algorithm for finding a global mincut in a graph has been highly influential. More recent work has obtained several different (nonuniform) random contraction algorithms for mincut in hypergraphs and hedgegraphs. Motivated by the conceptual goal of understanding these algorithms in a unified fashion, we study random contraction algorithms for finding a minimum quotient of a polymatroid. We introduce the notion of quotient-bounded polymatroids and show that several existing results can be derived and understood under a common algorithmic framework for quotient-bounded polymatroids.

title: Beyond Distance Ordering: Resource Complexity and Universal Optimality of Exact Labeled Directed Shortest Paths
comment: 45 pages, including appendices and references. One endpoint theorem is verified by an exact computer-assisted finite certificate
summary: We study exact single-source shortest paths when the output is only the materialized labeled distance vector ($\mathrm{DIST}$), rather than a distance order. In the full deterministic comparison-addition model, the minimum worst-case number of additions on every fixed directed topology is exactly the maximum number $\rho_{\mathrm{fwd}}$ of forward nonsource endpoint classes over rooted vertex orders; the lower bound permits adaptive control, literals, and arbitrary mixed sums. This arithmetic law aligns with the comparison optimum on DAGs, where the full resource region is an exact rectangle. title: On Maximizing a Weakly Submodular Function over a Matroid Constraint via the Greedy Algorithm
summary: We consider the problem of approximately maximizing a weakly submodular function using the standard greedy algorithm, which is known to give tight approximation results for such functions under a cardinality constraint. We show that this is not the case for general matroid constraints. For any $\gamma < 1$, we give a family of $\gamma$-weakly submodular functions and a simple partition matroid constraint and show that the standard greedy algorithm provides no constant approximation for the resulting constrained maximization problem.

title: Online Matching in Convex Bipartite Graphs
summary: Online resource-allocation systems, like outpatient scheduling and spectrum allocation, often assign sequentially arriving requests to an ordered pool of scarce resources, where each request accepts a contiguous interval of feasible options. We study the resulting online matching problem on convex bipartite graphs under irrevocable decisions and adversarial arrivals. We first show that convexity alone does not improve the classic worst-case guarantee of 1-1/e, achieved by Ranking. We then consider the uniform-length model, in which every online request has exactly d consecutive offline neighbors. We propose Flip, which uses one random bit to commit ex-ante to either earliest-feasible assignment or latest-feasible assignment. Although either natural deterministic policy can waste capacity and be asymptotically only 1/2-competitive, we show that their randomized mixture is 2/3-competitive. This guarantee is tight for Flip and remains valid against a semi-adaptive adversary that observes the selected policy before choosing the arrival order. We also prove that no randomized online algorithm can achieve a competitive ratio strictly larger than 3/4 in the uniform-length model.
